title: Towards Diverse and Comprehensive Benchmarks for Mutual Information Estimation
summary: Mutual information (MI) estimation is a central problem in machine learning and statistics; however, existing benchmarks typically evaluate estimators on simplified, low-dimensional distributions, leaving their performance on complex, realistic data largely unexplored. We address this gap with a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in a unified copula-theoretic perspective that subsumes existing benchmarks as special cases. Within this framework, we propose two complementary families of tests: a copula-first family that systematically varies ground-truth MI, dimensionality, and marginal complexity using synthetic and flow-based transformations; and a marginals-first family that couples real-world image data with controlled dependency structures, extending the classic same-class-pairing paradigm. We use this suite to extensively evaluate three classes of estimators: non-parametric, discriminative, and generative. Contrary to prevailing assumptions, our results indicate that there is no universal winner: each category can systematically outperform all other estimators under specific setups. By analyzing these cases, we identify fundamental estimation barriers and propose new tests that more effectively stress these specific limitations. We share the open source code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于统一Copula视角的互信息（MI）估计基准框架，包含copula-first与marginals-first两类互补测试族，系统评测非参数、判别式与生成式三类估计器，发现不存在普适最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MI估计器基准多局限于简化低维分布，对复杂真实数据上的表现缺乏评估；作者希望用统一理论框架覆盖并扩展既有基准，揭示各估计器的系统性失效边界。
AI.method: 以copula理论统一刻画MI分解（copula密度+边缘），构建两族测试：copula-first通过合成与流模型变换系统地调节真值MI、维度与边缘复杂度；marginals-first将真实图像数据与受控依赖结构耦合，扩展同类配对范式。在统一框架下评测非参数、判别式与生成式三类估计器，并针对发现的具体瓶颈设计新测试加以压力测试。
AI.result: 实验结果推翻"MINE型判别式估计器普遍更优"等常规假设：三类估计器各有能系统性超越其他的特定设置，不存在通用赢家；据此定位了若干根本性估计障碍，并提出更能暴露这些局限的新测试用例。
AI.conclusion: MI估计评测应基于可分解、可控制真实性的统一框架；选择估计器依赖数据维度、边缘复杂度与依赖结构，需按应用场景匹配而非追求单一最优方案。代码已开源。

title: Wavelet Phase Diffusion for Structurally and Semantically Consistent Sim-to-Real Translation
comment: Accepted by WACV 2027. 20 pages, 15 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference. Second, Low-Frequency Randomization (LFR) replaces the low-frequency packet, decoupling the model from the synthetic illumination prior and enabling in-distribution real-world appearance. Both components train on unpaired open-domain data, and introduce negligible inference overhead. The spatial locality further enables instance-level translation, where individual objects or regions are translated to photorealistic appearance independently while the surrounding scene remains untranslated. On vKITTI $\to$ KITTI image translation, $\psi$-PD outperforms prior methods in realism and semantic consistency while maintaining competitive structural alignment. For CARLA video translation, $\psi$-PD approaches the realism of paired-data methods while reducing VLM planner ADE and FDE by $5.4\%$ and $5.1\%$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出小波相位扩散(ψ-PD)，在双树复小波包变换域进行空间局部化的相位注入，并用低频随机化(LFR)解耦合成光照先验，实现免训练的仿真到真实外观翻译。
AI.motivation: 仿真到真实(sim-to-real)翻译需弥合外观差距同时保持结构与语义一致性。条件控制方法需昂贵控制模块；配对数据方法依赖复杂合成管线且易改变几何与语义；免训练编辑法缺乏学习到的外观先验，感知质量受限。已有的相位保持扩散在傅里叶域受全局频谱耦合限制，产生振铃与边界泄漏等空间伪影。
AI.method: 两大组件：(1) 在双树复小波包变换(DTCWPT)域操作，利用小波包的空间局部性实现空间自适应相位注入，避免全局频谱干扰；(2) 低频随机化(LFR)，替换低频小波包，使模型脱离合成光照先验并生成分布内真实世界外观。两组件均在非配对开放域数据上训练，推理开销可忽略；空间局部性还支持实例级翻译（单独翻译指定物体/区域而保留背景）。
AI.result: vKITTI→KITTI 图像翻译中，在真实感与语义一致性上超过先前方法，结构对齐保持竞争水平。CARLA 视频翻译中，真实感接近配对数据方法，同时将 VLM 规划器的 ADE 和 FDE 分别降低 5.4% 和 5.1%。
AI.conclusion: 小波包域的局部相位注入是解决傅里叶全局耦合伪影的有效途径，可在免配对数据、免推理开销条件下实现高保真、语义一致的 sim-to-real 外观翻译，并支持实例级可控编辑。

title: Where Planning Changes the Outcome of Orbital Games
summary: This paper introduces OrbitalGym, a simulation environment for studying when planning algorithms or system design determine the outcome of adversarial orbital encounters. In an orbital game, two non-cooperative teams of satellites maneuver during rendezvous and proximity operations to win a differential-reward objective. Advances in terrestrial game playing have prompted many methods for orbital games, but studies typically evaluate one method in one scenario, often against a passive or random defender. It is unclear whether better planning matters once vehicle capability (maneuverability, sensing, communications) and adversarial responses are considered. OrbitalGym is a JAX-based environment supporting varying numbers of agents, state representations (position, velocity, attitude, fuel), explicit or implicit communication, and proximity or conical field-of-view sensors. It compiles games to batched GPU code, enabling large-scale parallel simulation of policies across many configurations. This identifies regimes where policy choice affects outcomes and regimes where system capability dominates. We study two close-range games: pursuit-evasion, where one spacecraft tries to capture another, and lady-bandit-guard, where a guard prevents an attacker from reaching a protected asset. We compare PD, LQR, model predictive path integral control, and Monte Carlo tree search over ratios of thrust and propellant, initial separation, game duration, sensor capability, and the definition of capture. In pursuit-evasion the propellant ratio decides most encounters: against five of six evader policies, pursuer policy changes capture probability by 10 percent or more in at most 15 of 90 capability configurations. In lady-bandit-guard, policy matters more: against bandits able to reach the asset, a better guard policy raises defense probability by at least 10 percent in 56 to 74 of 90 configurations.

AI.tldr: OrbitalGym 是一个基于 JAX 的卫星近距离博弈仿真环境，支持多智能体、多状态表征与批量化 GPU 并行，用于辨析在对抗性轨道交会中"规划算法"与"系统能力"哪个决定胜负。
AI.motivation: 现有轨道博弈研究多为"单方法单场景"评估，常以被动或随机对手为基线，无法回答在机动能力、感知、通信等平台能力与对手响应共同作用下，更好的规划是否仍然重要。
AI.method: 构建可编译为 batched GPU 代码的 JAX 环境，覆盖可变智能体数、状态表征（位置、速度、姿态、燃料）、显式/隐式通信、近距离与锥形视场传感器；在两个近距博弈——追逃（pursuit-evasion）与 lady-bandit-guard——中对比 PD、LQR、MPPI 与 MCTS，并在推力/推进剂比、初始间距、博弈时长、传感能力、捕获定义等维度上扫描。
AI.result: 追逃博弈中推进剂比主导结果：对六种逃逸策略中的五种，追方策略仅在最多 15/90 的能力配置中使捕获概率变化≥10%。lady-bandit-guard 中策略更关键：对能抵达资产的入侵者，更优防守策略在 56–74/90 的配置中把防御成功率提升≥10%。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出"策略敏感区"与"能力主导区"的划分，表明对抗仿真须系统扫描能力参数而非单场景评测；OrbitalGym 为此类大规模并行消融提供可复用基础设施。

title: Towards Myocardial Infarction Diagnosis: An Investigation into Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms using ECG Data
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Based on the authors' undergraduate thesis at BRAC University (2023)
summary: Myocardial Infarction (MI) is a severe and potentially fatal cardiac condition caused by myocardial injury due to ischemia, and timely detection can substantially reduce its mortality. Electrocardiography (ECG) is the primary diagnostic modality for MI, but manual interpretation is susceptible to human error. In this work, we propose Visionary V2, a multi-step, adaptive filtration method for ECG signal normalization, and use it to study machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches to MI detection on the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database using all 15 available leads. On statistical features extracted from the filtered signals, such as the R-R interval, a Bagging ensemble of decision trees reaches 96.6% accuracy, compared with 87.7% when the signals are processed with BioSPPy. We further generate an image dataset from the filtered signals, on which a custom ResNet-50 misclassifies only 1 of 7,000 validation images and a custom CNN reaches an F1 score of about 98.7%. Finally, we apply LIME, Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients to verify that the image models attend to the ECG waveform rather than the background. These results indicate that careful signal normalization combined with ML and DL models can support fast and accurate automated MI screening.

AI.tldr: 提出 Visionary V2 自适应多步滤波方法用于 ECG 信号归一化，并在 PTB 数据库全部 15 导联上比较 ML/DL 心梗检测性能。
AI.motivation: ECG 是心梗主要诊断手段，但人工判读易出错；已有自动化方法对信号预处理与归一化不够重视，滤波质量直接影响后续分类器性能。
AI.method: 多步自适应滤波（Visionary V2）做 ECG 归一化；提取 R-R 间期等统计特征训练 Bagging 决策树集成；将滤波信号转为图像数据集，训练自定义 ResNet-50 与自定义 CNN；用 LIME、Grad-CAM、Integrated Gradients 做可解释性验证（关注波形而非背景）。
AI.result: 统计特征 + Bagging 达 96.6% 准确率（BioSPPy 预处理为 87.7%）；图像模型 ResNet-50 在 7000 张验证图像中仅 1 例误分类，CNN F1 约 98.7%；归因图显示模型聚焦 ECG 波形。
AI.conclusion: 精细的信号归一化结合 ML/DL 可支撑快速准确的自动化心梗筛查；但属医学信号领域 CV 应用，未涉及 Physical AI/VLA/3D 重建等核心方向，缺乏跨域方法洞见。

title: Sparse tensor networks for individual tree diameter estimation in mixed forests
summary: Measurements of tree diameter at breast height (DBH) are fundamental to forest inventories, but manual surveys across entire stands or regions are impractical. UAV-borne laser scanning (ULS) enables scalable automated forest surveys, yet canopy occlusion makes accurate DBH estimation from ULS point clouds non-trivial. Limited stem-level point density of ULS data constrains approaches relying on detailed stem reconstruction, such as Quantitative Structure Models (QSMs) and circle fitting. Empirical machine learning methods based on predefined point cloud metrics are an alternative. New deep learning approaches offer an even more principled solution, allowing models to learn directly from point clouds. Sparse tensor networks have shown particular promise, transforming forestry tasks such as tree species classification. We investigate whether these strengths can be extended to estimate individual tree DBH from ULS data across four mixed-species temperate forest plots in Germany. We further advance existing sparse tensor networks by introducing TreeNext, a lightweight deep learning architecture for direct individual tree parameter estimation from voxelized LiDAR point clouds. We present a fully automated forest inventory pipeline from individual tree instance segmentation to DBH regression, and quantify the impact of segmentation errors by comparing performance on automatically segmented and ground truth instances. TreeNext achieves an $R^2$ of 0.8355 on automatically segmented trees and 0.9380 on ground truth segments, outperforming strong tabular baselines including Random Forest and XGBoost. Segmentation quality emerges as the dominant error source in the automated pipeline. TreeNext proves highly data-efficient, performing well even in small data scenarios. Our findings establish sparse tensor networks as a practical foundation for automated individual tree DBH estimation from ULS.

AI.tldr: TreeNext：基于稀疏张量网络的轻量级深度学习架构，从无人机激光扫描（ULS）体素化点云直接回归单木胸径（DBH），并给出从单木实例分割到DBH回归的全自动森林清查流程。
AI.motivation: ULS 可实现规模化森林调查，但冠层遮挡导致树干点稀疏，QSMs 与圆拟合等依赖树干几何重建的方法受限，预定义点云指标+经验机器学习又依赖人工特征。作者希望验证稀疏张量网络（在树种分类上已显优势）能否推广到单木 DBH 估计。
AI.method: 在德国四块混交温带林样地采集 ULS 点云；将点云体素化后用稀疏张量网络直接回归单木 DBH；相较现有稀疏张量网络做轻量化改造提出 TreeNext；构建"实例分割→DBH 回归"全自动流水线，并在自动分割与真值分割实例上分别评估，以量化分割误差影响；与 Random Forest、XGBoost 等表格基线对比，并测试小样本数据效率。
AI.result: TreeNext 在自动分割树上 R²=0.8355，在真值分割上 R²=0.9380，优于 RF 与 XGBoost 等强基线；分割质量是自动流水线中的主导误差源；模型数据效率高，小样本场景仍表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏张量网络可作为 ULS 自动单木 DBH 估计的实用基础；端到端点云深度学习优于手工特征方法，但整体精度提升空间主要取决于单木分割质量。

title: DexSuite: An All-in-One Framework for Dexterous Manipulation Across Arms, Hands, and Tasks
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Human-level dexterity remains a central open problem in robotics, yet few simulation frameworks cover the full workflow of dexterous manipulation, from setting up a robot to collecting dexterous demonstrations and evaluating policies. We present DexSuite, an all-in-one simulation framework for dexterous manipulation built on the Genesis simulator. DexSuite provides 30 tasks and assembles its 10 arms and 12 end-effectors, from parallel-jaw grippers to dexterous hands, into more than 100 single-arm robots and thousands of bimanual pairs. It also ships a standardized environment API, integrated teleoperation, and simulated tactile sensing. Moreover, we define a benchmark of 16 task-embodiment pairs spanning diverse contact complexities and horizons, and release a dataset of 4,700 successful episodes in simulation from human teleoperation, scripted experts, and learned policies. We release DexSuite as open source and hope others will build on it. Videos and datasets are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DexSuite：基于Genesis仿真器的灵巧操作一体化仿真框架，含30任务、10臂×12末端执行器组合的100+单臂与数千双臂机器人、标准环境API、遥操作与仿真触觉，并发布16个任务-本体配对基准及4,700条成功episode数据集。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作仍是机器人学核心难题，而现有仿真框架很少覆盖"搭建机器人—采集灵巧演示—评估策略"的完整工作流，缺乏统一的基准与演示数据基础设施。
AI.method: 以Genesis仿真器为底座构建一体化框架：组装30个任务与10种机械臂、12种末端执行器（从平行夹爪到灵巧手）形成100+单臂机器人与数千双臂组合；提供标准化环境API、集成遥操作和仿真触觉传感；构建涵盖不同接触复杂度与时域的16个任务-本体配对基准。
AI.result: 发布开源框架、基准与4,700条仿真成功episode数据集（来源包括人类遥操作、脚本专家与学习策略）；摘要未报告具体策略性能数值或真机迁移结果。
AI.conclusion: DexSuite以"全流程+多本体+触觉"补齐灵巧操作仿真基础设施，但作为仿真/数据集/基准类工作，缺乏真机验证与算法层面的实质性方法贡献，短期优先级中等。

title: An Empirical Study of Wrist-Target Construction and Joint-Angle Limits in Humanoid Arm Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting maps a demonstrated human movement onto a robot to compute its joint motion. This study examines how the construction of the desired wrist position affects whether computed arm joint angles reach their permitted limits on a Unitree H1-2. A reconstructed target is formed from demonstrated arm directions and robot segment lengths, so its shoulder-to-wrist distance depends on the demonstrated angle between the segments even when no posture-matching preference is applied. A reach-normalized target retains that direction while rescaling the distance, using the same processed demonstrations and the same joint-angle method. Across a forward-reach sweep the reconstructed target places a joint angle at a bound in 10 of 20 repetitions and the reach-normalized target in none. Across 25 recordings from one participant the corresponding counts are 8 and 6 on the reaching arm and 14 and 5 on the supporting arm, and a second participant repeats the bricklaying and lifting comparison. In hardware replay a joint is commanded to a bound in 12 of 16 direction-matching arm-records and in none of the 16 normalized records, and within the eligible records both tracking error and executed torque at those frames exceed their values elsewhere in the same run. Cross-body reach and arm-to-arm clearance identify limits of radial adjustment. The findings support treating target construction and posture matching as separate retargeting decisions, and evaluating both alongside the wrist positions and clearance that manipulation requires.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析人形机器人运动重定向中"期望腕部位置构造方式"对关节角度是否触限的影响，比较重建式目标与按可达性归一化的目标。
AI.motivation: 重定向常把示教人体运动映射为机器人关节角，但目标腕部位置的构造方式与姿态匹配偏好混在一起，尚不清楚目标构造本身是否会导致关节角度贴限、进而引发跟踪误差与力矩饱和。
AI.method: 在Unitree H1-2上以相同示教数据、相同关节角求解方法，对比两种目标：(1)用示教臂段方向与机器人连杆长度重建的目标，其肩-腕距离随示教段间夹角变化；(2)保持方向不变、按可达性重缩放距离的归一化目标。通过前伸扫描、单人25段录制、第二被试重复搬砖/举升对比，以及16条硬件回放进行统计，并分析贴限帧的跟踪误差与执行力矩。
AI.result: 前伸扫描中重建目标20次有10次使某关节贴限，归一化目标0次；25段录制中伸手臂与支撑臂计数分别为8/6与14/5；硬件回放中贴限出现在16条方向匹配记录的12条、归一化记录的0条；且贴限帧的跟踪误差与执行力矩均高于同一运行其他帧。跨体中伸取与臂间间隙分析揭示了径向调整的局限。
AI.conclusion: 应将"目标构造"与"姿态匹配"视为两个独立的重新定向决策，并与操作所需的腕部位置和间隙一并评估。

title: TACOS: Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision for Visual Footstep Planning
summary: Humans navigate their environment based on their vision system, anticipating how the ground will respond before committing to a step. Self-supervised learning could provide legged robots the same ability, but the supervisory signal is typically chosen on intuition, and its effect on what the model learns is rarely examined. We present Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision (TACOS), which proposes a meaningful and consistent footstep instability score, based on the residual of a factor graph in legged state estimation. It projects the continuous score into preceding images to supervise a dense visual predictor. We propose two variants, a hard score that exploits hindsight and a causal soft score available immediately. Both metrics are compared against state-of-the-art alternatives in two independent evaluations that share no data or labels. On 1716 manually annotated contacts, both variants outperform every evaluated alternative at detecting instability and ranking its severity, improving pooled severity ranking by 28 % over the strongest baseline. On three outdoor test runs, our metric also trains the most accurate visual predictor, improving rank correlation by 58 % over the strongest alternative, and by a further 25 % when supplemented with onboard context. In a real-world experiment over a 50 m forest trajectory, the trained predictor handles non-geometric terrain properties such as mud and vegetation, while stepping around geometric obstacles like fallen branches. Code is available for reproducibility at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出TACOS，利用腿足机器人状态估计中因子图残差构造足步不稳定性度量，投影到前序图像上作为自监督信号训练稠密视觉预测器，实现地形属性（泥地、植被）与几何障碍的预判。
AI.motivation: 腿足机器人需要像人一样在迈步前预判地面响应，但自监督信号通常凭直觉选取，其对模型所学表征的影响鲜有检验。作者希望设计一个有物理意义、可复现且一致的足步不稳定度监督信号。
AI.method: 以腿足状态估计的因子图残差构造足步不稳定性得分，并将其投影到对应的前序图像中，监督稠密视觉预测器。提出两种变体：利用后见信息（hindsight）的硬分数，和可即时获得的因果软分数。并在两组互不共享数据与标签的独立评测中与SOTA替代指标对比。
AI.result: 在1716个手工标注触地点上，两种变体在检测不稳定性和排序严重程度上均优于所有对比方法，汇总严重度排序提升28%。在三段户外测试中训练出最准确的视觉预测器，秩相关比最强基线提升58%，加入机载上下文后进一步再提升25%。50米森林轨迹真实实验中，预测器可处理泥地与植被等非几何地形属性，同时绕开倒木等几何障碍。
AI.conclusion: 自监督信号的设计选择对腿足机器人视觉地形感知至关重要；基于状态估计残差的监督既有效又具备机载可用性，代码开源。

title: GOFish: Full Field-of-View Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Extraction
summary: Robots, autonomous vehicles, and consumer 360° cameras use fisheye lenses for wide fields of view (FoVs). Simulation-ready digital twins require photorealistic rendering across the full FoV and an aligned collision mesh. However, prior fisheye Gaussian Splatting methods only rasterize up to 180° and do not produce meshes, while Gaussian surface reconstruction methods assume pinhole training images. We present GOFish, the first 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method to train directly on fisheye images, rasterize FoVs beyond 180°, and extract an aligned mesh from the same scene. Calibrated densification recovers the surface across the entire FoV, while Calibrated Mip Filtering and Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling keep pixel blur and lens falloff out of the scene and mesh. Across the 200° FIORD and 205° FullCircle benchmarks, GOFish improves PSNR over the best prior method by 2.28 and 1.97 dB, respectively. It also outperforms fisheye rendering baselines within their own FoVs and achieves the highest mesh F-score on FIORD and the main ScanNet++ set. Together, the Gaussian scene and mesh form a LiDAR-free, simulation-ready digital twin that renders in real time, ray traces the full FoV, and provides collision geometry.

AI.tldr: GOFish 是首个直接在全鱼眼图像上训练、可光栅化超过 180° 视场并输出对齐网格的 3DGS 表面重建方法，面向无需 LiDAR 的仿真就绪数字孪生。
AI.motivation: 鱼眼镜头广泛用于机器人、自动驾驶与 360° 相机，但已有鱼眼 3DGS 只能渲染至 180° 且不产网格，而表面重建方法又假设针孔图像，导致无法构建全视场、带碰撞网格的仿真数字孪生。
AI.method: 在鱼眼投影模型下直接训练 3DGS：Calibrated Densification 按相机标定在全视场恢复表面；Calibrated Mip Filtering 与 Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling 分别抑制像素模糊与镜头衰减对场景/网格的污染。
AI.result: 在 200° FIORD 与 205° FullCircle 基准上，PSNR 分别较最优基线提升 2.28 dB 与 1.97 dB；在其视场内亦优于鱼眼渲染基线；在 FIORD 与 ScanNet++ 主集上取得最高网格 F-score。
AI.conclusion: 高斯场景与网格共同构成免 LiDAR、实时渲染、可全视场光线追踪并提供碰撞几何的仿真就绪数字孪生，可直接用于机器人与自动驾驶仿真管线。

title: Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network
summary: Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

AI.tldr: 面向异步事件传感器（事件相机、脉冲耳蜗），提出"时间介导的非交换（TM）模型"理论：证明输出对同刻事件处理顺序无关、对时间戳连续，当且仅当事件更新两两对易；给出分辨率鲁棒性界；构造最小TM层（Hassenstein-Reichardt相关器的可学习Lipschitz推广）与CFE层，证明三维TM状态可统一表示有序成对交互而单层加性层不能。
AI.motivation: 现有事件驱动学习系统通常把异步事件流切分为帧或数据包，导致输出依赖分片方式（分片敏感性），缺乏对时间戳连续性与同时事件顺序无关性的形式化保证，同时又要保留对时间顺序的敏感性。
AI.method: 形式化定义事件流的三条性质（顺序无关、时间戳连续、时间顺序敏感）；对任意非线性事件模型证明性质(i)(ii)等价于事件更新的两两对易，且对易后剩余顺序依赖来自其与事件间动力学的非交换并随滞后线性消失；据此定义TM模型类并推导任意模型的分辨率鲁棒性界；构造最小TM层（HR相关器的可学习推广）、TM-k高阶单层构造与保性质堆叠规则；实例化为线性复杂度CFE层，并给出点过程的免拓扑变体与预注册时钟鲁棒性协议。
AI.result: 理论：加性单层无法一致表示有序成对交互，三维TM状态可以；每个TM层相较加性层增加两级时间嵌套。实验（开发集）：TM状态较同构加性状态在DVS128 Gesture上提升3.5–9.1点，SHD上24.5点，Speech Commands上30.6点。
AI.conclusion: 以"非交换性作为时间表征来源"的统一理论框架替代分片式事件处理，为神经形态感知提供可证明鲁棒、可堆叠、计算线性的事件层，并为时间点过程的免时钟建模提供范式。

title: Convex Potential Learning for Optimal Transport Between Medical Images
summary: Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出通过参数化凸势函数来估计医学图像间的最优传输映射，构造上保证映射无旋（符合Brenier定理），在2D/3D医学影像数据集上取得更低传输误差和更高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像最优传输方法难以扩展到大规模3D影像，或依赖正则化公式只能得到近似传输映射，影响下游形态学分析精度。
AI.method: 直接参数化最优传输的凸势函数（Brenier 势），使得到的传输映射天然为某凸函数的梯度，从而保证无旋性；在2D与3D医学影像数据上评测。
AI.result: 实验显示传输估计误差低于现有方法，图像重建质量更高。
AI.conclusion: 凸势参数化为3D医学图像提供了精确且可扩展的最优传输估计方案，但摘要未给出具体网络结构、规模实验数值或代码链接。

title: Effects of Deep Learning Architecture and Pretraining on Automated Vocal Fold Segmentation in Ex Vivo High-Speed Phonation Images
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) intraglottal particle image velocimetry (PIV) of ex vivo phonation experiments quantifies vocal fold medial surface dynamics and the intraglottal flow field. However, it relies on manual segmentation because residual glare, low tissue-to-flow contrast, and tracer-particle speckle obscure the vocal fold boundaries. This study assessed how deep learning architecture and ImageNet pretraining affect automated vocal fold segmentation in these high-speed images. Four established architectures from three categories were benchmarked: the convolutional neural network (CNN)-based UNet and UNet++, the hybrid CNN-transformer-based TransUNet, and the pure transformer-based Swin-UNet, the latter two trained from scratch and from ImageNet-pretrained weights. Using 16,344 expert-annotated images from 227 phonation trials of excised canine larynges, the six pipelines were trained with five seeds under a standardized protocol and compared on 50 held-out test trials using trial-level Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction. Mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) spanned only 0.9734 to 0.9764, so the pipelines differed mainly in boundary fidelity. Pretraining significantly improved the boundary F1 score (BF1) and 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of the TransUNet and Swin-UNet, about four times more for the Swin-UNet. Once pretrained, the two performed similarly, although the Swin-UNet has only about a quarter of the trainable parameters. Without pretraining, the TransUNet had a significantly higher BF1 and a lower HD95 than both CNN-based pipelines and about half their share of images with HD95 > 50 pixels. To our knowledge, this is the first study to apply deep learning to vocal fold segmentation in 2D intraglottal PIV, and it offers a reference framework for segmenting experimental flow-visualization images with noisy optical conditions or highly deformable objects.

AI.tldr: 该文以深度学习对二维声门内PIV高速图像做声带分割，比较UNet、UNet++、TransUNet、Swin-UNet在ImageNet预训练与否下的六种流程；DSC差异极小(0.9734–0.9764)，主要差异体现在边界精度，预训练显著改善Transformer类模型的BF1与HD95。
AI.motivation: 声门内PIV可量化声带内侧表面动力学与流场，但残余眩光、组织—流动低对比度及示踪粒子散斑使声带边界难以自动提取，目前依赖人工分割。
AI.method: 使用16,344张专家标注图像(227次离体犬喉发声试验)，对CNN类(UNet、UNet++)、混合CNN-Transformer(TransUNet)、纯Transformer(Swin-UNet)四类架构、含/不含ImageNet预训练共六条流水线，统一协议下以5个随机种子训练，在50个留出测试试验上以试验级Wilcoxon符号秩检验(Holm校正)比较；指标为DSC、边界F1(BF1)、HD95、HD95>50像素图像占比及参数量。
AI.result: DSC仅0.9734–0.9764，差异集中在边界保真度；预训练显著提升TransUNet与Swin-UNet的BF1和HD95，Swin-UNet提升幅度约为其四倍，预训练后两者性能相近，而Swin-UNet可训练参数仅约四分之一；无预训练时TransUNet的BF1更高、HD95更低，HD95>50像素样本比例约为两种CNN流程的一半。
AI.conclusion: 首次将深度学习用于二维声门内PIV声带分割，为噪声光学条件下、高度可变形对象的实验流场可视化图像分割提供参考框架；预训练对Transformer类架构的边界质量尤为关键，小参数量的Swin-UNet在预训练后具性价比优势。

title: Echo: Scaling Visual Reinforcement Learning with Off-policy Experience
summary: Scaling visual reinforcement learning (RL) with GPU-accelerated simulation is computationally expensive due to rendering and visual-policy inference costs. Consequently, two-stage teacher--student distillation is commonly used to train visual policies, but introduces an imitation gap. In this preliminary study, we introduce \echomethod{}, \textbf{a single-stage off-policy RL framework that scales experience collection without proportionally increasing visual computation}. Through \textbf{inverse distillation}, a state-based auxiliary policy imitates the evolving visual policy and collects inexpensive, unrendered experience. Echo leverages this experience for off-policy value learning, directly improving the visual policy through a shared privileged critic. We instantiate \echomethod{} with FastTD3 and evaluate it on three visual control tasks and two dexterous manipulation tasks in Genesis. Relative to \sdpgmethod{} under the evaluated configurations, Echo reduces time to reference returns by an average of \textbf{60\% across the three locomotion tasks} and \textbf{56\% across both hand tasks}, while improving peak mean returns by \textbf{62\% and 12\%}, respectively. Both hand tasks also achieve higher mean returns at matched simulator-transition budgets. These initial results suggest that scaling off-policy experience is a promising approach to efficient direct visual RL.

AI.tldr: 提出 Echo：单阶段 off-policy 视觉强化学习框架，通过"逆蒸馏"让基于状态的辅助策略模仿不断演化的视觉策略并采集廉价无渲染经验，再由共享特权评论家直接改进视觉策略，从而在不按比例增加视觉计算的前提下扩展经验收集。
AI.motivation: GPU 仿真中视觉 RL 的渲染与视觉策略推理成本极高，常用两阶段 teacher-student 蒸馏虽降低成本却引入模仿间隙（imitation gap）。作者希望以单阶段方式在扩展经验量的同时避免该间隙。
AI.method: 核心为 inverse distillation：状态辅助策略模仿当前视觉策略（方向与常规蒸馏相反），在无渲染环境中批量采样；采得经验用于 off-policy 价值学习，视觉策略与状态策略共享一个使用特权信息的 critic，从而使视觉策略直接从廉价经验中获益。实例化为 Echo + FastTD3，在 Genesis 仿真器上测试三个视觉控制任务与两个灵巧手任务，与 SDPG 基线对比。
AI.result: 相对 SDPG：三个 locomotion 任务达到参考回报的时间平均减少 60%，两个手部任务减少 56%；峰值平均回报分别提升 62% 与 12%；两个手部任务在相同仿真转移预算下平均回报更高。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果表明，扩展 off-policy 经验是高效直接视觉 RL 的有前景方向；逆蒸馏可将状态信息优势转化为视觉策略改进，规避两阶段蒸馏差距。作者定位为 preliminary study，任务与配置范围仍有限。

title: What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine
summary: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.

AI.tldr: 论文以扩展Khana印度菜数据集和七种预训练视觉表征（CNN、Transformer、自监督、图文对齐）为对象，研究食物相似性在身份之外的检索邻域结构、跨表征一致性与图像级/菜品级差异，并与食谱相似性对比。
AI.motivation: 食物表征通常只用身份保持（识别/分类）指标评估，但检索、推荐、替换等食物计算任务真正依赖的是"相似性关系结构"。作者希望检验不同视觉表征如何组织食物的关系邻域、揭示或遮蔽哪些烹饪关系，以及这些结构跨表征是否稳定。
AI.method: 构建扩展版Khana数据集；选取7个预训练视觉表征（卷积、Transformer、自监督、图文对齐四类）；做图像到图像检索与图像到菜品邻域分析，考察烹饪家族结构、对比案例和跨表征一致性；将图像表征聚合到菜品级，比较跨模型的菜品级视觉相似性，并与同一菜品的食谱派生相似性对照。
AI.result: 图像级邻域在不同表征间差异显著，甚至出现跨烹饪家族边界的相似性；菜品级聚合后仍呈现共同的视觉结构（尽管局部存在变异），但该结构与食谱派生相似性对应较弱。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠识别性能无法刻画关系结构；食物相似性取决于表征、模态与抽象层级，而非食物集合的固定属性。理解这些结构是把多模态食物信息融合成统一相似性概念的前提。

title: PairCLIP-SWA: Similarity-Guided Balancing and Stochastic Weight Averaging for Generalized Deepfake Image Detection with OpenCLIP
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 12 tables. Code and experiment outputs: this https URL
summary: Deepfake detectors are almost always deployed as the single checkpoint that scored best on a validation split, yet the reliability of that choice is rarely measured. We measure it with PairCLIP-SWA, a single-backbone detector that adapts an OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 visual tower by progressive block unfreezing on a class-balanced corpus built by CLIP-similarity-guided one-to-one subsampling, and averages the fine-tuning trajectory in weight space. Trained in-domain on the IEEE SP Cup 2025 (DF-Wild-Cup) benchmark under the same protocol as the strongest published three-backbone ensemble, the weight-averaged detector reaches 97.04% accuracy, 98.64% AU-ROC and a 4.07% equal error rate, against 94.46%, 97.60% and 5.00%. Its training log shows why averaging matters: over the averaged epochs the non-averaged checkpoint swings across 5.34 points of validation accuracy while its validation loss more than doubles, whereas the average is never worse and is up to 5.99 points better. On an OpenForensics-derived benchmark the same instability becomes a misranking: the checkpoint that validation accuracy selects (98.43%) scores 88.85% on a disjoint 10,905-image test partition, rejecting 21.1% of genuine photographs, while the terminal average, ranked last on validation, scores 94.76%. A study of twenty-two in-house configurations on the identical DF-Wild-Cup split, including preprocessing ablations, shows that CLIP pre-training rather than ensembling drives accuracy, that secondary face cropping costs about 34 points, and that frequency-domain inputs transfer poorly. We recommend per-class selection criteria measured off the early-stopping split.

AI.tldr: 单骨干OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 deepfake检测器，通过渐进式解冻与权重空间轨迹平均（SWA），仅用单检查点即在DF-Wild-Cup上与最强三骨干集成相当或更优，并揭示验证集选模的不可靠性。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造检测器普遍只用验证集最优的单一检查点部署，但这一选择本身的可靠性从未被量化；且验证精度选模可能导致严重的伪/真图错分与模型误排序。
AI.method: PairCLIP-SWA：以OpenCLIP ViT-L/14视觉塔为唯一骨干，渐进式block解冻微调；类平衡语料由CLIP相似度引导的一对一子采样构建；对微调轨迹在权重空间做平均（SWA）。在DF-Wild-Cup同协议下与三骨干集成对比，并在OpenForensics派生基准上检验选模行为；另做22组内部配置的预处理消融。
AI.result: DF-Wild-Cup：97.04% acc / 98.64% AU-ROC / 4.07% EER，对比94.46% / 97.60% / 5.00%。非平均检查点在平均区间内验证精度波动达5.34点、验证损失翻倍以上，而平均权重从不更差、最多高出5.99点。OpenForensics派生测试集（10,905张）：验证精度最优检查点实测88.85%（误拒21.1%真实照片），验证排名末位的终点平均为94.76%。消融显示CLIP预训练（而非集成）是精度主要来源，二次人脸裁剪损失约34点，频域输入迁移差。
AI.conclusion: 单骨干+权重轨迹平均可替代多骨干集成，且稳定性显著更好；验证集最优选模存在系统性偏差，建议采用按类别（分真实/伪造）的选模准则并基于早停划分评估。

title: Intersectional Invariant Learning for Fair Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detection models achieve high overall accuracy but exhibit large performance disparities across demographic groups, causing some groups to experience substantially higher false-positive rates than others. Existing fairness-aware methods address this by constraining model outputs to equalize group predictions, but do not tackle the underlying feature-level bias. As a result, models may still rely on demographic characteristics, such as skin texture, as indirect cues for detecting manipulated content. To address this problem, we propose Intersectional Invariant Learning (IIL), a framework that improves feature learning rather than only adjusting model outputs. IIL alternates between identifying the most challenging demographic partitions and learning features that remain consistent across those partitions. The framework also includes a false-positive-rate fairness objective and group-balanced sampling across six gender x skin-tone intersectional groups. We evaluate IIL on a large-scale fairness benchmark containing over one million images, 10 baseline detectors, and 21 fairness and utility metrics. Results show that IIL achieves Pareto-optimal performance, simultaneously attaining an AUC above 99%, a false-positive rate under 2.5%, and the lowest intersectional fairness disparity (FMEO) among all compared methods. IIL outperforms prior fairness-aware methods on the large majority of the 21 evaluation metrics, while reducing both false-positive rates and intersectional fairness disparities by several-fold compared with the strongest competing method.

AI.tldr: 提出 Intersectional Invariant Learning (IIL)，通过交替识别最困难的人口统计划分并学习跨划分一致的特征，结合假阳性率公平目标与六组性别×肤色平衡采样，实现 Deepfake 检测的特征级公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有 Deepfake 检测模型总体准确率高，但不同人口群体假阳性率差异显著。已有公平性方法仅在输出层约束并均衡组间预测，未解决特征级偏差，模型仍可能依赖肤色纹理等人口特征作为间接线索。
AI.method: IIL 框架在训练中交替进行：(1) 识别最具挑战性的人口统计划分；(2) 学习在这些划分间保持一致的不变特征。损失中引入假阳性率公平目标，并对 6 个性别×肤色交叉组进行组平衡采样。
AI.result: 在含 100 万+ 图像、10 个基线检测器、21 项公平性与效用指标的基准上评估：IIL 达到帕累托最优，AUC>99%、FPR<2.5%、交叉公平差异 FMEO 最低；在多数指标上优于先前公平性方法，FPR 与交叉组公平差异较最强基线降低数倍。
AI.conclusion: 特征级不变学习比单纯输出层公平约束更有效，可同时维持高检测效用与低交叉组公平差异，为公平 Deepfake 检测提供可操作范式。

title: FYC: FPR-Disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration for Fair Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detectors routinely achieve high aggregate accuracy while exhibiting substantial demographic disparities in their errors: false-positive rates differ by double digits across gender and skin tone. Most existing remedies require either full retraining with a fairness-aware objective or demographic-annotated training data, both impractical when only a pretrained checkpoint is available, while label-free post-hoc calibrators leave the detector's weights unchanged. We introduce FYC (FPR-disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration), a two-stage post-hoc method that perturbs a detector's weights under an FPR-disparity criterion, then calibrates a separate decision threshold for each demographic group - requiring no architectural changes and no full retraining. Evaluated against every detector benchmarked on AI-Face v2 across six intersectional gender x skin-tone groups, FYC outperforms the field on 18 of 21 reported fairness and utility metrics, including purpose-built fairness architectures, at a fraction of the training cost. We further identify why the choice of fairness criterion is critical: the original Demographic Parity objective used in prior weight-perturbation work is architecture-dependent and unpredictable, improving two of four evaluated architectures, leaving a third largely unchanged, and substantially degrading the fourth (PG-FDD), with no way to anticipate the outcome for a given checkpoint in advance. Conditioning the same objective on real images only - our FPR-disparity criterion - eliminates this unpredictability, improving fairness and accuracy jointly across all four architectures with no exceptions.

AI.tldr: FYC：两阶段后处理方法，先在FPR差异准则下做权重扰动，再为各人口统计组分别校准决策阈值，无需重训练或人群标注，即提升deepfake检测器的公平性与效用。
AI.motivation: Deepfake检测器总体准确率高，但跨性别与肤色的假阳性率差异达两位数；现有补救方案需带公平目标的全量重训或人群标注数据，在实际仅有预训练权重时不现实；无标签事后校准器又不改变检测器权重。
AI.method: 两阶段事后方法：(1) 在FPR差异（仅在真实图像上条件化人口统计均衡）准则下对检测器权重施加扰动；(2) 为每个人口统计组分别校准决策阈值（Youden校准）。无需架构改动、无需全量重训。在AI-Face v2上按6个性别×肤色交叉组、对全部已评测检测器进行对比。
AI.result: 在21项公平性与效用指标中的18项上优于领域内方法（含专门设计的公平架构），训练成本仅为其一小部分。进一步发现：先前权重扰动工作使用的Demographic Parity目标具架构依赖性——4个架构中2个改善、1个几乎不变、PG-FDD显著退化，且无法事前预判；改为仅条件化于真实图像的FPR差异准则后，4个架构均同时改善公平性与准确率，无例外。
AI.conclusion: 公平准则的选择本身决定权重扰动成败；FPR差异准则可去除架构不确定性，是低成本、可即插即用的事后公平校正方案，适用于仅有checkpoint的部署场景。

title: When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models
summary: On PushT, our fixed action updater (1,505 parameters) solves 8 of 16 scenes reserved from our configuration selection. The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before evaluation. We also conduct another matched experiment where we only replay the first ten commands in each context and then allow the next solve 4, 8 or 12 updates (subsequent solves all get 8 updates). Among all 16 contexts (8 scene clusters), the 3 budgets get 9, 8 and 7 successes, respectively. Interestingly, the extra updates did not rescue any failing task in this experiment. All the changes in success/failure happen in one scene cluster, where we observe that the extra updates decrease the costs of the selected latent world-model trajectories for our updater, while the tasks that used to be successes become failures. The code, weights, evaluators, execution traces and cost accounting accompany the paper.

AI.tldr: 该摘要报告了一个仅含1,505参数的固定动作更新器在PushT任务上的评测结果：16个场景中解决8个，与Adam(7)、iCEM(2)、官方LePlanner(16)相比处于中间水平，但未满足预设的任务代价准则；额外更新预算(4/8/12)未能挽救任何失败任务，成功/失败变化集中在同一场景簇。
AI.motivation: 比较极轻量、固定参数的动作更新器与现有规划器(Adam、iCEM、LePlanner)在PushT上的求解成功率与规划/编码开销，并检验"更多迭代更新预算是否能提升成功率"这一直觉假设。
AI.method: 在PushT的16个预留场景(8个场景簇)上评测一个1,505参数的固定动作更新器，并与选定Adam、适配iCEM、官方发布的LePlanner对比；另设匹配实验：仅重放每段上下文前10条指令，再给予4/8/12次更新预算，统计成功数与代价变化，记录规划与编码时间及潜在世界模型轨迹代价。
AI.result: 固定更新器解决8/16(P&E时间59.079s)，Adam 7/16(218.440s)、iCEM 2/16(49.309s)、LePlanner 16/16(5.652s)；更新器未满足预设任务代价准则。额外更新实验的成功数为9/8/7，额外更新未挽救任何失败任务，成功与失败的变化均集中于一个场景簇——额外更新降低了选中潜在世界模型轨迹的代价，却使原成功任务转为失败。
AI.conclusion: 极轻量动作更新器能达到与Adam相当的成功率但代价准则未达标，且明显落后于官方LePlanner；"更多更新=更好"不成立，代价下降与任务成功并不同向，提示世界模型代价指标与真实任务成功率之间存在错配。

title: What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for $π_{0.5}$ on BEHAVIOR-1K
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文在BEHAVIOR挑战赛全部100个任务上系统配对评估先前提出的VLA推理与数据采集策略，发现这些策略并不能统一迁移到新环境与任务。
AI.motivation: 已有VLA推理与数据采集策略多在小规模设定下验证，其在规模化、多样化任务套件上是否仍有效尚不清楚，需要系统性配对评估。
AI.method: 基于2025 BEHAVIOR挑战赛冠军方案微调的π0.5模型（公开测试集Q-score 0.39），在全部100个任务上对多种推理策略与数据采集策略进行配对对照评估。
AI.result: 所评估的策略在不同环境与任务间表现不一致，无法均匀迁移；存在明显的任务/环境依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 小规模设定的经验不能直接外推到大规模VLA任务套件，需针对新环境与任务重新审视推理与数据策略选择。

title: Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage
summary: Real-world forgery is inherently heterogeneous: it manifests not only as digital manipulation but also as physical spoofing, and is carried not only by images but also by videos. Despite substantial progress, a unified anti-forgery foundation model covering such a broad threat spectrum remains absent. In this paper, we present Venus-DefakerOne2, which substantially extends the forensic capability boundary along both the forgery-form and media-type dimensions. Trained on tens of millions of open-source and in-house samples, it incorporates two key designs. Tide-Style-Tuning alternates LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning to balance computational efficiency, generalization, and hard-sample fitting while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Entropy-based Test Adaptation determines the optimal prediction modality by analyzing prediction entropy. Venus-DefakerOne2 achieves new state-of-the-art performance across a comprehensive suite of benchmarks, including DeepFake faces (96.7%), AI-generated images (93.3%), tampered documents (87.6%), manipulated natural images (89.6%), physical spoofs (93.1%), and AI-generated videos (96.0%). It significantly outperforms both specialized expert models and its predecessor, DefakerOne, establishing itself as a powerful and versatile foundation model for binary-decision forensic tasks.

AI.tldr: Venus-DefakerOne2 是统一的取证基础模型，同时覆盖数字篡改与物理欺骗、图像与视频两类伪造形态，采用 Tide-Style-Tuning 与基于熵的测试自适应。
AI.motivation: 真实场景伪造呈现异质性：既有数字操纵也有物理欺骗，载体既含图像也含视频；现有工作缺少覆盖如此宽威胁谱的统一反伪造基础模型。
AI.method: 在数千万开源与自研样本上训练；Tide-Style-Tuning 交替使用 LoRA 与全参数微调，以兼顾算力效率、泛化性与难样本拟合，并缓解灾难性遗忘；熵驱动的测试自适应通过分析预测熵选择最优预测模态。
AI.result: 在 DeepFake 人脸 96.7%、AI 生成图像 93.3%、篡改文档 87.6%、自然图像操纵 89.6%、物理欺骗 93.1%、AI 生成视频 96.0% 等基准上达到 SOTA，显著优于专用专家模型与前代 DefakerOne。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将取证基础模型的能力边界沿伪造形态与媒体类型两个维度同时扩展，可作为二分类取证任务的通用强力基础模型。

title: 3D Occupancy-Language Fields from mmWave Radar
summary: Radar systems can recover scene geometry and recognize predefined categories, but these outputs do not provide a persistent spatial representation for open-ended language queries. Such queries require linking observations from different viewpoints to the same physical locations. We present TextRadar, a framework that constructs a scene-level 3D occupancy-language field from panoramic radar observations. The field combines occupancy with scale-dependent language features at surface locations, allowing the reconstructed scene to be queried with new descriptions. A single-frame radar distillation model predicts aligned ranges and language features from each radar observation. Using radar-estimated poses, we register these predictions to reconstruct the field from radar alone in a new scene. Experiments on approximately 20k synchronized observations across seven buildings demonstrate scene-level natural-language querying and prompt-free semantic visualization. Analysis of camera-to-radar concept transferability shows stronger agreement for structures, materials, and human poses than for colors and printed text.

AI.tldr: TextRadar从全景雷达观测构建场景级3D占据-语言场，支持开放式自然语言查询，仅用雷达与新位姿即可重建新场景。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达系统虽能恢复几何与识别预定义类别，却缺乏支撑开放式语言查询的持久空间表征；此类查询需要将不同视角的观测关联到同一物理位置。
AI.method: 提出TextRadar框架：在表面位置联合占据与尺度相关语言特征，构建场景级3D占据-语言场；用单帧雷达蒸馏模型从每次雷达观测预测对齐的深度距离与语言特征，再借助雷达估计位姿配准，仅靠雷达在新场景中重建该场。
AI.result: 在7栋建筑约2万条同步观测上实现场景级自然语言查询与无提示语义可视化；相机到雷达的概念迁移分析显示，结构、材质与人体姿态的一致性优于颜色与印刷文字。
AI.conclusion: 雷达单独即可支撑开放词汇的空间语义场重建与查询，但跨模态语义迁移在细粒度外观属性上仍受限，适用于结构/材质层面的机器人感知与导航任务。

title: You Don't Need Aligned Representations: Knowledge Distillation via Random Prototype Spaces
comment: To appear at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text plus appendices. Code: this https URL
summary: A widely held assumption in knowledge distillation is that teacher and student representations must occupy a compatible or explicitly aligned feature space. We propose RPKD (Random Prototype Knowledge Distillation), which discards this assumption by comparing both networks against a shared bank of randomly initialized, frozen prototype vectors. Alignment is therefore carried out in an external reference space rather than in the teacher's native feature coordinates: the teacher side is projected by fixed random maps that carry no trainable parameters, and only the student adapts. Two branches handle the transfer: a logit branch aligning global prototype similarity distributions and a feature branch matching spatially-resolved prototype activation maps. Both operate within the same fixed prototype space, which can be interpreted as a random feature embedding that approximately preserves inter-sample similarity structure, so the prototype bank and the distillation objective stay unchanged across teacher-student pairs while only the input projections are instantiated per architecture. In low-category settings, decoupling the prototype vocabulary from the task label space yields richer supervision than the label space alone, an advantage absent from logit-based methods, whose supervisory signal collapses as class count shrinks. This advantage is especially relevant in real-world scenarios where the label space is typically constrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RPKD, achieving a maximum gain of +7.98% over OFA on CIFAR-100, +12.44% on ImageNet-100, and +1.28% on ImageNet-1K. Source code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: RPKD 丢弃"教师与学生特征空间必须对齐"的假设，将师生两侧都投影到一组随机初始化、冻结的原型向量所张成的外部参考空间中进行知识蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏普遍假定师生表征需落在兼容或显式对齐的特征空间，导致跨架构迁移受教师原生特征坐标限制；同时基于 logit 的方法在类别数很少时监督信号会坍塌。
AI.method: 构建共享的随机初始化冻结原型 bank；教师侧用无参数的固定随机映射投影，仅学生可训练。双分支蒸馏：logit 分支对齐全局原型相似度分布，feature 分支匹配空间分辨的原型激活图；原型 bank 与目标函数跨师生对保持不变，仅输入投影按架构实例化，可视为近似保持样本间相似度结构的随机特征嵌入。
AI.result: CIFAR-100 上相对 OFA 最高提升 +7.98%，ImageNet-100 +12.44%，ImageNet-1K +1.28%。
AI.conclusion: 将原型词表与任务标签空间解耦，可在低类别数场景提供比标签空间更丰富的监督，弥补 logit 蒸馏信号随类别减少而收缩的缺陷；该方法框架通用、可复用原型 bank，适用于标签空间受限的实际场景。

title: Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. English-language author version of a paper presented at GraphiCon 2026, Saint Petersburg, Russia, 22-24 September 2026. Russian-language proceedings forthcoming. Related work updated for this version
summary: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.

AI.tldr: 该工作用元学习式初始化（Reptile）与坐标网络共享分量迁移（STRAINER）来加速 KAN-IDIR 变形医学图像配准的测试时适应，比较早迭代阶段配准质量与预训练成本。
AI.motivation: 隐式神经表示（INR）配准需对每对新图像重新优化网络参数，适应速度慢是实际瓶颈；作者希望用历史已解配准任务学到的初始化缩短早期适应时间。
AI.method: 以 KAN-IDIR 作为基础 INR 位移场模型；对比随机初始化、Reptile 元初始化与 STRAINER 共享分量迁移两种方案；在 OASIS-1 上以 364 对连续图像训练、49 对做测试时适应；指标为均值 Dice、HD95 及第 1500 次迭代时负雅可比行列式体素比例。
AI.result: 在所研究配置下，两种方案在早期迭代均比随机初始化获得更高 Dice 与更低 HD95；小迭代预算下 Reptile 数值上优于 STRAINER（但二者预训练预算未对齐）；随迭代增加方案差异缩小；STRAINER 预训练耗时 39–40 分钟，Reptile 为 44.98 小时。
AI.conclusion: 基于历史任务学习的初始化可加速 INR 配准的早期适应，但加速收益随迭代增加而消失，且存在预训练成本与公平比较的问题；该问题设置偏医学影像域，结论对通用 INR 加速的推广价值有限。

title: FORGE: Feasible Online Reduced-Order Reference Generation and Whole-Body Execution for Agile Humanoid Locomotion
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE-RAS 25th International Conference on Humanoid Robots (Humanoids)
summary: This paper presents a two-stage learning framework for versatile and agile humanoid locomotion that couples online reduced-order model (ROM) reference generation with whole-body tracking control. In the first stage, we train a command-conditioned whole-body reference generator using single rigid body dynamics combined with full humanoid kinematics. In the second stage, the frozen ROM policy is rolled out online to generate references for training a whole-body tracking policy on the full-order dynamics model. Learning a kino-dynamically consistent reference generator in the simplified ROM space enables us to generate references over a broad command space and over multiple locomotion strategies using a single unified framework. We demonstrate the approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, achieving longitudinal velocities from -2.0 m/s to 2.8 m/s, lateral velocities up to +-1.0 m/s, angular velocities up to +-3.0 rad/s, one-legged hopping, and continuous transitions across the commands, all using one unified reference policy and one whole-body tracking policy.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段分层学习框架：先用单刚体动力学+全人形运动学训练命令条件化的降阶模型(ROM)全身参考生成器，再在线rollout冻结的ROM策略为全阶动力学全身跟踪策略生成参考，在Unitree G1上实现宽范围命令的通用敏捷运动。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人需要在一个统一框架下兼顾宽命令空间与多种运动策略（行走、奔跑、跳跃、侧移），直接在简化模型空间学习运动学-动力学一致的参考可以降低全阶跟踪的学习难度，并避免为每种步态单独设计参考。
AI.method: 两阶段：Stage 1 在简化降阶模型空间中，用单刚体动力学配合完整人形运动学训练命令条件化的全身参考生成器；Stage 2 冻结该ROM策略并在线rollout产生参考，用其训练全阶动力学上的全身跟踪策略（teacher-student式参考跟随）。单一框架覆盖多种步态。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1真机上实现纵向速度-2.0至2.8 m/s、横向±1.0 m/s、角速度±3.0 rad/s、单腿hop及命令间连续切换，全部由单一参考策略+单一时跟踪策略完成。
AI.conclusion: 在简化ROM空间中学习运动学-动力学一致的参考生成器，可在单一统一策略下获得宽命令范围与多步态能力，为敏捷人形全身控制提供了可扩展的分层范式；真机结果验证了在线参考生成+整身跟踪的有效性。

title: Active Constraints for Simultaneous Guidance and Safety in Handheld Micromanipulation
summary: In micromanipulation, erroneous hand motion limits unaided manipulation accuracy, which can affect task performance and safety in critical applications like microsurgery. Handheld robots (micromanipulators) enable motion accuracy beyond human limits by providing robotic assistance in a low-cost, compact, intuitive form factor. Particularly, active constraints are an effective form of robotic assistance, which aids the operator by restricting the robot's permissible motion based on task-specific requirements or objectives, thereby providing task guidance and enforcing safety. However, existing formulations of active constraints for handheld systems are limited, most notably because of the inability to provide guidance and enforce safety simultaneously. Implementing active constraints with optimization-based methods can address these limitations, but existing implementations are designed for free-standing robots, and neglect that handheld robots actuate relative to the operator's hand with a limited workspace. In this work, we propose an optimization-based active constraint framework for handheld micromanipulation that enables simultaneous guidance and safety enforcement. The formulation was implemented in a handheld robot and demonstrated on a medically relevant artificial task. Results show that the proposed formulation reduced safety violation rate by more than two orders of magnitude relative to baselines, while recovering the threefold accuracy loss from enforcing safety alone.

AI.tldr: 提出面向手持式微操作机器人的优化型主动约束框架，同时实现任务引导与安全约束，并在医疗相关人工任务中验证，安全违规率较基线降低两个数量级以上，同时挽回单纯执行安全约束带来的三倍精度损失。
AI.motivation: 手持机器人可在低成本、紧凑、直观的形态下突破人手操作精度极限；现有手持系统的主动约束形式无法同时提供引导与安全保障，而基于优化的实现又多针对自由站立式机器人，忽略手持机器人相对操作者手部驱动、工作空间受限的特性。
AI.method: 构建基于优化的主动约束统一框架，将任务引导目标与安全约束联合求解；在建模中考虑机器人相对操作者手部的相对运动与有限工作空间，并部署于手持机器人原型上进行医疗相关人工任务实验。
AI.result: 安全违规率相比基线降低两个数量级以上；仅施加安全约束会带来约3倍精度损失，而所提框架可将该精度损失完全恢复。
AI.conclusion: 统一优化型主动约束可兼顾引导与安全，适用于手持微操作；但验证限于单一人造医疗任务与单平台，泛化性与多任务适用性有待进一步验证。

title: Hierarchical Diffusion for Camera-controlled Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: We address the task of long-video, camera-controlled generation from a single image. The dominant autoregressive paradigm suffers from two key limitations: (1) error accumulation over time, as distant frames are conditioned on previously generated outputs rather than ground truth, leading to drift; and (2) ambiguity in how to incorporate camera control. Standard solutions to both--such as self-forcing and conditioning on explicit 6-DOF poses--either incur significant computational overhead or produce drifting scene geometries over time. We propose a simple and lightweight framework that combines autoregressive generation (WanAR) with hierarchical long-context denoising (FixAR). To enforce scene geometry remains consistent with input cameras, we draw from feed-forward novel-view synthesis and reformulate video generation as a warping-and-inpainting problem. To mitigate drift, we introduce a hierarchical denoising strategy in which different stages condition on different temporal histories. Specifically, we first generate frames conditioned on the immediate past, and then refine them using a second denoiser conditioned on a temporally subsampled long-range history to enforce global consistency. This fine-to-coarse scheme enables each generated frame to effectively condition on the full temporal context without incurring a prohibitive cost. Experiments on RealEstate10k and DL3DV demonstrate that WanAR+FixAR outperforms prior methods for camera-controlled long-video generation, producing results that are both temporally stable and consistent with input camera trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出WanAR（自回归）+FixAR（分层长上下文去噪）框架，将相机可控长视频生成重构为warping+inpainting问题，用细到粗两级去噪分别以短期与长程历史为条件，实现无漂移的全局一致长视频生成。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成存在两大缺陷：(1)误差累积导致时间漂移，远帧以生成结果为条件而非真值；(2)相机控制注入方式含混，自强制(self-forcing)开销大，显式6-DOF位姿条件导致几何漂移。
AI.method: 借鉴前馈新视角合成，将生成表述为warpping-and-inpainting；采用两级层次化去噪：第一级基于紧邻历史生成帧，第二级去噪器以时间下采样后的长程历史为条件进行精修，以低成本近似全时域上下文。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10k与DL3DV上优于既有相机可控长视频生成方法，时间稳定性好且与输入相机轨迹一致。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级"细到粗"分层条件方案可在不显著增加计算的前提下缓解长视频漂移并保证相机几何一致性，是可插拔的自回归生成增强模块。

title: Self-Labeled Preference Transfer for Steerable Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can learn to follow execution preferences, such as where to grasp an object or how to move around an obstacle, from demonstrations annotated with preference labels. Providing these annotations for every new task, however, is costly. We study whether learned preference control can transfer to new tasks whose demonstrations contain the desired behaviors but lack preference annotations. We find that a policy trained with preference annotations can follow preferences on a new task before adaptation but achieves limited task success. Fine-tuning on target demonstrations without these annotations improves task success while weakening preference control. Motivated by this finding, we introduce Self-Labeled Preference Transfer (SPT). SPT jointly trains a shared vision-language backbone for preference-conditioned action prediction and preference recognition on annotated source demonstrations. It then freezes the recognizer to preserve its cross-task preference recognition capability and uses it to self-label target demonstrations for policy fine-tuning. Across five types of execution preferences in simulation, the recognizer achieves 96.4% accuracy, and SPT reaches 84.8% preference following and 89.2% task success, compared with 59.4% and 88.0% for naive finetuning. We further extend to multiple preferences, achieving 93.8% preference following compared with 42.5% of baselines. In real-world experiments, SPT increases preference following from 52.5% to 92.5% relative to naive finetuning across two task transfers. These results show that SPT can support preference adaptation across tasks and objects while maintaining success, without additional manual preference annotations.

AI.tldr: SPT（Self-Labeled Preference Transfer）研究如何把已有的偏好控制能力迁移到缺乏偏好标注的新任务：先在带标注源数据上联合训练偏好条件动作预测与偏好识别共享VLM骨干，冻结识别器以自标注目标演示，再微调策略。
AI.motivation: VLA策略可从带偏好标签的演示中学习执行偏好（抓取位置、绕障方式等），但为新任务逐条标注偏好代价高昂，需要无标注偏好迁移的方法。
AI.method: 关键观察：带偏好标注训练的策略在新任务上未适配即可遵循偏好但任务成功率低；直接在无标注目标演示上微调会提升成功率却削弱偏好控制。据此提出SPT：共享视觉-语言骨干联合训练偏好条件动作预测与偏好识别；随后冻结识别器以保留跨任务偏好识别能力，并用其为目标演示生成偏好伪标签用于策略微调。
AI.result: 仿真中五类执行偏好下识别器准确率96.4%，SPT达84.8%偏好遵循率与89.2%成功率（朴素微调为59.4%/88.0%）；多偏好设定下93.8% vs 42.5%；真实实验两个任务迁移中偏好遵循由52.5%提升至92.5%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结识别器自标注可实现跨任务、跨物体的偏好迁移，无需额外人工偏好标注且不牺牲成功率。

title: Frequency-Adaptive Gaussian Grids for Efficient Image Representation
summary: Neural representation has emerged as a powerful tool to mitigate the demand for increasingly higher-resolution images. However, a fundamental trade-off remains between structured (e.g., feature grids, which offer spatial consistency) and unstructured (e.g., 2D Gaussians, which adaptively capture local variances) representations. This choice significantly affects how well an algorithm represents an image. Here, we present Gaussian-Grid, a hybrid neural representation that adaptively integrates structured and unstructured primitives. By dynamically partitioning computation between 2D Gaussian distributions and their attached multi-resolution feature grids based on the local frequency content, Gaussian-Grid automatically optimizes its architecture to match the underlying complexity of the target signal. We evaluate our approach using high-resolution natural images and demonstrate its applications as GPU-native dataset storage, showing $1.24$-$2.14\times$ decoding speed improvement and PCIe data traffic reduction of $23\times$-$176\times$ over JPEG + ZIP data archiving. The results show that Gaussian-Grid maintains small memory footprints while achieving high reconstruction fidelity across a variety of datasets.

AI.tldr: Gaussian-Grid 提出一种混合神经表示，按局部频率内容在 2D 高斯与附着的多分辨率特征网格之间动态分配计算，自适应融合结构化与非结构化原语，实现高分辨率图像的高保真、小内存表示。
AI.motivation: 神经表示中结构化表示（特征网格，具空间一致性）与非结构化表示（2D 高斯，自适应捕捉局部方差）之间存在固有权衡，单一选择会限制图像表示能力；因此需要一个能随信号局部复杂度自适应切换的混合架构。
AI.method: 以 2D 高斯分布为原语，并为每个高斯附着多分辨率特征网格；依据局部频率内容动态划分高斯与网格之间的计算分配，从而自动优化表示架构以匹配目标信号的底层复杂度。在 GPU 原生数据集存储场景中实现解码。
AI.result: 在高分辨率自然图像上，相比 JPEG+ZIP 归档，解码速度提升 1.24–2.14×，PCIe 数据传输量降低 23×–176×；在多个数据集上保持较小内存占用并达到高重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 结构化与 unstructured 原语的自适应混合可同时获得空间一致性与局部自适应性，Gaussian-Grid 作为 GPU 原生数据存储方案在速度、带宽与保真度上均优于传统压缩流程，但其评估限于 2D 图像，尚未扩展到 3D/机器人场景。

title: Where Can We Fool the Model's Mind? Response-Guided Semantic Probing and Adaptive Routing for Transferable Attacks on Black-Box MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) ground language in visual evidence, yet their semantic reasoning can be exploited through transferable black-box adversarial attacks. Existing attacks typically allocate perturbations using surrogate-model saliency, which may not reflect how an unseen MLLM semantically interprets or relies on different image regions. We introduce VISTA (Vulnerability-Informed Semantic Transfer Attacks), a black-box framework that identifies semantically vulnerable visual regions from an MLLM's responses without access to gradients, logits, parameters, or internal representations. VISTA supports two attack settings: (i) VISTA-Proxy, a pure-transfer setting that probes an open-source MLLM and transfers the resulting adversarial examples to unseen commercial MLLMs without querying them; and (ii) VISTA-Victim, a query-assisted setting that probes the target MLLM to capture model-specific semantic vulnerabilities. VISTA builds an Uncertainty-Based Multimodal Behavior (UBMB) map from response drift, conflict, misleading, and semantic shifts, then uses entropy-adaptive Sinkhorn routing and a surrogate ensemble to focus perturbations on vulnerable regions. Across GPT-5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, VISTA achieves up to 97 % attack success rate (ASR) while maintaining a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 30 dB. Notably, VISTA-Proxy achieves up to 93 % ASR without querying the final victim, demonstrating that response-derived semantic vulnerability can enable effective transfer across heterogeneous MLLMs.

AI.tldr: VISTA: 黑盒多模态大模型对抗攻击框架，通过响应衍生的"不确定性多模态行为(UBMB)"图定位语义脆弱区域，配合熵自适应Sinkhorn路由与代理集成聚焦扰动；VISTA-Proxy纯迁移可达93% ASR，VISTA-Victim查询辅助下最高97% ASR，PSNR>30dB。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM黑盒迁移攻击依赖代理模型的显著性来分配扰动，无法反映目标MLLM在语义层面如何解读和依赖不同图像区域，导致跨模型迁移性受限。作者希望仅从响应（无梯度、logits、参数、内部表示）中推断出语义脆弱区域，提升黑盒迁移攻击效果。
AI.method: 提出VISTA框架，支持两种设置：(i) VISTA-Proxy纯迁移，仅探测开源MLLM并将对抗样本迁移至未见商业模型；(ii) VISTA-Victim查询辅助，直接探测目标模型捕捉模型特有脆弱性。核心是从响应漂移、冲突、误导与语义偏移构建不确定性多模态行为(UBMB)图，再用熵自适应Sinkhorn路由和代理模型集成将扰动集中到脆弱区域。
AI.result: 在GPT-5、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6上，ASR最高达97%，同时PSNR保持在30dB以上；VISTA-Proxy在不查询最终受害者的情况下ASR最高达93%，证明响应衍生的语义脆弱性可跨异构MLLM有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 响应衍生的语义脆弱性图能够替代代理显著图，成为跨异构MLLM的有效扰动分配信号，实现高成功率且感知质量可接受的黑盒攻击。该工作属AI安全/多模态鲁棒性范畴，与具身智能、VLA、3D重建等核心方向关联较弱，对相关系统的安全性评估有间接参考价值。

title: METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids
summary: Humanoid controllers often require task-specific training despite sharing the need for balance and whole-body coordination. We present Metatron, a promptable whole-body execution layer combining a generative base policy with a programmable skill layer. The base policy receives partial goals, collectively called a prompt, that can combine timed body-part targets, velocity commands, and style cues. It produces diverse whole-body motions consistent with these goals. Training combines motion capture, synthetic recovery trajectories, and retargeted scene-interaction motions. After training, the policy is frozen. Stateful programs called skills express task intent as prompts at each control step, drawing rough geometric sketches that the policy turns into coordinated movement. Skills are ordinary code, refined by coding agents that analyze motion data and fit compact rules without task-specific policy training. On the physical Unitree G1, one frozen checkpoint supports walking, recovery, teleoperated object pickup, and sitting on furniture. Comparative evaluations show higher reaching success and push robustness than the tested reference-tracking pipelines. The same recipe produces climbing and acrobatics on a simulated character. Metatron enables coding agents to turn learned motor capabilities into new skills through code, without further policy training.

AI.tldr: Metatron：一个可提示（promptable）的全身执行层，由冻结的生成式基础策略（组合定时身体部位目标、速度指令、风格线索）与可编程技能层组成，技能为普通代码并通过编码智能体分析运动数据、拟合紧凑规则来生成，无需任务特定策略训练。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人控制器通常需针对每个任务单独训练，尽管各任务共享平衡与全身协调能力；作者希望构建一个统一的、可被程序化调用的全身执行层，把已学到的运动能力通过代码复用于新任务。
AI.method: 训练生成式基础策略，输入为部分目标组成的 prompt（定时身体部位目标 + 速度指令 + 风格提示）；训练数据混合动捕、合成恢复轨迹、重定向的场景交互运动；训练后冻结权重。在其上构建有状态的 skill 层，用每个控制步的 prompt 表达任务意图，形成几何草图由策略转为协调动作；skill 由编码智能体根据运动数据分析迭代拟合紧凑规则得到，而非训练策略。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 真机上，单一冻结 checkpoint 支持行走、恢复、遥操作抓取物体、坐家具；与参考的参考轨迹跟踪流水线相比，达到更高的抓取/伸手成功率与更强的抗推鲁棒性；同一套配方在仿真角色上实现攀爬与杂技动作。
AI.conclusion: Metatron 表明编码智能体可通过编写代码将冻结的通用运动基座转化为新技能，使人在环的智能体驱动技能构建替代任务特定策略训练，为可编程的全身执行层提供可行路径。

title: Learning from Relative Action Credit for Escaping Local Minima
summary: Reinforcement learning holds the promise of robots that learn manipulation skills from interaction alone, without pretrained priors or demonstration data. In practice, on-policy methods such as PPO routinely stall on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks: dense reward shaping carries the policy through stages, yet stitching them together and discovering sparsely rewarded events rarely succeeds. We trace this failure to the missing action discrimination in state-value credit assignment: a state-value critic judges progress only by episode outcomes, so when the policy converges to a partial solution all outcomes coincide, and improvement stops because no action can prove better than another. We therefore extend PPO with an action conditioned value critic which, can compare the executed action with alternatives sampled at the same state and aid the learning signal. Combined with Generalized Advantage Estimation and a bound on exploration noise, we show how the extended algorithm escapes the plateau and completes precise peg insertion within a training budget where PPO with identical exploration fails.

AI.tldr: 为PPO引入动作条件状态价值评论家（action-conditioned critic），通过在同状态下比较执行动作与替代动作来改善稀疏奖励下的信用分配，配合GAE与探索噪声约束，在相同训练预算下完成精密销孔插入任务。
AI.motivation: 指出on-policy RL（如PPO）在长时程、富接触任务中停滞的根因：状态价值评论家仅以回合结局判断进展，当策略收敛到部分解时所有结局趋于一致，动作间无法区分优劣，梯度信号消失，形成平台期。
AI.method: 在PPO之上扩展出动作条件价值评论家：在给定状态时，将实际执行动作与同状态采样的替代动作进行价值比较，从而为动作产生判别性学习信号；结合GAE优势估计与探索噪声上界约束以稳定训练并保证逃逸平台期。
AI.result: 在与普通PPO（相同探索设置）完全相同的训练预算下，扩展算法能够脱离平台期并完成精密peg insertion；而普通PPO失败。摘要未给出具体成功率与对比数值。
AI.conclusion: 价值函数的动作条件化是缓解稀疏奖励长时程操作任务中信用分配失效的有效且轻量手段；论文属于方法性RL探索，仅报告单一接触密集任务，缺乏真机验证与多任务泛化证据。

title: EARS-Info: Information-Aware Event-Driven Reallocation for Multi-Robot Exploration
summary: We introduce EARS-Info, an information-aware extension of Event-Driven Ant Reallocation Search for multi-robot exploration on OpenStreetMap-derived grids. It combines marginal sensing gain, feasible relocation, return-aware routing, sensing reservations, and cached shortest paths. Across 168,000 episodes comparing 30 implementations on eight city maps, EARS-Info achieves the highest mean operational score in every evaluation panel. With eight robots and 3% communication dropout, it improves the score over EARS-Safe by 5.43%, increases weighted discovery from 88.88% to 98.46%, and reduces mean energy use by 2.62%. Score differences are positive in all eight cities ($p=0.0078125$; descriptive 95% city-bootstrap interval $[0.0159,0.0694]$), with no simulated incidents across 5,600 EARS-Info episodes. These results support the complete controller; individual component advantages remain uncertain. Generalization is limited by reused geography, one training replicate, coarse maps, and adapted comparison methods.

AI.tldr: EARS-Info 在多机器人OSM栅格探索中将边际感知增益、可行重定位、返航感知路由、感知预约与缓存最短路整合，在168,000回合、8城市、30种实现的对比中取得最高平均运行分数。
AI.motivation: 面向多机器人探索的事件驱动蚂蚁重分配搜索（EARS）缺少对感知信息价值的显式利用，需提升探索效率与能量效率并保证安全返航。
AI.method: 在EARS框架上扩展为信息感知控制器，融合边际感知增益、可行重分配、返航感知路由、感知预约机制和缓存最短路径；在8张OpenStreetMap派生栅格地图上以30种实现、168,000回合做消融/对比，并采用城市级bootstrap与符号检验评估。
AI.result: 所有评估面板中平均运行分数最高；8机+3%通信丢包下相较EARS-Safe分数提升5.43%，加权发现率由88.88%升至98.46%，平均能耗降低2.62%；8城市分数差均为正（p=0.0078125，95%城市bootstrap区间[0.0159,0.0694]），5,600个EARS-Info回合无模拟事故。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持整体控制器有效性，但各组件单独贡献尚不确定；泛化性受地理复用、单训练重复、低分辨率地图及对比方法经改编等因素限制。

title: Can Event Detectors Leave the Broadcast Camera? Evidence from Tennis
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Benchmark, evaluator and frozen predictions: this https URL
summary: Ball bounces and racket hits are the events from which tennis statistics are derived, and on monocular video the two are easy to confuse. We release a benchmark of 345 bounce and hit annotations at frame level on eight clips that mix broadcast, fixed elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, with a frozen development and test split, a confusion-aware matcher, clip-level bootstrap intervals and a blind second annotation of three clips. On it we score supervised precise spotters with published broadcast weights, two zero-shot vision-language models, and RallyArb, an arbitration layer over a ball track and player poses that fits no parameter on event labels. The supervised spotters score near-perfectly on broadcast footage and almost nothing on phone and court-level footage, where the pooled bounce F1 of E2E-Spot is 0.130. RallyArb keeps a bounce F1 above 0.8 on the three phone and court-level clips, two of which were used to tune it, and finds 8 of 11 bounces on the held-out one, but it places hits too far from the contact frame to match human timing. The vision-language models detect events on every viewpoint and miss the contact frame by about 0.1 s. Fine-tuned leave-one-clip-out from its broadcast weights, the spotter reaches about 0.8 bounce F1 on two phone and court-level clips and stays at 0.2 on a grazing phone angle. The annotations, the evaluator and the frozen predictions of every scored row are released.

AI.tldr: 论文发布了一个边框球/击球（bounce/hit）帧级标注基准（8段视频、345个标注、涵盖广播/固定高机位/手机/场边视角），并提出无需在事件标签上调参的仲裁层 RallyArb（基于球轨迹与球员姿态），对比监督式精确检测器、两个零样本视觉语言模型及微调基线。
AI.motivation: 网球统计依赖反弹与击球事件，但单目视频中二者易混淆；现有监督检测器在广播视角近乎完美，却在手机与场边视角严重失效，缺少跨视角评测基准。
AI.method: 构建345个帧级事件标注的8段视频基准，含冻结dev/test划分、混淆感知匹配器、片段级bootstrap置信区间与3段盲标注；评测(1)带广播权重的监督精确检测器、(2)两个零样本视觉语言模型、(3) RallyArb——在球轨迹与球员姿态上做事件仲裁且不在事件标签上拟合参数；另做从广播权重的留一视频微调。
AI.result: 监督检测器广播视角近满分，但手机/场边汇总反弹F1仅0.130；RallyArb在三个手机/场边片段反弹F1>0.8（其中两段用于调参），留出片段11个反弹找到8个，但击球定位与接触帧偏差大；VLM在各视角均可检测但接触帧误差约0.1s；留一微调后两段反弹F1约0.8，擦边手机角度仍仅0.2。
AI.conclusion: 单目无标定视角下事件检测仍开放，几何/姿态先验的解析式仲裁比监督检测器跨视角更稳健；标注、评测器与全部冻结预测开源。

title: Classifying Urban Locations by Cyclist Facility Usage and Directional Alignment: A Validated Camera-Based Framework from Multi-Site Observations
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 106th Transportation Research Board (TRB) Annual Meeting, Washington, D.C., January 10-14, 2027
summary: Objectives: Agencies invest in bicycle facilities but lack tools to assess whether cyclists use them as designed. We examine whether usage patterns follow facility configurations and whether higher bike lane usage is associated with less wrong-way riding. Methods: Motion-triggered cameras covered 19 deployments at 17 locations in Tempe, Arizona, in 2023. Manual review identified 1,963 cycling events; excluding 20 crossings left 1,943 labeled events for analysis. An automated pipeline on the same captures counted 92.9 percent of the full manual total (per-deployment r = 0.99), and every automated wrong-way call was visually verified. Deployments were classified using thresholds on facility usage shares. Findings: Deployments were bike-lane dominant (9), sidewalk dominant (6), or mixed (4). Cyclists in bike lanes rode against the flow in 4.6 percent of events; on sidewalks, riders opposed the near-side traffic flow in 49.6 percent. Across deployments, bike lane share and wrong-way rate were negatively correlated (Spearman rho = -0.87, p < 0.001, n = 16). An independent volunteer count in the same city showed a similar sidewalk-direction pattern (rho = 0.79). Novelty: The study combines multi-site still-camera observations with a fully hand-verified benchmark to characterize facility use and travel direction. Practical Applications: The workflow offers planners a low-cost screen for locations with high sidewalk cycling and travel against the near-side traffic flow, supporting more detailed site investigation.

AI.tldr: 用自动相机流水线统计Tempe 17个点位19次部署的自行车道使用情况，发现车道骑行逆行为4.6%、人行道骑行逆行为49.6%，且车道使用占比与逆行率强负相关（rho=-0.87）。
AI.motivation: 交通部门投资建设自行车设施，但缺乏评估骑行设施是否被"按设计使用"的低成本工具。
AI.method: 2023年在亚利桑那州Tempe 17处地点部署19次运动触发相机；人工标注1,943个骑行事件作为基准，自动流水线召回92.9%（逐部署r=0.99），所有自动逆行判定均人工复核；用使用占比阈值将点位划分为车道主导/人行道主导/混合三类，并做Spearman相关分析，另以同城志愿者计数做外验。
AI.result: 车道主导9处、人行道主导6处、混合4处；车道逆行4.6%，人行道逆近侧车流49.6%；车道占比与逆行率rho=-0.87（p<0.001, n=16）；志愿者计数复现同类模式（rho=0.79）。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一套低成本、可复核的路侧视觉筛查流程，可识别高人/非机动车道逆行点位，指导深入现场调查与设施改善。

title: Forward-Backward Map Matching for Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation
comment: 37 pages, 11 figures, submitted for publication: The Journal of Navigation (CUP)
summary: Airborne magnetic anomaly navigation provides a passive, unjammable alternative to Global Navigation Satellite Systems positioning by matching magnetometer measurements against a lithospheric magnetic anomaly map. Existing map-matching algorithms either assume a Gaussian posterior (extended Kalman filter), require Monte Carlo sampling (particle filter), or discard posterior uncertainty in favour of a single optimal path (Viterbi algorithm). Here we formulate map matching as inference on a chain-structured factor graph and solve it segment by segment using the forward-backward algorithm, which yields a discrete posterior over candidate positions and its Shannon entropy $H_t$ at time $t$. Over the \texttt{Renfrew\_395} map, $10^3$ synthetic trials yield a median position error of $32.7$ m, $91\%$ below the median inertial drift of $362$ m. On these trials and $10^3$ flight paths, the median error is $43\%$ below the extended Kalman filter and particle filter. Across these paths, a threshold on segment-level entropy detects $47\%$ of segments with errors above two map cells and $94\%$ of those above three, at a $10\%$ false-alarm rate. The foregoing results indicate that $H_t$ provides a truth-free diagnostic of map-conditioned navigation ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 将地磁异常匹配导航建模为链式因子图推断，用前向-后向算法逐段求解，输出候选位置的离散后验及其香农熵H_t，作为无需真值的定位模糊度诊断量。
AI.motivation: 现有地磁地图匹配算法各有缺陷：EKF假设高斯后验，粒子滤波需蒙特卡洛采样，Viterbi只保留单条最优路径而丢弃后验不确定性；同时缺乏无需真值即可评估定位可靠性的手段。
AI.method: 把地图匹配表述为链式结构因子图上的推断问题，基于前向-后向算法逐段精确边缘化，得到时刻t的离散后验分布与香农熵H_t；在Renfrew_395地磁图上用合成轨迹与飞行路径与EKF、粒子滤波对比，并以段级熵阈值作为误差预警。
AI.result: 10^3次合成试验中位位置误差32.7 m，比中位惯性漂移362 m低91%；在同样试验与10^3条飞行路径上中位误差比EKF和粒子滤波低43%；段级熵阈值以10%虚警率检出47%误差超过两个地图单元的段和94%误差超过三个地图单元的段。
AI.conclusion: H_t可作为无需真值的地图条件导航模糊度诊断指标，兼具更优定位精度与不确定性量化能力。

title: Vision Tomography: Towards Portable 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Inference from Visual Data
summary: Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. For applications such as remote diagnostics, digital healthcare, forensic identification, missing-person investigation, and archaeological analysis, there is an urgent need for a portable, safe, and accessible solution to capture 3D skull geometry. In this work, we introduce Vision Tomography (VT), a concept and framework capable of reconstructing paired 3D face-skull geometry from various visual modalities, and also enabling joint manipulation of 3D facial and skull geometry. To achieve this, we first construct a dataset of over 200 samples, where each case includes a CT-based skull, a CT-based face, and a high-fidelity textured face scan. Secondly, we propose a novel dense ray matching registration method that ensures topological consistency across face, skull, and their tissue correspondences. Building on this registration, we introduce the 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model (BFSM) as the foundation of Vision Tomography, which enables shape inference between the face and skull through a shared coefficient space, while also modeling tissue thickness variation to support one-to-many facial reconstructions from the same skull, reflecting individual facial changes such as age or body fat. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Vision Tomography across various forensic and medical applications, including paired 3D face-skull reconstruction from images or sketches and predicting surgical outcomes with joint face-skull editing. Extensive experiments confirm the robustness and accuracy of our method. Vision Tomography is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 Vision Tomography (VT) 框架：仅凭图像/素描等视觉模态即可重建成对 3D 人脸-颅骨几何，并支持人脸-颅骨联合编辑。核心是密集射线匹配配准 + 双向人脸-颅骨可变形模型 BFSM。
AI.motivation: 传统 CT 可获取成对 3D 人脸与颅骨，但成本高、设备固定、有辐射，无法满足远程诊断、数字医疗、法医鉴定等场景对便携、安全、可及的 3D 颅骨采集需求。
AI.method: (1) 构建 200+ 样本数据集，每例含 CT 颅骨、CT 人脸与高保真纹理人脸扫描；(2) 提出密集射线匹配配准方法，保证人脸、颅骨及软组织对应关系的拓扑一致性；(3) 基于该配准构建 3D 双向人脸-颅骨可变形模型 BFSM，通过共享系数空间实现人脸↔颅骨形状推断，并建模软组织厚度变化以支持同一颅骨到多张人脸的 one-to-many 重建（如年龄、体脂变化）。
AI.result: 在法医与医学多类任务上验证有效性，包括由图像或素描重建成对 3D 人脸-颅骨、以及通过人脸-颅骨联合编辑预测手术结果；大量实验表明方法具备鲁棒性与准确性，并已开源。
AI.conclusion: VT 以视觉模态替代 CT 获取成对 3D 人脸-颅骨，借助统计可变形模型实现跨模态形状推断与联合编辑，为远程医疗、法医鉴定与考古等提供安全可及的替代方案；主要局限在于样本规模有限、依赖双侧对应统计先验，泛化到极端个体差异仍需验证。

title: Efficacy of Monocular Depth Estimation in Lunar Environments
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo) 2026
summary: Recent advances in monocular depth estimation have demonstrated highly accurate 3D reconstructions within in-distribution terrestrial domains. This study investigates the efficacy of several state-of-the-art approaches to reconstruct out-of-distribution lunar environments using the NASA Ames Polar Optical Lunar Analog Reconstruction (POLAR) stereo dataset and Apollo 17 surface imagery. By leveraging these datasets, we establish a robust analog-to-field validation pipeline that evaluates quantitative performance against ground-truth physical analogs and qualitative performance against historical field data. Our results indicate that select state-of-the-art techniques can successfully generalize to produce high-fidelity relative 3D reconstructions of the unstructured lunar surface.

AI.tldr: 用NASA POLAR立体月球模拟数据集与Apollo 17影像检验多种SOTA单目深度估计在分布外月球环境的泛化能力，建立模拟-实地验证流程。
AI.motivation: 现有单目深度估计在陆地域内已达高精度，但其在分布外（OOD）月面环境的泛化性未知，这对月球探测视觉感知至关重要。
AI.method: 构建analog-to-field验证管线：在POLAR立体数据上以物理真值做定量评估，在Apollo 17历史影像上做定性评估，系统评测多种SOTA相对深度/单目深度方法。
AI.result: 部分SOTA方法可泛化至非结构化月面，生成高保真相对3D重建；但仅验证相对几何一致性，绝对尺度与定量遥测误差未充分讨论。
AI.conclusion: 为OOD月面深度估计提供了可复用的跨域评测范式，说明现成模型可迁移至行星表面重建，后续需向绝对尺度与实时部署推进。

title: From Next Day Wildfire to Next Days Wildfire: A New Multi-Continent Dataset of Active-Fire Spread for Sequence-to-Sequence Forecasting
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 19 pages including supplementary material, 12 figures, 13 tables
summary: Benchmarks such as WildfireSpreadTS (WSTS) have enabled data-driven forecasting of wildfire spread from multimodal satellite time series, but they suffer from limitations: size restricts them to large fires that burn for weeks, and they are from similar environments. We introduce AFSeq, a multimodal dataset of 1,194 recent fire events (2023 to 2026) from 8 different countries across three regions, dominated by the short, small fires that existing benchmarks underrepresent. Our dataset is the largest and most diverse to date for time-series-based wildfire spread prediction. We also introduce UTAE-AR, an extension of a classical U-Net with Temporal Auto Encoder, enhanced with recurrent modules before the decoder.
