This allows the model to not only predict the next day but the whole sequence in an autoregressive way. Moreover, our model can feed its own predicted fire mask back one day at a time, producing the day-by-day forecasts that single-step models cannot. Our results show that UTAE-AR surpasses state-of-the-art on both WSTS, WSTS+ and AFSeq for next-day accuracy while having 21.5% of their parameters, and being able to predict confidently at a longer horizon.

AI.tldr: AFSeq: 1,194 recent wildfire events (2023–2026) from 8 countries/3 regions, focused on short small fires; UTAE-AR extends U-Net+TAE with recurrent modules for autoregressive multi-day fire-mask forecasting using its own predictions as input.
AI.motivation: Existing benchmarks (e.g., WildfireSpreadTS) only contain large, long-burning fires from similar environments due to size limits, biasing data-driven wildfire spread models toward unrepresentative events; single-step models also cannot produce day-by-day rollouts.
AI.method: Build a multimodal satellite time-series dataset covering 1,194 fire events across 8 countries and 3 regions (2023–2026), dominated by short/small fires. Propose UTAE-AR: classical U-Net with Temporal Auto-Encoder plus recurrent modules before the decoder, trained to predict full sequences and to feed its own predicted fire mask back one day at a time for autoregressive multi-day forecasting.
AI.result: UTAE-AR outperforms state-of-the-art on WSTS, WSTS+ and AFSeq for next-day accuracy with 21.5% of their parameters, and provides confident longer-horizon forecasts.
AI.conclusion: A larger, more diverse benchmark and a lightweight autoregressive spatio-temporal model jointly advance wildfire spread forecasting; the recurrent autoregressive design enables reliable multi-day rollouts at a fraction of prior parameter cost.

title: The Prestige: Benchmarking Cognitive Visual Reasoning using Magic Tricks
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: We introduce The Prestige, a video understanding benchmark that probes cognitive visual reasoning through professional magic performances, where deliberate misdirection challenges models to track events and explain unexpected outcomes. The benchmark comprises open-ended questions ranging from temporal and causal understanding to robustness against adversarial questions. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary VLMs reveals a substantial gap between even the strongest model and human performance. We also find systematic discrepancies between human and automated grading and identify recurring model failure modes. Ablations further show that models can select correct multiple-choice answers even when they fail to generate correct explanations independently, motivating further investigations into question formats. Together, these findings highlight limitations in both VLM reasoning and its evaluation, underscoring the need for more reliable video understanding models and more rigorous benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出视频理解基准 The Prestige，用专业魔术表演中刻意误导的视觉线索考察视觉语言模型的事件追踪与因果解释能力，开放式问答覆盖时序、因果与抗对抗性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准难以有效检验模型的认知层面视觉推理，尤其是面对刻意误导信息时能否保持事件追踪与因果解释的一致性；同时自动化评测本身的可信度存疑。
AI.method: 构建基于魔术表演视频的开放式问答基准，问题涵盖时序理解、因果理解及对抗性鲁棒测试；对主流开源与闭源 VLM 进行评测，与人类表现对比，并做人类评分与自动评分的系统性偏差分析、失败模式归纳，以及"选择题 vs 开放式生成"格式消融。
AI.result: 最强模型与人类表现之间仍存在显著差距；人类评分与自动评分存在系统性不一致；模型呈现重复性失败模式；消融显示模型在无法独立生成正确解释时仍能选对多选题选项。
AI.conclusion: 结论指出 VLM 推理能力与其评测方法均存在局限，既需要更可靠的视频理解模型，也需要更严格的基准设计（包括对题型的审慎选择）。

title: Same Label, Different Interface: Beyond Action-Space Labels in Robot Learning
summary: Robot-learning studies often compare position and velocity actions as though each label identified a single experimental treatment, yet the label alone does not determine what the robot executes. Before affecting robot motion, bounded policy output passes through filtering, physical scaling, reference construction, feedback, timing, and effort limits. We study how these omitted properties affect attribution under one shared learner and training budget. Across three contact-rich Factory tasks (PegInsert, GearMesh, and NutThread), we compare five joint-space interfaces, with ten independently trained policies per condition. We first remain within the same position-feedback law and vary the executed interface: substituting only the physical action scale as the directly modified component changes sample-median evaluation success by 0.645-1.000 across tasks, while removing an exponential moving average produces task-dependent changes. We then move to a cross-law comparison and choose a velocity scale that exactly matches the position interface's local raw-torque command gain. This calibration raises the sample median on GearMesh and NutThread, with no median change on PegInsert. Yet clear residual sample-median gaps remain on PegInsert and GearMesh, while the NutThread interval includes zero. Thus, even this explicit equality leaves feedback and held-action dynamics unmatched and does not establish position-velocity trained-outcome equivalence. Action-interface comparisons should therefore report the executed pathway and state the physical quantity they match.

AI.tldr: 在共享学习器与训练预算下，系统研究"位置 vs 速度动作"标签之外被忽略的执行通路因素（滤波、物理缩放、参考构造、反馈律、时序、力矩限制），发现仅改变物理动作尺度即可使成功率变化0.645-1.000，即使力矩增益精确对齐仍存在残差差异，故位置/速度接口不构成单一实验处理。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习文献常以"位置动作"与"速度动作"作为单一实验处理的标签进行比较归因，但标签本身并不决定机器人实际执行的物理量：策略输出在影响运动前要经过滤波、物理缩放、参考构造、反馈、时序与力矩限制等多重环节。作者意在揭示这些被隐去的执行通路属性如何扭曲动作接口的归因结论。
AI.method: 固定同一学习器与训练预算，在三个接触密集型 Factory 任务（PegInsert、GearMesh、NutThread）上比较五种关节空间接口，每种条件独立训练10个策略。第一阶段保持同一位置反馈律不变，仅替换执行接口：单独改变物理动作尺度作为直接修改组件，并对比移除指数滑动平均（EMA）的影响；第二阶段做跨反馈律比较，选取使速度接口的局部原始力矩指令增益与位置接口精确相等的速度尺度，做"增益校准"后再比较训练结果中位数。
AI.result: 仅改变物理动作尺度即导致样本中位成功率的跨任务变化达0.645–1.000；移除EMA的影响呈任务依赖性。增益校准后，GearMesh与NutThread的样本中位数上升，PegInsert无中位数变化；仍存在明显的样本中位残差差距（PegInsert、GearMesh），仅NutThread的区间包含零。说明即使显式对齐力矩增益，反馈律与保持动作（held-action）动力学仍不匹配，无法确立位置-速度训练结果的等价性。
AI.conclusion: 动作接口标签不等于实验处理，评估差异很大程度来自未被报告的执行通路细节而非接口本身的训练特性。建议动作接口比较研究必须报告所执行的完整通路，并明确声明所匹配的物理量（如力矩增益、动作尺度、滤波），否则归因不可靠。这是一篇方法论/批判性实证研究，对具身策略设计与基准报告规范有实际影响。

title: Who Called? V33DA: A Physically Verified Multimodal Benchmark for Vocal Attribution in Zebra Finch Groups
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 43 pages, 3 figures. Dataset: this https URL ; Code: this https URL
summary: Deciding which member of an animal group produced a vocalization and where that vocalization was produced are central to studying social communication but are rarely evaluated with physically verified ground truth. Existing resources either localize sounds without identifying the caller, or recognize individuals from isolated vocalizations without reliance on the 3D candidate geometry. We close this gap with V33DA, a dataset-centered multimodal benchmark for spatial vocal attribution in social zebra finches: it comprises 33,625 verified events coupling 5-channel audio with three camera views, calibrated 3D pose for every visible candidate, and per-bird radio telemetry across 10 individuals and three experiments. Caller identity is verified from an on-body accelerometer-derived vibration signal; this channel is withheld from benchmark models and used only by an on-body reference ceiling. Given a detected vocalization and the visible candidate birds, the task is to select the caller. We evaluate it under three regimes: session-disjoint testing on familiar birds from held-out recording dates, held-out-experiment transfer to a new cohort, and leave-one-individual-out evaluation on a bird whose vocalizations are held out from training. Reference methods expose a consistent gap between in-domain accuracy and transfer to unseen individuals: methods that can exploit familiar vocal identity perform well on known callers but degrade sharply on unseen ones, whereas candidate-aware methods preserving explicit spatial reasoning transfer substantially better. The on-body reference stays near-perfect across regimes, confirming the internal consistency of the accelerometer-verified labels. We release V33DA with fixed protocols and code for the evaluated methods, and V33DA++, an unevaluated companion set of verified overlapping-call events and +/-2 s context windows.

AI.tldr: V33DA：面向斑胸草雀社会鸣声的“空间发声归属”多模态基准，33,625个经加速度计验证的事件耦合5通道音频、三视角视频、标定3D姿态与无线遥测，评测“已知个体/跨实验/留一个体”三种迁移范式。
AI.motivation: 现有资源要么只做声源定位不识别发声者，要么在孤立叫声上做个体识别而不用3D候选几何；物理验证的真值（哪只鸟、在哪里发声）稀缺，导致“谁说的、在哪说的”这一社会交流核心问题缺乏可迁移的评测。
AI.method: 构建数据集与固定协议：5通道音频＋3路相机＋每个可见候选的标定3D姿态＋逐鸟无线遥测；由体表加速度计振动信号验证发声者身份，该通道从基准模型中扣留，仅作为on-body参考上界。任务定义为：给定检测到的发声与可见候选鸟，选出真正的发声者。设三种评测制度（同期个体不相交、跨实验新队列迁移、留一个体）。对比方法含可利用熟悉声纹身份者与显式空间推理的候选感知方法。
AI.result: 域内精度与未见个体迁移之间存在稳定落差：依赖熟悉声纹身份的方法在熟悉发声者上表现好，但迁移到未见个体明显退化；保留显式空间推理的候选感知方法迁移更好。on-body参考在各制度下接近满分，验证标签内部一致。同时发布V33DA++（重叠鸣叫事件＋±2 s上下文窗）作为未评测伴生集。
AI.conclusion: 贡献以数据集/基准与协议为主，核心洞见是“个体识别式声纹线索难以泛化，空间几何推理更可迁移”，对多模态空间归属与跨个体泛化有参考价值；但缺少可直接迁移到机器人/3D重建流程的方法创新。

title: What Does LOL Measure? Hidden Label Shifts in Low-Light Enhancement Benchmarks
summary: LOL-v1 and LOLv2-Real are the standard benchmarks for supervised low-light image enhancement, and several leading methods ship hand-set test-time adjustments with their evaluation scripts. We audit both benchmarks with 18 public checkpoints of eight methods under one metric implementation that reproduces every published number to within 0.09 dB, and find that their test labels differ from their training labels. (i) The 15 LOL-v1 test labels are rendered differently: the same captures appear in LOLv2 with labels of identical luminance but 1.48x lower saturation, and LOL-v1's own training labels match the LOLv2 rendering; we confirm this on the official release. (ii) The LOLv2-Real test set is the contiguous block of images 690-789, whose labels are 14% darker than the training labels (Cliff's delta = -0.45, p < 1e-12) with no comparable shift in the input statistics we examined; methods trained without any labels score up to 5.5 dB higher on test than on train. (iii) All 15 LOL-v1 test inputs reappear in LOLv2-Real, 12 in its training set. The released test-time settings are consistent with compensating for these shifts. Separating what can be calibrated on training data from what only test-set tuning finds, the test-only residual has median 0.00 dB on LOLv2-Syn, which has no shift, but 0.37 dB on LOL-v1 and 0.92 dB on LOLv2-Real (up to 3.9 dB). Under the shift, test-set checkpoint selection inflates a from-scratch model by 0.9-2.0 dB, and removing the released settings changes which method ranks first. We give concrete reporting recommendations.

AI.tldr: 审计LOL-v1与LOLv2-Real低光照增强基准，发现测试标签与训练标签存在系统性渲染/亮度偏移，且测试集与训练集存在图像重叠，导致已发表方法的测试时手工调参实质在补偿数据泄漏与分布偏移。
AI.motivation: LOL-v1/LOLv2-Real是监督式低光增强的标准基准，多数领先方法在评测脚本中附带人工设定的测试时调节参数。作者怀疑这些基准存在训练-测试标注不一致，需量化其影响并审视排行榜结论的可信度。
AI.method: 用8种方法的18个公开权重、统一的指标实现（复现所有发表数值误差≤0.09 dB）对两基准进行审计；对比训练/测试标签的亮度与饱和度统计；用Cliff's delta与p值检验偏移显著性；分析测试集与训练集的图像重叠；将测试时增益分解为"训练数据可校准部分"与"仅靠测试集调参获得的残差"；考察测试集选点（checkpoint selection）造成的虚高。
AI.result: (i) LOL-v1的15张测试标签渲染不同，同源图像在LOLv2中同亮度但饱和度低1.48倍，而LOL-v1训练标签与LOLv2渲染一致；(ii) LOLv2-Real测试集为690–789连续图像块，标签比训练集暗14%（Cliff's delta=-0.45, p<1e-12），无标签训练方法在测试上高出至多5.5 dB；(iii) LOL-v1的15张测试输入全部重现于LOLv2-Real，12张属于其训练集。测试时残差：LOLv2-Syn 0.00 dB、LOL-v1 0.37 dB、LOLv2-Real 0.92 dB（最高3.9 dB）；测试集选点使scratch模型虚高0.9–2.0 dB；移除附带设置会改变排名第一的方法。
AI.conclusion: LOL系列基准存在标签渲染不一致、测试-训练分布偏移与测试/训练重叠，使手工测试时调参和测试集选点可系统性虚高指标并扭曲方法排序。作者提出具体的报告规范建议：显式区分训练可校准与仅测试集可得的部分、报告固定超参结果、披露重叠与标签差异。

title: Minimum-Time Escape from the Conic Field of View of a Reeds--Shepp Pursuer: the Faster Evader
summary: We continue the study of minimum-time escape of an omnidirectional evader from the forward conic field of view of a Reeds--Shepp pursuer, now for a faster evader, and solve the game for every speed ratio $\nu>1$ and every half-angle $0<\alpha<\pi/2$: the escape time is characterized by explicit characteristics and the selection of roots of a scalar equation, and it is the value of the game in nonanticipative strategies at every state. Above the end $E$ of the evader's dispersal line on the front axis, the evader chases the reversing pursuer along a universal line fed by tributaries. The characteristic from the boundary of the usable part is an involute of a circle of radius $\nu$ ending at a cusp, and two explicit thresholds decide whether it reaches the axis before the cusp and whether the jump of the escape time across it ends before the cusp or runs to it; in the latter case primaries fold back next to the barrier. The pursuer's optimal strategy is the relay of the slower case. The evader follows the tributaries and switches once to a primary, or commits in advance to a heading certified by the scalar equation of the primaries. Level-set and semi-Lagrangian computations are compared with the value.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全向逃逸者从Reeds–Shepp追捕者的前向锥形视场中最小时间逃逸问题，在逃逸者更快（速比ν>1）的情形下，对任意半角0<α<π/2给出完整博弈解，逃逸时间由显式特征线和一个标量方程根的选取刻画。
AI.motivation: 前作仅覆盖较慢逃逸者的情形；本文旨在将最小时间逃逸博弈推广到任意速比ν>1与任意半角α，并给出对所有状态一致的最优策略刻画与可验证的数值-解析对照。
AI.method: 微分博弈与Hamilton–Jacobi方法：构造从可用部分边界出发的特征线（半径为ν的圆的渐开线，终止于尖点），由两个显式阈值判定特征线是否在尖点前到达前轴、以及跨特征线的逃逸时间跳跃是否在尖点前终止（否则原特征线在障碍附近折叠）；逃逸时间等于某标量方程根的选取值；追捕者采用慢速情形的relay策略；逃逸者沿支流方向运动并一次切换至主特征线，或预先锁定由主特征线标量方程认证的航向；以level-set与半拉格朗日方法进行数值验证。
AI.result: 对每个ν>1与0<α<π/2得到闭式（由显式特征线与标量方程根选择构成）的逃逸时间，并证明其为非预期策略下的博弈值；刻画了逃逸者前沿散布线端点E上方沿普适直线追逐反向追捕者的行为；给出判定特征线-前轴相交、跳跃终止位置的两个显式阈值及原特征线折叠现象；数值上level-set与半拉格朗日计算与解析值吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完成了Reeds–Shepp追逐–逃逸最小时间问题在更快逃逸者情形下的完整解析求解，凸显奇异特征线（渐开线与尖点、折叠）结构，为视线受限追逃博弈的最优策略设计提供了可计算的价值函数与阈值判据。

title: SKiD-SLAM: Resource-Aware Distributed Multi-Robot LiDAR SLAM for Planetary Missions with Field Deployments at Analog Sites
comment: 31 pages. Published in IEEE Transactions on Field Robotics. Code and field data: this https URL
summary: Future planetary exploration missions require teams of robots to collaboratively map unknown environments under severe communication limits, constrained onboard computation, and no central infrastructure. In this field report, we present SKiD-SLAM, a distributed multi-robot LiDAR simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system for such environments, and report its deployment across two mission concepts: cave exploration and scientific surface exploration. We survey the communication and computation budgets of actual planetary missions and select modules that fit these budgets for inter-robot place recognition, relative pose estimation, and distributed trajectory fusion. Before field deployment, we verify the assembled system on public datasets resembling planetary environments and in a simulator built on NASA JPL's Open Source Rover. We then validate SKiD-SLAM through field deployments in South Korea: a team of wheeled rovers explores the Majang lava-tube cave on Jeju Island, and quadruped robots carry out a crater-and-rock science scenario on a planetary analog terrain at the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology (KICT) in Yeoncheon. Across both deployments, SKiD-SLAM reliably performed distributed multi-robot LiDAR SLAM within a 250 kbps inter-robot communication budget, demonstrating its feasibility under challenging field conditions. Supplementary materials, including code and field data, are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SKiD-SLAM: a distributed multi-robot LiDAR SLAM system targeting planetary exploration, validated in two real field deployments (Jeju lava-tube cave with wheeled rovers; KICT Yeoncheon crater/rock science scenario with quadrupeds), operating within a 250 kbps inter-robot communication budget.
AI.motivation: 未来行星探测需要机器人在通信受限（极低带宽）、星载算力受限、无中心基础设施条件下协同建图，而现有集中式多机SLAM难以满足这些硬约束，需要按真实任务预算裁剪系统。
AI.method: 先调研实际行星任务的通信与计算预算，据此选型满足预算的模块：机器人间地点识别（inter-robot place recognition）、相对位姿估计、分布式轨迹融合；在类行星环境的公开数据集与基于NASA JPL Open Source Rover的仿真器中验证；再于韩国开展两类实地部署（济州岛万丈熔岩管洞穴轮式编队、涟川KICT行星模拟地形的四足机器人陨石坑/岩石科学场景）。
AI.result: 两次实地部署中，SKiD-SLAM在250 kbps机器人间通信预算下稳定完成分布式多机LiDAR SLAM，验证了在严苛野外条件下的可行性；并提供代码与实地数据。
AI.conclusion: SKiD-SLAM证明了面向行星任务的分布式多机LiDAR SLAM可在真实带宽约束下落地；偏系统级 field report，方法新颖性有限，但对极端通信约束下的多机协同导航与实地部署证据具参考价值。

title: StepControl: Long-Horizon Human Motion Generation from Foot-Contact Schedules
summary: Controllable human motion generation has largely focused on specifying what action should occur or where the body should move. We study a complementary question: can full-body motion be controlled by specifying only when each foot contacts the ground? We introduce StepControl, an autoregressive diffusion model conditioned on a future binary left/right foot-contact schedule, without requiring target root and body poses, or semantic prompts. StepControl represents contact as explicit temporal events and injects them through dedicated cross-attention with classifier-free guidance. We further introduce a stochastic mixture noise schedule and warmup strategy for stable long-horizon autoregressive generation. Experiments show that StepControl follows prescribed contact timing more accurately than adapting existing spatially guided motion generators to contact constraints. It maintains effective contact control over long continuous rollouts and responds to edited schedules such as cadence changes, stop-and-go pauses, limping gaits, and bilateral jumping. Our results show that minimal foot-contact schedules provide an effective and intuitive temporal interface for controllable motion generation.

AI.tldr: StepControl：以未来左右脚触地时间表为唯一条件，用自回归扩散模型生成全身动作，通过显式接触事件+交叉注意力+CFG实现精确时序可控。
AI.motivation: 现有可控人体动作生成多关注"做什么动作"或"身体往哪走"（语义/根轨迹条件），缺少一种仅由时序界面（何时触地）控制全身动作的表征方式；接触时序是直观且低带宽的控制信号。
AI.method: 自回归扩散生成框架，条件为未来二元左/右脚接触时间表；将接触建模为显式时间事件，经专用交叉注意力注入并配合classifier-free guidance；提出随机混合噪声调度与warmup策略以稳定长时程自回归生成；无需目标根位姿、身体位姿或文本提示。
AI.result: 在接触时序跟随精度上优于将现有空间引导动作生成器改造为接触约束的基线；长连续rollout下接触控制持续有效；可响应节奏变化、走走停停、跛行步态、双脚跳跃等编辑后的时间表。
AI.conclusion: 最小化的脚部接触时间表可作为有效且直观的时序接口，实现可控全身动作生成。

title: REEL: Same Frames, Different Answers and Different Costs
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027, Datasets and Evaluation Track
summary: Video understanding keeps moving toward longer recordings, and the longer a recording is, the more questions can be asked about it. But processing it again for every question does not scale, so many systems watch the video once, build a memory, and answer later questions from it. Yet what to remember is decided before anyone knows what will be asked, and whatever is left out cannot be recovered later. Moreover, whether the savings pay off is judged by token counts, which fall when the input gets shorter but not when the model reuses what it has already computed. We present REEL, an evaluation framework that compares three saved representations built from exactly the same observed frames, so that a change in answers can come only from what the system remembered. Text writes a short record of what happened, Visual keeps the encoder outputs, and Prefix State also keeps the language-model prefix. Each is compared with full reprocessing (Frames) by paired correctness changes, cumulative GPU time, and storage size. Across six vision-language models and two benchmarks, Text and Frames differ in correctness on 20\% to 29\% of questions, even when their mean accuracy is almost the same. By contrast, Visual and Prefix State stay much closer to Frames. With unlimited storage, Prefix State is the cheapest in total GPU time among memories that keep almost all of the answers Frames gets right, for every model on both benchmarks. The trade-off is storage: Prefix State keeps up to about 21 GiB per video, whereas Text needs only kilobytes. Reusing computation and discarding information both look like efficiency, but only the second removes evidence that later questions may need, and neither mean accuracy nor token count tells them apart. REEL makes that difference measurable for any system that answers many questions from one saved memory.

AI.tldr: REEL 是一个评测框架，在完全相同的观测帧上比较三种"视频记忆"表征（文本摘要 / 视觉编码器输出 / 语言模型前缀状态）与全量重算（Frames），用配对正确率、累计 GPU 时间和存储量衡量"复用计算"与"丢弃信息"两类效率的差异。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中"看一遍建记忆、后续问题查记忆"是主流省算力范式，但记忆内容在问题提出前就已固定，被丢弃的信息不可恢复；且现有评测用 token 数衡量"节省"，无法反映模型复用已计算状态带来的真实收益，也无法区分"复用计算"与"丢失证据"。
AI.method: 构建 REEL 评测框架，对同一组观测帧构造三种保存表征：Text（事件的简短文字记录）、Visual（保留编码器输出）、Prefix State（额外保留语言模型前缀状态），并与 Frames（全量重处理）在严格配对设定下对比，指标为逐题正确性变化、累计 GPU 时间和存储占用。
AI.result: 在 6 个视觉-语言模型、2 个基准上，Text 与 Frames 在 20%–29% 的问题上正确性不同，即便平均准确率接近；Visual 与 Prefix State 则显著接近 Frames。在不限存储的条件下，Prefix State 在所有模型和基准上都是"保留几乎全部 Frames 答对题目"的记忆中累计 GPU 时间最低者，代价是每段视频最多约 21 GiB 存储，而 Text 仅需 KB 级。
AI.conclusion: 复用计算与丢弃信息在效率指标上外观相似，但后者会永久移除后续问题可能依赖的证据；平均准确率与 token 数都无法区分二者，REEL 使这一区别对任何"一次记忆、多次问答"的系统可度量。

title: Neighbourhood shortcuts in building damage assessment from very-high-resolution satellite imagery: diagnosis and a building-evidence plug-in
comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Building damage assessment (BDA) from very-high-resolution imagery supports disaster response, and deep models now achieve high overall accuracy on public benchmarks. Because damage is spatially clustered, most buildings share the damage level of their neighbours, so overall scores are dominated by such buildings, whereas damaged buildings among intact ones are rare and easily overlooked. A high overall score therefore cannot tell whether a model judges the building itself or relies on its neighbourhood as a shortcut, and this study tests which of the two current models do. We stratify buildings by their agreement with their neighbours, move buildings into new neighbourhoods with their pixels unchanged, and diagnose nine models covering the main paradigms of BDA. All models miss a third to half of the isolated damaged buildings, and in non-flood events they call 73--87% of intact buildings damaged once these are moved into a damaged neighbourhood. We propose a building-evidence plug-in that adds two experts to an existing model without retraining it. One expert sees only the building, and the other sees its surroundings but is trained with seamlessly swapped neighbourhoods so that it learns not to trust them. With each of the nine models, the plug-in maintains or improves overall accuracy, reduces errors on buildings that disagree with their neighbours by 8--18%, and cuts by 40--69% the intact buildings that a damaged neighbourhood turns into damaged ones. It also raises the detection of synthetic isolated damage from 1--6% to 13--39% and carries over to optical--SAR data and to an unseen earthquake. High overall scores thus conceal a systematic reliance on the neighbourhood, which building-level evidence reduces at low cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"邻域一致性分层"和"建筑物迁移"实验揭示BDA模型依赖邻域上下文捷径，并提出免重训的建筑证据插件（双专家）缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 公共基准总体精度高但无法区分模型是判断建筑本身还是利用空间聚集的邻域信息走捷径，导致孤立受损建筑被系统性漏检。
AI.method: 构造三种诊断：按与邻居一致性分层、保持像素不变将建筑移入新邻域、覆盖九种BDA范式的模型；并设计即插即用双专家模块（仅看建筑 / 看邻域但用无缝替换邻域训练以抑制信任），不重训原模型。
AI.result: 九模型均漏检1/3–1/2孤立受损建筑；非洪涝事件中迁入受损邻域后73–87%完好建筑被误判为受损；插件保持或提升总精度，分歧建筑错误降8–18%，邻域诱导误判降40–69%，合成孤立损伤检出从1–6%升至13–39%，并迁移至光学-SAR与未见地震。
AI.conclusion: 高总体分数掩盖了系统性邻域依赖，建筑级证据可低成本显著缓解该捷径，提示评估应关注分层与反事实指标。

title: Data Amount Heterogeneity Improves Performance in Federated Learning for Neuroimaging
summary: Federated Learning (FL) allows for secure analysis of distributed data without data sharing. We and others have successfully applied FL to neuroimaging tasks, such as Alzheimer's disease classification from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). FL trains a deep learning model locally at each site, encrypts the local model parameters and sends them to a federation controller that aggregates the local models under homomorphic encryption, the resulting community model is sent back to the sites for further training, and the process repeats for a number of rounds. FL often achieves learning performance (e.g., accuracy) close to centralized training, but no data leaves the sites and model parameters are protected through encryption and other measures. In this paper, we show that federations composed of sites with heterogeneous amounts of data (1 large site plus small sites) perform better than homogeneous (same data per site) federations, particularly in low data regimes, while reaching performance close to centralized training. Having a big site often results in faster convergence and higher final accuracy. Heterogeneous federations better exploit sites with small amounts of data, a common situation in large consortia such as ENIGMA.

AI.tldr: 该论文表明：在联邦学习神经影像（如阿尔茨海默病MRI分类）中，由"1个大站点+多个小站点"构成的异构数据联邦，比各站点数据量相同的同构联邦表现更好，尤其在小数据情形下，且性能接近集中式训练。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可在不共享数据的前提下进行分布式数据分析，已在神经影像任务（如基于结构MRI的阿尔茨海默病分类）中取得成功；但现实大型联盟（如ENIGMA）中各站点数据量极不均衡，需考察数据异质性（站点规模差异）对联邦训练的影响。
AI.method: 采用标准FL流程：各站点本地训练深度学习模型、加密本地参数上传至联邦控制器、在同态加密下聚合得到社区模型、回传站点继续训练，迭代多轮；比较"1个大站点+若干小站点"的异构联邦与各站点数据量相同的同构联邦，并与集中式训练对比收敛速度与最终精度。
AI.result: 异构联邦优于同构联邦，在低数据情形下优势尤为明显，且性能可接近集中式训练；存在一个大站点通常带来更快的收敛和更高的最终精度；异构联邦能更有效利用小数据站点。
AI.conclusion: 站点数据量不均衡（含一个大站点）对联邦学习是有利配置而非缺陷，可提升收敛速度与精度；这对ENIGMA等大规模联盟的联邦协作具有实践指导意义，同时模型参数经加密保护、数据不出站点。

title: Minimum Sufficient Communication for Independent Behaviour Tree Robot Teams
comment: 10 pages; accepted for presentation at the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2026)
summary: We present an experimental framework for determining sufficient communication in robot teams running fixed, independent Behaviour Trees with private blackboards. Within a declared policy family, we vary message content and admission frequency and measure traffic in recipient-weighted bits per robot decision. A dense sweep identifies candidate policies for comparison with full-state communication. We retest selected candidates and the reference on fresh, paired scenarios, using one-sided simultaneous confidence bounds to assess whether success remains within five percentage points of the full-state reference. The bounds also assess whether tested cheaper policies can be ruled out as insufficient. Depending on the evidence, the framework reports an exact minimum, a positive bracket, a sufficient upper bound, or an unresolved boundary. Experiments with eight content policies across four warehouse conditions identify zero communication as the exact minimum under low contention. In the scaled condition, the no-release policy at gate $q=0.992222$ is confirmed sufficient, achieving 96.33% success at an estimated rate of 738.55 bits per robot decision, or 0.544% of full-state traffic. The positive minimum remains unresolved. These claims apply only to the declared policy family, sampled gate values and operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出实验框架，用单侧联立置信界判定机器人团队（独立行为树+私有黑板）中"充分通信"的最小策略；在仓库场景中确认零通信为低竞争下的精确最小值，并在规模放大场景中确认 no-release（q=0.992222）策略充分（96.33%成功率，738.55 bits/决策，为全状态通信的0.544%）。
AI.motivation: 机器人团队通常默认使用全状态通信以保证任务成功，但通信带宽与延迟代价高；需要严格统计判定"多少通信才够"，而非凭经验削减消息。
AI.method: 在声明的策略族内改变消息内容与准入频率；用接收者加权 bits/机器人决策度量流量；稠密扫描筛选候选后，在新鲜配对场景重测，并用单侧联立置信界判定成功率是否维持在距全状态参考5个百分点内，同时检验更廉价策略能否被排除为不充分；输出精确最小值、正区间、充分上界或未定边界四类结论。
AI.result: 四种仓库条件下八种内容策略：低竞争时零通信即为精确最小值；规模化条件下 no-release（q=0.992222）被确认为充分，成功率96.33%，约738.55 bits/机器人决策，占全状态流量0.544%；正最小值仍未被解决。
AI.conclusion: 给出可复现的统计式通信充分性判定流程，表明在特定策略族、采样门限与工况下通信可压缩至全状态的千分之五量级；结论严格限定于所声明范围。

title: Complementing Text Based Moderation with Multimodal Grounding: Detecting Fraudulent Inducement Behaviors on Short Video Platforms
summary: Short video platforms have become a primary channel for black and gray industry operations in internet finance, where inducements such as prompts to like, follow, join private chat groups, or click external links frequently steer users toward fraud. Because such videos are short, dynamic, and often convey intent through fleeting visual cues rather than stable text, a moderation system must guarantee detection recall and localize the offending segment so reviewers inspect only the relevant clip. Existing OCR+LLM pipelines transcribe on-screen text frame by frame and classify the transcript, but exploit only textual information. Many inducements are conveyed through visual cues OCR cannot observe, and keyframe-based localization cannot recover precise temporal boundaries. We explore OCR+MLLM, which augments the text pipeline with a Multimodal Large Language Model, and compare three routes: OCR+LLM, OCR+MLLM, and a large zero-shot MLLM, along detection, latency, token consumption, and deployment complexity. OCR preserves the text signal that guarantees recall, while the MLLM jointly performs OCR-grounded discrimination and temporal grounding, localizing both textual and non-textual inducements. We construct a dataset of 2,419 internet finance short videos (66.49 hours) with 3,194 annotated events across four categories, and study reward design for RL-based grounding under class imbalance. We report two findings: auxiliary reward terms are exploited through reward hacking, and stronger localization rewards degrade class-balanced detection. We therefore design a recall-weighted F2 localization reward with class-balanced resampling. Experiments show OCR+MLLM localizes better than the keyframe OCR+LLM baseline (mIoU 26.52 vs. 14.49) and detects non-textual inducements that text-only pipelines miss, while maintaining 67.0 percent macro recall.

AI.tldr: 论文研究短视频平台互联网金融黑灰产诱导内容的审核：构建2,419条视频（66.49小时）、3,194个事件的数据集，比较OCR+LLM、OCR+MLLM与零样本大MLLM三条路线，提出由MLLM联合完成"OCR接地的判别+时序定位"，并用召回加权F2定位奖励与类均衡重采样解决RL奖励黑客与定位-检测权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 短视频诱导（诱导点赞/关注/私聊/点外链）已大量转向视觉瞬时线索而非稳定文字，纯OCR+LLM流水线只用文本信号，漏检非文本诱导；同时关键帧定位无法给出精确时间边界，而审核系统既要高召回又要让人工只复核相关片段。
AI.method: 构建含四类事件标注的短视频违规数据集；对比OCR+LLM、OCR+MLLM、zero-shot大MLLM三种方案在检测、时延、token消耗与部署复杂度上的差异；OCR保留召回保障的文本信号，MLLM做OCR接地的文本+非文本诱导判别并输出时序grounding；系统研究类不均衡下RL式grounding的奖励设计，发现辅助奖励被reward hacking、强定位奖励损害类均衡检测，最终采用召回加权F2定位奖励+类均衡重采样。
AI.result: OCR+MLLM定位优于关键帧OCR+LLM基线（mIoU 26.52 vs 14.49），可检出纯文本流水线漏掉的非文本诱导，同时保持67.0% macro recall；并给出两类奖励设计的负面/正面实证结论。
AI.conclusion: 在需要"高召回+片段级定位"的内容审核场景中，文本OCR与MLLM互补优于任一单独路线；RL式时序定位的奖励设计需显式对抗reward hacking并与类均衡目标联合设计。

title: Embodied at Sea: Imitation Learning for Multi-Task Underwater Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. For associated files, see this https URL
summary: Behavior Cloning has demonstrated promising generalization capabilities for robotic manipulation in terrestrial environments. However, marine visual distortions and dynamic currents create a severe domain shift that remains a key bottleneck in adapting generalist architectures to underwater field manipulation. To address this, 1616 episodes of underwater manipulation data were collected in calm and turbulent waters and were used to train 14 generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models (DynamicVLA) with varying proprioception observation configurations. Across three tasks on 1260 gradable on-hardware rollouts in a pool, 10 models outperformed the baseline, with the highest-performing model achieving a 93.3% overall success rate, including partial successes. Results are also introduced from a case study evaluating the performance of a single-task Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) and a generalist VLA (SmolVLA) policy for two tasks in marine archaeology and conservation: grasping and mooring. Experiments are performed on an ROV on and around the WWII wreck Coralita X127 and at Manoel Island Marina, Malta. Across 748 collected episodes and 508 gradable on-hardware rollouts, the ACT policy substantially outperformed SmolVLA (47.9% vs. 7.9% pooled success rate), earning a 66.7% success rate on the most successful task at the marine archaeological site. To enable further contributions to embodied intelligence in marine field robotics, the BLUEMBODIED KIT used to collect data, train models, and deploy policies on the ROV has been open sourced.

AI.tldr: 论文构建1616条水下操作数据，训练14个不同本体感知配置的通用VLA（DynamicVLA），并在泳池1260次硬件rollout中取得最高93.3%成功率；同时在海难考古现场用ACT与SmolVLA对比，ACT显著占优（47.9% vs 7.9%），并开源BLUEMBODIED KIT。
AI.motivation: 陆上BC/通用VLA已显示泛化能力，但水下视觉畸变与动态水流造成严重域偏移，是通用架构迁移到水下现场操作的瓶颈；同时缺乏水下真机数据与可复用的采集-训练-部署工具链。
AI.method: 采集平静与湍流海域1616条水下操作episode，在不同本体感知观测配置下训练14个通用VLA（DynamicVLA）；在泳池三任务上进行1260次可评分硬件rollout与基线对比。另做案例研究：ROV（WWII沉船Coralita X127及马耳他Manoel Island Marina）上比较单任务ACT与通用SmolVLA，共748条episode、508次可评分rollout。开源数据采集、训练与部署工具包BLUEMBODIED KIT。
AI.result: 泳池实验中10个模型优于基线，最佳模型总分成功率93.3%（含部分成功）。现场案例中ACT大幅优于SmolVLA（池化成功率47.9% vs 7.9%），最成功任务（考古点）达66.7%；SmolVLA在真实水下域偏移下几乎失效。
AI.conclusion: 通用VLA在水下可控环境中可超越基线并对本体感知配置敏感，但在真实海况下小规模单任务专用策略仍显著更鲁棒；水下现场操作仍需针对域偏移的数据与架构适配。作者开源BLUEMBODIED KIT以推动海洋具身智能研究。

title: CuraEval: Evaluating Demonstration Curation on Mixed-Skill Robot Data
comment: Accepted by the CoRL 2026 Workshop "Oops, I Erred". 10 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
summary: Robot imitation learning uses demonstrations from operators of varying skill, but selecting training data remains challenging. Existing methods score demonstrations using smoothness, diversity, or estimated influence on policy performance, but differences in selection and evaluation protocols make it difficult to determine whether they outperform simple baselines. We introduce \textbf{CuraEval}, a framework combining mathematical analysis of demonstration scores with controlled comparisons against fixed size-matched random subsets and full-data training on mixed-skill robomimic data using Diffusion Policy and BC-RNN. We show that the evaluated PSD score depends only on episode length and squared position magnitudes, and produces nearly the same ranking as episode length on \textit{square} ($\rho=0.999$). With Diffusion Policy, selecting the shortest 50\% of demonstrations improves \textit{square} success from 70.7\% under random selection to 76.5\%. Compared with random selection, our adapted geometric-entropy LOO selector reduces success at 25\% retention from 94.7\% to 74.0\% on \textit{can} and achieves 41.7\% on \textit{square}, below the mean success rates of all three independently sampled random subsets (59.8--62.5\%). On the same 3 \textit{square} Diffusion Policy training seeds, length-based selection at 75\% retention improves success over full-data training from 76.7\% to 86.7\% under the original protocol, but lowers it from 80.5\% to 79.5\% after checkpoint reporting, rollout count, and evaluation seed change jointly. No evaluated curated condition significantly outperforms full-data training after Holm correction, although confidence intervals still permit useful gains. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CuraEval框架系统评估混合技能机器人演示数据选择方法：PSD分数仅取决于回合长度与位置幅值平方，与长度排序几乎一致（square上ρ=0.999）；长度选择可提升square成功率，但几何熵LOO选择器在25%保留率下显著低于随机选择；经Holm校正后无任何筛选条件显著优于全量训练。
AI.motivation: 机器人模仿学习的训练数据来自技能水平不一的操作者，如何挑选演示数据是关键问题。现有基于平滑性、多样性或策略性能影响估计的评分方法，因选择与评测协议不一致，难以判断其是否优于简单基线，缺乏可比较、可复现的对照评测。
AI.method: 提出CuraEval框架：对演示评分进行数学解析，并在混合技能的robomimic数据上，使用Diffusion Policy与BC-RNN做受控对比，基线包括同规模随机子集（多次独立采样）与全量数据训练；比较对象含PSD分数、长度选择、以及改编的几何熵留一法（LOO）选择器，并在不同保留率（25%/50%/75%）下评测；同时检验评测协议变化（checkpoint报告、rollout次数、评测随机种子）的联合影响，并用Holm校正做多重比较统计检验。
AI.result: PSD分数在数学上仅依赖回合长度与位置幅值平方，在square上与长度排序相关性达ρ=0.999。Diffusion Policy下选取最短50%演示使square成功率由随机选择的70.7%升至76.5%；几何熵LOO选择器在can上25%保留率把成功率从94.7%降至74.0%，square上仅41.7%，低于三个独立随机子集均值（59.8–62.5%）。square上75%保留率长度选择在原协议下使成功率由76.7%升至86.7%，但联合改变checkpoint报告、rollout次数与评测种子后由80.5%降至79.5%。经Holm校正，无任何筛选条件显著优于全量训练，但置信区间仍容许潜在收益。
AI.conclusion: 多数演示数据选择评分（如PSD）实际退化为长度代理，复杂选择器（几何熵LOO）反而可能劣于随机选择；报告的性能增益对评测协议高度敏感，需以同规模随机子集与全量训练为基线并做多重比较校正。该工作揭示了现有选择方法的实证弱点，强调评测规范化的必要性。

title: Silhouette-Based Gaitomics for Frailty Assessment in Older Adults
summary: Walking offers a window into physical function that may support interpretable video-based frailty assessment. We developed silhouette-based "gaitomics" to connect frailty predictions with measurable patterns of body configuration and movement. In 66 older adults assessed using the Fried Frailty Phenotype, standardized silhouettes and gait energy images yielded 90 descriptors of shape, temporal variation, motion, and texture. Minimum redundancy maximum relevance selection using the mutual information difference criterion prioritized informative features while limiting redundancy. Each classifier was evaluated using nested stratified cross-validation with five outer and three inner folds at the participant level, with feature ranking and feature-count selection confined to training partitions. Shapley additive explanations examined contributions to held-out predictions. Bilateral silhouette difference led the aggregate feature-selection rankings for three-class classification and both comparisons involving frail participants. Attribution profiles differed across tasks, with texture and consecutive-frame silhouette differences prominent in three-class classification. Among classifier-specific evaluations, CatBoost achieved the highest mean three-class micro-AUC of 0.647 \pm 0.085. Leading pairwise mean micro-AUCs were 0.833 \pm 0.249 for frail versus nonfrail, 0.765 \pm 0.168 for frail versus prefrail, and 0.554 \pm 0.129 for prefrail versus nonfrail classification. These findings connect model predictions to explicit gait characteristics while revealing task-dependent feature priorities and limited separation of prefrail and nonfrail participants. The framework provides an interpretable basis for further investigation, with larger independent studies needed to establish reliability and clinical relevance.

AI.tldr: 基于轮廓的"gaitomics"方法，用剪影与步态能量图提取90维可解释描述子，通过mRMR特征选择与CatBoost分类预测Fried衰弱表型，并用SHAP将预测归因到具体步态形态特征。
AI.motivation: 行走步态是反映身体机能的窗口，视频可为衰弱评估提供可解释依据；但现有视频衰弱预测多为端到端黑箱，缺乏与可测量体态/运动模式的明确联系。
AI.method: 66名老年人（Fried衰弱表型评估）；标准化剪影+步态能量图，提取形状、时间变化、运动和纹理共90个描述子；用互信息差准则的mRMR做特征选择；嵌套分层交叉验证（5外折/3内折，被试级别，特征排序与数量选择仅限训练折）；多种分类器对比；SHAP解释留出预测贡献。
AI.result: 双侧剪影差异在三分类及涉及衰弱者的两组比较中均居特征排序首位；三分类中纹理与相邻帧剪影差异贡献突出。CatBoost三分类平均micro-AUC 0.647±0.085；二分类micro-AUC：衰弱vs非衰弱0.833±0.249，衰弱vs衰弱前期0.765±0.168，衰弱前期vs非衰弱仅0.554±0.129。
AI.conclusion: 模型预测与显式步态特征建立了可解释联系，并揭示任务依赖的特征优先级；衰弱前期与非衰弱区分能力有限，需更大规模独立研究验证可靠性与临床价值。

title: 3DCodeEdit: Benchmarking Instruction-Guided 3D Program Editing
summary: Language models increasingly create 3D content through code, with practical workflows often relying on editing existing programs rather than regenerating them, for speed and precise control. Such edits require understanding what a program builds and foreseeing how a change reshapes it, yet prior benchmarks mostly evaluate generation or simple edits against a reference. In this paper, we introduce 3DCodeEdit, a benchmark of 2,592 instruction-guided editing tasks over 108 Blender programs that construct objects entirely in code. Its edits range from parameter to structural changes, style redesign, and scene composition, and are judged from renders against human-reviewed checklists. Across 17 models, the average success rate is only 37%, and even the strongest models complete fewer than 60% of structural and style edits. As models become more capable, their failures shift to geometric foresight, where the code runs but builds the wrong shape. We therefore study whether multi-turn feedback can compensate for this missing foresight. Feedback from a separate reviewer model that describes how the renders differ from the request helps most, more than maximum reasoning effort or an agent harness, and can let a 27B model surpass the single-shot rate of a 2.8T-parameter model.

AI.tldr: 提出 3DCodeEdit 基准：108 个 Blender 代码建模程序上的 2,592 个指令引导编辑任务，覆盖参数、结构、风格与场景组合四类编辑，基于渲染结果按人工审核清单评分；17 个模型平均成功率仅 37%，失败模式向"几何预见力"转移，独立审阅模型的渲染差异反馈最能弥补该缺陷。
AI.motivation: 实际 3D 代码工作流以"编辑已有程序"为主而非重新生成，因为更快且可控性更强；但这类编辑要求模型理解程序所构建的物体并预见改动后形状如何变化，而已有基准大多只评测从零生成或对照参考的简单编辑，缺乏对多类编辑与几何预见能力的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 3DCodeEdit：108 个纯代码构建物体的 Blender 程序，2,592 条指令引导编辑任务，编辑类型包括参数修改、结构修改、风格重设计与场景组合；采用渲染图+人工审核清单（checklist）进行判定。评测 17 个模型；进一步对比多轮反馈机制，包括独立审阅模型提供"渲染与需求差异"描述、最大推理预算、agent harness 三种补偿方案。
AI.result: 17 个模型平均成功率 37%，最强模型在结构与风格编辑上仍低于 60%；模型能力提升后，失败从"代码不可执行"转向"代码可运行但形状错误"的几何预见问题。独立审阅模型的渲染差异反馈收益最大，优于提高推理预算与 agent harness，并使 27B 模型单轮成功率超过 2.8T 参数模型。
AI.conclusion: 3D 代码编辑的核心瓶颈已由语法/API 正确性转为几何预见；基于渲染的差异化多轮反馈是当前最有效的补偿手段，其价值高于纯推理算力扩展与通用 agent 框架。该基准为程序化 3D 编辑提供了细粒度、可诊断的评测范式。

title: HERON: Real-Time Obstacle-Aware Reachability Maps for Mobile Manipulators
summary: Mobile manipulator robots rarely reposition their base during manipulation, because doing so requires real-time knowledge of how well the arm can reach its surroundings among obstacles. Reachability maps (RMs) encode this knowledge, but existing methods are slow, coarse (typically 5 cm), or ignore real obstacles. This article asks whether a neural network can predict an obstacle-aware RM at 2 cm resolution from a live depth camera, on embedded hardware, fast enough for online use. We present HERON, a 3D U-Net trained on RMs computed with the GPU-accelerated inverse kinematics of cuRobo, first on synthetic scenes and then on real depth data, and deployed on a Jetson AGX Orin with TensorRT and INT8 quantization. HERON predicts the RM of a 2.56 m cube around the arm in 115 ms on average, for a measured system rate of 8.57 Hz, close to the 10 Hz update rate of the obstacle map, whereas computing the same map with cuRobo takes about 90 min. Against the cuRobo ground truth, 95% of the voxels lie within 1 class out of 51 with the FP32 model and within 3 classes with the INT8 model, with a Pearson correlation of 0.99 and a quadratic weighted kappa above 0.9. Accuracy degrades mainly at the workspace boundaries.

AI.tldr: HERON：用3D U-Net从实时深度图预测2 cm分辨率的障碍物感知可达性图（RM），经TensorRT+INT8部署于Jetson AGX Orin，115 ms完成2.56 m立方体推理（8.57 Hz），与cuRobo真值高度一致。
AI.motivation: 移动机械臂很少在操作中重新布置基座，因为需要实时知道机械臂在障碍环境中对各方向的可达程度；现有可达性图方法慢、分辨率粗（约5 cm）或忽略真实障碍物，无法支撑在线基座重定位决策。
AI.method: 以cuRobo的GPU加速逆运动学离线计算可达性图作为监督真值，训练3D U-Net（先在合成场景、再用真实深度数据微调），在Jetson AGX Orin上用TensorRT + INT8量化部署，输入为单帧实时深度相机数据，输出为2 cm体素分辨率的障碍物感知RM。
AI.result: 对2.56 m立方体区域平均推理115 ms，系统频率8.57 Hz（接近障碍地图的10 Hz更新率），而cuRobo直接计算同一地图约需90分钟；与真值相比，FP32模型95%体素误差在51类中1类以内，INT8模型在3类以内，Pearson相关0.99，二次加权kappa>0.9；精度下降主要出现在工作空间边界。
AI.conclusion: 学习式方法可在嵌入式硬件上以近实时速度生成高分辨率、考虑障碍物的可达性图，为移动机械臂的在线基座重定位提供了可行前提；局限在于边界区域精度下降。

title: SimRetract: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robotic Assistance for Retractor Take-Over in Open Surgery
summary: We demonstrate the first zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for a surgeon-robot collaboration task in open surgery: retractor take-over. A robot arm takes a retractor from the surgeon's hand and preserves retraction at handoff, using a policy trained only on simulated demonstrations, without human demonstrations or real-world fine-tuning. Imitation learning from real demonstrations is limited by collection and labeling costs, and by performance degradation when the environment changes. Our framework, SimRetract, generates simulated demonstrations designed for transfer: the policy observes masked instrument images and grasp geometry, learns to recover from off-nominal states, and acts with margin for execution drift. Deployed zero-shot, it grasps the retractor in 90% of 50 surgeon-defined phantom presentations and preserves retraction at handoff in 78%. Results on unseen retractors suggest potential for generalization to instruments with similar grasp geometry. Across ten policy configurations and 1,200 simulated and real trials, we localize the sim-to-real gap to components: in simulation, grasp rates across ablations span 80-96%, while on the real robot removing the instrument mask alone drops performance to 22% grasped and 12% held. Transfer-oriented design thus makes zero-shot sim-to-real transfer feasible for a surgical assistance task without human demonstrations. Code is available here: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 SimRetract：仅用仿真演示训练的视觉-几何策略，在开放手术"牵开器接管"任务上实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移（50 次呈现中抓取成功率 90%，交接保持牵开 78%），并逐组件定位 sim-to-real 差距（如移除器械掩码使真实成功率降至 22%/12%）。
AI.motivation: 真实演示模仿学习受采集与标注成本制约，且环境变化易致性能下降；外科人机协作任务（牵开器接管）需在不做真实示范、不做真机微调的前提下获得可迁移策略。
AI.method: 面向迁移设计仿真演示生成：策略观测掩码后的器械图像与抓取几何，训练中注入偏离标称状态以学习恢复，并以执行漂移余量动作；在 10 种策略配置、1200 次仿真与真实试验上做逐组件消融归因。
AI.result: 零样本部署：50 次外科医生定义的体模呈现中抓取 90%、交接保持 78%；未见过器械显示对相似抓取几何具有一定泛化性。仿真中抓取率 80–96%，真机上仅去掉器械掩码即降至 22% 抓取、12% 保持。
AI.conclusion: 迁移导向的设计（掩码观测、偏离态恢复、漂移余量）使无人类示范的零样本 sim-to-real 在外科辅助任务上可行；sim-to-real 差距可被分解并定位到具体设计组件。

title: MEV: A Multi-Event Video Dataset for Long-Take Generation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Current datasets for text-to-video generation are largely limited to short clips depicting a single event or coarse-grained captions. As a result, they provide limited supervision for modeling long-take temporal dependencies, often leading to temporally inconsistent generations when describing multiple events. In this paper, we introduce MEV, a multi-event video dataset designed for long-take video generation. MEV provides high-quality real-world videos where subjects can perform a sequence of distinct, non-overlapping events, featuring precise temporal boundaries and fine-grained procedural annotations. This event-centric discretization reduces confounding factors and enables models to support temporally localized conditioning and build long-take videos from atomic event units. Furthermore, we introduce a comprehensive annotation pipeline that segments videos into temporally grounded events, and generates structured captions at both the global level and the event level. In addition, under an event-centric evaluation protocol, we conduct multi-event generation experiments by fine-tuning on MEV with temporally grounded event conditioning, leading to improved long-take event transitions and more coherent content. We believe this work provides a publicly available resource for multi-event fine-tuning and event-centric evaluation, together with practical insights into learning from temporally structured video-text data.

AI.tldr: MEV is a multi-event long-take video dataset with precise temporal boundaries and hierarchical (global + event-level) structured captions, plus an annotation pipeline and an event-centric evaluation protocol for temporally localized text-to-video conditioning.
AI.motivation: Existing text-to-video datasets consist of short single-event clips with coarse captions, offering weak supervision for long-take temporal dependencies, which causes temporal inconsistency when multiple events are described.
AI.method: Construct real-world videos where subjects perform sequences of distinct, non-overlapping events; discretize into temporally grounded atomic events (reducing confounders); build an annotation pipeline that segments videos and produces global- and event-level structured captions; fine-tune video generation models with temporally grounded event conditioning and evaluate under an event-centric protocol.
AI.result: Fine-tuning on MEV with event-level temporal conditioning improves long-take event transitions and content coherence; the dataset, pipeline, and evaluation protocol are released publicly.
AI.conclusion: Temporally structured, event-discretized video-text data is an effective resource for multi-event fine-tuning and event-centric evaluation of long video generation.

title: MATCH: Execution-Aware Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environment
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires instruction-consistent planning and reliable execution under collision constraints. Yet many hierarchical approaches optimize the planner while keeping execution fixed. We introduce MATCH, a framework that jointly learns a language-conditioned planner and a goal-conditioned primitive-action executor. An execution-aware topological graph represents start-dependent execution options and integrates executor value estimates with realized outcome memory, enabling the planner to select execution requests and refine their targets through bounded continuous offsets. A transition-aware dense macro reward balances ordered progress along the reference route against execution residual, encouraging executable requests without substituting local success for instruction following. A staged curriculum culminates in synchronized on-policy updates, with the executor learning on planner-generated requests and the planner adapting its requests to the executor's current behavior. With 0.5B parameters, MATCH achieves state-of-the-art performance on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks. Preliminary real-robot deployments further demonstrate its practical potential.

AI.tldr: MATCH: 联合学习语言条件高层规划器与目标条件底层执行器的VLN-CE框架，用执行感知拓扑图、宏奖励与分阶段同策略课程，仅0.5B参数即在R2R-CE/RxR-CE取得SOTA并有初步真机部署。
AI.motivation: 现有分层式VLN-CE方法多只优化规划器而固定执行器，导致"规划可行、执行不可行"的解耦问题；需要让规划器显式感知执行能力并在训练中相互适配。
AI.method: (1) 执行感知拓扑图：以起点相关的执行选项节点为基础，融合执行器价值估计与已实现结果记忆，规划器据此选择执行请求并通过有界连续偏移细化目标；(2) 转移感知稠密宏奖励：平衡沿参考路径的有序进展与执行残差，避免用局部成功替代指令跟随；(3) 分阶段课程 + 同步on-policy更新：执行器在规划器生成请求上学习，规划器自适应执行器当前行为。
AI.result: 0.5B参数模型在R2R-CE与RxR-CE上达到SOTA；初步真机部署展示了实用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 将规划与执行作为耦合系统端到端协同优化，是提升连续环境下指令一致性导航可执行性的有效路径；小模型+执行对齐即可超越更大规模基线。

title: ETA-Motion: Efficient Topology-Agnostic Motion Diffusion via Sparse Joint Learning
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027; Project page : this https URL
summary: Topology-agnostic motion generation aims to synthesize motions for diverse characters with arbitrary skeletons. Unlike conventional motion generation, which assumes a fixed skeletal template, this setting must handle diverse joint configurations and inconsistent joint semantics across characters. Existing methods address this challenge through dense full-joint modeling, which incurs substantial computational cost and hinders learning transferable motion patterns across diverse skeletal topologies. We present ETA-Motion, a topology-agnostic motion generation framework based on sparse joint learning. Instead of learning motion from all joints, our method uses a compact subset of joints to reduce redundancy and trains the motion generator on the resulting sparse skeleton. To facilitate correspondence across diverse topologies, we introduce semantic joint embeddings that combine textual and visual cues, together with topology-aware training objectives for preserving skeletal structure. Although ETA-Motion is trained only on sparse skeletal observations, it supports full-skeleton motion generation during inference. Experimental results demonstrate that ETA-Motion outperforms existing topology-agnostic baselines while significantly improving efficiency and generalization to unseen motions and unseen topologies.

AI.tldr: ETA-Motion: a topology-agnostic motion generation framework that learns from a compact subset of joints (sparse skeleton) using semantic joint embeddings (textual+visual) and topology-aware objectives, yet supports full-skeleton generation at inference.
AI.motivation: Conventional motion generation assumes a fixed skeletal template; topology-agnostic generation must handle arbitrary joint counts and inconsistent joint semantics. Existing dense full-joint modeling is computationally expensive and hinders transfer of motion patterns across topologies.
AI.method: Sparse joint learning: train the generator on a compact subset of joints to reduce redundancy; introduce semantic joint embeddings combining textual and visual cues for cross-topology correspondence; add topology-aware training objectives preserving skeletal structure; inference on full skeleton despite sparse-only training.
AI.result: Outperforms existing topology-agnostic baselines, with significantly improved efficiency and generalization to unseen motions and unseen topologies.
AI.conclusion: Sparse joint modeling with semantically grounded embeddings is an effective and efficient route to topology-agnostic motion generation, and sparse training transfers to full-skeleton inference.

title: TreemapMix: Dirichlet-Controlled Multi-Image Augmentation for Probability and Ordinal Supervision
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 40 pages including references, appendices, and checklist. Ejafa Bassam and Konstantin Garbers contributed equally
summary: Data augmentation improves visual recognition by exposing models to synthetic training examples that encourage generalization beyond the observed data. Mixed-sample methods extend this idea by combining multiple images. However, many common approaches either mix only pairs of images or rely on fixed small layouts, limiting control over source count, visible area proportions, and induced supervision. We propose TreemapMix, a distribution-controlled multi-image augmentation that samples source weights from a Dirichlet distribution and assigns them to area-proportional regions using a treemap partition. The resulting known region areas support two complementary objectives. TreemapMix with soft cross-entropy (SCE) treats areas as soft class-probability targets, while TreemapMix with a Plackett-Luce (PL) objective converts areas into ordinal supervision. On ImageNet-1K under matched training recipes, TreemapMix-SCE achieves substantially lower calibration error than evaluated mixed-sample baselines, while TreemapMix-PL achieves the strongest Top-1 accuracy. Transfer experiments on object detection and instance segmentation suggest that TreemapMix-pretrained features remain useful beyond classification. These results show that controlled multi-image composition can expose the same region-area information as either probability-matching or rank-matching supervision. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TreemapMix：用Dirichlet采样源权重并以treemap划分面积比例区域做多图混合增强，配合SCE（面积作软标签）或Plackett-Luce（面积作序数监督）两种目标。
AI.motivation: 现有混合样本增强多限于图像对或固定小布局，对参与源数量、可见面积比例及监督信号缺乏可控性。
AI.method: 从Dirichlet分布采样多张图的混合权重，用treemap分割将权重映射为面积成比例的矩形区域，合成多图样本；两种监督：TreemapMix-SCE将区域面积作为软类别概率目标，TreemapMix-PL借助Plackett-Luce模型将面积转为序数（排序）监督。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K同训练配方下，SCE变体校准误差显著低于对比的混合样本基线，PL变体取得最高Top-1精度；目标检测与实例分割迁移实验表明预训练特征具可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 受控的多图组合可让同一区域面积信息同时服务于概率匹配与排序匹配两类监督，且对下游密集预测任务有益。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Evaluation
summary: Embodied systems can update policies, world models, skills, and executable programs from deployment experience, allowing one interaction to benefit later tasks. When a system also revises and reuses its data-acquisition, feedback, or learning procedures, experience changes the process that produces capability, introducing recursive self-improvement. This paper surveys research in physical AI through the connection between persistent capability and its improvement process. We first explain the functional distinction between learner updates and improvers, then compare policy learning, imagined experience, memory and skill accumulation, and executable harnesses. These approaches connect to revisions of curricula, rewards, and research programs in different ways. Contact validity, recovery, retention, and resource costs determine whether the resulting gains accumulate during continued deployment. An L0-L3 rubric distinguishes task-local adaptation, persistent capability gain, inherited process revision, and verified improver gain. Representative benchmarks and within-study contrasts relate these distinctions to existing results. We further propose common-data and interactive comparisons that evaluate reference and revised improvers from shared learner starts, separating the use of experience from its acquisition. This perspective connects the diverse methods, physical operating conditions, and evaluation evidence, underpinning embodied RSI. A comprehensive list of studies in this survey is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 一篇以"持久能力"与"改进过程"关系为线索的具身物理AI综述，提出L0-L3递归自我改进(RSI)分级框架与共同数据/交互式对比评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能研究分散于策略学习、想象经验、记忆技能积累、可执行程序等不同路线，缺乏统一视角刻画"经验如何改变产生能力的过程"这一递归自我改进问题，也缺乏判断增益能否在持续部署中累积的评估标准。
AI.method: 概念性综述与框架构建：区分learner更新与improver（改进器）的功能差异，横向比较策略学习、想象经验、记忆与技能积累、可执行harness等路线及其对课程、奖励、研究程序的修订方式；提出接触有效性、恢复、保持、资源成本四项增益判定条件，建构L0-L3分级（任务局部适应／持久能力增益／过程修订继承／经验证的改进器增益），并关联代表性基准与同研究内对照实验。
AI.result: 给出L0-L3分级与现有结果的对齐解读，并提出共同数据与交互式对比评测协议：从共享learner起点出发评估参考改进器与修订后改进器，从而将"经验的使用"与"经验的获取"分离。
AI.conclusion: 该视角整合了多样方法、物理运行条件与评估证据，为具身递归自我改进提供概念与评测基础；属于框架性/综述性贡献，尚无新的实证实验结果。

title: BudSplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under a Rendering Budget
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising alternative to per-scene optimization, enabling fast novel view synthesis by predicting Gaussian primitives directly from input images. However, it quickly faces a bottleneck of rendering efficiency while scaling from sparse to dense multi-view inputs, which offer more geometric constraints but produce a rapidly growing set of candidate Gaussians. Existing solutions cannot reliably distinguish redundant primitives, leading to many redundant primitives from repeatedly observed regions and increased rendering cost without much gain in visual quality. We propose BudSplat, a compact feed-forward 3DGS framework that learns to keep the most valuable Gaussians under a limited primitive count. BudSplat has two novel designs. The first is a detail-aware importance score that is extracted from multi-level visual tokens, providing an explicit cue for regions where pruning is likely to harm perceptual quality. The score can be injected into voxel fusion to preserve high-value local contributors during multi-view aggregation. The second is quality-aware Gaussian pruning that selects a compact set of primitives by jointly considering rendering contribution and detail importance. The quality-aware pruning enables local quota redistribution that helps avoid over-allocating primitives to large redundant regions. Experiments on RE10K, DL3DV, and ACID show that BudSplat achieves a favorable trade-off among rendering quality and efficiency.

AI.tldr: BudSplat：前馈3DGS紧凑化框架，用细节感知重要性分数与质量感知剪枝，在有限高斯基元数量下保留最有价值的高斯，解决稠密多视图输入下的渲染效率瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 前馈3DGS从稀疏到稠密多视图输入时，候选高斯基元数量急剧增长，重复观测区域产生大量冗余基元，现有方法无法可靠区分冗余，导致渲染成本上升而视觉质量提升有限。
AI.method: 两项设计：(1) 细节感知重要性分数，从多级视觉token中提取，作为剪枝会损害感知质量区域的显式线索，并可注入体素融合，在多视图聚合时保留高价值局部贡献者；(2) 质量感知高斯剪枝，联合考虑渲染贡献与细节重要性选择紧凑基元集合，支持局部配额重分配，避免对大冗余区域过度分配。
AI.result: 在RE10K、DL3DV、ACID数据集上取得渲染质量与效率的良好折中。
AI.conclusion: BudSplat通过重要性引导的体素融合与配额感知剪枝，实现数量受限下的紧凑前馈3DGS，提升稠密输入场景的渲染效率。

title: ConvRoute-ViT: Convolutional Token Routing for Efficient Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong image recognition performance, but their self-attention increases quadratically with the number of input tokens and makes them computationally expensive. The standard implementation of ViT models treats all patch tokens with equal importance across every layer of the model. This uniform treatment introduces redundant computation and may reduce the model's focus on the most discriminative object regions. In this paper, we propose ConvRoute-ViT, a convolutional token routing mechanism for efficient vision transformers that performs token reduction through convolutional routing. Our model preserves the most relevant patch tokens according to class-token attention at selected layers, while the remaining tokens are spatially reorganized and compressed into a compact set of convolutional summary tokens. This design reduces the sequence length without completely removing the contextual information of the less informative tokens. By applying the routing process hierarchically, the proposed framework constructs compact and discriminative representations for deeper layers. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet show that ConvRoute-ViT improves computational efficiency while maintaining classification accuracy compared with the base ViT.

AI.tldr: ConvRoute-ViT用卷积路由在指定层按类token注意力保留关键patch，其余token空间重组压缩为卷积摘要token，从而缩短序列而不丢失上下文，提升ViT效率。
AI.motivation: ViT自注意力随token数二次增长，且对所有patch token等权处理造成冗余计算，削弱对判别性区域的关注。
AI.method: 基于class-token注意力在选定层筛选重要patch token并保留；剩余token经空间重组后压缩为一组卷积摘要token；分层级联路由以构造更深层的紧凑判别表示。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet上，相对基础ViT在保持分类精度的同时提升计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 卷积式token路由为ViT提供了一种折中：减少序列长度但保留被压缩token的上下文信息，是一种通用的效率优化范式。

title: PulmoWorld: An Asynchronous Multimodal Medical World Model for Longitudinal Pneumonia Dynamics
summary: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.

AI.tldr: PULMOWORLD：面向肺炎纵向演化的世界模型，用历史感知滤波做异步状态估计，支持递归仿真与证据约束（Cap-MBRL）规划。
AI.motivation: 肺炎涉及呼吸、炎症、器官功能多维度变化，多模态测量到达时间不同步且常有缺失，现有序列模型难以在部分可观测、异步更新的条件下做可靠的状态估计、长程预测与安全决策。
AI.method: 1) 历史感知滤波：将状态传播与观测驱动的校正解耦，仅在观测出现时更新共享信念状态；2) 基于该信念递归预测临床数值与模态表征，并生成未来预后摘要；3) Cap-MBRL：在授权动作集内搜索想象轨迹，仅当候选满足风险预算与预测代价裕度时才替换冻结的回退策略。
AI.result: 在 MASS 肺炎队列上，递归预测与任务专用序列模型相当，模拟未来状态保留预后信息；分别在 MIMIC-IV-CXR 影像与临床轨迹上训练后，在开发集上预后判别优于 latest-value 融合，在锁定肺炎面板上长程误差具竞争力；在 5 个已知机制 MASS-Syn 环境中，Cap-MBRL 相对直接执行回退策略降低选择遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 将"异步部分可观测状态估计—递归世界模型—受限模型式规划"统一为医学纵向决策框架，显示世界模型在临床动态建模中的可行性与安全性约束设计的价值；但证据限于医疗领域回顾性队列与合成环境，缺乏真实临床部署验证。

title: Compositional Diffusion Planning with Chunk Selection and Reachability Measure
summary: Compositional diffusion planners have demonstrated remarkable success on long-horizon diffusion planning by sampling short trajectories, namely chunks, and composing them into a long trajectory. However, averaging overlapping chunks can induce the mode-averaging problem, resulting in discontinuous trajectories. Several works aim to address this problem, whereas a non-negligible portion of plans remains infeasible. In this work, we propose Selective Compositional Diffuser (SCD), handling this problem by measuring reachability. To this end, we present a self-supervised learning method for the reachability classifier. This is trained on offline data and generated chunks jointly to address potential distributional mismatch, while reducing the bias inherited from the generated data. Based on this, we construct a graph whose edge costs represent whether consecutive chunks are reachable, and traverse the graph to find effective yet efficient routes. Lastly, we generate bridging trajectories and refine the composed trajectory for smooth transitions. We evaluate our method on OGBench stitching tasks. It practically reduces incompatible mode compositions and the mode-averaging problem compared to the studied baselines. Across tasks, SCD improves success rates, reaching state-of-the-art results on HumanoidMaze-Large and Giant tasks.

AI.tldr: SCD（Selective Compositional Diffuser）通过自监督学习可达性分类器，在离线数据与生成chunk联合训练以缓解分布不匹配，构建以“相邻chunk是否可达”为边代价的图，图搜索选取高效路径，再生成桥接轨迹并精修，从而减少mode-averaging与不兼容模式组合。在OGBench stitching任务上成功率提升，HumanoidMaze-Large与Giant达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 组合式扩散规划器通过采样短chunk并拼接成长期轨迹，在long-horizon任务上效果好；但直接对重叠chunk取平均会引发mode-averaging问题，导致轨迹不连续，现有方法仍有相当比例的不可行规划。作者希望以“可达性”度量来显式筛选可行的chunk组合。
AI.method: 1) 自监督训练可达性分类器，用离线数据与生成的chunk联合训练，兼顾缓解数据分布不匹配并减少对生成数据的偏差依赖；2) 以chunk为节点、相邻chunk可达性为边代价构建图，图搜索/遍历找到高效且有效的路径；3) 对所选路径生成桥接（bridging）轨迹并精修整条拼接轨迹，保证平滑过渡。
AI.result: 在OGBench stitching任务上，相较基线明显减少不兼容模式组合与mode-averaging问题；跨任务成功率提升，在HumanoidMaze-Large与Giant任务上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将可达性判定引入chunk组合的图搜索环节，配合桥接与精修，是缓解扩散规划器拼接失效的有效途径；但证据限于离线基准仿真，缺少真实机器人验证与计算开销评估。

title: Hidden Commitment: When Language Models Silently Pick a Side and How Steering Can Surface It
summary: Language-model answers are often treated as a visible record of the internal decision that produced them. We test this assumption in conflicting-context question answering, where two supplied documents support incompatible answers. A model can process the disagreement and still return a one-sided answer, even under prompts that ask it to disclose conflict. In Qwen 0.8B, hidden source commitment is captured by a residual source-choice direction whose sign tracks which document the answer uses. Sparse middle-layer MLP writers feed the same coordinate, and steering the coordinate changes the chosen source. A transfer run on Gemma 3 1B preserves the source-choice readout and sparse-write bridge under LLM-audited labels. Conflict disclosure follows a different pattern, appearing weaker, later-layer, and only partially steerable. These results support a practical monitoring strategy for retrieval systems that detects silent source commitment with residual readouts and pairs conflict-surfacing prompts with disclosure steering when the model has selected a side under disagreement.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验"语言模型回答是否真实反映内部决策"这一假设：在冲突语境问答中，模型内部存在残差"来源选择方向"，其符号编码它实际采信哪份文档，而冲突披露行为是较弱、较晚层、仅部分可操控的独立现象。
AI.motivation: 检索增强系统中，模型输出常被当作内部判断的可见记录；但当两份文档给出互斥答案时，模型可能已经处理了冲突却仍只给单边答案，甚至在要求披露冲突的提示下也是如此。作者希望验证这一假设，并提供可落地的监测手段。
AI.method: 构造冲突语境问答任务（两份文档支持不兼容答案）；在Qwen 0.8B中定位一个残差"来源选择方向"，其符号与答案所依据的文档对应；识别稀疏的中层MLP写入器向同一坐标注入信息；对该坐标进行steering验证其对来源选择的影响；在Gemma 3 1B上用LLM审计标签做迁移实验，检验读出面与稀疏写入桥是否保持。
AI.result: Qwen 0.8B中来源选择方向的符号可靠追踪答案所用文档，中层稀疏MLP写入者共同作用于该坐标，steering该坐标可改变来源选择；Gemma 3 1B迁移后来源选择readout与稀疏写入桥均保留。冲突披露则表现得弱、位于更后层，且仅部分可由steering控制。
AI.conclusion: 模型可能"沉默地对来源站队"而非如实披露冲突；建议检索系统用残差readout监测隐性来源承诺，并在模型已在分歧中选边时，将"冲突显露式提示"与披露steering配合使用。

title: Don't Ask the LLM: Visual Token Pruning with Spectral Structure and Semantic Relevance
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 19 pages (10 pages main paper, 9 pages supplementary material)
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) represent images and videos as long visual-token sequences, substantially increasing inference costs. These costs motivate visual-token pruning, whose effectiveness depends on both what signal is used for selection and when that signal becomes available. Our analysis reveals complementary limitations: visual-side [CLS] attention produces scattered, background-biased selections under aggressive compression, while stronger query-conditioned signals become available after substantial computation within the large language model (LLM). This raises a natural question: can structurally coherent, query-aware token selection be performed before consulting the LLM? We therefore propose ST-Pruner (Spectral-Textual Pruner), a training-free framework for pre-LLM visual-token selection. It combines attention-independent spectral saliency with inverted patch-text similarity through parameter-free multiplicative fusion. Across diverse LVLMs, ST-Pruner retains over 95% of full-token performance using at most 11.1% of visual tokens and achieves a 3.2x end-to-end speedup on LLaVA-NeXT. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ST-Pruner：免训练的“预LLM”视觉token剪枝框架，融合光谱显著性（与注意力无关）与倒置的patch-文本相似度，在送入LLM前完成结构化、查询感知的token选择。
AI.motivation: LVLM将图像/视频表示为长视觉token序列，推理成本高。现有剪枝依赖的信号各有缺陷：视觉侧[CLS]注意力在激进压缩下选择分散且偏向背景；更强的查询条件信号只有在LLM内部大量计算后才可用。故探索能否在咨询LLM之前完成结构连贯、查询感知的选择。
AI.method: ST-Pruner（Spectral-Textual Pruner），免训练框架。将注意力无关的光谱显著性（spectral saliency）与倒置的patch-文本相似度（inverted patch-text similarity）通过无参数乘法融合进行预LLM视觉token选择。
AI.result: 在多种LVLM上，仅用不超过11.1%的视觉token即保留95%以上的全token性能；在LLaVA-NeXT上获得3.2倍端到端加速。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM之前的阶段即可实现高质量、查询感知的视觉token剪枝，同时兼顾效率与精度，且无需训练即具跨模型通用性。

title: Does 3D Pose Improve Action Valuation in Football? An Empirical Study of Pose Representations and Learning Objectives
summary: Football action valuation estimates players' contributions to future scoring. Existing multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) models use 2D positions and velocities, omitting posture information relevant to imminent actions. We investigate whether adding 3D pose to a SARSA-based model improves observed-action values relative to attack returns: goals, conceded goals or final expected possession value. Using UEFA Champions League 2022/23 event, tracking and 3D pose data, we compare six representations (no pose, raw joints, torso and head orientation, and spatial-temporal graph convolutional network (ST-GCN) embeddings) across five learning settings and three seeds. The settings vary temporal-difference targets and action-prediction loss, with Monte Carlo return regression as a reference. Across 50 on-ball and off-ball comparisons, pose robustly improved return prediction in only three, all using torso and head orientation, while worsening it in twelve, mostly with ST-GCN. Training choices had greater effects: removing the action-prediction loss raised on-ball skill of position-only values from 0.003 to 0.040 and their correlation with expected goals from 0.23 to 0.60; the improvement in return prediction persisted at matched training length. Separately, pose improved prediction of the on-ball action 0.2 s ahead (macro AUC 0.914 to 0.934 with raw joints), while the passer's pose during execution improved pass-success prediction (AUC 0.844 to 0.856). Within this training protocol, pose informed imminent actions but rarely improved observed-action values.

AI.tldr: 在足球动作价值估计中引入3D姿态，对进攻回报（进球、失球、xEPV）预测几乎无稳定提升，但显著改善近未来动作与传球成功预测；训练目标设计的影响远大于姿态输入。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习（MADRL）足球动作价值模型仅用2D位置与速度，忽略了与即将发生动作相关的姿态信息。作者检验加入3D姿态能否提升基于SARSA的观测动作价值（相对进攻回报）估计精度。
AI.method: 使用UEFA欧冠2022/23的赛事事件、跟踪与3D姿态数据，比较6种表征（无姿态、原始关节、躯干+头部朝向、ST-GCN嵌入等）在5种学习设置与3个随机种子下的表现；设置变化TD目标与动作预测辅助损失，并以蒙特卡洛回报回归为参照。
AI.result: 50组有球/无球对比中，仅3组（均为躯干+头部朝向）姿态稳定提升回报预测，12组变差（多为ST-GCN）。训练选择影响更大：去除动作预测损失使位置模型有球技能从0.003升至0.040、与xG相关性从0.23升至0.60，且在等训练时长下回报提升仍保持。姿态改善了0.2秒后动作预测（macro AUC 0.914→0.934，原始关节）和传球成功预测（AUC 0.844→0.856）。
AI.conclusion: 在该训练协议下，姿态能更好刻画即将发生的动作，但很少能提升长期观测动作价值估计；价值学习的关键瓶颈在于训练目标与回报设定，而非输入表征缺姿态。

title: What Should a Navigator Remember? Spatiotemporal Memory for Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to use past observations without navigation-specific training. We study what information an 8B-scale navigation system should retain and how it should be organized for subsequent decisions. Our agent combines instruction progress, hierarchically compressed observation history anchored to poses, and accumulated geometry in complementary task, temporal, and spatial memories. An 8B observer summarizes observations, and an 8B reasoner uses the memories to select waypoint intents or request additional views, a geometric controller executes the selected targets. A semantic information perspective motivates the distinction between retaining evidence, making it accessible to the reasoner, and acquiring further observations. On R2R-CE val-unseen, the complete system achieves the highest among the evaluated Qwen3-based zero-shot baselines. Removing temporal memory reduces SR and sharply increases average path length from 16.9 to 39.1m, removing the spatial-map and planning component reduces SR as well. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that our zero-shot method achieves higher success rates than the post-trained baseline in both corridor and office environments, suggesting better transfer to the evaluated real-world settings. As a complementary evaluation, LAW2 uses paired instruction interventions to examine behavioral responses, instruction following ability beyond endpoint success. These results support preserving task progress, observation history, and geometry in structured memory for zero-shot navigation with smaller open models.

AI.tldr: 提出8B规模零样本VLN系统，用任务/时序/空间三类结构化记忆组织指令进度、位姿锚定的分层压缩观测历史与累积几何，由8B observer与8B reasoner分工决策、几何控制器执行，并引入LAW2配对指令干预评测。
AI.motivation: 零样本VLN缺少导航专用训练，关键问题在于8B级系统应保留哪些信息、如何组织以供后续决策；作者从语义信息视角区分"保留证据"、"使推理器可访问"与"主动获取新观测"。
AI.method: 混合LLM架构：8B observer压缩总结观测；8B reasoner基于互补的任务记忆（指令进度）、时序记忆（位姿锚定的分层压缩历史）与空间记忆（累积几何地图）选择航点意图或请求额外视角；几何控制器执行目标。消融时序记忆与空间地图/规划模块；Unitree Go2真机验证；LAW2成对指令干预评估行为响应。
AI.result: R2R-CE val-unseen上为所评测Qwen3系零样本基线中最优；移除时序记忆使SR下降且平均路径长度从16.9m激增至39.1m，移除空间地图与规划也降低SR；Go2在走廊与办公环境中零样本成功率高于后训练基线；LAW2揭示端点成功之外的行为差异。
AI.conclusion: 在较小开源模型上，以结构化记忆同时保留任务进度、观测历史与几何信息，可实现强零样本导航，并具备向真实机器人迁移的潜力。

title: Extremely Sparse-View Computed Tomography from 2D Projections via Pose-Aware Diffusion Priors
summary: Extremely sparse-view computed tomography (xSV-CT) is critical when scanning time, motion, or radiation tolerance limits each scan to only a few projections. In many such scenarios, the same acquisition limits also constrain dataset construction, making pre-reconstructed 3D volumes from dense scans unavailable. This exposes a gap in current sparse-view approaches: Optimization-based methods, which use the sparse measurements directly but lack data-driven priors to suppress artifacts, and learning-based methods, which use strong priors but usually require densely scanned training volumes acquired outside the xSV-CT regime. We study this train-sparse / infer-sparse setting by learning a pose-aware diffusion prior from one 2D projection per training sample, then guiding diffusion sampling with measured-view fidelity, shared-volume reprojection, and projection-physics consistency for tomographic reconstruction. On two public CT datasets across 1-, 4-, and 8-view settings, the proposed method achieves the best novel-view synthesis scores and best or competitive reconstruction quality compared with baselines that use dense-volume supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出"训练稀疏/推理稀疏"设定:仅用每个训练样本一张2D投影学习位姿感知的扩散先验,再以测量视图保真、共享体积重投影与投影物理一致性引导扩散采样,实现极稀疏视角CT重建。
AI.motivation: 极稀疏视角CT(xSV-CT)场景下扫描时间/运动/辐射限制导致既有稀疏投影数据,也限制了密集扫描3D体数据的构建;现有方法二分:优化类无数据先验、学习类依赖域外密集体积监督,存在空白。
AI.method: 从每样本单张2D投影学习位姿感知(pose-aware)扩散先验;采样阶段引入三种引导:测量视图数据保真、共享体积重投影、投影物理一致性。
AI.result: 在两个公开CT数据集、1/4/8视角设置下,新视角合成指标最优,重建质量优于或媲美使用密集体积监督的基线。
AI.conclusion: 证明仅凭单投影即可学习有效CT先验,在训练与推理均稀疏的条件下实现高质量体层重建,摆脱对密集体积监督的依赖。

title: SSQA: Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention for Hierarchical Modeling in Perception Tasks
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Published at ICRA 2026 (oral)
summary: Perception tasks for navigation in robotics, including aerial platforms such as drones and autonomous driving systems, are inherently structured. Drone-mounted cameras typically capture sky above, terrain below, and obstacles or man-made structures in between, while driving data often contains organized road layouts, lane markings, and surrounding agents. Motivated by these axis-aligned structural priors, we note that such information is typically more structured than in generic image tasks. We hypothesize that processing information in a quadtree-esque manner can not only model features effectively in a hierarchical manner, but also offers an efficient linear-time alternative to vanilla attention mechanisms, which run in quadratic time. In this paper, we propose Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA), which models image tokens hierarchically as a structured, full quadtree. We show analytical complexity analysis that guarantees linear-time feature modeling, in addition to empirical experiments comparing inference speeds with other popular modeling approaches, such as Mamba 2 and Quadtree Attention. Our results, benchmarked across several tasks, show that we achieve results at least as good, if not notably better, as others at a fraction of the computational costs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA)，将图像 token 组织为完整四叉树做层级建模，实现线性复杂度的注意力替代方案，在多种感知任务上以更低算力取得不逊或更优效果。
AI.motivation: 无人机与自动驾驶等导航感知数据的结构具有轴对齐先验（天空中、地形下、中间障碍/人造结构；道路布局、车道线等），比通用图像更有规律，因此可用四叉树式层级建模替代标准注意力，规避二次复杂度。
AI.method: 将 image token 组织为结构化完整四叉树，在每个节点内做“兄弟选择性”注意力（在兄弟节点间选择性地进行特征聚合），自顶向下/自底向上层级融合特征；给出保证线性时间复杂度的解析复杂度分析，并与 Mamba 2、Quadtree Attention 对比推理速度。
AI.result: 复杂度分析证明线性时间特征建模；实测推理速度快于 Mamba 2 与 Quadtree Attention；多任务基准上精度至少相当甚至显著更优，同时计算开销大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 利用导航类感知数据的结构先验，四叉树式选择性注意力是高效且有效的通用注意力替代方案；文中未提供机器人平台上的实机部署验证。

title: Knowledge-structured and evidence-aware semantic self-distillation for glomerular pathology foundation model
summary: Visual foundation models learn rich pathological morphology but lack explicit concept-level supervision. Vision--language pretraining can provide this supervision but requires costly image--text pairs. Here, we introduce GloSAGE, a semantic self-distillation framework that uses lesion profiles predicted by a pretrained visual teacher to construct structured pathology descriptions. Reliability-guided selection identifies image--text anchors, while Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis and Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction account for partially observed lesions. Image--text alignment trains projection layers while retaining the frozen visual encoder; an intermediate Semantic Transfer Layer supplies features for downstream tasks. Developed on GloMillion and evaluated across seven glomerulus- and case-level cohorts, GloSAGE supported zero-shot lesion recognition, image--text retrieval, hard-negative discrimination and concept-intervention analyses. It outperformed its source visual model in most lesion-recognition tasks and improved lesion grading, while supporting competitive case-level disease classification, injury grading and baseline renal function estimation. Ablations supported the combined contributions of knowledge-structured text and evidence-guided negatives, and the intermediate transfer layer improved mean lesion-recognition ROC-AUC relative to the complete projection output. A frozen language model conditioned on GloSAGE features generated glomerular descriptions. These findings suggest that teacher-derived lesion profiles can provide annotation-efficient semantic supervision for extending a glomerular visual foundation model.

AI.tldr: GloSAGE：用预训练视觉教师模型预测的病灶剖面构造结构化病理文本，实现语义自蒸馏，为肾小球视觉基础模型提供免标注的概念级监督，支持零样本病灶识别、图文检索与病例级分类。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型具备丰富病理形态表征但缺乏显式的概念级监督；视觉-语言预训练可提供该监督却依赖昂贵的图像-文本配对数据。作者希望以教师模型输出的结构化病灶描述作为廉价语义监督信号。
AI.method: 语义自蒸馏框架：1) 以预训练视觉教师预测的病灶剖面生成结构化病理描述；2) 可靠性引导的筛选确定图像-文本锚点；3) 知识结构化病理文本合成（Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis）与证据引导负样本构造（Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction）应对病灶部分可见问题；4) 仅训练投影层、冻结视觉编码器做图文对齐；5) 中间语义迁移层（Semantic Transfer Layer）为下游任务提供特征。数据基于 GloMillion 构建。
AI.result: 在七个肾小球级与病例级队列上，GloSAGE 支持零样本病灶识别、图文检索、困难负样本判别与概念干预分析；多数病灶识别任务优于源视觉模型，并提升病灶分级，病例级疾病分类、损伤分级与基线肾功能估计具竞争力。消融验证了结构化文本与证据引导负样本的联合贡献，中间迁移层相比完整投影输出提升了平均病灶识别 ROC-AUC；以 GloSAGE 特征为条件的冻结语言模型可生成肾小球描述。
AI.conclusion: 教师模型导出的病灶剖面可作为标注高效的概念级语义监督，用于扩展肾小球视觉基础模型；该自蒸馏+结构化文本范式对缺乏配对文本的专科基础模型具有推广价值。

title: Aligning Misaligned Benchmarks for Single-View Novel View Synthesis
summary: While single-view novel view synthesis methods have been dramatically enhanced recently, how to quantify their performance has yet to be standardized. In this work, we demonstrate that an important factor lies in how each method's own reference frame is aligned with the so-called ground-truth pose. Existing methods often rely on test-time optimization of target poses for this alignment, which inherently is ill-posed due to the complexity of the optimization landscape of camera poses vs render accuracy, leading to methods being evaluated at an arbitrary local optimum. Some recognize this limitation and thus rely on 3D reconstructions of entire scenes using training and test views to align poses, which may be infeasible. In this work, instead, we propose to use traditional 2D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D image matching techniques to align 3D reconstructions. We also evaluate only within co-visible regions, between different views, which is the only place where a `correct' ground truth can be defined. Our evaluations show that with proper coordinate alignment, novel-view synthesis methods that use explicit 3D Gaussians achieve the state of the art, despite being previously reported in the literature to be outperformed by pure image-based 2D methods.
