We further provide a simple baseline that directly utilizes an off-the-shelf video generator and a feed-forward geometry estimator. Our simple baseline is already comparable to state-of-the-art methods specifically trained for novel-view synthesis, without any task-specific training.

AI.tldr: 提出用传统2D-2D/2D-3D图像匹配对齐3D重建，解决单视图新视角合成评测中位姿对齐不唯一的问题，并仅在共视区域评估；结果显示显式3D高斯方法实为SOTA。
AI.motivation: 单视图新视角合成的评测缺乏标准，现有方法依赖测试时优化目标位姿来对齐各自参考系与"真值位姿"，而相机位姿与渲染精度的优化地形复杂导致该过程病态，方法常被在任意局部最优处评测；用训练+测试视图重建整个场景来对齐位姿又往往不可行。
AI.method: 以传统2D-to-2D与2D-to-3D图像匹配技术对齐3D重建，从而稳健地确定评测坐标系；评估仅在视图间共视区域内进行，这是"正确"真值可被定义的范围；并给出一项直接复用现成视频生成器与前馈几何估计器的简单基线。
AI.result: 在正确坐标对齐下，使用显式3D高斯的新视角合成方法达到SOTA，推翻了此前"被纯图像2D方法超越"的报道；无需任务特定训练的简单基线已与专门训练的SOTA方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 位姿/坐标系对齐是新视角合成评测的关键混杂因素，统一对齐协议可显著改变方法排序；显式3D高斯在新协议下占优。

title: Proprioceptive Finger Force Estimation for Reliable Box Manipulation
summary: Reliable box manipulation requires successful placement without damage, which depends on maintaining sufficient contact force without excessive loading. We hypothesize that per-finger force feedback improves manipulation reliability relative to open-loop finger commands. To this end, we present Finger External-Force Estimation from Proprioceptive SignaLs (FEEL), an uncertainty-aware residual method that estimates per-finger external force magnitude from proprioceptive histories. Our method combines a calibrated virtual-spring estimate with a residual distribution predicted by a Mixture Density Network (MDN) and requires no dedicated contact sensors during deployment. The estimated force is used for continuous per-finger adaptation, while predictive uncertainty is evaluated as an empirical signal of ambiguity in proprioceptive force estimation. Across ten fingers and contact forces spanning 0-20 N, our method achieves a mean RMSE of 0.251 N, reducing the error by 92.8% relative to the virtual spring and by 9.4% relative to an end-to-end MDN. In box pick-and-place, force adaptation maintains task success at 10/10 and increases both damage-free outcomes and reliability from 7/10 to 10/10. The project page is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: FEEL: 用本体感知信号（关节位置/电流历史）估计每指外力大小，采用"校准虚拟弹簧 + MDN 残差分布"的不确定性感知残差法，无需接触传感器，用于连续逐指力自适应，实现无损抓放。
AI.motivation: 可靠抓取盒状物体需在不损伤前提下维持足够接触力，避免过载；假设逐指力反馈优于开环指令，但专用接触/力传感器成本高、易损，故希望仅用本体感知推断外力。
AI.method: 将标定后的虚拟弹簧估计作为物理先验，再用 Mixture Density Network 从本体感知历史预测残差分布，二者相加得到逐指外力大小及预测不确定性；不确定性作为感知歧义的经验信号驱动连续逐指力自适应；部署时不需额外接触传感器。
AI.result: 十指、0–20 N 接触力范围内平均 RMSE 0.251 N，相较虚拟弹簧降低 92.8%，相较端到端 MDN 降低 9.4%；盒子抓取放置任务成功率保持 10/10，无损结果与可靠性从 7/10 提升至 10/10。
AI.conclusion: 本体感知力反馈结合不确定性量化可替代专用力传感器，显著提升接触密集操作的一致性与安全性；物理先验残差建模优于纯端到端回归。

title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
summary: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear. We address this gap with WeVisCut, a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning. Its agent harness maintains shared production state so that tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. Because finished videos do not expose these decisions, our four-stage data pipeline combines editing inversion with verified replay to turn recovered editing intent into executable supervision. Applied to 3,750 finished videos, this pipeline yields over 130K training examples. We use this supervision to train a single 9B policy that coordinates production and recovers from failures within the same harness. Moreover, we introduce a 100-task benchmark and five metrics assessing editing quality and delivery reliability. Under a shared tool environment, WeVisCut substantially outperforms its base model and achieves comparable performance to Claude Opus 5 while using nearly 33x fewer generated tokens per successful output minute. It also outperforms task-matched native editors on our proposed metrics.

AI.tldr: WeVisCut：面向长视频脚本到视频生成的紧凑9B策略系统，通过共享生产状态的agent harness连接工具执行与策略学习，用四阶段数据管线（编辑反演+验证重放）从3750个成品视频中恢复编辑意图，产出130K+训练样本，在自建100任务基准上以近1/33的token消耗达到接近Claude Opus 5的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频生成的多阶段"通用大模型+工作流"范式，其质量-成本权衡与紧凑任务适配策略的潜力尚不清楚；且成品视频不暴露中间编辑决策，导致缺乏可执行的监督信号。
AI.method: 1）agent harness维护共享制作状态，使工具反馈驱动后续决策与修复；2）四阶段数据管线：编辑反演（从成片恢复编辑意图）+ 验证式重放，转化为可执行监督；3）在130K样本上训练单一9B策略，在同一harness内协调制作与失败恢复；4）提出100任务基准与5项评估编辑质量与交付可靠性的指标。
AI.result: 共享工具环境下显著优于基座模型；性能与Claude Opus 5相当，而每个成功输出分钟的生成token数少近33倍；在所提指标上优于任务匹配的原生编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑任务适配策略在长视频脚本到视频生成中可实现接近前沿通用模型的编辑质量且成本极低，验证了"编辑反演+验证重放"作为意图监督来源的有效性与共享状态agent harness的价值。

title: CSO: Refining Robotic Policies via Skill Distribution Alignment and Skill-Grained Optimization
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 31 pages, including appendices and checklist
summary: Discretizing continuous actions into discrete skills using methods like VQ-VAE has emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, quantization errors yield a suboptimal distribution for the skill prior, degrading its performance. While reinforcement learning offers a path for refinement, its direct application faces unstable encoder updates and a granularity dilemma in importance sampling. To address these challenges, we introduce Cascaded Skills Optimization (CSO), a two-stage post-training framework. First, Rejection-Sampling Supervised Fine-tuning aligns the model's observation-to-skill mapping with the distribution of successful online trajectories via supervised fine-tuning. Second, with the observation encoder frozen, Skills Policy Optimization computes an independent, clipped importance ratio for each complete skill, enabling stable and efficient updates. With a lightweight QueST-style policy, CSO raises overall LIBERO success from 80.1% to 97.5%, improves performance on RoboTwin2.0, and achieves 61.0% success across five physical single-arm tasks. Additional comparisons with FAST, discrete BEAST, and fixed-buffer IQL further validate the effectiveness of our two-stage post-training strategy.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段后训练框架CSO：先用拒绝采样监督微调对齐观测-技能映射，再冻结编码器做整段技能级裁剪重要性比率的强化学习优化，将LIBERO成功率从80.1%提升至97.5%。
AI.motivation: VQ-VAE等离散技能方法存在量化误差，导致技能先验分布次优；直接应用强化学习又面临编码器更新不稳定和重要性采样粒度困境（技能级 vs 时间步级）。
AI.method: 两阶段后训练：(1) Rejection-Sampling Supervised Fine-tuning，用成功在线轨迹的分布校准observation-to-skill映射；(2) 冻结观测编码器后执行Skills Policy Optimization，为每个完整技能计算独立的裁剪重要性比率，实现稳定高效的策略更新。基于轻量QueST风格策略。
AI.result: LIBERO总体成功率80.1%→97.5%；RoboTwin2.0性能提升；5个真实单臂任务平均61.0%成功率；与FAST、离散BEAST、固定缓冲IQL的对比验证了两阶段后训练策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将离线技能先验的修正拆解为"监督对齐+技能级策略优化"两阶段，可规避编码器不稳定与重要性采样粒度问题，是离散技能VLA策略后训练的有效范式；真实机器人上61%成功率表明sim-to-real仍有提升空间。

title: Volley3D: Unified 3D Full-Sequence Reconstruction from Monocular Broadcasts
comment: 8 pages + 10 pages of supplementary. Videos available on the project webpage: this http URL
summary: 3D reconstruction from single-view sports broadcast is a pivotal capability for automated analytics and immersive AR/VR replays, yet notoriously ill-posed due to difficult-to-calibrate moving cameras and depth ambiguity. Unlike widely studied racket sports, team sports such as volleyball feature unpredictable multi-contact sequences and high altitude jumps. These dynamics categorically invalidate the standard planar projection assumptions relied upon by existing methods. To resolve these limitations without 3D training supervision, we propose a complete, physics-grounded pipeline tailored to monocular broadcast volleyball. First, we include a correction module to the perspective drift induced by ground-plane projection by coupling temporal jump spotting with Newtonian interpolation for 3D player placement. Second, for 3D ball trajectory estimation, we design a dedicated sub-trajectory segmentation architecture alongside a collision-matching algorithm. By anchoring physical equations to reconstructed 3D hand vertices, we lift noisy ball 2D detections into a spatiotemporally coherent 3D scene. Evaluations on multi-camera benchmarks demonstrate our approach significantly reduces 3D spatial drift compared to 2D-reprojection baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出无3D监督的物理驱动单目排球转播3D重建流水线：用时间跳跃检测+牛顿插值修正地平面投影透视漂移，用子轨迹分割+碰撞匹配将2D球检测提升为时空一致3D轨迹。
AI.motivation: 团队运动（排球）转播存在多接触序列与高空跳跃，标准平面投影假设失效；移动摄像机难以标定，且缺乏3D训练监督。
AI.method: 1) 透视漂移校正模块：耦合时间跳跃spotting与牛顿运动学插值完成3D球员定位；2) 3D球轨迹估计：专用子轨迹分割架构+碰撞匹配算法，将物理方程锚定在重建的3D手部顶点上，将噪声2D检测提升为时空一致的3D场景。
AI.result: 在多相机基准上，相较2D重投影基线显著降低3D空间漂移。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束+手部3D锚定可在无3D监督下实现转播场景的三维重建，验证了跳出平面投影假设的必要性。

title: SparseTokenGS: Gaussian-based Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction via Reusable Token Pool
comment: 10 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
summary: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography is widely used for fast, low-dose volumetric imaging and lesion localization in dentistry and image-guided interventions, but it introduces severe artifacts. Feed-forward Gaussian methods transfer the reconstruction cost to training and decode each coordinate from projection-aligned features and neighboring anchors. However, information from the whole scan is written only when the field is constructed and cannot be retrieved during coordinate decoding, leaving the volume inconsistent within the scan. This is a common limitation of such methods: once the field is fixed, decoding uses only local features and reconstruction quality drops substantially. We propose SparseTokenGS, a Gaussian-based method for sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography reconstruction via a reusable token pool. Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention query this shared pool at the anchors and at the query coordinates, respectively. The local Gaussian prior is retained, and the volume is reconstructed in one forward pass, without per-scan optimization or a projection-domain loss. On three public chest and dental datasets, SparseTokenGS achieves the highest reconstruction performance among the compared methods. On clinical dental scans, reconstruction from only six projections reaches 29.51 decibels in peak signal-to-noise ratio and a structural similarity of 0.842 against the full-view reference, and off-the-shelf tooth-and-pulp segmentation keeps these structures separable for root-canal localization. Experiments on volcanic rock and chicken show performance after same-object adaptation. A reusable token pool gives feed-forward reconstruction a mechanism that keeps scan-wide context available through decoding and can benefit future rapid clinical lesion localization and analysis. The code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 SparseTokenGS：用可复用 token pool 让前馈 Gaussian 稀疏视角 CBCT 重建在解码阶段仍可访问全扫描上下文，单次前向完成重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角锥束CT存在严重伪影；现有前馈 Gaussian 方法把开销放在训练端，但全局信息仅在场构建时写入，坐标解码只能用局部特征与邻域 anchor，导致场内不一致、质量明显下降。
AI.method: 构建可复用 token pool；用 Anchor Token Fusion 在 anchor 处、Point-Token Attention 在查询坐标处分别查询共享池；保留局部 Gaussian 先验，单次前向重建，无需逐扫描优化，也不用投影域损失。
AI.result: 三个公开胸部与牙科数据集上重建指标最优；临床牙科扫描仅 6 个视角即达 PSNR 29.51 dB、SSIM 0.842，下游牙齿/牙髓分割仍可分离，支持根管定位；火山岩与鸡肉实验显示同物体自适应后可提升。
AI.conclusion: 可复用 token pool 为前馈重建提供了解码期保留全扫描上下文的机制，有望用于快速临床病灶定位与分析；代码已开源。

title: ELEVATE: Agentic Controller Acquisition from Task Failure for Quadrupedal Manipulation
comment: 23 pages, 14 figures, including appendix. Project page and videos: this https URL
summary: Quadrupedal manipulators can extend their workspace through whole-body interaction, but task-planning agents' capabilities remain limited by their available controllers. We present ELEVATE, a framework that uses persistent failures during task-program refinement to identify and acquire missing whole-body control capabilities. When these failures suggest a missing physical capability, a coding agent formulates and iteratively refines a reinforcement-learning problem, specifying behavior-specific rewards, curricula, and termination conditions. Validated controllers are added to the capability library and composed with existing controllers to retry the task. Starting from a single pretrained loco-manipulation controller, ELEVATE autonomously acquires controllers for wall-supported elevation, supported manipulation, and wall descent across a sequence of seven simulation tasks. These controllers are reused in subsequent reaching and object-manipulation tasks. On the five tasks beyond the initial controller's workspace, ELEVATE achieves mean success rates of 98.4%-100% across five independent runs, while coding-agent baselines with a fixed controller library fail to complete these tasks. The synthesized task programs, together with the acquired controllers, also transfer to a physical quadrupedal manipulator without real-robot training or fine-tuning, achieving 18/20 successes in rack retrieval and 16/20 in floor-to-rack placement. Videos and demonstrations are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ELEVATE框架：利用任务程序细化中的持续失败来触发编码智能体自动合成并迭代精化强化学习问题，为四足机械臂自主习得缺失的全身控制能力并入库复用。
AI.motivation: 任务规划智能体的能力受限于其可用控制器集合；当任务需要超出初始控制器工作空间的全身交互（如撑墙升降）时，程序细化会反复失败但无法自行补齐能力。
AI.method: 以持续失败为信号识别缺失的物理能力；编码智能体据此撰写行为专属奖励、课程与终止条件，迭代精化RL问题；验证通过的控制器加入能力库，与已有控制器组合重试任务。从单一预训练loco-manipulation控制器出发，在7个仿真任务序列上自主习得撑墙抬升、支撑操作、沿墙下降三个控制器。
AI.result: 后续抓取与物体操作任务中复用新控制器；在超出初始工作空间的5个任务上，五次独立运行平均成功率98.4%–100%，固定控制器库的编码智能体基线全部失败；任务程序与控制器零真机训练迁移到四足机械臂，置物架取物18/20、地面到置物架放置16/20。
AI.conclusion: 将“失败驱动的能力缺口识别”与编码智能体自动构建RL问题相结合，可在无人工设计的情况下扩展机器人全身控制能力库，并实现仿真到真机的直接迁移，为自我扩展式具身智能体提供可行范式。

title: Visually Irrelevant Hallucinations in Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show strong performance in radiology report generation (RRG) and medical visual question answering (Med-VQA), producing free-form clinical descriptions and answers from medical images. However, they may generate clinically meaningful statements that lack visual evidence or contradict image content. We refer to these errors as visually irrelevant hallucinations and investigate them at the phrase level. We propose CLEAR (Counterfactual Localized Evaluation of Alignment and Response), a model-agnostic post-hoc framework for phrase-level hallucination risk estimation. CLEAR decomposes generated responses into visually assessable clinical phrases. For each phrase, phrase-conditioned grounding identifies a candidate visual region, which is selectively perturbed by a localized counterfactual intervention. CLEAR characterizes the intervention using two complementary auditing cues: response cues, capturing semantic and clinically meaningful changes in the generated response, and alignment cues, measuring changes in image-phrase compatibility. These cues are normalized and jointly modeled to estimate phrase-level hallucination risk. Across four datasets spanning RRG and Med-VQA, CLEAR outperforms state-of-the-art hallucination detection baselines across multiple medical and general-purpose VLMs. On MIMIC-CXR, CLEAR improves AUPRC from 85.10% to 90.23%. Its effectiveness is further validated on a GT-derived controlled VIH benchmark. These results establish visually irrelevant hallucination as an important fine-grained reliability failure mode in medical VLMs and demonstrate the value of model-agnostic visual-support auditing for more trustworthy multimodal clinical generation.

AI.tldr: 提出CLEAR：一个模型无关的事后审计框架，将医学VLM输出拆解为可视觉验证的临床短语，通过短语条件定位区域并施加局部反事实扰动，用"响应线索"与"对齐线索"联合估计短语级"视觉无关幻觉"风险。
AI.motivation: 医学VLM在放射报告生成(RRG)与医学VQA中表现良好，但会产生看似临床合理却缺乏视觉证据或与图像矛盾的陈述（视觉无关幻觉）。现有幻觉检测多为整体/句子级，缺乏短语级、可解释且模型无关的细粒度风险估计手段。
AI.method: CLEAR为模型无关的后处理框架：1) 将生成响应分解为可视觉评估的临床短语；2) 对每个短语做短语条件grounding，定位候选图像区域；3) 对该区域施加选择性局部反事实扰动（如遮挡/替换）；4) 提取两类审计线索——响应线索（生成响应在语义与临床意义上的变化）与对齐线索（图文-短语兼容度的变化）；5) 线索归一化后联合建模，输出短语级幻觉风险分数。
AI.result: 在RRG与Med-VQA的四个数据集、多种医学与通用VLM上，CLEAR优于SOTA幻觉检测基线；MIMIC-CXR上AUPRC由85.10%提升至90.23%；并在基于GT构建的受控视觉无关幻觉基准上进一步验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将"视觉无关幻觉"确立为医学VLM的一类重要细粒度可靠性失效模式，并证明模型无关的视觉支撑审计对更可信的多模态临床生成具有价值。

title: When "No Worries" Went Wrong: HRI Lessons for Foundation-Model Robots
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE Robotics & Automation Magazine
summary: When a person declined our robot's invitation to play, Alice turned her shoulder away and said "No worries, it's all good." Only after a brief pause did she drive off. The words and gestures were plausible but their order changed the message. In another episode, Alice informed a host that his visitor had arrived---while the visitor stood right beside him. Both came from a three-year ROS 2 HRI consortium that integrated large language and vision models as they emerged. Today's foundation models give robots broader capabilities to perceive their surroundings, reason about situations and generate behavior. Yet capability alone does not ensure that a changed situation shapes the action that reaches a person. Evidence may never be acquired, or a purpose or constraint may fail to survive planning and execution. A system may even report Success when an action no longer serves its intended purpose. Drawing on the consortium's engineering experience, we develop five design lessons about attention, knowledge, commitments, embodied timing and action authority. We then introduce TRACE, a lightweight review that changes one interaction premise, follows it to a decision or enforcement boundary, and produces an actionable architecture finding. A bounded analysis of a published LLM-generated behavior-tree system illustrates how an available clarification mechanism can go unused. The engineering lesson is to preserve accountability boundaries, not the computational pipelines that once exposed them.

AI.tldr: 基于三年 ROS 2 HRI 联盟经验，提出机器人交互中"情境变化能否真正改变到达人的动作"这一问责性问题，总结注意力、知识、承诺、具身时序与行动权限五条设计教训，并给出 TRACE 轻量审查方法，通过改变单一交互前提追踪至决策或执行边界，产出可操作的架构发现。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型让机器人具备更强的感知、推理与行为生成能力，但"能力≠问责"：证据可能从未被获取，目的或约束可能在规划与执行中丢失，系统甚至在动作已背离原意时仍报告成功。作者希望把关注点从计算管线转移到问责边界上。
AI.method: 归纳联盟多机器人/多场景 HRI 工程经验，提炼五条设计教训；提出 TRACE 审查流程：变更一个交互前提（premise），沿信息流追踪到决策边界或执行/强制边界（enforcement boundary），并输出具体架构层面的发现。以一篇已发表的 LLM 生成行为树系统为案例做有界分析。
AI.result: 案例显示，一个系统中虽存在可用的澄清机制（clarification），却在需要时未被调用，说明澄清能力的可获得性不等于其被有效触发；表明交互失败常来自前提假设失效后信息未能跨边界传递，而非模型能力不足。
AI.conclusion: 机器人 HRI 工程的核心是保留问责边界（谁获取证据、谁做决策、谁有权执行），而不是保留曾经暴露这些边界的计算管线；TRACE 提供了一种低成本、可复用的架构审查手段。

title: SpaceAct: Benchmarking 3D Spatial and Temporal Reasoning via Closed-Loop Action and Active Perception
summary: To solve problems in 3D space rather than merely describe images, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) need 3D spatiotemporal reasoning: reconstructing 3D geometry from occluded 2D views, anticipating physical dynamics, and executing precise, closed-loop actions. Prior studies test passive VQA on static images or symbolic planning, requiring no execution or supplying privileged coordinates while ignoring collision, statics, and timing. We introduce SpaceAct, an interactive benchmark evaluating 3D spatiotemporal reasoning via closed-loop physical action and active perception, with SAPA, a Spatiotemporal Active-Probing Agent framework. Built on interlocking bricks and mechanical puzzles, it has 108 verified instances across 36 task families in six categories, without privileged coordinates, and diagnostic modes (+plan, +state, no-camera, blind, L7 levers). In brick-bridging or aperture-threading, models rotate the camera to resolve occlusion, read in-scene rulers, output 6-DoF poses under swept-collision and statics checks, and self-correct via split-screen rollback feedback (dynamic tasks freeze time during deliberation and give five strobe frames). Across 10 frontier MLLMs on the 44 hardest instances, scores span 4.8-79.1 (seven solve at most 27.3% of 6-DoF tasks); for the top three, a reference plan (+plan) closes 44% of the gap while leaving collisions at 5.2 per episode, whereas adding exact 3D state (+state) closes 90% and cuts collisions to 0.5; for four others, +plan lifts the mean score from 10.9 to 35.3 and +state to 81.8; and 46% of failures are collision or observation loops. SpaceAct and SAPA advance evaluation to closed-loop physical interaction, showing that even with a valid plan, MLLMs remain bottlenecked by 3D visual grounding and action refinement, while offering a testbed for active multi-view exploration and explicit 3D grounding.

AI.tldr: SpaceAct是一个闭环物理动作与主动感知的交互式基准（108个实例/36个任务族，积木与机械谜题，无特权坐标），并配套SAPA时空主动探询智能体框架；评测10个前沿MLLM在6-DoF位姿输出、遮挡消解、碰撞与静力学约束下的自纠错能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM的3D评测多为静态图像被动VQA或符号化规划，不要求执行、常提供特权坐标，且忽略碰撞、静态稳定性与时间约束，无法检验真正的3D时空推理与闭环物理交互能力。
AI.method: 构建基于互锁积木与机械谜题的交互基准，要求模型旋转相机消解遮挡、读取场景内标尺、输出经扫掠碰撞与静力学校验的6-DoF位姿，并通过分屏回滚反馈自我纠正；动态任务在思考时冻结时间并提供5帧频闪。设置诊断模式（+plan、+state、no-camera、blind、L7杠杆）与SAPA主动探询智能体框架。
AI.result: 10个前沿MLLM在44个最难实例上得分4.8–79.1，7个模型对6-DoF任务解决率≤27.3%；前三名中+plan弥补44%差距但每回合仍有5.2次碰撞，+state弥补90%并将碰撞降至0.5；另四个模型+plan使均分从10.9升至35.3、+state升至81.8；46%的失败为碰撞或观测循环。
AI.conclusion: SpaceAct与SAPA将MLLM评测推进到闭环物理交互，表明即便给定有效计划，模型瓶颈仍在于3D视觉定位与动作细化；该基准可作为主动多视角探索与显式3D定位的测试平台。

title: Structure-retained low-rank adapters for weather synthesis
summary: Real-world deployment of computer vision models, particularly in outdoor scenarios, is often limited by environmental interferences, such as adverse weather. Improving model robustness across weather conditions is thus critical for reliability. However, sourcing high-quality data relevant to isolated weather effects is a significant challenge. Most datasets include changes in dynamic elements across observations of the same scene: subjects such as pedestrians and vehicles change between shots, while camera viewpoints vary. These aspects make it difficult to decouple solely weather-induced distribution shifts from the scene. In this work, we address this with a novel weather synthesis framework that utilizes structure-retaining Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA). We analyze the attention blocks in Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) and identify where relevant structural information is mostly processed during image-to-image translation. Through an architectural analysis of SDXL, we learn structural LoRA matrices for the corresponding blocks and then leverage them for weather synthesis, eliminating the need for external conditioning such as ControlNet. Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves upon existing synthesis approaches, achieving greater realism while preserving structure. This provides a robust pipeline for generating high-fidelity training and evaluation data for outdoor computer vision applications.

AI.tldr: 用结构保持 LoRA（Structure-preserving LoRA）在 SDXL 上做天气合成，无需 ControlNet 外部条件，生成结构一致的高保真天气数据以提升户外视觉模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 户外部署的视觉模型受天气干扰限制，但现有含天气变化的数据集同时存在动态元素（行人、车辆）与视角变化，导致无法将天气引起的分布漂移与场景本身解耦，缺乏高质量孤立天气效应数据。
AI.method: 分析 SDXL 的注意力块在 image-to-image 转换中处理结构信息的层位，据此为对应模块学习结构 LoRA 矩阵（structure-retaining LoRA），将其用于天气合成，从而替代 ControlNet 类外部结构条件。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在合成真实感与结构保持上优于现有天气合成方法，可作为生成高保真训练与评测数据的流水线。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构级定位结构注意力块并注入 LoRA，实现无外部条件的可控天气合成，为户外视觉任务的域泛化/鲁棒性研究提供数据生成工具。

title: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
summary: Humans routinely consume multimodal content, where textual and visual information is naturally interleaved. Although Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) can jointly generate text and images, multimodal interleaved generation remains largely underexplored. Progress in this area is hindered by two key limitations: (1) the lack of well-defined interleaved generation tasks and corresponding training data, and (2) the absence of fine-grained evaluation protocols that can reliably diagnose model performance across different capability dimensions. To this end, we present IntReal, comprising two complementary components: IntReal-100K, a real-world dataset of multimodal interleaved samples spanning four major categories, and the IntReal Evaluation Suite, which evaluates model performance across seven complementary dimensions using specialized expert models, enabling coarse-to-fine diagnosis. Extensive experiments validate our evaluation suite through low inter-metric redundancy (max pairwise absolute Spearman's $\rho \leq 0.42$ ), high agreement with human judgments (83.3% accuracy), and strong consistency across different expert evaluators (Spearman's $\rho > 0.9$ ), supporting the complementarity and reliability of our metrics. By benchmarking four families of UMMs, we show that IntReal Evaluation Suite reveals distinct strengths and weaknesses across models. Post-training experiments demonstrate the utility of IntReal-100K for improving interleaved generation and further show that training unimodal generation can also benefit interleaved generation. These findings suggest that interleaved generation can benefit from modality-specific optimization, rather than requiring joint text-image training at every stage.

AI.tldr: 提出IntReal，包含真实世界图文交错生成数据集IntReal-100K（4大类）与7维度细粒度评测套件（用专家模型打分），用于诊断Unified Multimodal Models的交错生成能力，并发现单模态生成训练可迁移增益交错生成。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）已能联合生成文本与图像，但"图文交错生成"研究不足，主要受限于：(1) 缺乏明确定义的交错生成任务与训练数据；(2) 缺乏可跨能力维度可靠诊断的细粒度评测协议。
AI.method: 构建IntReal-100K真实世界交错样本数据集（覆盖四大类别）；设计IntReal Evaluation Suite，用多个专用专家模型在七个互补维度上评分，实现由粗到细的诊断；对四个UMM族系进行基准测试，并开展基于IntReal-100K的后训练实验。
AI.result: 评测套件验证有效：指标间冗余低（最大成对|Spearman ρ|≤0.42），与人类判断一致率83.3%，不同专家评估器间一致性高（ρ>0.9）。基准测试揭示各模型在不同维度上的明显强弱差异；后训练实验表明IntReal-100K可提升交错生成，且单模态生成训练也能改善交错生成。
AI.conclusion: 交错生成可从模态特定优化中获益，而不必在每个阶段都进行文本-图像联合训练；IntReal为交错生成提供了可复用的数据与诊断基准。

title: Skeleton-Guided Geometry-Aware Auto-Labeling for Robotic Grasping: From 4-DoF Learning to 6-DoF Execution
comment: Published in The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR), OnlineFirst, September 2026
summary: Robotic grasping relies on large manually annotated datasets, which are costly to create. We introduce a straight-skeleton-based algorithm for generating two-finger grasp keypoints and identifying regions suitable for stable, feasible grasps. Our automated pipeline produces consistent grasp annotations without human intervention. We also propose the Skeleton-based Generative Grasp Convolutional Neural Network (SkelGG-CNN), a 4-DoF architecture that learns geometric grasp features from skeleton-based guidance. To extend auto-labeling to 6-DoF grasping, we develop a generalized quasi-3D skeletonization algorithm that operates directly on point clouds. Using automatically generated 4-DoF labels, SkelGG-CNN achieves accuracies of 95.42%, 96.55%, and 97.1% on Jacquard V1, Jacquard V2, and Cornell, respectively. On the GraspNet novel split, 6-DoF auto-labeling achieves an average precision of 18.33, comparable to state-of-the-art model-based approaches. In simulation, the 6-DoF method achieves success rates of 98.4% on Dex-Net and 89.1% on EGAD!. Real-world experiments with a Delta parallel robot show success rates of 97.4% on single household objects and 95.0% in cluttered scenes, outperforming state-of-the-art methods without domain adaptation. The 4-DoF pipeline adapts across environments and produces annotations approaching human-level precision, enabling efficient training of lightweight models on small datasets. The generalized 6-DoF method provides scalable, geometry-aware annotations for cluttered 3D scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出基于直骨架(skeleton)的自动抓取标注流水线(4-DoF与广义准3D 6-DoF)，并设计SkelGG-CNN学习骨架引导的几何抓取特征，实现免人工标注的高质量抓取数据生成与轻量模型训练。
AI.motivation: 机器人抓取依赖大规模人工标注数据集，成本高且标注一致性差；希望用几何先验(骨架)自动产生稳定、可行的抓取标注，从而在少量数据下高效训练轻量模型。
AI.method: 1) 基于直骨架的算法生成两指抓取关键点并识别稳定可行抓取区域，构成全自动标注流水线；2) SkelGG-CNN：4-DoF CNN架构，以骨架引导学习几何抓取特征；3) 推广到6-DoF：提出直接在点云上运行的广义准3D骨架化算法，用于杂乱3D场景的自动标注。
AI.result: 4-DoF：在Jacquard V1/V2、Cornell上准确率分别为95.42%、96.55%、97.1%；6-DoF：GraspNet novel split平均精度18.33，与SOTA基于模型方法相当；仿真成功率Dex-Net 98.4%、EGAD! 89.1%；Delta并联机器人真实实验：单一家用物体97.4%、杂乱场景95.0%，无域适应即超过SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 自动化骨架标注接近人工精度，使轻量模型可在小数据集上高效训练；广义6-DoF骨架化方法为杂乱3D场景提供可扩展、几何感知的标注，且真实机器人验证了跨环境泛化能力。

title: Automatic Iconographic Annotation of Medieval Illuminations: Comparing Generative Vision-Language Models and Supervised Discriminative Classifiers
summary: The large-scale digitisation of medieval manuscripts creates a growing need for automated iconographic indexing. We evaluate two complementary paradigms for this task on 9,735 full-folio images annotated with 2,333 TIMEL concepts: generative Vision-Language Models (VLM) and supervised discriminative classifiers (SDC). The VLM experiments evaluate fine-tuning, structured JSON decoding, taxonomybased candidates generation, and deterministic reranking. The discriminative experiments evaluate flat, hierarchy-aware, and patch-attention heads over a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Our results highlight key functional differences: ML-Decoder (SDC) achieves the strongest overall retrieval performance (precision@1 of 0.696, MRR of 0.806), with loss calibration (Asymmetric Loss) serving as the primary performance lever. While SDCs provide superior precision and reliability within a closed vocabulary, VLMs offer strong semantic generalization and broad taxonomic coverage, particularly through structured JSON targets and verify-calibrate reranking (hierarchical F1 of 0.559). Furthermore, model behavior strongly depends on concept abstraction: SDCs excel at perceptually grounded descriptive concepts, whereas VLMs provide useful hypotheses for complex interpretative scenes. Finally, we find that enforcing explicit hierarchy within model architectures limits coverage compared to spatial feature aggregation. Overall, rather than competing approaches, SDCs and VLMs emerge as complementary components for future hybrid indexing systems combining structured retrieval with exploratory annotation assistance. As a methodological contribution, we define the soft F1 metric to provide a taxonomy-aware evaluation that credits semantically close predictions based on lowest common ancestors.

AI.tldr: 本文在9,735张中世纪手稿整页图像、2,333个TIMEL概念上系统对比生成式视觉语言模型（VLM）与监督判别分类器（SDC）用于图像志索引，提出soft F1指标。
AI.motivation: 手稿大规模数字化催生自动化图像志索引需求，需厘清VLM与SDC在该细粒度、长尾、层次化概念标注任务上的功能差异与互补性。
AI.method: VLM侧评估微调、结构化JSON解码、基于分类体系的候选生成与确定性重排序；SDC侧在冻结DINOv3编码器上比较flat、层次感知与patch-attention头（ML-Decoder），并以非对称损失校准；另定义基于最低公共祖先的soft F1。
AI.result: ML-Decoder取得最佳检索性能（P@1=0.696，MRR=0.806），非对称损失为主要增益来源；VLM在结构化JSON目标与"验证-校准"重排序下层次F1达0.559，语义泛化与分类覆盖更广；SDC擅长感知性描述概念，VLM擅长复杂解释性场景；架构内显式层次约束反而降低覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: SDC与VLM并非竞争关系而是互补组件，可构建"结构化检索+探索式标注辅助"的混合索引系统。

title: Geometry-Aware Trajectory State Modeling for Few-Shot Action Recognition
comment: This work is accepted by The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: Few-shot action recognition (FSAR) requires representations that expose discriminative motion dynamics from only a few labeled videos. Recent trajectory-based methods leverage long-term point tracks for explicit temporal correspondence, but often treat trajectories as carriers of sampled visual features or summarize their motion with compact 2D displacement-based descriptors. We instead view an action as the ordered evolution of 2.5D trajectory states and their local geometric interactions. Based on this view, we introduce GeoTRAM, a geometry-aware trajectory state modeling framework for FSAR. GeoTRAM lifts sparse tracks into 2.5D trajectories, where StateMotion models ordered intra-trajectory state evolution and RelMotion captures state-conditioned local interactions through time-varying relative geometry and motion. Quality-filtered spectral sampling provides more reliable trajectory initialization; complementary semantic, motion, and depth cues are separately refined and preserved for joint spatio-temporal modeling; action-guided reweighting and top-$\rho$ trajectory selection support complementary frame- and trajectory-level matching. Experiments on five FSAR benchmarks demonstrate strong gains on the motion-centric Something-Something benchmarks while maintaining competitive performance on more appearance-driven benchmarks and a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: GeoTRAM: 将动作视为 2.5D 轨迹状态的有序演化与局部几何交互，用于少样本动作识别（StateMotion + RelMotion 双分支）。
AI.motivation: 少样本动作识别需要从少量标注视频中提取判别性运动表征。现有轨迹方法或将轨迹仅当作采样视觉特征的载体，或用紧凑的 2D 位移描述子概括运动，丢失了轨迹状态的三维/几何演化信息与轨迹间局部几何交互。
AI.method: 提出几何感知轨迹状态建模框架 GeoTRAM：将稀疏点轨迹提升为 2.5D 轨迹；StateMotion 建模轨迹内有序状态演化，RelMotion 通过时变相对几何与运动捕捉以状态为条件的局部交互；采用质量过滤的谱采样获得更可靠轨迹初始化；语义、运动、深度三类线索分别精炼并保留以做联合时空建模；引入动作引导重加权与 top-ρ 轨迹选择，支持帧级与轨迹级的互补匹配。
AI.result: 在五个 FSAR 基准上验证：运动主导的 Something-Something 系列基准有显著提升，外观主导基准保持竞争性表现，并具备良好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 以 2.5D 几何轨迹状态演化替代纯位移描述子是有效的 FSAR 表征范式；几何交互与多线索解耦精炼带来运动感知增益。属视频理解方向的表征方法，未涉具身/机器人大规模验证或 3D 重建泛化实验。

title: Calibrating Track-Query Updates at Test Time for Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) requires localizing multiple objects and maintaining their identities over time. Recent query-propagation trackers carry target-specific representations across frames and update them with current-frame image features, yet identity association remains difficult when visually similar targets overlap or cross. During such interactions, current-frame query updates may contain components directed toward nearby active tracks, which may affect identity association in later frames. To investigate this issue, we analyze track-query updates preceding identity switches (IDSWs), where the same target is assigned a different track ID. Our analysis shows that (i) propagated track-query representations change more abruptly before IDSWs, (ii) current-frame updates have larger positive projections along directions toward other active tracks, and (iii) bounding-box intersection over union (IoU) retrieves the counterpart track involved in a subsequent IDSW with high recall when that track remains active before the switch. Motivated by these findings, we propose Test-time Track-Query Calibration (TQC), a training-free and gradient-free method for query-propagation trackers. TQC calibrates the tracker output before propagation using a bounded correction estimated from update components directed toward nearby active tracks. It requires only track-query representations and bounding boxes available during inference, without retraining or architectural modification. Across nine DanceTrack and SportsMOT test settings, TQC improves HOTA and AssA in all settings and IDF1 in eight, with an average HOTA gain of +0.38 and limited inference overhead. Controlled variants on six validation settings further show that TQC's correction direction yields more consistent HOTA improvements than alternative directions with matched correction norms.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、免梯度的测试时轨迹查询校准方法TQC，针对query-propagation式多目标跟踪器，利用指向邻近活跃轨迹的更新分量做有界校正，在DanceTrack与SportsMOT九个测试设置上平均提升HOTA +0.38。
AI.motivation: query-propagation类MOT跟踪器跨帧携带目标特定表征并用当前帧特征更新，但当视觉相似目标重叠或交叉时，当前帧的query更新会混入指向其他活跃轨迹的分量，导致后续身份关联错误（IDSW）。作者先系统分析IDSW发生前的track-query更新行为以验证这一假设。
AI.method: 1) 实证分析IDSW前兆：传播的track-query表征变化更剧烈；当前帧更新在指向其他活跃轨迹方向上的正投影更大；IoU可高召回地检索出后续IDSW所涉及的对应轨迹。2) 基于上述发现设计TQC：在传播前对跟踪器输出做有界校正，校正量由指向邻近活跃轨迹的更新分量估计得到。3) 方法仅需推理时已具备的track-query表征与边界框，不重训练、不改结构、不需梯度。
AI.result: 在DanceTrack与SportsMOT共九个测试设置中，TQC全部提升HOTA与AssA，八个设置提升IDF1，平均HOTA增益+0.38，推理开销有限；在六个验证设置上的对照变体显示，在校正范数匹配条件下，TQC的校正方向比替代方向带来更一致的HOTA提升。
AI.conclusion: 证明了IDSW前的track-query更新中包含可测量的跨轨迹污染信号，并据此提出一种即插即用、零训练成本的测试时校准策略，为query-propagation跟踪器的身份保持提供了一个轻量且有效的改进方向。

title: Vision-Based Density Estimation for Adaptive Traffic Control
summary: Traffic congestion is becoming a critical challenge in rapidly growing urban centers, particularly in developing nations where rapid urbanization and inadequate transport infrastructure place increasing strain on transport networks. In highly heterogeneous and chaotic traffic flows, camera-based traffic-state estimation is limited by severe vehicle occlusion and overlap. In this paper, we propose a framework to optimize traffic flow directly from stochastic visual observations. The architecture is structurally decoupled into three primary components: (a) vehicle density estimation, (b) predictive dynamics modeling, and (c) policy optimization. The proposed methodology introduces a convolutional neural network (CNN) that learns the mapping from camera feeds to spatial density maps, utilizing an adaptive k-nearest-neighbor (k-NN) Gaussian kernel to handle varying congestion levels. This feeds into an ST3DNet predictive module for spatiotemporal forecasting, followed by a hierarchical Graph-Transformer Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) algorithm to optimize signal phases. The density estimation stage was evaluated on 40 annotated intersection images from Rambagh 4, Jaipur, India, with a reported five-fold validation mean absolute error (MAE) of $3.32 \pm 0.95$ vehicles and a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 14.5%. These results pertain to the perception component; empirical training and evaluation of the forecasting and control stages remain future work.

AI.tldr: 提出解耦框架：CNN+自适应k-NN高斯核估计车辆密度图，ST3DNet做时空预测，图-Transformer多智能体强化学习优化信号相位；仅密度估计阶段完成验证（40张路口图像，MAE 3.32±0.95辆，MAPE 14.5%）。
AI.motivation: 发展中国家快速城市化下交通拥堵严重，异构混乱车流中相机视觉受严重遮挡与重叠限制，难以可靠估计交通状态，需直接从随机视觉观测优化交通流。
AI.method: 结构解耦为三部分：(a) 卷积网络学习相机画面到空间密度图的映射，采用自适应k近邻高斯核以适配不同拥堵程度；(b) ST3DNet预测模块进行时空预测；(c) 分层图-Transformer多智能体强化学习优化信号相位。
AI.result: 仅在Jaipur Rambagh 4路口40张标注图像上评估感知模块：五折交叉验证MAE为3.32±0.95辆，MAPE为14.5%；预测与控制阶段未做实证训练与评估，缺乏端到端闭环验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以视觉密度估计缓解遮挡问题并串联预测与信号控制，但证据仅覆盖感知环节，整体框架的有效性尚未证实，属城市交通视觉感知的应用型工作。

title: Residual Motion Splatting for Continuous Space-Time Video Super-Resolution
summary: Continuous space-time video super-resolution produces a high-resolution, highframe-rate video from a low-resolution, low-frame-rate one at arbitrary spatial scales and temporal instants. Classical spatial multi-frame super-resolution has shown that detail beyond a single frame's sampling limit can be recovered by aligning complementary observations with sub-pixel precision and accumulating them on a finer grid. Existing learning-based methods largely depart from this principle: some align and fuse frames only at low resolution before regressing a continuous high-resolution representation, while others interpolate each frame to the output resolution before splatting. In both cases, the per-frame samples are resampled before fusion, so their sub-pixel positions are lost before frames are combined. Restoring this principle in a learned continuous model raises two challenges: estimating sub-pixel motion at unobserved times, and handling holes and occlusions when splatting a coarse grid onto a finer one. We address the first by predicting per-pixel continuous trajectories that refine linear optical-flow paths with smooth residual motion, using features integrated over the full video sequence. We address the second by directly splatting consecutive low-resolution features in a learned latent space onto a high-resolution grid at their predicted sub-pixel positions with predicted visibility weights, before a decoder resolves remaining ambiguities. This makes temporal interpolation and multi-frame superresolution a single operation. Our method improves both reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality on multiple standard benchmarks over the state of the art, while running up to an order of magnitude faster.

AI.tldr: 提出连续时空视频超分方法：以全序列特征预测逐像素连续轨迹（线性光流+平滑残差），在学习的潜空间中把连续低分辨率特征按亚像素位置与预测可见性权重splat到高分辨率网格，再由解码器消歧，将时间插值与多帧超分统一为单次操作。
AI.motivation: 经典多帧超分表明，以亚像素精度对齐互补观测并在更细网格上累积，可恢复超出单帧采样极限的细节。现有学习式连续时空超分在融合前先重采样（低分辨率融合或逐帧上采样后splat），丢失了亚像素位置信息，违背该原理。恢复该原理面临两大挑战：未观测时刻的亚像素运动估计，以及粗网格向细网格splat时的空洞与遮挡。
AI.method: 1) 运动：利用整段视频整合的特征预测逐像素连续轨迹，在线性光流路径上叠加平滑残差运动，得到任意时刻的亚像素位置；2) 融合：不做中间重采样，直接在学习的潜空间中将相邻低分辨率特征按预测亚像素位置、以预测可见性权重splat到高分辨率网格；3) 解码器处理剩余歧义与空洞/遮挡；时间插值与多帧超分合并为单一操作。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准上，相比SOTA同时提升重建保真度与感知质量，且运行速度最高快一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将经典“亚像素对齐+细网格累积”原理引入学习式连续时空超分是有效的：避免融合前重采样、在潜空间直接亚像素splat，可同时获得更优的重建/感知质量与显著效率优势。

title: OmniQuad: a Wheeled-Legged Hybrid Robot with Omnidirectional Wheels
summary: Combining wheeled and legged locomotion within a single robotic platform offers the potential to harness the advantages of both systems. The development of such hybrid systems remains an active area of research. While legged robots exhibit remarkable adaptability for traversing uneven and rugged terrains, their relatively low speed limits their practicality in indoor environments. Conversely, wheeled robots demonstrate higher efficiency on flat surfaces but often encounter difficulties when navigating obstacles such as steps. This paper introduces OmniQuad, a novel hybrid robot that integrates mecanum wheels with legged locomotion to exploit the benefits of both modalities. Mecanum wheels provide omnidirectional mobility, enhancing the robot's manoeuvrability by enabling agile movement in confined spaces and the ability to maintain a consistent orientation during task execution. In this work, we first present the design of a custom wheeled-foot featuring mecanum wheels. Subsequently, we describe the complete robot assembly, comprising these wheeled feet and EM-Act actuators. Finally, we detail the control scheme developed to govern the OmniQuad and evaluate its performance through experimental trials conducted in both indoor and outdoor environments.

AI.tldr: OmniQuad：将麦克纳姆轮与腿式运动结合的四足混合机器人，含定制轮足设计、EM-Act执行器装配与控制方案，并在室内外环境中完成实验评估。
AI.motivation: 腿式机器人地形适应性强但室内速度慢，轮式机器人平地高效但越障（如台阶）能力弱；将两者结合可兼顾优势，而这类混合系统仍是活跃研究方向。
AI.method: 设计带麦克纳姆轮的定制轮足，提供全向移动能力；用该轮足与EM-Act执行器组装整机；开发相应控制方案操控OmniQuad。
AI.result: 在室内与室外环境开展实验试验，评估所提控制方案与整机性能（摘要未给出定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 轮足混合设计可同时获得全向机动性与地形适应性，适用于受限空间任务与需保持恒定朝向的场景；后续需补充定量对比与越障能力验证。

title: UnMixMamba: Unmixing Guided State Space Subpixel Mapping of Crops from MODIS Time Series
summary: Subpixel mapping (SPM) of crop types from \SI{250}{m} Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) time series to field-scale Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) labels supports acreage estimation and agricultural monitoring. Three difficulties remain: (i)~spectral-temporal coupling and mixed pixels that break direct coarse-to-fine classifiers; (ii)~intra-class endmember variability that a single spectrum per crop cannot capture; and (iii)~uniform refinement on the high-resolution (HR) grid, which treats every subpixel the same, so most of the effort goes to easy pixels while errors remain in the minority class. UnMixMamba addresses them as follows. For~(i), a temporal-spectral-spatial decoupled (TSSD) factorization estimates simplex fractions and drives AAFC classification from the same mixture field, instead of mapping low-resolution (LR) observations directly to HR logits. For~(ii), \(\times 8\) abundance super-resolution and a learnable per-crop variant endmember bank reconstruct the MODIS cube at LR and HR under a linear mixing model. For~(iii), the predicted crop fractions decide where a fixed Mamba token budget is spent, so HR refinement focuses on the minority class instead of the full grid. On Alberta 2015 under a fixed spatial-block protocol, UnMixMamba reaches OA 0.8397, mIoU 0.6640, AA 0.7837, and Kappa 0.7715, ahead of ST-DRes, ESPCN, FineCrop, AgriFM, and classical SPM baselines. The task is closed-set four-crop mapping inside a known agricultural mask.

AI.tldr: UnMixMamba：以时间-光谱-空间解耦分解估计端元丰度，结合×8丰度超分与可学习逐作物变体端元库重建MODIS立方体，并用预测丰度分配Mamba token预算进行非均匀HR细化，实现250m MODIS到田块级四类作物亚像元制图。
AI.motivation: 从250m MODIS时序向AAFC田块尺度标签做作物亚像元制图，可支撑面积统计与农情监测。现有方法存在三点困难：(i) 光谱-时间耦合与混合像元使由粗到细的直接分类失效；(ii) 单一端元光谱无法刻画类内变异性；(iii) 在HR网格上均匀细化，把算力浪费在易分像元，少数类错误残留。
AI.method: 提出UnMixMamba：(1) 时间-光谱-空间解耦(TSSD)因子分解，先估计单纯形内丰度再由同一混合场驱动AAFC分类，而非把LR观测直接映射为HR logits；(2) ×8丰度超分辨率 + 可学习逐作物变体端元库，在线性混合模型下同时重建LR与HR的MODIS立方体；(3) 由预测作物丰度决定固定Mamba token预算的分配，使HR细化集中于少数类而非全网格。
AI.result: 在Alberta 2015数据、固定空间分块协议下达到OA 0.8397、mIoU 0.6640、AA 0.7837、Kappa 0.7715，优于ST-DRes、ESPCN、FineCrop、AgriFM及经典SPM基线。任务为已知农业掩膜内的闭集四类作物制图。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型驱动的分解-超分-非均匀细化框架在遥感作物制图中有效，但属遥感亚像元制图领域，缺乏机器人、3D重建、世界模型等物理AI核心要素；其"丰度引导token预算分配"思路对稀疏/少数类细化有可迁移的启发价值。

title: SaiVLA-JEPA: Evaluating Future Latent Prediction in JEPA-Conditioned VLA Control
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn to predict representations rather than pixels, offering a compact way to model how visual scenes evolve. We ask whether this predictive objective improves closed-loop control when a vision-language-action (VLA) policy already uses V-JEPA features. We call our JEPA-conditioned flow policy family SaiVLA-JEPA. It combines a vision-language model with a diffusion transformer action expert and receives features from a frozen V-JEPA encoder. Two lightweight auxiliary heads predict future representations during training and are omitted at inference, leaving the action sampler unchanged. We compare policies without JEPA features, with current JEPA conditioning, and with additional future supervision on 10,030 paired LIBERO-Plus episodes. Current JEPA conditioning reaches about 82.5% success versus 71.6% without JEPA, while future supervision provides no detectable aggregate gain at the evaluated training budget. We separately evaluate SaiVLA-JEPA-TCA, which adapts latent context, and SaiVLA-JEPA-TPA, which adapts selected parameters. The context-retry gain is a system-level result under a larger attempt budget; parameter adaptation shows no consistent advantage over the frozen policy and target controls. These results motivate assessing latent-prediction objectives through paired closed-loop rollouts rather than latent loss alone.

AI.tldr: SaiVLA-JEPA：在 VLA 流匹配策略中以冻结 V-JEPA 特征作为条件，训前加轻量未来表示预测头（推理时移除）。LIBERO-Plus 10030 组配对实验显示当前 JEPA 条件化达 82.5% 成功率（无 JEPA 为 71.6%），未来监督无显著增益。
AI.motivation: 探究 JEPA 的"预测表征而非像素"目标，在 VLA 策略已使用 V-JEPA 特征时是否还能提升闭环控制性能；并区分"当前条件化"与"额外未来监督"两种增益来源。
AI.method: VLM + 扩散 Transformer 动作专家组成的流匹配策略，动作采样器接收冻结 V-JEPA 编码器特征；训练时两个轻量辅助头预测未来表征，推理时丢弃，不改变采样器。另提出 TCA（潜上下文自适应）与 TPA（部分参数自适应）两个变体；采用配对闭环 rollout 评估。
AI.result: 当前 JEPA 条件化 ≈82.5% vs 无 JEPA 71.6%（配对 LIBERO-Plus 10030 episodes）；额外未来监督在给定训练预算下无可检测聚合增益；TCA 的 context-retry 增益属更大尝试预算下的系统级结果；TPA 相对冻结策略与目标控制无稳定优势。
AI.conclusion: 增益主要来自表征条件化而非潜空间预测目标本身；评估潜预测目标应以配对闭环 rollout 而非仅 latent loss 为准。证据限于仿真基准，缺少真机验证。

title: Similar Scores, Opposite Failures: Human Correction as an Instrument for Video Caption Evaluation
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables. Analysis code included as ancillary files. Data available on request at this https URL
summary: Video captioning models are increasingly evaluated with metrics designed for single-sentence image captions. We test whether those metrics recover human judgement on dense, multi-window video description, and find that they do not. Six frontier models captioned 196 short clips. Trained annotators post-edited every caption against a failure taxonomy fixed before annotation, once as a whole-clip overview and once window by window, and a quality-control reviewer checked each annotation, yielding 1,144 overview verdicts and 4,672 window verdicts. Reference-overlap metrics do not separate the captions reviewers accepted from those they rejected: BLEU-4 reaches an AUC of 0.510 and a CIDEr-style tf-idf cosine 0.528, and restricting references to reviewer corrections leaves BLEU-4 at 0.479 (95% CI 0.431-0.529), indistinguishable from chance. Review granularity changes what is detected. The same annotators record camera and shot errors on 2.7% of captions when reading the overview and on 12.8% when reading window by window, a 4.7x gap that holds across every robustness check we ran, on the mode most likely to need a near-total rewrite. Correct-overview rates span 54.1-72.7%, but only 4 of 15 pairwise gaps survive Bonferroni correction (5 after adjusting for reviewer and clip effects), and accuracy and derived severity order the models differently. Models with statistically indistinguishable accuracy have sharply different failure profiles, which no single scalar shows. We argue that caption evaluation should record what was wrong rather than only how often, and we report the taxonomy, the per-model profiles, the corpus properties that predict difficulty, and the code that regenerates every number in the paper.

AI.tldr: 对196个短视频用6个前沿模型生成密集多窗口视频描述，由标注员按预设失败分类法整体与逐窗口修订并经质检，共1144条整体判定和4672条窗口判定；发现BLEU-4/CIDEr类指标AUC仅约0.48-0.53，无法区分被接受与被拒描述，且评估粒度显著改变检测到的错误（镜头错误2.7% vs 12.8%）。
AI.motivation: 视频描述研究普遍沿用单句图像描述的参考重叠指标（BLEU/CIDEr等）进行评估，但这类指标是否还能反映人类对密集、多窗口视频描述的判断，缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 构建196段短片的受控评测集：6个前沿模型生成描述；标注员按预先固定的失败分类法对每条描述进行后编辑，一次作为整段概述、一次逐窗口进行；质检复核后得到1144条概述判定与4672条窗口判定。以AUC衡量参考重叠指标对"被接受/被拒"的区分能力，并做置信区间、Bonferroni多重比较校正以及审稿人与片段效应校正等稳健性检验。
AI.result: BLEU-4 AUC=0.510，tf-idf余弦式CIDEr为0.528；仅用审稿人修订作参考时BLEU-4为0.479（95% CI 0.431-0.529），与随机无异。同一标注员在概述模式下记录镜头/机位错误占2.7%，逐窗口模式为12.8%，相差4.7倍且在所有稳健性检查中稳定。整体正确率范围54.1%-72.7%，但15组两两差距中仅4组（校正审稿人与片段效应后为5组）通过Bonferroni校正；准确率与派生严重度给出不同的模型排序，且精度统计上无差异的模型失败画像差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 参考重叠指标不能替代人类判断用于密集视频描述评估；应记录"错在哪里"而非只统计"错多少次"，并应采用细粒度窗口级评估。作者公开失败分类法、各模型失败画像、预测难度的语料属性及可复现全部结果的代码。

title: Force-Driven Hook Disassembly via Constraint-Aware Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning
summary: The growing volume of end-of-life products has intensified the need for automated disassembly, yet hook-type connections remain challengin: their orientations vary, they deform under load, and their geometry is hidden, so vision alone cannot identify a feasible non-destructive disassembly direction. This work proposes a constraint-aware reinforcement learning framework that infers feasible extraction directions online from contact forces. The policy is trained in a robot-agnostic, object-centric simulation on a simplified peg-in-hole pair and deployed zero-shot on a physical robot, where it transfers to real connections with unseen, multi-stage constraint structures. Because instantaneous contact forces are noisy and locally ambiguous, the policy is coupled with a particle filter belief that provides the policy with temporally integrated directional information and reduces redundant exploratory motion. The approach is validated on four real-world tasks, from peg-in-hole pairs to the inner propeller and front cover of an end-of-life air-conditioning unit. The full method achieves success rates of 100%, 100%, 90%, and 75% with the highest path efficiency on every task, and raises the success rate on the air-conditioning cover from 45% to 75% relative to a policy trained without the belief. These results indicate that force-driven reinforcement learning can enable disassembly without product-specific models or demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出约束感知强化学习框架，利用接触力在线推断可行的无损拆解方向；结合粒子滤波信念做时间积分以抑制噪声与冗余探索，在简化peg-in-hole仿真中训练并零样本迁移到真实机器人，完成从销孔对到报废空调内风机和前面板的四类真实拆解任务。
AI.motivation: 报废产品增长使自动拆解需求上升，但钩型连接件方向多变、受载变形、几何被遮挡，纯视觉无法确定可行且无损的拉出方向，需要依赖接触力信息。
AI.method: 约束感知RL：在机器人无关、以物体为中心的仿真中用简化peg-in-hole对训练策略，部署时零样本迁移到真实机器人；因瞬时接触力噪声大且局部歧义，将策略与粒子滤波信念耦合，为其提供时间积分的方向信息，减少冗余探索；无需产品专用模型或示教。
AI.result: 四个真实任务成功率分别为100%、100%、90%、75%，且每项任务路径效率最高；相对无信念策略，空调前面板成功率由45%提升至75%。
AI.conclusion: 力驱动的强化学习可在无产品专用模型与示教条件下实现拆解，具备零样本跨结构迁移能力，粒子滤波信念对接触力歧义的消解有实质贡献。

title: The Power Watershed as a Differentiable Segmentation Layer
summary: Can a Watershed transform, the classical tool of morphological segmentation, be placed at the end of a deep network and trained through? The Power Watershed (PW) is the limit of the seeded Random Walker (RW) as p grows to infinity with edge weights raised to the power p. At every finite p the RW solves a sparse positive-definite linear system and is exactly differentiable with respect to the edge weights and the unaries through one adjoint solve; its multi-label form costs one right-hand side per label, and its limit is the PW. We study this family as the last layer of a segmentation network, the watershed layer (WS layer). A conditioning study measures how the solve, the gradient and the distance to the limit evolve with p, and the implicit gradient is checked against unrolling. On synthetic data with correct edge costs the WS layer transforms a soft prediction into an exact boundary. On nuclei segmentation (PanNuke), a binary WS layer is level with a thresholded U-Net. With the instances as labels, the WS layer turns the U-Net into an instance segmenter whose number of labels is set per image by the markers rather than by the output layout, and the network is trained through that partition: instance F1 score rises from 0.656 to 0.795 over a U-Net with connected components, level with the same network followed by a tuned marker watershed. At the training temperature the partition is a watershed of the learned costs, and the finite temperature lets the solve hedge, discounting weak markers and sharing contested pixels. The hedging puts the WS layer 0.015--0.020 F1 ahead of the baseline when trained on a tenth of the data, at the price of having to deploy the finite-p solve rather than its exact limit at inference. Code and the full experimental record are released.

AI.tldr: 将可分水岭变换（Power Watershed）作为深度分割网络末端的可微层：用有限p的种子随机游走（稀疏正定线性系统）实现精确隐式求导，多标签只需每标签一个右端项，p→∞即PW极限。
AI.motivation: 分水岭是形态学分割的经典工具，但通常作为不可微后处理；作者希望把分割的“精确边界化/实例划分”操作放进网络末端并端到端训练，使标签数量由标记（markers）而非输出布局决定。
AI.method: 以种子随机游走（权重的p次幂）逼近Power Watershed，利用单次伴随求解获得对边权与unary的精确隐式梯度；做条件性研究考察求解、梯度、到极限的距离随p的变化，并用展开（unrolling）校验隐式梯度；在合成数据与PanNuke（二类与实例设定）上把WS层接在U-Net之后训练。
AI.result: 合成数据（正确边代价）下WS层将软预测变为精确边界；PanNuke二类任务与阈值化U-Net持平；实例设定下实例F1由0.656（U-Net+连通域）提升至0.795，与调好的marker watershed后处理持平；仅用1/10数据训练时，有限温度的“对冲”行为带来0.015–0.020 F1增益，但推理需部署有限p求解而非精确极限。
AI.conclusion: 可微Power Watershed层可行且有效：隐式求导成本低、能端到端训练出实例分割能力，并通过有限温度的对冲机制在弱标记与争议像素上获益；代价是推理时必须使用有限p求解。代码与完整实验记录已开源。

title: Self-Consistency Geometry Injection for Multi-view Consistent Image Generation
summary: Recent diffusion models have achieved impressive progress in single image to multi-view generation by synthesizing consistent novel views efficiently. Existing methods usually explicitly or implicitly couple geometry inference and texture synthesis, making generation vulnerable to inaccurate geometry prediction. Although several geometry-guided methods have explored decoupling, they usually treat predicted geometry as a fixed condition and do not explicitly model whether the geometry is reliable. We therefore propose Reliability-Guided Multi-View Generation (RGMV), which comprises a parameter-free Self-Consistency Geometry Gate (SCG) and a Reliability-aware Geometry Injection (RGI) module. Specifically, a geometry proposal generator produces multiple geometry predictions for the same reference image and target viewpoints under different stochastic sampling configurations. SCG measures their spatial agreement to derive a reliability map, which RGI uses to modulate the injection strength of geometry-conditioned residuals in the RGB synthesis model. Moreover, RGMV can adapt to different geometry proposal generators. As a result, RGMV preserves stronger geometric guidance in stable regions while attenuating unreliable geometry cues before they propagate into multi-view RGB generation. Extensive experiments show that reliability-aware geometry injection improves the geometric quality of multi-view generation. Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: RGMV 通过参数无关的自一致性几何门控（SCG）与可靠性感知几何注入（RGI），在单图多视角生成中显式建模几何预测可靠性并调节条件注入强度。
AI.motivation: 现有单图多视角生成方法隐式耦合几何推断与纹理合成，对不准确的几何预测脆弱；已有解耦方法将几何视为固定条件，未建模其可靠性。
AI.method: 几何提议生成器在不同随机采样配置下对同一参考图与目标视角输出多个几何预测；SCG 度量其空间一致性得到可靠性图；RGI 用该图调制 RGB 合成模型中几何条件残差的注入强度。
AI.result: 大量实验表明可靠性感知的几何注入提升了多视角生成的几何质量；方法可适配不同几何提议生成器。
AI.conclusion: 将几何可靠性显式建模为可调制的注入权重，可在稳定区域保留更强几何引导、并抑制不可靠线索向 RGB 生成传播，是解耦式多视角生成的一种有效改进。

title: From the Superderivative to a Relative-Gradient Edge Operator
summary: First-derivative edge detectors such as Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts and Scharr measure absolute grey-level differences. We revisit the log-gradient magnitude, a relative-gradient edge operator, and motivate it by analogy with the superderivative, a multiplicative derivative in which the independent variable is perturbed multiplicatively rather than additively. In one and two dimensions the logarithm of the superderivative is a radial logarithmic derivative; its local, origin-free, isotropic analogue is the magnitude of the logarithmic gradient. The resulting operator measures relative rather than absolute change, giving an edge-strength map that is invariant under global intensity rescaling. We present the theory, show how the operator can be implemented in two steps---a classical gradient kernel plus a pointwise division---and compare it with standard first-derivative filters on synthetic images with ground-truth edges and on the official BSDS500 benchmark. We also study a parametric family that interpolates between the absolute gradient and the log-gradient; empirically, the best members are small intermediate exponents, which edge the classical kernels by a small but statistically detectable margin in the per-image metric and, with the same Gaussian smoothing as the single-$\sigma$ Canny, match it in ODS and lead it in OIS and AP, while the tuned Canny remains ahead in ODS. The single-threshold margin over the kernels does not replicate on the held-out test split, and the fully relative endpoint is never the best member, its ranking depending on the edge-map normalisation. The contribution is the construction and the invariance it buys, not a new state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视对数梯度幅值（log-gradient magnitude）这一相对梯度边缘算子，通过与"超导数"（乘性导数）类比给出理论动因，证明其对全局灰度缩放不变，可用"经典梯度核+逐点除法"两步实现，并在合成图像与BSDS500上与Sobel/Prewitt/Roberts/Scharr及Canny比较。
AI.motivation: Sobel、Prewitt、Roberts、Scharr等一阶导数边缘检测器度量的是绝对灰度差，因此边缘强度会随图像全局强度缩放而改变。作者希望通过类比"乘性扰动下的导数"（超导数），构造一个度量相对变化、对全局强度缩放不变的边缘算子，从而获得原理上更合理的边缘强度表示。
AI.method: 1) 以超导数（independent variable乘性扰动）为出发点，说明在一维/二维中其对数即径向对数导数；取局部、无原点、各向同性的类比形式即对数梯度幅值 |∇log I|；2) 该算子度量相对变化，对 I→cI 不变；3) 实现上等价于经典梯度核（如Sobel/Scharr）后再做逐点除法；4) 提出在 |∇I| 与 |∇log I| 之间插值的参数族（幂指数形式），进行消融；5) 在带真值边缘的合成图像与官方BSDS500 benchmark上与标准一阶导数滤波器及Canny对比，报告ODS/OIS/AP与单阈值指标。
AI.result: 最佳成员是小的中间幂指数，而非完全相对的端点；它们在per-image指标上以小幅但统计可检测的优势超过经典核；在与单σ Canny使用相同高斯平滑时，ODS持平、OIS与AP领先，但调优后的Canny在ODS上仍更好。单阈值下的优势在held-out测试划分上不可复现；完全相对端点从不是最优，其排名依赖边缘图归一化方式。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于算子的构造及其带来的尺度不变性，而非新的SOTA。作者明确承认：对数梯度的纯相对形式在实践中并不占优，增益来自绝对梯度与对数梯度之间的中间插值；性能提升幅度小且部分结论对划分与归一化敏感。论文定位为理论/算子层面的补充，而非替代现有边缘检测器。

title: Influence of Agent Number and Behavior on Users' Psychological Responses in VR Evacuation Training
comment: The 2nd International Workshop on Trust and Blame in Multi-Person Multi-Agent Societies (TBSA_2nd) in conjunction with HAI 2026, 7 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables
summary: This study aims to build effective drill software by combining a virtual simulation of a disaster with multiple agents capable of expressing emotions. We evaluated how the number of agents and their emotional and behavioral actions during evacuation influence users in a virtual space. The results showed that users tended to act more confidently when many agents evacuated with them, and that the evacuation route chosen by the agents influenced the users' decision-making. These findings indicate that users' evacuation behavior is shaped not only by the environment itself but also by the collective behavior of surrounding agents, underscoring the need to consider how agent behavior affects users' psychological states during training.

AI.tldr: 将多智能体（可表达情绪）与灾害虚拟仿真结合构建疏散演练软件，并实验评估智能体数量及其情绪/行为对用户疏散决策的影响。
AI.motivation: 提升灾害疏散演练软件的有效性，关注虚拟环境中他人（智能体）的集体行为如何影响受训者的心理状态与决策。
AI.method: 构建含多名具备情绪表达的智能体的灾害虚拟仿真系统；通过用户实验操纵智能体数量、情绪与疏散行为，观察其对用户疏散路线选择与信心的影响。
AI.result: 随同疏散的智能体数量越多，用户行为越自信；智能体所选疏散路线会显著影响用户的路线决策。
AI.conclusion: 用户疏散行为不仅由环境决定，还受周围智能体集体行为塑造；演练设计需考虑智能体行为对受训者心理的影响。

title: Detecting Fine-Grained Differences between Image Datasets
summary: Detecting whether and in particular how two data distributions differ is a fundamental statistical problem. For example, we might be interested in which concepts (expressed in natural language) differ between two classes, the outputs of different generative models, or the same model with different prompt specifications. When working with large and complex image datasets, we intuitively think that first selecting concepts from a broad list using fine-grained patch embeddings, and then optimizing the concepts to better fit the data is an effective workflow. However, prior work instead uses MLLMs to propose concepts and image-level embeddings to select them. Therefore, we systematically compare these techniques and find that selecting concepts from broad lists can replace MLLM-proposals at obviously lower cost. MLLM inference can then be spent on optimizing selected concepts instead to achieve substantial improvements. Additionally, by designing a new benchmark that focuses on low-prevalence and multi-concept distinctions, we find that selecting nonredundant concepts instead of only the most distinguishing concepts matters, and we introduce techniques for how to effectively do this. Finally, we show how our methods address important problems like detecting spurious correlations and biases. Overall, our work presents a fundamental perspective shift on how we analyze interpretable distributional differences between datasets.

AI.tldr: 通过系统比较发现：用细粒度patch嵌入从宽泛概念列表中选取概念可低成本替代MLLM提出概念，节省的MLLM推理预算用于优化所选概念；并强调应选非冗余而非仅最具区分性的概念。
AI.motivation: 检测两个数据分布在"哪些概念上不同"是基础统计问题；既有工作用MLLM提概念+图像级嵌入筛选，直觉上猜测patch级嵌入选概念+概念优化更有效，但缺乏系统对比。
AI.method: 系统对比概念获取/筛选技术（MLLM提议 vs. 宽泛列表+patch嵌入选择；图像级 vs. patch级嵌入）；将MLLM推理预算转移到所选概念的自然语言优化；构建聚焦低流行度与多概念区分的新基准；设计非冗余概念选择技术以减少冗余。
AI.result: 宽泛列表选择在明显更低成本下可替代MLLM提议；概念优化带来实质提升；新基准显示选非冗余概念优于仅选最区分概念；方法可检测伪相关与偏差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出一种分析数据集间可解释分布差异的新范式，以选择+优化概念的工作流取代MLLM提议流程，兼顾成本与效果。

title: A Multi-Layer Navigation System for Smart Wheelchairs with a Limited Input Interface
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Presented at IROS 2026 (IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems); to appear in the conference proceedings
summary: Smart wheelchairs are robotic devices that gather information from the surroundings and allow people to safely drive through various environments. They usually rely on the interpretation of high-level user's intentions, typically decoded through human-robot interface (HRI) or brain-machine interface (BMI). However, navigating in an unknown environment and accurately understanding user commands remain significant challenges. Misinterpretation of commands or the environment can lead to user frustration, distrust of the system, or even unsafe situations. In this paper, we present a novel Multi-Layer Navigation System (MLNS) for a smart wheelchair that enables navigation in unknown environments while interpreting and safely contextualizing user's intentions even in the case of limited and faulty commands. The stack relies on a Virtual Sensors-Driven Potential Fields (ViSPF) method for obstacle detection that accounts for the wheelchair's actual size, a Model Predictive Control (MPC) module for trajectory generation, and an open-vocabulary computer vision algorithm for target identification. Finally, a system based on Priority Queue (PQ) was implemented for target selection. We validated our system on a real smart wheelchair with experiments involving 10 participants without disabilities, including scenarios with faulty input interfaces. The results demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our system in real-world environments, proving its potential for practical applications in assistive technologies.

AI.tldr: 提出面向智能轮椅的多层导航系统（MLNS）：ViSPF虚拟传感势场避障（考虑轮椅实际尺寸）+ MPC轨迹生成 + 开放词汇视觉目标识别 + 优先队列目标选择，在真实轮椅上以10名无残障被试（含故障输入场景）验证，可在未知环境中容错解读用户意图并安全导航。
AI.motivation: 智能轮椅依赖HRI/BMI（含脑机接口）解读用户高层意图，但未知环境导航困难，命令或环境误解会导致挫败、不信任甚至不安全；需在命令有限或有误时仍能安全、有上下文地行动。
AI.method: 多层导航栈：1) Virtual Sensors-Driven Potential Fields (ViSPF) 用于考虑轮椅实际几何尺寸的障碍检测；2) MPC 模块生成轨迹；3) 开放词汇计算机视觉算法识别目标；4) 基于优先队列（PQ）的目标选择机制。各层解耦，实现容错与安全上下文化。
AI.result: 在真实智能轮椅上完成10名无残障被试实验，包含故障输入界面场景；结果表明系统在真实环境中具备鲁棒性与有效性，对高层意图误解读具有容错能力。
AI.conclusion: 模块化多层架构（势场避障+MPC+开放词汇识别+优先队列）可提升智能轮椅在未知环境与不可靠人机接口下的安全性与可用性，具备辅助技术落地潜力；但仅小规模无残障被试，缺失临床/目标人群与长时自主性评估。

title: RoSAMDepth: Robust Self-supervised Depth Estimation Leveraging Segment Anything Model
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, including supplementary material. Published in CVPR 2026
summary: Robust depth estimation aims to maintain high-quality depths across diverse conditions. However, most existing methods estimate depth without taking into account the object-level information. As a result, the predicted depth may easily deviate within objects and become blurred under adverse conditions. To overcome this weakness, we propose RoSAMDepth, a novel framework that can assist robust self-supervised depth estimation in leveraging rich and diverse object-level priors from the Segment Anything Model (SAM). We focus on incorporating object-level information across three key aspects: a segment-guided representation contrasting method that injects object-level awareness into the feature representation space; an adaptive regional outlier masking strategy combined with a regional Gaussian likelihood loss that enforces regional depth smoothness; and an object-level reliability estimation strategy that mitigates the influence of unreliable supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse weather conditions demonstrate that our method produces sharper, more accurate depth predictions, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RoSAMDepth：利用 SAM 的物体级先验增强鲁棒自监督深度估计，包含分段引导表示对比、自适应区域离群掩码+区域高斯似然损失、物体级可靠性估计三个模块。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒深度估计方法忽略物体级信息，导致预测深度在物体内部易偏移、恶劣条件下边界模糊。
AI.method: 基于自监督深度框架，从 SAM 提取物体级先验并三方面注入：(1) segment-guided representation contrasting 将物体级感知注入特征空间；(2) adaptive regional outlier masking 结合 regional Gaussian likelihood loss 强制区域深度平滑；(3) object-level reliability estimation 抑制不可靠监督的影响。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与多种天气条件下实验，深度预测更锐利、更准确，持续优于 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 物体级先验（SAM 分割）可有效提升自监督深度估计的鲁棒性与边界/区域内一致性。

title: SpectralTF-MAE: A Pre-trained Spectral Foundation Model for Tokamak Fusion Plasma Diagnostics
summary: Spectroscopic diagnostics provide rich information for characterizing plasma states in tokamak fusion experiments, while existing learning-based approaches are often designed for individual tasks and rely heavily on labeled data. In this work, we propose SpectralTF-MAE, a self-supervised spectral foundation model for tokamak plasma diagnostics. The model is pretrained on paired charge-exchange recombination spectroscopy (CXRS) and X-ray crystal spectroscopy (XCS) measurements through masked spectral reconstruction. To better capture diagnostically important spectral structures, we introduce a peak-aware masking strategy together with a peak-enhanced reconstruction objective, encouraging the model to focus on characteristic spectral regions. A shared Transformer encoder is employed to learn transferable representations across different diagnostic modalities. The pretrained model is further adapted to several downstream tasks, including plasma-parameter prediction, cross-diagnostic spectral generation, and spectral peak analysis. Experiments on EAST diagnostic data demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance across different tasks and consistently benefits from self-supervised spectral pretraining. These results indicate the potential of SpectralTF-MAE as a general and transferable representation learning framework for plasma spectroscopic diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpectralTF-MAE，面向托卡马克等离子体诊断的自监督光谱基础模型，在 CXRS 与 XCS 配对标定数据上通过掩码光谱重建预训练，采用峰值感知掩码与峰值增强重建目标，共享 Transformer 编码器跨模态学习，并迁移到参数预测、跨诊断光谱生成与谱峰分析等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的等离子体光谱诊断方法多为单任务定制且高度依赖标注数据，缺乏可跨诊断模态共享的通用表征，因此需要一个自监督、可迁移的光谱表征框架。
AI.method: 以 MAE 式掩码重建为主干，联合 CXRS 与 XCS 配对测量进行自监督预训练；引入 peak-aware masking 令掩码集中在诊断关键谱区，并加入 peak-enhanced 重建目标强化特征峰拟合；使用共享 Transformer 编码器统一两模态表征；预训练后微调至参数预测、跨诊断生成与谱峰分析。
AI.result: 在 EAST 诊断数据上，多下游任务均取得有竞争力的表现，且各任务一致受益于自监督光谱预训练，验证了跨模态预训练的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: SpectralTF-MAE 展示了作为等离子体光谱诊断通用可迁移表征学习框架的潜力；峰值先验与跨诊断共享编码器是有效的领域适配设计。

title: Data Scaling Laws in Stereo Matching: From In-domain Fitting to Cross-domain Generalization
summary: In the era of large models, stereo matching is developing towards generalizable foundation models trained on million-scale synthetic images. However, how model performance scales up with synthetic data is still underexplored. In this work, we preliminarily investigate the in-domain and cross-domain data scaling laws in stereo matching. A realistic synthetic dataset, named XStereo, containing 200 thousand samples is first built to serve as a high-quality benchmark for data scaling research. In-domain training on five large-scale datasets demonstrate a two-regime scaling behavior with data, transitioning from the standard power law to saturation, where the critical transition point is approximately invariant under a fixed model. Cross-domain performance exhibits a substantially weaker and less predictable dependence on the source-domain data scale. The distribution and coverage diversity are more effective for diminishing domain gaps. More instructive suggestions are provided for high-efficiency data construction and training. The insightful findings are significant verification and extension of the existing scaling laws in both language and vision, paving the way to efficient and stronger stereo matching. The XStereo dataset is public at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文构建20万样本的真实感合成立体匹配数据集XStereo，并系统研究立体匹配中的数据缩放律：域内呈“幂律→饱和”双阶段行为且临界点近似不变，跨域对源域数据规模依赖弱且难预测，分布与覆盖多样性更利于缩小域间隙。
AI.motivation: 大模型时代立体匹配趋向百万级合成数据训练的泛化基础模型，但模型性能如何随合成数据规模变化（缩放律）尚缺乏研究，域内与跨域数据缩放规律均未被刻画。
AI.method: 构建包含200k样本的真实感合成数据集XStereo作为数据缩放研究基准；在五个大规模数据集上进行域内训练，拟合性能-数据规模曲线；同时评估跨域性能对源域数据规模的依赖，并分析数据分布与覆盖多样性的作用。
AI.result: 域内训练表现出两段式缩放行为，由标准幂律过渡到饱和，临界转折点在固定模型下近似不变；跨域性能对源域数据规模依赖明显更弱且更难预测；分布与覆盖多样性对缩小域间隙更为有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究对语言与视觉领域已有缩放律构成验证与扩展，并为高效数据构建与训练给出指导性建议；数据集已公开。

title: V-CAPE: Visual Consistency Assessment for Product Image Editing
summary: Recent advances in generative image editing enable complex transformations such as background replacement, object manipulation, and pose adjustment from natural language instructions. However, verifying that these transformations preserve visual consistency, defined as the preservation of an object's intrinsic visual attributes, including geometry, texture, color, and fine-grained details, remains a largely unsolved problem. This challenge is particularly pronounced at scale, where manual inspection is infeasible and automated quality assessment (AutoQA) could become essential. In this work, we introduce Visual Consistency Assessment for Product Image Editing (V-CAPE), a large-scale dataset for evaluating visual consistency in generative image editing. The dataset consists of 40K unique source-target product image pairs, each annotated with binary accept/reject labels and structured failure modes capturing fine-grained inconsistencies such as geometric distortions, pose errors, and identity mismatches. V-CAPE combines real-world edited images with a synthetic subset constructed from 3D assets, enabling both realistic evaluation and controlled analysis. Vision-language models (VLMs) across all evaluated size categories on AutoQA achieve accuracy below 65%, indicating that the dataset poses a substantial challenge regardless of model scale. Our results highlight fundamental limitations of current models in verifying visual consistency under transformation, positioning V-CAPE as a benchmark for advancing fine-grained image editing evaluation.

AI.tldr: V-CAPE：4万对产品图像编辑源-目标对的大规模数据集，含接受/拒绝二元标签与细粒度失败模式标注（几何畸变、姿态错误、身份不一致），用于评估生成式图像编辑的视觉一致性；现有VLM在该基准上准确率不足65%。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像编辑已支持背景替换、物体操作、姿态调整等复杂变换，但"变换后物体内在视觉属性（几何、纹理、颜色、细节）是否保持"缺乏可规模化的自动校验手段，人工检查在大规模场景下不可行，因此需要AutoQA基准。
AI.method: 构建V-CAPE数据集：40K唯一源-目标产品图像对，每对标注二元accept/reject标签，并附加结构化失败模式（几何畸变、姿态误差、身份不匹配等细粒度不一致类别）；混合真实世界编辑图像与基于3D资产合成的子集，兼顾真实性与可控分析；随后在该数据集上系统评测不同规模VLM的AutoQA能力。
AI.result: 所有尺寸档位的VLM在AutoQA任务上准确率均低于65%，表明该数据集无论模型规模如何都构成实质性挑战，暴露当前模型在变换下视觉一致性验证上的根本局限。
AI.conclusion: V-CAPE可作为细粒度图像编辑评估的基准，推动视觉一致性验证模型的发展；但论文本身以数据集与评测为主，未提出新的方法框架。

title: TRIM: Temporal Run-Time Monitoring of 3D Object Detection via Activation Statistics
comment: 6 pages. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 23rd International Conference on Smart Communities: Improving Quality of Life using AI, Robotics and IoT (HONET)
summary: Reliable perception is essential to intelligent transportation systems, yet deep neural networks can silently miss safety-critical objects while continuing to produce apparently plausible outputs. Existing run-time monitors for 3D object detection generally assess each frame independently and therefore cannot exploit the temporal evolution of occlusion, point sparsity, and scene complexity. We present TRIM, a lightweight temporal monitor that detects missed-object failures without modifying or retraining the underlying detector. TRIM summarises intermediate activations using compact channel-wise statistics and processes short sequences of these summaries with a temporal convolutional network. Experiments on NuScenes show that temporal monitoring improves AUROC from 0.686 to 0.704 and reduces the false alarm rate at 95% recall from 0.818 to 0.759 compared with single-frame monitoring. Early and intermediate backbone features provide the strongest monitoring signal, while the temporal inference head requires only 0.159 ms on a CPU.

AI.tldr: TRIM：轻量级时序监控器，用通道级统计摘要+时序卷积网络检测3D目标检测器的漏检失效，无需修改或重训检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有3D检测的运行时监控器逐帧独立评估，无法利用遮挡、点稀疏和场景复杂度的时间演化信息，导致漏检（silent missed-object）难以被及早发现。
AI.method: 提取检测器中间激活的紧凑通道统计量作为帧级摘要，用TCN对短序列摘要进行时序建模，输出失效评分；不修改主干与检测头。
AI.result: NuScenes上AUROC由0.686升至0.704，95%召回下误报率由0.818降至0.759；骨干网络早/中层特征监控信号最强；时序推理头CPU耗时仅0.159 ms。
AI.conclusion: 时序上下文对漏检监控有稳定增益且开销极低，可作为3D检测系统的外挂式安全监控模块，但当前精度水平（AUROC≈0.70）仍偏弱。

title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
summary: Jev enables efficient decision-making with large language models (LLMs) through typed querying primitives, allowing the same semantic state to be expressed in different formats, such as binary and multiple-choice queries. However, the consistency of decisions across primitives has not been systematically evaluated. This work introduces PrimaCons, a four-axis benchmark for assessing cross-primitive consistency while preserving the semantics of the query. Evaluations across three Jev sizes reveal consistency violations across all four axes. Our analysis shows that these violations follow systematic patterns and that cross-primitive discrepancies predict decision failure with a ROC-AUC of 0.91. To mitigate these inconsistencies, we propose the Cross-Primitive Residual Calibrator (CPRC), which attaches a lightweight residual network to a frozen backbone and jointly optimizes predictive accuracy and cross-primitive consistency. Under a leave-one-domain-out protocol, CPRC reduces cross-primitive inconsistency by 58.57% and improves accuracy by +2.97%., demonstrating its effectiveness in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Our findings establish cross-primitive consistency as a key dimension for evaluating Jev and provide a practical approach to improving the reliability of its decisions. Code and benchmark is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 PrimaCons 四轴基准评估 Jev 型 LLM 决策在不同类型查询原语（二分类/多选）间的一致性，发现系统性不一致并以 ROC-AUC 0.91 预测决策失败，提出冻结主干+轻量残差网络的跨原语残差校准器 CPRC，使不一致性降低 58.57%、准确率提升 2.97%。
AI.motivation: Jev 通过类型化查询原语支持 LLM 高效决策，同一语义状态可用不同格式表达，但跨原语决策一致性从未被系统评估；若同一语义在不同原语下给出不同决策，则决策可靠性存疑。
AI.method: 构建 PrimaCons 四轴基准，在保持语义不变前提下度量跨原语一致性；在三种规模 Jev 上评测并分析不一致的模式及其与决策失败的关联；提出 CPRC——在冻结主干上附加轻量残差网络，联合优化预测准确率与跨原语一致性，并采用 leave-one-domain-out 协议验证域外泛化。
AI.result: 四个轴上均观察到一致性违背且呈系统性模式；跨原语差异可预测决策失败（ROC-AUC 0.91）；CPRC 使跨原语不一致性下降 58.57%，准确率提升 +2.97%，域内与域外均有效。
AI.conclusion: 跨原语一致性应作为评估 Jev 类决策系统的关键维度，CPRC 提供了提升决策可靠性的可行轻量方案，并公开了代码与基准。

title: The Reality Gap in Automated Driving Systems Testing: Landscape, Challenges, and Research Directions
summary: Simulation is essential for testing automated driving systems (ADS), but discrepancies between simulation and reality can undermine testing conclusions. It remains unclear which discrepancies the literature addresses and what evidence supports correspondence claims. We present a systematic mapping of 235 primary studies that measure or mitigate the reality gap in ADS testing, selected from 4,195 publications. We characterise objectives, targets, approaches, experimental setups, and evaluation evidence. Our classification distinguishes simulated and real-world execution across six ADS test components, separately for each approach and its evaluation reference. This distinguishes real-world information used to construct an approach from evidence used to evaluate its claims. Of the included studies, 76% address mitigation, primarily targeting scenario and actor realism and perception, while 94% report validation or measurement procedures. Only 61 studies report metrics from multiple families covering sensor/perception correspondence, ADS behaviour, vehicle dynamics, or safety outcomes; this coverage does not establish causal links between discrepancies and test verdicts. The synthesis highlights that real-world content and physical execution must be interpreted against the claim evaluated. The findings motivate claim-specific evaluation and component-level reporting to establish which discrepancies affect testing conclusions and when simulation evidence supports conclusions about real-world ADS behaviour.

AI.tldr: 系统性映射235项关于自动驾驶仿真"现实差距"的研究，提出按六个测试组件区分仿真/真实执行、并区分"构建依据"与"评估证据"的分类框架，指出多数研究仅做缓解、证据覆盖不足，呼吁按声明定制评估与组件级报告。
AI.motivation: 仿真对ADS测试至关重要，但仿真与现实的差异可能使测试结论失效；现有文献未清晰界定究竟关注哪些差异，以及支持"对应性"主张的证据是什么。
AI.method: 从4195篇文献中筛选235篇测量或缓解现实差距的一手研究，按目标、对象、方法、实验设置与评估证据进行系统映射；分类框架在六个ADS测试组件上区分仿真执行与真实执行，并对每种方法及其评估参照分别标注。
AI.result: 76%研究聚焦缓解（主要为场景与交通参与者真实性、感知），94%报告验证或测量流程；仅61篇报告跨多个指标族的度量（传感器/感知对应性、ADS行为、车辆动力学、安全结果），且这些覆盖不足以建立差异与测试判定之间的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界内容与物理执行须对照所评估的具体主张来解读；应推行按声明定制的评估与组件级报告，以判定哪些差异影响测试结论、以及仿真证据何时可支撑关于真实ADS行为的结论。

title: Explore Where It Matters: Targeted Exploration for Efficient Rover Adaptation
summary: Future planetary rovers will traverse steep, deformable terrain where slip, sinkage, and terrain deformation can threaten mobility. Although simulation can capture some wheel-soil effects, unmodeled deformable-terrain phenomena create sim-to-real gaps requiring deployment-time adaptation. Yet, rover operations leave little room for extensive trial-and-error. We introduce TERRA (Targeted Exploration for Reward-Relevant Adaptation), an online adaptation framework that efficiently seeks deployment data exposing task-relevant model errors and corrects them. TERRA adapts a simulation-trained world model with a reward-weighted prediction loss and trains a loss predictor to estimate where future performance-relevant errors are likely to occur, using this signal to guide exploration during MPC. In simulation, TERRA reaches approximately 90% slope-climbing success within five trials under severe out-of-distribution pretraining conditions, outperforming exploration baselines in reward, completion time, and energy to first success. On the ERNEST rover, TERRA recovers coordinated active-suspension locomotion on a deformable Mars-simulant slope within three to five real-world trials. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: TERRA proposes an online adaptation framework that uses reward-weighted prediction loss to fine-tune a simulation-trained world model and trains a loss predictor to guide MPC exploration toward reward-relevant model errors, enabling fast sim-to-real adaptation on deformable terrain.
AI.motivation: Future rovers must traverse steep, deformable terrain where slip, sinkage, and soil deformation cause sim-to-real gaps that unmodeled physics cannot capture; deployment-time trial-and-error is prohibitively costly, so adaptation must be data-efficient and targeted.
AI.method: TERRA maintains a simulation-pretrained world model and adapts it online with a reward-weighted prediction loss. A separate loss predictor estimates where future performance-relevant prediction errors are likely, and this signal is used as an exploration objective inside MPC to actively seek task-relevant deployment data.
AI.result: In simulation under severe out-of-distribution pretraining, reaches ~90% slope-climbing success within five trials, outperforming exploration baselines in reward, completion time, and energy-to-first-success.
