On the ERNEST rover, recovers coordinated active-suspension locomotion on a deformable Mars-simulant slope within 3–5 real-world trials.
AI.conclusion: Targeted, reward-aware exploration combined with online world-model correction is an effective and highly sample-efficient route to bridging deformable-terrain sim-to-real gaps, validated by real rover experiments.

title: Quantize by Doing: Task-Guided Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory footprint of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but lowering bit widths while maintaining task performance remains challenging. Existing work has used sensitivity estimates from calibration data to assign bit widths to different model components. However, using task success directly to guide mixed-precision allocation is underexplored because closed-loop evaluations are costly and the effect of quantizing one component depends on the precision of other components. To this end, we propose \textbf{QbD-VLA}, a task-guided mixed-precision quantization method that uses task success from short closed-loop evaluations to assign weight and activation bit widths while accounting for interactions between model components. Experiments covering four VLA models and all four LIBERO suites show strong task performance at average precisions of approximately 4 bits for weights and fewer than 6 bits for activations. On SIMPLER, the gain over uniform quantization is small. On a Franka Research 3 robot arm, simulation-selected allocations show no detected success-rate loss on X-VLA but fail on $\pi_{0.5}$. These findings support using task success to guide mixed-precision VLA quantization, while highlighting the need for real-world evaluation before deployment. Code is available at \href{ this https URL }{\texttt{ this http URL }}.

AI.tldr: QbD-VLA：用短闭环任务成功率指导混合精度PTQ，为VLA的权重/激活分配比特宽度并建模组件间量化交互，在4个VLA与LIBERO全套上实现约4bit权重、<6bit激活仍保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: PTQ可降低VLA显存开销，但降比特的同时保持任务性能困难。已有方法依赖校准数据的敏感度估计来分配比特宽度；直接用任务成功率指导混合精度分配很少被探索，原因是闭环评估成本高，且某组件量化效果依赖于其他组件的精度（组件间耦合）。
AI.method: 提出任务引导的混合精度量化框架：以短闭环评估得到的任务成功率为目标，对权重与激活分别分配比特宽度，显式考虑模型组件之间的量化交互（而非独立敏感度假设）。在4个VLA模型、LIBERO全部4个suite上验证，并在SIMPLER仿真与Franka Research 3真机上验证。
AI.result: 平均约4bit权重、少于6bit激活下仍保持较强任务性能；SIMPLER上相对均匀量化的增益较小；真机上由仿真选出的配置在X-VLA上未检测到成功率损失，但在π0.5上失败。
AI.conclusion: 任务成功率可作为VLA混合精度量化的有效信号，但仿真选择的分配方案不能直接迁移到真机，需要在部署前进行真实环境评估。

title: AskStream: When and What to Ask Proactively under Uncertainty in Streaming Video Understanding
comment: 42 pages, 9 figures. Project: this https URL ; Code: this https URL ; Dataset: this https URL
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models have increased interest in interaction paradigms for video understanding. The evolution from offline to streaming and proactive interaction has gradually shifted models from passive responders toward more proactive agents that can decide when to answer. However, existing proactive paradigms typically assume that the information required to answer a query is complete, leaving models to only wait or answer. In the real world, however, information is often incomplete due to uncertainty from either the video or the user. In proactive paradigms, such uncertainty can cause the model to wait forever or generate highly hallucinatory responses. We therefore argue that proactive interaction should be redefined with a third action: ask, allowing models to actively ask for missing information. To study when and what models should ask before answering, we introduce AskStream, the first multi-turn benchmark spanning video and user uncertainty for streaming video understanding, with four task categories and eight subtasks. It contains 438 videos with 2,714 manually annotated frame-level time windows across three types: wait, ask, and answer. Across both multiple-choice and open-ended settings, even the strongest model attains only 52.18% on our proposed Ask-F1 metric, highlighting substantial limitations in proactive information seeking under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出 AskStream——首个覆盖"视频不确定性"与"用户不确定性"的流式视频多轮基准，将主动交互从"等待/回答"二选一重定义为含"提问"的三动作范式，含438视频、2714个帧级标注时间窗与4类8子任务；最强模型Ask-F1仅52.18%。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式视频理解范式假设回答所需信息是完备的，模型只能在"等待"与"回答"间选择；而真实场景中视频端或用户端的不确定性常导致信息缺失，模型要么无限等待，要么产生严重幻觉。因此需要引入第三个动作"提问"，主动索取缺失信息。
AI.method: 构建多轮流式视频基准 AskStream：涵盖视频侧不确定性与用户侧不确定性，划分4类任务、8个子任务；438段视频配2,714个人工标注的帧级时间窗，标签为 wait/ask/answer 三类动作；在多项选择与开放式两种设定下评测，并提出 Ask-F1 指标衡量"何时问+问什么"的决策质量。
AI.result: 最强模型（含前沿多模态大模型）在两种设定下均表现受限，Ask-F1 最高仅 52.18%，暴露出在不确定性下的主动信息寻求能力存在显著不足。
AI.conclusion: 主动式流式视频交互需扩展为 wait/ask/answer 三动作框架；现有模型在"何时提问、提问什么"上仍远未达标，AskStream 为该方向提供了首个系统性评测载体，但本文未提出具体建模方法。

title: Geometry Matters in Packed 3D Attention
summary: Packing a 3D volume into a token sequence is not merely long-sequence modeling. Once the volume is packed, sequence order no longer encodes the geometry of the sample---so a positional mechanism indexed by sequence position can learn the memory layout rather than the object. This is a general failure mode for attention over packed geometric data. We introduce PACK3D, a local-global attention operator that separates memory layout from attention geometry. PACK3D keeps local neighborhood attention exact, compresses only distant context into contiguous 3D block summaries, and indexes every query-key interaction with axial RoPE on true token-grid coordinates rather than packed positions. Because the rotation is applied before a block is summarized, the query-to-summary logit remains a weighted sum of query-relative 3D displacements; compressed global context therefore stays spatially interpretable after packing, instead of collapsing to anonymous pooled content. We measure the failure mode directly. On a controlled synthetic task---train on one packing, change only the memory order of the tokens, hold the physical labeling rule fixed---learned positional embeddings and packed-sequence RoPE solve the training layout perfectly yet collapse under Morton, block-contiguous, and random repacking, while axial grid-coordinate RoPE stays exact throughout. The same coordinate system carries to real data: on Allen WTC-11 hiPSC microscopy, PACK3D improves over a parameter-matched 3D U-Net on the 15-structure joint task and over a matched learned-position local-global baseline, with controls isolating the coordinate system, not encoder capacity, as the source of the gain. A fused Triton implementation matches windowed-attention latency at 65k tokens while supplying the long-range context windowing cannot---so the operator is not only correct but trainable at scale.

AI.tldr: 针对「打包后的3D体数据使序列位置不再编码几何、位置编码会学成内存布局」这一通病，提出PACK3D局部-全局注意力算子：局部邻域精确注意力+远端上下文压缩为连续3D块摘要，并用真实token网格坐标上的轴向RoPE索引所有QK交互，使其对任意打包顺序保持几何一致，配Triton实现可训到65k token。
AI.motivation: 把3D体素打包成token序列后，位置编码若按序列下标索引，会学到内存排布而非物体几何；这是对打包几何数据做注意力的通用失效模式，作者希望把「内存布局」与「注意力几何」解耦。
AI.method: PACK3D：保持局部邻域注意力精确；仅将远距离上下文压缩为连续的3D块摘要；所有query-key交互使用基于真实token网格坐标的轴向RoPE（旋转在块摘要之前施加），使query-to-summary logit仍是query相对3D位移的加权和，压缩后的全局上下文保持空间可解释；另提供融合Triton实现。
AI.result: 受控合成任务中（只改变token内存顺序、固定物理标注规则），学习式位置嵌入与打包序列RoPE能完美拟合训练布局，但在Morton、块连续、随机重排下崩溃，轴向网格坐标RoPE始终精确；Allen WTC-11 hiPSC显微图像15结构联合任务上优于参数量匹配的3D U-Net与匹配的学习式位置局部-全局baseline，消融显示收益来自坐标系而非编码器容量；Triton实现在65k token时达到窗口注意力级延迟。
AI.conclusion: 打包序列的位置编码存在系统性几何失效，应以真实网格坐标RoPE替代序列位置；该算子正确、可解释且可大规模训练，但主要验证域为显微成像等体数据，尚缺机器人/具身场景证据。

title: inkGround: Benchmarking Fine-grained Visual Grounding Capabilities of Vision-Language Models for Cursive Handwriting in the Wild
summary: Human handwriting is produced as an ordered sequence of pen movements, but an offline image keeps only the final ink. Handwriting trajectory recovery aims to restore the ordered stroke points and their pen-up/pen-down transitions. Existing image-trajectory pair datasets are recorded with digitizing tablets under controlled conditions, which limits writer coverage and stylistic diversity. Moreover, there is no benchmark that measures the visual grounding capabilities of general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for the stroke trajectory recovery task. In this work, we introduce inkGround, a benchmark for stroke trajectory recovery from full-page, camera-captured handwriting. inkGround pairs 537 page images (~18.7k words, ~163k strokes) with reference trajectories produced by a pretrained offline-to-online model, filtered by OCR agreement, and verified by human raters. Because these references are pseudo-labels that represent one plausible pen trajectory, we also evaluate VLMs on the IAM-OnDB dataset, which provides recorded pen trajectories. We cast the task as text-conditioned point grounding: given a page image and a target word, the model must locate the word and output its ordered stroke points. Outputs are scored by trajectory fidelity (DTW, Chamfer distance), readability of the rendered strokes (Accurate Rate, Correct Rate), and style similarity. We benchmark four open-source and three frontier closed-source VLMs with a shared in-context prompt. Closed-source models, notably Gemini-3.1-Pro, produce legible trajectories close to the reference, and this ranking also holds on IAM-OnDB.

AI.tldr: inkGround：从整页相机拍摄手写图像恢复有序笔画轨迹的新基准，将任务建模为文本条件下的点定位，评测7个VLM并给出轨迹保真/可读性/风格相似度指标。
AI.motivation: 离线手写图像只保留最终墨迹，丢失笔画顺序与抬笔/落笔信息；现有人工轨迹数据集由数字化板在受控条件下采集，书写者覆盖与风格多样性有限；且缺乏衡量通用VLM笔画轨迹恢复视觉定位能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建inkGround基准：537张整页相机图像（约18.7k词、163k笔画），参考轨迹由预训练offline-to-online模型生成，经OCR一致性筛选并由人工标注者核验（属伪标签）；另在含真实记录笔迹的IAM-OnDB上评测。任务定义为文本条件点定位：给定页面图像与目标词，输出该词的有序笔画点。评价含轨迹保真度（DTW、Chamfer距离）、渲染笔画可读性（Accurate Rate、Correct Rate）与风格相似度。
AI.result: 以统一in-context提示评测4个开源与3个前沿闭源VLM，闭源模型（尤其Gemini-3.1-Pro）生成的轨迹接近参考且可辨识，该排序在IAM-OnDB上同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供首个面向整页相机拍摄手写的笔画轨迹恢复基准与多维度评测协议，表明前沿闭源VLM在文本条件笔画定位上显著领先开源模型，伪标签参考需配合真实记录数据交叉验证。

title: Value Function-Guided MPPI for Hierarchical Planning and Control in Off-Road Autonomous Navigation
summary: Autonomous navigation in off-road terrain is commonly achieved using hierarchical control and planning architectures that rely on explicit cost maps and one-way information flow from a high-level planner to a low-level controller, decoupling planning from the true execution cost experienced during control. We propose a hierarchical planning and control framework in which information flows bidirectionally, allowing the low-level controller to guide trajectory selection at the planning level. The highest level of the hierarchy is a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control-style planner that determines optimal trajectories and passes these waypoints to a pretrained low-level reinforcement learning (RL) controller. Rather than drawing from an explicit cost map, our MPPI planner leverages the value function of the RL controller as an implicit cost representation. In this formulation, MPPI serves as a trajectory exploration mechanism, while the low-level controller's value function guides the search. To account for the distribution shift seen by the value function between training and evaluation, we propose an online policy evaluation process that adapts the value function to unseen driving experiences, and we demonstrate this adaptation in unseen off-road simulation environments. We evaluate our approach in a high-fidelity off-road driving simulator across a range of challenging terrain conditions and compare its performance against a baseline MPPI controller. The results demonstrate that our method achieves safer and more effective navigation to goal locations while eliminating the need for explicit cost maps and enabling tighter coupling between planning and control.

AI.tldr: 提出层次化双向信息流框架：高层MPPI规划器以低层预训练RL控制器的价值函数作为隐式代价进行轨迹搜索，并用在线策略评估适配电形分布漂移，在越野仿真中优于基线MPPI。
AI.motivation: 传统层次导航架构依赖显式代价地图与单向信息流（规划→控制），使规划与真实执行代价解耦，显式代价难以刻画控制层实际可执行性；需让低层控制器反向指导高层轨迹选择。
AI.method: MPPI风格规划器采样轨迹并将路点传给冻结的预训练RL控制器；以RL价值函数替代显式代价图作为隐式代价，MPPI充当轨迹探索机制、价值函数引导搜索。为应对训练-评估分布漂移，引入在线策略评估自适应更新价值函数。
AI.result: 在高保真越野驾驶仿真器的多种挑战地形上与基线MPPI对比，目标点导航更安全有效，且无需显式代价地图。
AI.conclusion: 用RL价值函数作隐式代价可实现规划与控制的紧耦合，消除代价地图依赖；方法仅在仿真验证，未见真实机器人实验。属相邻工作范畴（控制/规划耦合、sim-to-real潜力），非核心VLA/世界模型。

title: RuleForge: Inferring and Instantiating Latent Visual Rules as Executable Programs
summary: Visual rule reasoning asks whether multimodal models can recover an abstract concept from a few examples. Existing studies either infer rules from visual examples but evaluate only classification or verbalization, or supervise executable generation with rules provided as input. Consequently, the relationship between visual rule understanding and reliable rule instantiation remains insufficiently explored. We present Bongard-Forge100k, a controlled benchmark, together with RuleForge, a backbone-agnostic framework that jointly learns visual rule understanding and rule-conditioned executable generation. The benchmark contains 108,797 problems: 86,000 for training, 19,297 for testing familiar rules, and 3,500 for testing held-out rule compositions. The framework progresses through rule-understanding training, joint understanding and scene-program supervision, and refinement via execution-grounded reinforcement learning with Understanding Replay. Executing generated programs under multiple random seeds provides verifiable feedback on executability, rule satisfaction, diversity, and robustness. With UniLIP as the primary backbone, RuleForge improves multiple-choice accuracy over the base model by 20.93 percentage points on familiar rules and 28.42 percentage points on held-out rule compositions, while increasing scene-level rule satisfaction on familiar rules from 2.91% to 70.99%. Additional experiments on InternVL3.5, Qwen3-VL, and Show-o2 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed training data and framework across diverse multimodal architectures.

AI.tldr: Bongard-Forge100k基准（10.8万题）与RuleForge框架：联合训练视觉规则理解与规则条件下的可执行场景程序生成，并以执行反馈强化学习精炼；UniLIP上熟悉规则多选题+20.93pt、held-out规则组合+28.42pt，场景级规则满足率2.91%→70.99%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉规则推理研究要么仅从视觉样例推断规则但只评测分类/语言描述，要么把规则作为输入来监督可执行程序生成，导致"视觉规则理解"与"可靠规则实例化"之间的关系未被充分探究；也缺乏可控、可验证的基准。
AI.method: 构建Bongard-Forge100k可控基准（训练86k、熟悉规则测试19,297、held-out规则组合测试3,500）。提出与骨干无关的RuleForge框架，三段式训练：(1) 规则理解训练；(2) 理解与场景程序监督的联合训练；(3) 以执行结果为奖励的强化学习精炼（含Understanding Replay机制）。在多随机种子下执行生成程序，给出可执行性、规则满足度、多样性与鲁棒性的可验证反馈。
AI.result: 以UniLIP为主干，熟悉规则多选题准确率较基线提升20.93pt，held-out规则组合提升28.42pt；熟悉规则场景级规则满足率由2.91%升至70.99%。在InternVL3.5、Qwen3-VL、Show-o2上验证训练数据与框架的跨架构有效性。
AI.conclusion: 视觉规则理解与规则条件下的可执行生成可以相互促进；借助执行落地（execution-grounded）的强化学习与可回放机制，模型从"能说出规则"走向"能按规则生成可执行场景"，且方法具有骨干无关的通用性。

title: AtomTree: A Hierarchical Framework for State-Aware Embodied Instruction Following with LLMs
summary: Embodied instruction following in interactive environments requires agents to interpret natural language commands and complete long-horizon tasks. Existing planners either rely on large labeled trajectories, or use few-shot and zero-shot LLM prompting that produces a whole plan in a single serial reasoning process. These approaches depend on linguistic common sense, commit to a plan from the initial instruction, and only update after failures, which weakens robustness and state awareness. We present AtomTree, a hierarchical framework for state-aware task planning with LLMs. AtomTree incrementally builds a tree of subgoals and actions, where the LLM decides at each step, from the current symbolic state, whether to further decompose or to output a grounded low-level action. A lightweight memory module summarizes past outcomes for reuse in later decisions. When a low-level action stalls, AtomTree triggers hierarchical backtracking replanning to return to the parent node and regenerate the subtree plan from the latest state, preventing continued drift along an incorrect trajectory. In zero-shot evaluation on the ALFRED benchmark, AtomTree outperforms prior LLM-based planners. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: AtomTree：基于LLM的分层具身任务规划框架，从当前符号状态逐步构建子目标-动作树，判断继续分解或输出可执行低级动作，并配轻量记忆模块汇总历史结果；动作卡住时触发层级回溯重规划，从最新状态重建子树，零样本ALFRED上优于既有LLM规划器。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM规划器或依赖大规模标注轨迹，或采用少样本/零样本单次串行推理一次性生成完整计划，只能依赖语言常识、初始指令即锁定计划、仅在失败后更新，导致鲁棒性与状态感知不足。
AI.method: 分层框架AtomTree：增量式构建子目标与动作组成的树；每一步由LLM基于当前符号状态决定是进一步分解子目标还是输出接地的低层动作；引入轻量记忆模块总结过去执行结果以供后续决策复用；当低层动作停滞时触发层级回溯重规划，返回父节点并从最新状态重新生成子树计划，避免沿错误轨迹持续偏移。
AI.result: 在ALFRED基准的零样本评测中，AtomTree优于此前的LLM-based规划器。
AI.conclusion: 以增量式、状态感知的树搜索式分层规划替代一次性串行规划，配合记忆复用与层级回溯，可在零样本条件下提升长程具身指令跟随的鲁棒性，为LLM任务分解与重规划提供了可复用的框架思路。

title: A 211K Parameter Foundation Model: Genetic Prompting in Neural Cellular Automata
summary: The scale of modern foundation models enables broad task generalization. In medical imaging, where segmentation demands vary widely across clinical contexts, such flexibility is invaluable. But current models, such as SAM trade adaptability for scale, locking their utility behind high-end infrastructure and leaving behind the low-resource environments most in need of diagnostic support. To bridge this gap, we introduce Foundational-NCA, a lightweight foundation model capable of adapting to a wide range of medical segmentation tasks without retraining. Built on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), Foundational-NCA incorporates gradient-based learning with genetic optimization over a latent task space, using a compact task vector to guide predictions. This enables dynamic adaptation via a genetic prompt mechanism, allowing the model to generalize across tasks while keeping the parameter count magnitudes lower at just 211 thousand, compared to SAM-based models with 38.9 to 636 million parameters. We evaluate Foundational-NCA on 15 trained and 6 entirely unseen segmentation tasks from the TotalSegmentator dataset, achieving an average Dice score of 84.5% on known tasks and 60.4% on unseen ones. These results demonstrate that task generalization is possible in ultra-compact models, laying the groundwork for resource-efficient, deployable foundation models in clinical environments where infrastructure is limited. By reducing model size by over 180 times, Foundational-NCA takes a step toward a more equitable future for medical AI, one where powerful tools are within reach of every healthcare setting.

AI.tldr: Foundational-NCA：基于神经细胞自动机（NCA）的超轻量医学分割基座模型，仅211K参数，通过潜任务空间上的遗传优化+梯度学习及“遗传提示”机制，无需重训练即可适配多种分割任务。
AI.motivation: SAM类基座模型以规模换取通用性，参数量达38.9M–636M，依赖高端算力，难以部署于低资源临床环境；而医学分割任务需求高度多样，亟需可自适应且极轻量的方案。
AI.method: 以NCA为骨干构建基座模型；将梯度学习与遗传算法优化的潜任务空间结合，用紧凑任务向量引导预测；推理时通过遗传提示机制动态适配新任务，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在TotalSegmentator的15个已训练任务和6个完全未见任务上，平均Dice分别为84.5%和60.4%；参数量较SAM类模型小180倍以上（211K vs 38.9M–636M）。
AI.conclusion: 证明超紧凑模型亦可实现任务泛化，为资源受限临床环境的可部署基座模型提供路径；属医学影像领域工作，方法思路（潜任务向量+遗传提示）可作轻量适配的参考工具。

title: Evaluating Visual Realism of AI-Generated Videos with Eye Tracking
summary: Human evaluation of AI-generated videos has so far relied on explicit human feedback, such as judgments or ratings. While these signals capture the conclusions viewers reach, they fail to offer insights into the perception that leads to them. This paper investigates eye tracking as a complementary human evaluation signal for AI-generated videos. We conducted two Visual Turing Test (VTT) experiments with a total of 90 participants on videos generated by latest generative models, in which participants watched each video twice and then gave their feedback. Across the experiments, we collected 4,286 valid eye-tracking trials on 438 videos. Our analysis indicates that gaze patterns offer informative evaluation signals that align with explicit human feedback. Building on the findings, we propose the first computational method GazeEval to predict the perceived visual realism of AI-generated videos from eye-tracking data. It achieves 71.3% accuracy in prediction, providing evidence that eye tracking data carries informative signals about how people evaluate a video. We release the study data to support further research on eye tracking for evaluating AI-generated video.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用眼动追踪作为AI生成视频人类评估的补充信号，开展两项共90人的Visual Turing Test，采集438个视频上的4286次有效眼动试验，并提出GazeEval方法从眼动数据预测视频被感知的视觉真实度，达71.3%准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统AI生成视频的人类评估依赖显式反馈（评分、判断），只能得到结论而无法揭示导致该结论的感知过程；希望引入眼动这一隐式生理信号，刻画观看者判断视频真实性的感知机制。
AI.method: 两项VTT实验，共90名参与者，观看最新生成模型生成的视频（每个视频观看两次后给反馈）；构建438视频、4286有效trial的眼动数据集；分析注视模式与显式反馈的一致性，并提出首个计算模型GazeEval，从眼动数据预测感知视觉真实度。
AI.result: 注视模式与显式人类反馈存在一致性，携带可用的评估信息；GazeEval在预测感知视觉真实度上达到71.3%准确率；研究数据公开。
AI.conclusion: 眼动数据可作为评估AI生成视频的有效互补信号，为生成视频评估提供感知层面的可解释依据，并开放数据支撑后续研究。

title: Beyond Region Memory: Local Point Tracking for Vocal Cord Localization in Video Laryngoscopy
summary: Reliable vocal-cord localization in emergency video laryngoscopy remains visually challenging due to rapid tissue deformation, specular highlights, and instrument occlusions. We propose Local Point Tracking (LPT), a robust framework that combines a single-frame detector, local point propagation, and stateless mask refinement. LPT follows a localize first, snap second pipeline. First, a single-frame semantic detector generates sparse anchors, within which LPT initializes local query points (SAM-supported by default, with a regular grid as fallback). A point-propagation module tracks these points through detector-missed frames and recovers temporal bounding boxes from their geometry. Second, because point-derived boxes can be loose around the visible boundary, a box-snap step refines the selected box to the target boundary. This decomposition keeps temporal state in local point coordinates rather than a stateful mask or whole-region representation, while the spatial refinement module handles single-frame boundary precision without feeding mask errors back into temporal memory. Extensive evaluations on two distinct datasets demonstrate that our proposed LPT method achieves strong overall performance against existing baselines, with the best mAP_50, success AUC, and missing rate on both datasets. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm that point tracking primarily enhances temporal tracking robustness, while box-snap refinement effectively improves boundary tightness.

AI.tldr: LPT提出"先定位、后吸附"的局部点跟踪框架：单帧语义检测器生成稀疏锚点并初始化局部查询点，点传播模块在检测漏帧时跟踪这些点并恢复时序边界框，再用box-snap将框精化到目标边界。
AI.motivation: 急救视频喉镜下的声带定位受组织快速形变、镜面高光与器械遮挡影响，逐帧分割/状态化掩码容易漂移且会把掩码误差累积进时序记忆。作者希望将时序状态改由局部点坐标承载，避免状态化掩码和全区域表示的脆弱性。
AI.method: 三组件解耦：(1) 单帧语义检测器输出稀疏锚点；(2) 在锚点内初始化局部查询点（默认 SAM 支持，回退为规则网格），点传播模块跨检测漏帧跟踪点并由几何恢复时序边界框；(3) 无状态 mask 精化中的 box-snap 步骤将松散的由点推导框吸附至可见目标边界。时序状态保存在局部点坐标而非掩码，空间精化不回写掩码误差。
AI.result: 在两个不同数据集上总体优于现有基线，两项数据集均取得最优 mAP_50、success AUC 与最低 missing rate。消融显示点跟踪主要提升时序鲁棒性，box-snap 主要改善边界紧致度。
AI.conclusion: 将时序建模与单帧空间精化解耦的有效性得到验证；该思路对检测漏检场景鲁棒，但整体属医疗/内窥镜领域 CV，方法可迁移性尚需非医疗场景验证。

title: Inertial Steering and Motion Prediction of Tracked Vehicles on Low-Adherence Surfaces
summary: Tracked vehicles are widely used in off-road applications, but their conventional motion models often rely on no-slip assumptions that become inaccurate on low-adherence surfaces. Rather than treating inertial effects arising from slip as a disturbance to be minimized, this work investigates how inertial effects arising from a moving mass can be deliberately exploited for steering on low-friction surfaces. A dynamic model for an articulated tracked vehicle with a passive trailer is developed, allowing inertial effects from trailer motion to be captured. The approach is experimentally evaluated on ice, where our dynamic model outperforms the kinematic baseline. We also propose a mixed dynamic-kinematic model to adapt predictions to both surface and situation by exploiting predictions from both methods. Finally, we demonstrate inertial steering on a mono-track vehicle without a conventional steering mechanism, showing that controlled movements of an internal mass can generate turning motion on ice. The resulting behavior can be predicted using the proposed dynamic model by representing the internal mass as a frictionless trailer, revealing the analogous dynamics between the two configurations. These results demonstrate the feasibility of inertial steering as an alternative steering mechanism for tracked vehicles operating in low-adherence environments.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用履带车在低附着表面上的滑移惯性效应进行转向：建立带被动拖车的铰接履带车动力学模型，在冰面上验证优于运动学基线，提出动静混合预测模型，并在无转向机构的单履带车上通过内部质量受控移动实现冰面惯性转向，且可将内部质量建模为无摩擦拖车以用同一动力学模型预测。
AI.motivation: 传统履带车运动模型依赖无滑移假设，在低附着（冰面等）场景下失效；作者不把滑移带来的惯性效应视为需抑制的扰动，而是探索将其主动利用为转向手段，以拓展低附着环境下的转向能力。
AI.method: 1）建立含被动拖车的铰接履带车动力学模型，显式捕捉拖车运动产生的惯性效应；2）提出动静混合（mixed dynamic-kinematic）模型，融合动力学与运动学预测以适配不同表面与工况；3）在冰面做实验对比；4）在无常规转向机构的单履带车上，用内部质量的受控平移产生转向，并将内部质量等效为无摩擦拖车，从而复用同一动力学模型。
AI.result: 冰面实验中动力学模型精度优于运动学基线；混合模型在多种表面/工况下提升预测适应性；单履带车演示表明内部质量受控运动可产生冰面转向，且该行为可由所提等效拖车动力学模型预测，揭示两种构型的动力学同构性。
AI.conclusion: 惯性转向可作为低附着环境下履带车辆的替代转向机制，具备可行性；动力学（含惯性/滑移）建模配合动静混合预测是实用路径，且拖车质量与内部移动质量存在等价建模关系。

title: OneScene-Bench: Do Vision-Language Models Integrate Evidence Across Views?
comment: Accepted at LM4RWD Workshop, Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly process multiple views of the same scene, but it remains unclear whether they integrate these observations into a coherent scene-level representation. Existing multi-image evaluations do not isolate this capability, as tasks may admit correct solutions through independent per-view processing without requiring cross-view correspondence. We introduce OneScene-Bench, a controlled benchmark designed to explicitly distinguish when cross-view integration is necessary. Our benchmark evaluates three complementary capabilities on real-world multi-view scenes: unique object counting, cross-view consistency, and spatial reasoning. For counting, we control object overlap across views to separate cases solvable by simple per-view aggregation from those requiring instance-level correspondence. For consistency, we introduce localized edits in shared and view-specific regions, testing whether models distinguish genuine scene contradictions from differences caused by viewpoint and visibility. For spatial reasoning, we construct object relations that require combining spatial evidence across viewpoints to compare physical proximity. We evaluate twelve state-of-the-art open-weight and proprietary VLMs and find that counting accuracy drops substantially on complementary views, ranging from 4.5-50.0%, compared with 45.5-81.5% on complete-overlap examples. Moreover, cross-view consistency remains around 50% across models, including recent proprietary VLMs, despite substantially stronger performance on spatial reasoning. Our results reveal a substantial gap between processing multiple images and integrating evidence across them, highlighting the need for evaluations that explicitly test scene-level multi-view understanding. Code and data are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: OneScene-Bench 通过受控多视图任务（实例计数、跨视图一致性、跨视角空间推理）区分"逐视图独立处理"与"真正的跨视图整合"，评测 12 个主流 VLM，发现多视图证据整合能力显著缺失。
AI.motivation: VLM 越来越多地接收同一场景的多幅视图，但现有评测无法判断模型是否把多视图整合为一致的场景级表征——许多任务可通过逐视图独立推理"蒙对"。需要一个显式隔离跨视图整合必要性的受控基准。
AI.method: 构建 OneScene-Bench，在真实多视图场景上设计三项互补任务：(1) 唯一物体计数，通过控制视图间目标重叠度，区分可逐视图聚合的样例与必须做实例级对应的互补视图样例；(2) 跨视图一致性，在共享区域与视图特有区域做局部编辑，检验模型能否区分真实场景矛盾和由视角/可见性造成的差异；(3) 空间推理，构造需跨视角合并空间证据才能比较物理邻近关系的物体关系。评测 12 个开源权重与闭源 SOTA VLM。
AI.result: 互补视图上的计数准确率降至 4.5%–50.0%，而完全重叠样例为 45.5%–81.5%；跨视图一致性在所有模型（含近期闭源模型）上仅约 50%；相对而言空间推理表现明显更强。
AI.conclusion: "处理多张图像"与"跨视图整合证据"之间存在实质性鸿沟，模型缺乏场景级多视图理解；呼吁采用显式检验跨视图整合的评测范式。

title: Selective Sliding Mode Control Enhances Robustness of Aerial Robots Under Disturbances
summary: Quadrotor control under disturbances such as wind gusts and payload variations remains challenging. First-order sliding mode control (SMC) and matched/unmatched uncertainty distinction are classical approaches; however, neither tells a practitioner which loops in a cascaded controller should be made robust to sustain disturbances, how to tune those loops, nor what the additional costs are on an embedded processor. Applying robust control uniformly across all axes addresses disturbances indiscriminately, adding tuning effort on axes where no disturbance acts. On inherently underactuated vehicles, disturbances along some axes cannot be opposed directly at all. We propose a principled methodology for deciding where robust control belongs in a cascaded architecture, with all control running onboard the vehicle. We recover the acting disturbance from PID hover flights under disturbance by inverting the equations of motion, use the recovered signal to identify and quantify the excited axes, and deploy robust control where it counts. Experiments on a Crazyflie 2.1 quadrotor under slung-payload and oblique-wind disturbances show tracking improvements concentrated on the axes the rule selects, and gain sweeps confirm that the switching gain reduces error on matched axes but has no effect on an excited unmatched axis, as the analysis predicts.

AI.tldr: 提出一种有原则的方法论：先用PID悬停飞行数据反演运动方程以恢复实际扰动量，据此识别被扰动的轴，只在"扰动真正作用"的控制环上部署鲁棒控制，并在Crazyflie 2.1上完成吊挂负载与斜风扰动实验验证。
AI.motivation: 一阶滑模控制与匹配/非匹配不确定性的经典区分为工程实践留下空白：无法告诉使用者级联控制器中哪些环需要鲁棒化、如何调参、以及嵌入式平台上的额外代价；而对所有轴统一施加鲁棒控制会带来无谓调参成本，且在欠驱动飞行器上部分轴的扰动本身无法直接对消。
AI.method: 在PID悬停飞行数据上通过反演运动方程恢复作用扰动信号；用恢复信号识别并量化被激励的轴；仅在被激励的匹配轴上启用鲁棒（滑模）控制；全部控制律在机载处理器上运行；并以增益扫描检验开关增益的作用范围。
AI.result: 吊挂负载与斜风扰动实验显示，跟踪性能提升集中在规则所选的轴上；增益扫描证实开关增益仅在匹配轴上降低误差，对被激励的非匹配轴无影响，与分析预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒控制应"按需投放"而非全局施加：基于数据反演扰动的轴选择规则可有效指导级联架构中的鲁棒环设计，降低调参负担并避免在不可控轴上做无效动作。

title: GradSplat: Gradients Inside the Forward Pass for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting predicts a scene from a few images, but our predictor is less accurate than its own Gaussians optimized per scene on those images. This gap lies mostly in the shape of the Gaussians, their scale and rotation, since optimizing the shape alone recovers almost all of it and opacity and color recover less. Gradient steps on the input views correct this shape, and the model holds these views at inference. Log-anisotropy correction changes the axis ratios of each Gaussian in log space at constant volume, and in-forward gradient refinement renders the Gaussians into the input views and applies the gradient of the photometric loss with a learned recurrent update, first to opacity and color and then to the shape. GradSplat is a feed-forward model that refines its own Gaussians by learned gradient steps inside its forward pass, with no target view. On both complete six-view RealEstate10K protocols, it has the best PSNR and SSIM among nine methods and keeps its accuracy from $6$ to $42$ input views. Without fine-tuning, it is the most accurate on DL3DV and has the best PSNR and SSIM on ScanNet++. The code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GradSplat：在前馈3DGS预测器内部用学习到的梯度步对自身高斯进行细化，重点修正高斯的形状（尺度与旋转），在无目标视图情况下缩小与传统逐场景优化的差距。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D高斯泼溅能从少量图像预测场景，但精度低于在同一批图像上逐场景优化的高斯。作者分析该差距主要来自高斯形状（尺度、旋转），而非不透明度与颜色，因此希望在前馈推理中直接修正形状。
AI.method: 两项技术：(1) 对数各向异性校正——在对数空间中保持体积不变地调整每个高斯的三轴比值；(2) 前向梯度细化——把高斯渲染到输入视图，计算光度损失梯度，用学习到的循环更新模块先作用于不透明度与颜色、再作用于形状；整个过程无需目标视图。
AI.result: 在两个完整的六视图RealEstate10K协议上，PSNR与SSIM在九种方法中最佳；输入视图数从6增至42时精度保持稳定。无需微调即在DL3DV上最准确，在ScanNet++上取得最佳PSNR与SSIM。
AI.conclusion: 将可学习的梯度细化嵌入前馈推理，可有效弥补形状层面的优化差距，实现不依赖目标视图、对输入视图数鲁棒的高精度前馈3D重建。

title: What do MLLMs know about 'Waldo'? Evaluating Visual Reasoning under Multi-Instance Multi-Object Challenges
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have led to significant progress in visual reasoning capabilities. However, existing benchmarks curate image-question pairs pertaining to object categories with few instances, enabling trivial object referencing and limited visual ambiguity. In this work, we introduce MIMO-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in a Multi-Instance per Multi-Object categories (MIMO) setting. Each image-question pair in our benchmark pertains to instances belonging to object categories with multiple instances. The presence of such similar feature distractors causes hindrance in basic visual reasoning tasks, necessitating the referring expression to be composed of multiple visual subtasks to uniquely and unambiguously identify the target object. MIMO-Bench comprises 3,802 image-question pairs across attribute binding and numerical counting tasks. Despite impressive performances on existing benchmarks, both SOTA open-source (InternVL, QwenVL) and proprietary (Gemini, GPT-5) models exhibit substantially lower performance on MIMO-Bench, highlighting their limitations in the MIMO setting. The benchmark will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 MIMO-Bench 基准，评估 MLLM 在多物体类别、每类多实例（MIMO）场景下无需依赖简单物体指代的多模态视觉推理能力，覆盖属性绑定与计数任务，共 3802 组图文问答。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 视觉推理基准的图像-问题对通常涉及实例极少的物体类别，目标指代过于简单，视觉歧义不足，无法检验模型在相似特征干扰存在时进行多步视觉子任务组合推理与消歧的能力。
AI.method: 构建 MIMO-Bench：每张图像的问答均针对含多个实例的物体类别，制造相似特征干扰项，使指代表达必须由多个视觉子任务组合才能唯一确定目标；任务维度包括属性绑定与数值计数。
AI.result: SOTA 开源模型（InternVL、QwenVL）与闭源模型（Gemini、GPT-5）在 MIMO-Bench 上性能显著低于既有基准，暴露多实例干扰设置下的明显局限。
AI.conclusion: MLLM 在存在同类多实例干扰时的视觉指代与组合推理能力仍不足，MIMO-Bench 提供了针对该薄弱环节的评测手段。

title: Learning Event-based Obstacle Avoidance via Differentiable Simulation
summary: Reliable obstacle avoidance is essential for safe quadrotor flight in unknown environments, yet conventional frame-based cameras remain challenged by motion blur, limited dynamic range, and latency under fast motion. Event cameras, with sub-millisecond latency, high dynamic range, and negligible motion blur, offer a promising alternative, but leveraging them for closed-loop control remains difficult. Existing approaches either adopt cascaded architectures that first estimate depth and then map it to control commands, introducing error propagation, or achieve end-to-end control through costly offline pretraining before online fine-tuning can even begin. We address these challenges with a CUDA-based event simulator that exploits GPU parallelism to render events efficiently within the training loop, integrated into a differentiable simulation pipeline that enables direct gradient backpropagation through the differentiable physics model, improving sample efficiency. This allows us to train an end-to-end policy that maps event frames directly to control commands, without intermediate depth estimation. We validate our approach through zero-shot real-world deployment on a quadrotor, achieving robust obstacle avoidance in both odometry-assisted and odometry-free settings, including under low-light conditions where conventional cameras typically fail.

AI.tldr: 提出基于CUDA的事件相机模拟器与可微物理仿真流水线，将事件帧直接映射为控制指令训练端到端策略，实现四旋翼零样本真机避障（含无里程计与低光场景）。
AI.motivation: 传统帧相机在快速运动下存在运动模糊、动态范围受限与延迟；事件相机虽具亚毫秒延迟与高动态范围优势，但现有用法要么采用"先深度后控制"的级联架构导致误差传播，要么依赖昂贵离线预训练才能在线微调，闭环控制应用困难。
AI.method: 利用GPU并行性构建CUDA事件模拟器，在训练循环内高效渲染事件；嵌入可微仿真流水线，使梯度可穿过可微物理模型反传，提升样本效率；从而直接训练事件帧到控制指令的端到端策略，无需中间深度估计。
AI.result: 在真实四旋翼上完成零样本部署，在有里程计辅助与无里程计两种设定下均实现稳健避障，并在传统相机通常失效的低光条件下保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 可微事件仿真+端到端策略是可落地的方案，规避了级联误差与离线预训练开销，并展示了事件感知在极端光照下的实用价值。

title: Open-World Object Motion Anticipation via Meta-Learned Semantic Adaptation
summary: Anticipating the motion of nearby objects is critical for safe and efficient robot navigation. Without a proper understanding of what may move, a robot may plan overly conservative, inefficient trajectories to guarantee safety, or it may be overly risky, resulting in unacceptable collisions. While tracking and predicting the motion of known objects has seen significant progress, little research addresses how a robot should adapt online to novel objects, including anticipating how one object may move another (e.g., a person operating a forklift to move a pallet). To enable this capability, we propose a meta-learned graph neural network that leverages a semantic, geometric, and relational history of objects to accurately predict, from a few online observations, when objects will begin to move in new environments. We demonstrate that our method, which is trained only in simulation, accurately anticipates the motion of objects unseen at training time, transfers to hardware without any fine-tuning, and outperforms a vision-language model and a class-frequency baseline in both simulation and hardware experiments. Our method's accurate prediction enables collision-free traversals in a closed-loop navigation simulation, while remaining within four seconds of the fastest, collision-prone planner.

AI.tldr: 提出元学习图神经网络，仅用少量在线观测即可预测新环境中未知物体（含物体间相互带动）何时开始运动，纯仿真训练可零微调迁移到真机。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航需预判附近物体运动，但已知物体追踪预测研究充分，对训练时未见的新物体及其被他物带动的运动缺乏在线适应能力；不预判会导致轨迹过度保守或碰撞。
AI.method: 元学习（meta-learning）框架下的图神经网络，节点编码物体的语义、几何与关系历史，以图结构建模物体间交互；通过元学习使模型从few-shot在线观测快速适应新物体与动态起始时刻预测。
AI.result: 仅仿真训练即在未见物体上准确预测运动起始，零微调迁移到真机；在仿真与硬件实验中优于视觉语言模型（VLM）基线和类别频率基线；闭环导航仿真中实现无碰撞通行，且仅比最快但易碰撞的规划器慢四秒以内。
AI.conclusion: 语义-几何-关系历史结合元学习图网络可泛化地预测新物体运动意图，支撑安全且非保守的闭环导航，并具备良好的sim-to-real迁移性。

title: AlbumVSR: Identity-Preserving Face Video Super-Resolution from a Personal Photo Album
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Nianyao Du and Xijun Wang contributed equally
summary: Severe blur, downsampling, noise, and compression can erase the identity cues needed to faithfully restore a person's face. We therefore use photographs of the same person as an external source of identity. AlbumVSR conditions a frozen, one-step streaming diffusion transformer on a personal album. We use four MagFace/CLIP set tokens to encode the album, and 64 texture tokens which come from a fused UV atlas rendered at the current window's estimated face pose. These tokens are appended to the transformer's cached cross-attention context. On an identity-disjoint VoxCeleb2 benchmark with heavy synthetic degradation, AlbumVSR raises ArcFace similarity to the ground truth from 0.586 to 0.670 and face PSNR from 24.98 to 26.71 dB. On the 91 test identities, its mean identity similarity is higher than that of all 14 baselines.

AI.tldr: AlbumVSR用个人相册作为身份先验，通过冻结的单步流式扩散Transformer的条件交叉注意力注入身份/纹理token，实现重度退化视频的人脸复原。
AI.motivation: 严重模糊、下采样、噪声与压缩会抹除忠实复原人脸所需身份线索，仅靠视频本身不可逆，需引入同一人的外部照片作为身份来源。
AI.method: 冻结的单步流式扩散Transformer；用4个MagFace/CLIP集合token编码相册，另用64个纹理token，来自在当前窗口估计人脸姿态下渲染的融合UV atlas；这些token追加到Transformer缓存的cross-attention上下文中。
AI.result: 在身份不重叠、重度合成退化的VoxCeleb2基准上，ArcFace与GT相似度从0.586提升到0.670，人脸PSNR从24.98提升至26.71 dB；91个测试身份上平均身份相似度高于全部14个基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式相册身份条件+姿态对齐UV纹理token能在不微调主干的情况下显著提升退化视频人脸复原的身份保真度，但仅在合成退化、身份级评测上验证，缺真实退化与下游任务评估。

title: Self-Supervised Doppler-Guided RF Odometry
summary: Radio-frequency (RF) sensing enables robot ego-motion estimation in darkness, smoke, and fog, yet RF odometry remains challenging because multipath and moving reflectors make cross-frame matching highly ambiguous. Existing methods often rely on auxiliary inertial sensors or ground-truth pose supervision. We present RFWalk, a self-supervised, RF-only odometry framework that models dense correspondences across range-azimuth frames as random walks on a space-time graph and learns them from unlabeled sequences through temporal cycle consistency. To rule out correspondences that are cycle-consistent but physically implausible, we introduce a Doppler consistency loss that constrains correspondence-induced motion using radial velocity measured by the RF sensor itself. Ego-motion is then recovered through robust $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ registration that suppresses uncertain correspondences and those arising from independently moving objects. Without pose labels or auxiliary sensors, RFWalk remains competitive with supervised baselines in static scenes and reduces absolute trajectory error by 58% in dynamic scenes with moving pedestrians.

AI.tldr: RFWalk：纯射频（无惯性、无位姿标签）自监督里程计，将距离-方位帧间稠密对应建模为时空图上的随机游走，用时序循环一致性学习，并引入多普勒一致性损失剔除物理不合理对应，最终用鲁棒SE(2)配准恢复自运动。
AI.motivation: RF传感可在黑暗、烟雾、雾霾中实现机器人自运动估计，但多径与运动反射体导致跨帧匹配高度歧义；现有方法依赖辅助惯性传感器或真值位姿监督。
AI.method: 以随机游走在时空图上表示稠密对应，从无标注序列中用时间循环一致性自监督学习；新增多普勒一致性损失，用RF传感器自身测得的径向速度约束对应所诱导的运动；再用鲁棒SE(2)配准抑制不确定对应及独立运动物体带来的对应。
AI.result: 无位姿标签与辅助传感器条件下，静态场景与监督基线相当；在有行人运动的动态场景中绝对轨迹误差降低58%。
AI.conclusion: 多普勒约束+循环一致性的自监督RF-only里程计是可行的，可作为无光/遮挡环境下的鲁棒定位方案。

title: Fed-IGTD: A federated learning-based framework for tabular-to-image encoding
summary: Tabular-to-image encoding methods, which transform tabular data into image-like representations, have shown promising results in predictive tasks. Despite their benefits, these methods follow a centralized paradigm, in which the data are collected and models are trained on a central device. This raises privacy and security concerns, particularly the risk of data leakage, unauthorized data collection and access to users' private information. Federated Learning (FL) provides a decentralized framework in which multiple clients jointly optimize a shared model without directly sharing training data. We introduce Fed-IGTD, a horizontal FL-based approach in which clients share a common feature space and upload only local statistics, from which the server reconstructs the global correlation matrix and obtains a feature-to-pixel mapping to train a convolutional neural network via Federated Averaging (FedAvg). We studied two differential privacy (DP) mechanisms: (i) a one-shot Gaussian mechanism protecting the correlation-aggregation step; and (ii) a client-level DP-FedAvg variant protecting the training with privacy loss composed via a Renyi-DP accountant. We evaluated Fed-IGTD on five datasets under a systematic sweep of non-IID severity and privacy budgets. Privacy protection applied to the mapping-construction step has little impact on predictive performance. By contrast, DP-FedAvg substantially degrades utility at moderate privacy budgets with a small client cohort (K=5). Ablation study indicates that this degradation is driven mainly by the injected noise rather than by uniform averaging or update clipping. Macro-F1 exhibits sensitivity to performance degradation than accuracy under non-IID heterogeneity and class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 将表格转图像的编码（IGTD）与横向联邦学习结合，提出Fed-IGTD：客户端只上传本地统计量，服务器重建全局相关矩阵得到特征-像素映射，再用FedAvg训练CNN，并比较两种差分隐私机制。
AI.motivation: 表格转图像方法虽有效但依赖集中式训练，存在隐私泄露、未授权数据收集等风险；希望在保留IGTD表示优势的同时用联邦学习实现去中心化训练并量化隐私保护的代价。
AI.method: 横向FL框架Fed-IGTD，客户端共享特征空间、仅上传本地统计量；服务器聚合得到全局相关矩阵并生成特征到像素的映射，再以FedAvg训练CNN。两种DP机制：(i) 一次性高斯机制保护相关矩阵聚合步骤；(ii) 客户端级DP-FedAvg，隐私损失用Rényi-DP记账。在5个数据集上系统扫描非IID程度与隐私预算，并做消融。
AI.result: 映射构建阶段的隐私保护对预测性能影响很小；而DP-FedAvg在中等隐私预算、小客户端规模（K=5）下显著降低效用，消融表明退化主要来自注入噪声而非均匀平均或更新裁剪；在非IID异质性与类别不平衡下Macro-F1比Accuracy更敏感。
AI.conclusion: 隐私保护放在图像映射构建环节是廉价可行的，而训练阶段加DP代价高；实际部署需在客户端数量、隐私预算与效用间权衡，并建议用Macro-F1评估联邦表格模型。

title: The Search for Statistical Indistinguishability Between Real and Fake Images
summary: Images produced by generative models appear strikingly similar to real ones. In this work, we study whether perfection has been reached by generated content in terms of matching the properties of real data. We train deep neural networks to separate real data from fake and observe their test accuracies. Only a chance performance has any scope of proving statistical indistinguishability. However, since generative models are known to sometimes introduce small errors, e.g., low level checkerboard artifacts, we create progressive abstractions of the original real/fake images to potentially bring them to a space where those artifacts get wiped away. These include operations such as blurring, downsizing, cropping, converting RGB images into edge/semantic maps, etc. To our surprise, almost none of the abstractions are able to make fake data indistinguishable from real. The only cases when neural network based classifiers fail to separate the two categories is when the data is abstracted to such an extent that the original content seems mostly lost to the human eye, e.g., downsizing a $256 \times 256$ RGB image of human face to $4 \times 4$ resolution. We observe this trend across four different datasets of varying complexity (MNIST, CelebA, FFHQ and GenImage) and across various types of generative models (GANs, VAEs, diffusion models). This shows that the nature of fake artifacts extends all the way from low level to very high level in images. The simple implication is that fake images are much more different from real than we are used to think.

AI.tldr: 通过模糊、降采样、裁剪、转边/语义图等渐进抽象，训练分类器检验生成图像与真实图像能否统计不可分；结果几乎无抽象能使二者不可分，仅内容几乎全失（如256²人脸降到4²）时才失败，说明伪造痕迹贯穿低层到高层。
AI.motivation: 检验生成模型是否已“完美”逼近真实数据分布，即真假数据是否统计不可分；并针对生成图可能残留的低层伪影（如棋盘格），试图通过抽象操作把这些伪影抹除，构造一个真假不可分的检验空间。
AI.method: 训练深度分类器区分真/假图并观察测试准确率（仅随机水平才能证明统计不可分）；对真/假图像施加渐进抽象（模糊、降采样、裁剪、RGB→边缘/语义图等），观察各抽象层级下的可分性；在MNIST、CelebA、FFHQ、GenImage四类数据集与GAN/VAE/扩散模型上统一验证。
AI.result: 几乎所有抽象下分类器仍显著高于随机水平；仅当抽象到内容对人眼基本丢失时（如256×256人脸降采样至4×4）分类器才失效。该趋势在四个数据集与三类生成模型上一致。
AI.conclusion: 伪造痕迹从低层延伸至高层语义，生成图与真图的差异比通常认为的大得多，生成模型远未达到与真实数据统计不可分；高分辨率下的“逼真”更多是感知层面的错觉，抽象层面反而易于区分。

title: LightGenBench: A Benchmark for 3D Emission Generation
summary: Recent generation methods produce 3D assets with detailed geometry and rich textures. However, these assets are non-emissive: they reflect light but emit none. We study a new task, emission generation: predicting spatially varying RGB emission over a 3D asset's surface from its geometry, non-emissive materials, and a rendered view. To support this task, we introduce LightGenBench. Our benchmark makes three contributions. First, we curate a dataset of 37k artist-authored emissive assets in UV, voxel, and multi-view form. Second, we establish baselines across four method families: UV-domain, sparse-voxel, multi-view, and segmentation-based generation. Third, we design an evaluation protocol that measures where an asset emits and how, complemented by user-study comparisons on renderings with varying emission strength. Across the four families, the sparse-voxel baseline TRELLIS.2-Emission performs best because generating emission natively in 3D avoids the failure modes of the other representations, such as the fracturing artifacts of UV space and the occluded emitters that multi-view generation cannot see. However, TRELLIS.2-Emission only reaches an IoU of 0.271, leaving the task far from solved. We hope LightGenBench establishes emission generation as a benchmarkable problem for 3D generation.

AI.tldr: 提出"自发光生成"(emission generation)新任务：由几何、非自发光材质与渲染视图预测表面空间变化的自发光；构建LightGenBench（37k艺术家资产，UV/体素/多视图三表示），比较四类方法，稀疏体素基线TRELLIS.2-Emission最优（IoU仅0.271）。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成资产仅具反照率/材质属性，缺乏自发光（发光）通道，限制了灯饰、屏幕、霓虹等可发光资产的下游应用，且该问题尚无基准化定义。
AI.method: 新任务定义 + 基准构建：整理37k艺术家制作的自发光资产（UV、体素、多视图）；建立四族基线（UV域、稀疏体素、多视图、分割驱动），其中TRELLIS.2-Emission在原生3D体素中生成发光；设计"何处发光+如何发光"的评测协议，并配合不同发光强度渲染的用户研究。
AI.result: 稀疏体素基线最佳，规避了UV空间碎裂伪影与多视图遮挡发光体不可见的问题；但最佳方法IoU仅0.271，任务远未解决。
AI.conclusion: 将自发光生成确立为3D生成领域可基准化的新问题，开源数据集与评测协议，指出纯3D原生表示的优势与巨大提升空间。

title: Catch It All!: Generalizable Dynamic Catching with a Dexterous Hand
summary: Catching arbitrary objects requires generalization to novel projectiles and real-time adaptation to unpredictable contact dynamics under noisy visual observations. This paper presents Catch It All!, a sim-to-real catching framework for humanoid robots that generalizes and adapts to unseen objects with variable physical properties for underhand and overhand catches, using only one egocentric camera. We learn policies which generalize to unseen objects with varying geometry, deformability, elasticity, and physical properties. Effective grasps which adapt real-time to object poses and shapes are learned through careful grasp reward design. We provide safety-aware curricula which enable safe, high-frequency action execution near hardware limits, including wrist torque limits as low as 5 Nm. We validate our system by deploying zero-shot on a Unitree G1. With only one egocentric camera, Catch It All! successfully performs underhand and overhand catches on 9 unseen objects not seen during training, including low-rebound plushes, semi-deformable toys and chip bags, and rigid-elastic objects with high rebound on contact.

AI.tldr: 提出 Catch It All! 人形机器人仿真到现实抓接框架，仅用单个第一人称相机，通过抓取奖励设计与安全感知课程学习，实现对未见物体的正手/反手抓接泛化与实时自适应。
AI.motivation: 任意物体抓接需泛化到新投射物，并在噪声视觉观测与不可预测接触动力学下实时适应；现有工作多限于固定物体集或缺乏硬件安全约束下的高频执行能力。
AI.method: 学习可泛化到几何、形变、弹性等物理属性各异物体的抓取策略；通过精心的抓取奖励设计获得随物体位姿与形状实时自适应的有效抓取；引入安全感知课程（含腕部力矩低至5 Nm限制）实现接近硬件极限的安全高频动作执行；单目第一人称相机输入，零样本部署于Unitree G1。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1上零样本部署，仅用一个第一人称相机即成功完成对9个训练未见物体的正手与反手抓接，涵盖低回弹毛绒玩具、半形变玩具与薯片袋、以及接触高回弹的刚弹性物体。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了单目视觉人形机器人抓接的可泛化性与硬件安全约束下的实时自适应能力，为通用动态操作提供可行路径。

title: Robotic Data Inoculation
summary: Modern robot learning systems feed on high-quality demonstration data, and their performance hinges on coverage. Without good coverage, small errors compound and the policy can quickly go into out-of-distribution states from which it cannot recover. Yet there is no principled way of collecting high-coverage data, and data collection often relies on heuristic instructions to human operators. Purely online reinforcement learning (RL) explores at the cost of safety and sample efficiency, while DAgger-style interventions require the policy to fail by chance before a human can correct it. In this paper, we ask instead whether we can modify how the robot behaves during data collection to collect more useful data. We propose Data Inoculation (DI), a shared-control framework in which a human provide closed-loop teleoperation commands while a residual policy perturbs these commands. The residual policy is trained online, on the growing dataset, with the same reward-maximizing objective later used for policy extraction, so its perturbations steer data collection toward the deviations a policy trained on the data would make. These perturbations expose the robot to a wider range of states, while the human's continuous corrections provide recovery demonstrations, "inoculating" the dataset against the learner's future mistakes while the human remains in control. On three challenging real-world robotic tasks, DI consistently improves or matches the success rate of policies trained with both behavioral cloning and offline RL, showing DI as an effective data collection strategy for improving downstream policy performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Data Inoculation (DI)：人在环遥操作提供闭环指令，同时用在线训练、与策略提取同目标（reward-maximizing）的残差策略扰动这些指令，从而在人类纠正下采集更广状态覆盖并附带恢复示范的示教数据，在三个真实机器人任务上优于/持平 BC 与 offline RL。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习依赖高覆盖示教数据，覆盖不足会使小误差复合进入 OOD 状态；现有采集依赖启发式人工指令，纯在线 RL 不安全且样本低效，DAgger 式干预需策略先偶然失败才被纠正。作者转而修改"采集时机器人行为"以提升数据效用。
AI.method: 共享控制框架：人类给出闭环遥操作命令，残差策略对其施加扰动；残差策略在线于增长中的数据集上训练，优化目标与后续策略提取一致的 reward-maximizing 目标，使扰动指向"用该数据训练的策略会犯的偏差"。人类连续纠正同时充当恢复示范，实现"数据接种"，且控制权始终在人手中。
AI.result: 在三个具有挑战性的真实机器人任务上，DI 相比 behavioral cloning 与 offline RL 训练的策略，成功率一致提升或持平。
AI.conclusion: 将"扰动—纠正"结构化地耦合进遥操作采集循环，可在无需策略真实失败的前提下系统性地扩大状态覆盖并注入恢复示范，是一种有效、可落地的示教数据采集策略增强手段。

title: Controlling Continuum Robot Shape in Enclosed Space with Embedded Sensing using IMU and Actuator Feedback
summary: Controlling continuum robots' shape to operate in confined, enclosed environments is challenging, since it cannot rely on external observation. Existing embedded shape sensing methods, although they can provide shape reconstruction, are insufficient to enable real-time shape control due to limitations in reconstruction accuracy, computational speed, and compatibility with shape-state representation. In this work, we present an embedded shape-sensing framework that uses readily available IMU and actuator feedback to reconstruct the continuum-robot shape with a neural network, providing accurate shape feedback at $400~\mathrm{Hz}$ for physical closed-loop control. We systematically investigate four key reconstruction design choices: shape-state representation, network architecture, training objective, and sensing inputs, through more than $5{,}000$ trained models on one- and three-segment continuum robots. The selected framework achieves global shape errors of $0.9\%L$ and $1.7\%L$ (of the robot length) for the one- and three-segment systems, respectively. In closed-loop control, one-segment tip tracking achieves a $6.1\%L$ error and three-segment shape control achieves a $2.3\%L$ global shape error, whereas IMU--PCC reconstruction using the same uncompensated measurements fails. Enclosed-space experiments further demonstrate operation without external observation. These results provide a practical framework for translating readily available embedded sensing into high-rate feedback for continuum robot closed-loop control.

AI.tldr: 提出嵌入式形状感知框架，用IMU与驱动反馈经神经网络以400Hz重建连续体机器人形状，实现无外部观测的闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 连续体机器人在受限封闭空间中操作时无法依赖外部视觉观测，现有嵌入传感方法在重建精度、计算速度和形状状态表示兼容性上不足，难以支撑实时形状闭环控制。
AI.method: 以易得的IMU与执行器反馈为输入，用神经网络重建形状；在单段与三段连续体机器人上训练超过5000个模型，系统消融四类设计选择：形状状态表示、网络架构、训练目标、传感输入配置；输出400Hz形状反馈用于物理闭环控制。
AI.result: 全局形状误差0.9%L（单段）与1.7%L（三段）；闭环中单段末端跟踪误差6.1%L，三段全局形状误差2.3%L；相同未补偿测量下的IMU-PCC重建方法失败；封闭空间实验验证无外部观测运行。
AI.conclusion: 为将低成本嵌入传感转化为高速率反馈提供了可实践框架，弥合了嵌入式形状感知与连续体机器人实时闭环控制之间的差距。

title: Tactus: Tactile & Pose Sensing Glove for Natural Dexterity Data Collection
summary: Collecting naturalistic human manipulation demonstrations with accurate contact force and hand pose is essential for robot dexterous manipulation policy and foundational world model learning - yet no existing wearable platform provides both calibrated fingertip force sensing and occlusion-resilient hand tracking in a form factor that preserves natural manipulation behavior. We present Tactus, a textile-integrated sensing glove that co-optimizes three design pillars: (1) a thin, conformal 3D-knit form factor (1.5 mm fingertip stackup) designed to minimize interference with natural manipulation, (2) strategically placed capacitive tactile sensors at manipulation-relevant regions informed by empirical contact studies, and (3) IMU-fused pose tracking that maintains accuracy through the hand-object occlusions where manipulation data is most valuable. Tactus includes a documented calibration pipeline for cross-glove consistency and per-session calibration for subject-dependent correction. To enable objective comparison, we introduce standardized benchmarking protocols for tactile force regression and hand pose estimation, and apply them to Tactus and two commercially available tactile gloves - to our knowledge the first quantitative cross-platform evaluation of this kind. Tactus resolves a minimum detectable force of 0.59 N at 95% confidence, 1.6 - 2.7x lower than the commercial baselines, and with 0.87 cross-participant consistency, while our pose tracking sustains 11.0 mm fingertip keypoint relative error during manipulation, when occlusion is heaviest. We show that these combined signals support object property estimation, slip detection, and representative recording of hand-object interaction - yielding demonstration data with the fidelity required for contact-aware manipulation policies and world models.

AI.tldr: Tactus：一种织物集成传感手套，融合薄型3D针织结构、电容式触觉传感与IMU融合位姿跟踪，提供跨平台触觉力回归与手部位姿估计基准，力分辨率0.59 N，遮挡下手部关键点误差11.0 mm。
AI.motivation: 自然人类操作演示需要同时具备标定过的指尖力感知与抗遮挡手部跟踪的可穿戴设备，而现有商用触觉手套无法兼顾，且干扰自然操作行为、缺乏跨平台定量比较。
AI.method: 三项协同设计：(1) 1.5 mm指尖堆叠的薄型共形3D针织形态；(2) 依据实证接触研究在操作相关区域布置电容式触觉传感器；(3) IMU融合位姿跟踪以抵抗手-物遮挡。配套跨手套一致性标定流程与会话级个体校正；提出触觉力回归与手部位姿估计的标准化基准，并对比Tactus与两款商用触觉手套。
AI.result: 95%置信度下最小可检测力0.59 N，比商用基线低1.6–2.7倍；跨被试一致性0.87；遮挡最严重时手部操作中指尖关键点相对误差11.0 mm。联合信号可支撑物体属性估计、滑移检测与手-物交互记录。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次给出触觉手套跨平台定量评测，所采演示数据可满足接触感知操作策略与世界模型训练所需的保真度。

title: CAPTURER: A Dexterous Aerial Manipulator for Dynamic and Precise Grasping across Diverse Environments
summary: As a representative form of embodied robotic interaction, aerial grasping requires close coordination between the aerial platform and manipulator. Most existing systems perform aerial grasping with static or slowly moving targets under fixed scenarios. Dynamic and precise grasping across different conditions introduces additional challenges, including target motion, localization drift, dynamic coupling, and external disturbances. In this work, we present CAPTURER, a dexterous aerial manipulator for centimeter-level grasping across diverse environments. To achieve the challenging goal, we first develop an onboard perception system for state estimation and target detection. Drift correction and global pose transformation are introduced to improve target localization during flight. A cooperative motion planner is proposed to coordinate the mobility of the aerial platform with the dexterity of the manipulator according to the relative target state. To maintain grasping accuracy under disturbances, we design a disturbance-rejection controller to compensate for dynamic coupling, model uncertainty, and external disturbances. The capability of CAPTURER is validated through indoor and outdoor experiments with both static and moving targets. The results demonstrate that CAPTURER achieves centimeter-level grasping accuracy for a marker pen measuring only 1.5 cm in diameter at flight speeds exceeding 1.5 m/s.

AI.tldr: CAPTURER：面向多环境的厘米级空中抓取灵巧机械臂系统，包含机载感知/目标定位漂移校正、移动平台-机械臂协同运动规划、抗扰控制器，实现>1.5 m/s飞行速度下抓取直径1.5 cm马克笔的厘米级精度。
AI.motivation: 现有空中抓取系统多在固定场景、静态或慢速目标下工作；动态、跨场景的精确抓取面临目标运动、定位漂移、动态耦合与外部扰动等额外挑战。
AI.method: 1) 机载感知系统做状态估计与目标检测，引入漂移校正与全局位姿变换以改善飞行中目标定位；2) 协同运动规划器依据相对目标状态协调平台机动性与机械臂灵巧性；3) 抗扰控制器补偿动态耦合、模型不确定性与外部扰动。
AI.result: 室内外实验（静态与移动目标）验证：飞行速度超过1.5 m/s时，对直径仅1.5 cm的马克笔实现厘米级抓取精度。
AI.conclusion: 完整系统级实现+多场景真机验证，属移动/空中操作控制与感知的扎实增量工作，但非核心关注方向（VLA/世界模型/3D重建/交互恢复）。

title: Tracking Task Progress Through Errors and Recovery:A Benchmark and Recurrent Distributional Model
summary: Operational strategies for long-horizon robotic tasks require reliable evaluation to determine whether execution is progressing, stalling, regressing, or recovering from errors. Yet real- world robot datasets that capture error recovery and provide frame-level error annotations remain scarce. To address this gap, we introduce and open-source ReSTEP, a dataset of 3,156 episodes across two manipulation tasks with semantic stage labels and frame-level er- ror annotations. ReSTEP supports training and benchmarking progress monitors through successful execution, mistakes, and recovery. Existing progress estimators can struggle to distinguish visually similar task stages and maintain temporally consistent predictions while responding to genuine setbacks. We therefore propose REMORA, an online progress esti- mator that combines recurrent visual memory, distributional prediction, and causal peak selection. Memory retains execution history to help resolve visual ambiguity, while distribu- tional prediction represents alternative progress hypotheses and causal peak selection tracks a supported hypothesis over time. Together, these components enable consistent progress tracking that remains responsive to errors and recovery. Experiments on both ReSTEP tasks demonstrate that REMORA outperforms the state-of-the-art SARM baseline in progress ac- curacy and temporal consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出ReSTEP数据集（3156条episode，两个操作任务，含语义阶段标签与帧级错误标注）与REMORA在线进度估计器（循环视觉记忆+分布预测+因果峰值选择），在进度准确率与时间一致性上优于SARM。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作需要可靠的执行进度评估来判断是否推进、停滞、回退或从错误中恢复，但包含错误恢复与帧级错误标注的真实机器人数据集稀缺，且现有进度估计器难以区分视觉相似阶段、难以在时间上保持一致同时对真实挫折响应。
AI.method: 开源ReSTEP数据集，覆盖成功执行、失误与恢复过程；提出REMORA在线进度估计器，三大组件：循环视觉记忆（保留执行历史以消解视觉歧义）、分布预测（表示多种进度假设）、因果峰值选择（随时间追踪有支撑的假设）。
AI.result: 在两个ReSTEP任务的实验中，REMORA在进度准确率与时间一致性指标上均超过SOTA基线SARM。
AI.conclusion: 帧级错误标注与错误恢复数据可支撑进度监控的训练与评测；记忆、分布化预测与因果峰值选择三者结合能实现既一致又对错误与恢复敏感的在线进度跟踪。

title: Actuator-Aware Observer Inputs for Cascade ADRC of Quadrotors Under Rotor Lag, Measurement Delay and Sensor Noise
comment: 19 pages. MATLAB and PX4 SITL evaluation. Code, controller gains, random seeds, and per-seed results: this https URL
summary: In sampled cascade linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) of quadrotors, the extended-state observer typically receives the instantaneous command, although the delayed measurement reflects an earlier, rotor-filtered acceleration. This paper proposes actuator-aware (AA) observer inputs: altitude and attitude observers use limited virtual inputs filtered by an assumed rotor model and aligned with the measurement delay, and horizontal observers use acceleration reconstructed from measured attitude. Fixed gains are selected on the discrete-time model under sensitivity and step-response requirements and stationary covariance ceilings on each channel's control variance and increment and on the noise-induced inner-loop increment of the full cascade. In paired set-point trials, PID-Budget, AA-Budget and AA-HalfGain reach mean RMSEs of 65.5, 19.2 and 16.9~mm; under a stricter common cascade ceiling, the AA designs reach 29.9 and 26.4~mm versus 72.3~mm for a PID that uses roughly double their rotor-command increment. PX4 software-in-the-loop runs reproduce these results. Behind EKF2, a noise model fitted to the estimation errors predicts the roll/pitch and yaw increments within 5\% on held-out and out-of-sample runs and the total rotor-command increment within 14\%. Redesigned for this stack under the same sensitivity and response specification and estimator-aware ceilings, AA-Budget-E reduces the set-point RMSE from 59.1~mm (PID-E) to 44.0~mm with a lower rotor-command increment in every paired set-point and lemniscate run (mean S6 rotor-command-increment reductions relative to PID-E: 45\% before and 15\% after output quantization); AA-HalfGain-E beats PID-E only on the lemniscate. The evidence is simulation-based, and the ceilings are nominal tuning constraints.

AI.tldr: 采样串级LADRC四旋翼控制中，将观测器输入改为"执行器感知"信号（经转子模型滤波并延迟对齐的虚拟输入、由实测姿态重构的水平加速度），在灵敏度/阶跃响应与协方差上限约束下整定固定增益，使定点跟踪RMSE由65.5 mm降至16.9–19.2 mm，并在PX4 SITL与EKF2在环条件下验证。
AI.motivation: 采样串级LADRC中扩展状态观测器通常接收瞬时指令，而实际测量反映的是延迟且经转子滤波的更早加速度，二者不匹配导致观测器输入与量测失配，进而限制跟踪精度与鲁棒性。作者希望在保持固定增益、可工程部署的前提下消除这一失配。
AI.method: 提出执行器感知观测器输入：高度与姿态通道使用经假设转子模型滤波、并与测量延迟对齐的限幅虚拟输入；水平通道使用由实测姿态重构的加速度。在离散时间模型上按灵敏度与阶跃响应指标，加上各通道控制量/增量及全串级噪声诱导内环增量的平稳协方差上限，选取固定增益；并以拟合EKF2估计误差的噪声模型做预测校验。
AI.result: 成对定点试验平均RMSE：PID-Budget 65.5 mm、AA-Budget 19.2 mm、AA-HalfGain 16.9 mm；更严格的公共串级上限下AA为29.9/26.4 mm，而转子指令增量约为其两倍的PID为72.3 mm。PX4软件在环复现该结果；EKF2后噪声模型对滚转/俯仰与偏航增量预测误差在留出与样本外运行中均<5%，总转子指令增量误差<14%。重设计的AA-Budget-E将定点RMSE由59.1 mm（PID-E）降至44.0 mm，且所有成对定点与八字轨迹运行转子指令增量更低（S6平均降低45%/量化后15%）；AA-HalfGain-E仅在八字轨迹优于PID-E。
AI.conclusion: 观测器输入与执行器/延迟失配是可观且可修的增益外性能瓶颈；简单的执行器感知输入重设计在不增加带宽的前提下显著提升定点精度并降低控制增量。局限在于证据完全基于仿真、协方差上限属名义整定约束，真实平台验证仍待补充。

title: Kinematic Causal Attribution: Black-Box Explanations of Motion versus Geometry for 4D Point-Cloud Video Models
summary: 4D perception models, which classify 3D point-cloud videos, are being built into robots, assistive monitoring and AR, yet before deploying one a practitioner cannot check which cue it relies on: how a body part moves, or what shape it has. 3D attribution is single-frame, video attribution is confined to RGB pixels, gradient maps need white-box access, attention is absent from state-space backbones, and point-level perturbations assume a point correspondence across frames that real depth and LiDAR data lack. We present Kinematic Causal Attribution (KCA), a black-box, interventional attribution method that queries only the model's outputs. Its freeze operator removes a region's motion while keeping its shape, and a shape-free proxy removes the shape while keeping the motion. Together they span a motion$\times$geometry cube for every tracked region, whose order-symmetric Shapley decomposition is complete and whose interaction is measured rather than assumed away. The operators rewrite per-frame point sets, so they need no correspondences, and a context-averaged estimator handles structures that span several regions. We validate KCA on the official PSTNet, P4Transformer and Mamba4D trained on MSR-Action3D. The decisive test is an audit: two binary tasks are built from real clips whose classes differ only in the motion or only in the shape of the same arm, and the motion share of the arm's importance follows the defining cue on all three backbones (0.83 vs. 0.60 on P4Transformer, 0.86 vs. 0.30 on PSTNet, 0.92 vs. 0.61 on Mamba4D), a distinction no single attribution map can make. The split costs no faithfulness: the necessity maps have the lowest deletion AUC on P4Transformer and PSTNet, tie with the best baseline on Mamba4D, and lose their correlation with the trained model's once the weights are randomised. Skeleton ground truth, re-sampling stability and cost complete the validation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Kinematic Causal Attribution (KCA)：一种黑盒、干预式方法，仅查询模型输出即可把 4D 点云视频感知模型的归因分解为"运动 vs 几何形状"两维，在 PSTNet/P4Transformer/Mamba4D 上验证，能区分仅运动或仅形状不同的二分类任务。
AI.motivation: 4D 感知模型（点云视频分类）将部署到机器人、辅助监测与 AR，但部署前无法检验模型依赖的是"身体部位如何运动"还是"形状"。现有归因手段存在硬伤：3D 归因仅单帧；视频归因限于 RGB 像素；梯度图需白盒访问；状态空间骨干无注意力；点级扰动假定跨帧点对应，而真实深度/LiDAR 数据不具备。
AI.method: 完全黑盒、仅用输出查询的干预式归因。两个算子：(1) freeze 算子移除某区域运动而保留形状；(2) shape-free 代理移除形状而保留运动。二者为每个被追踪区域张成 motion×geometry 的二维立方体，采用顺序对称的 Shapley 分解（完备且显式度量交互项而非假设其可忽略）。算子直接重写逐帧点集，无需点对应；并用上下文平均估计器处理跨多个区域的结构。
AI.result: 在 MSR-Action3D 上训练的官方 PSTNet、P4Transformer、Mamba4D 上验证。审计实验：由真实片段构造两个二分类任务（类别仅在同一条手臂的运动或形状上有差异），手臂重要性的"运动占比"在所有骨干上均跟随定义性线索：P4Transformer 0.83 vs 0.60，PSTNet 0.86 vs 0.30，Mamba4D 0.92 vs 0.61——这是任何单一归因图无法做出的区分。分解不损失忠实度：必要性图在 P4Transformer/PSTNet 上 deletion AUC 最低，在 Mamba4D 上与最佳基线持平；权重随机化后与训练模型的相关性消失。另补充骨架真值、重采样稳定性与开销验证。
AI.conclusion: KCA 为 4D 点云视频模型提供首个可部署前的黑盒、无对应依赖的运动/几何解耦归因，兼具可解释性与忠实度，可作为机器人等安全攸关场景下 4D 感知模型审计的实用工具。

title: STRATA: Reinforcement-driven Active Sampling with Tri-paradigm Adaptation for Efficient 3D Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables joint characterization of tissue morphology and gene expression. However, 3D volumetric ST acquisition remains expensive. AI-driven methods offer a low-cost alternative but remain limited in accuracy, while recent 2D section-wise ST acquisition still rely on dense grid sampling, resulting in redundant measurements and undersampling of biologically informative regions. To bridge the gap, we propose STRATA, a reinforcement-driven active sampling framework with tri-paradigm adaptation for reconstructing dense 3D transcriptomic maps from sparse voxel-wise ST acquisition. STRATA constructs a 3D graph integrating H&E morphology with single-cell priors and employs a reinforcement learning agent to estimate morphological sparsity and transcriptomic informativeness, enabling budget-aware selection of informative spots. Given these sparse measurements, an adaptive tri-paradigm predictor combines retrieval, regression, and cross-layer imputation through lightweight fusion, dynamically weighting their contributions. Experiments across datasets demonstrate improved sampling efficiency and accuracy, particularly under low-budget settings. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: STRATA：强化学习驱动的主动采样框架，从稀疏体素级ST测量重建稠密3D空间转录组图，含检索-回归-跨层插补三范式自适应预测器。
AI.motivation: 3D体素级空间转录组（ST）采集成本高；AI重建方法精度有限；现有2D逐切片ST仍采用稠密网格采样，造成冗余测量且对生物学信息丰富区域采样不足。
AI.method: 构建融合H&E形态与单细胞先验的3D图；用RL智能体估计形态稀疏性与转录组信息量，在预算约束下选择高信息量采样点；采用自适应三范式预测器（检索、回归、跨层插补）经轻量融合动态加权，实现稠密3D转录组重建。
AI.result: 多数据集实验显示采样效率与重建精度提升，尤其在低预算设定下优势明显；论文提供开源代码。
AI.conclusion: 将主动采样与多范式自适应融合结合，可在显著降低ST采集成本的同时保持高保真3D转录组建图，为低成本体素级空间组学提供可行方案。

title: VEvo-Harness: Causally-Guarded Self-Evolving Harness for Agentic Image Generation
summary: The central bottleneck in visual generation and editing has migrated from achieving pixel-level fidelity to satisfying densely constrained user specifications through increasingly agentic workflows. Prevailing agentic generation pipelines remain shallow generate-verify-rewrite loops treating VLM judgments as coarse visual feedback, either discarding repair experience or admitting ungated updates that poison skill library. With memorize and govern periods left open, they degrade into ungoverned iterators of repeated trial-and-error rather than continual self-evolving harness. Towards this issue, we present \textbf{VEvo-Harness}, the first causally-guarded continual self-evolving harness system for agentic visual generation. VEvo-Harness introduces four coupled innovations: (1) \textit{a visual traceback} that densifies sparse judgments into root-cause attributions with a hierarchical verification tree; (2) \textit{a visual continual governance} that admits only causally valid skill patches through counterfactual dual-arm image generation replay; (3) \textit{a lifecycle-managed harness state} that hierarchically distills root-cause-anchored episodes across working, experience, and pattern tiers into a persistent skill library of routable and causally verified capabilities; (4) \textit{a heterogeneous sandbox policy} that orchestrates a diverse action space of repair primitives, dynamically routing cost-aware interventions based on root causes to select the most effective strategy. VEvo-Harness surpasses state-of-the-art agentic methods and rivals proprietary generators (\textit{e.g.}, GPT-Image, Nano-Pro) while maintaining the continual harness evolution and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出 VEvo-Harness：首个带因果门控的持续自我演化 harness 系统，用于 agentic 视觉生成/编辑。用分层验证树把稀疏 VLM 判定细化成根因归因，用反事实双臂重放只准入因果有效的技能补丁，用工作/经验/模式三级生命周期蒸馏持久技能库，并用异构沙箱按根因路由修复原语。
AI.motivation: 当前 agentic 视觉生成多为浅层"生成-验证-重写"循环：VLM 反馈粗糙，修复经验或丢弃、或无门控写入而污染技能库，缺少记忆与治理机制，退化为无治理的反复试错，无法持续自我演化。
AI.method: 四项耦合机制：(1) visual traceback——分层验证树将稀疏判定稠密化为根因归因；(2) visual continual governance——通过反事实双臂图像生成重放，仅准入因果有效的技能补丁；(3) 生命周期管理的 harness 状态——在 working/experience/pattern 三层蒸馏锚定根因的片段，形成可路由、经因果验证的持久技能库；(4) 异构沙箱策略——编排多样化修复原语动作空间，按根因动态路由成本感知干预。
AI.result: 摘要称其超越当前 SOTA agentic 方法，并可媲美商用生成器（GPT-Image、Nano-Pro），同时保持持续 harness 演化与泛化能力；未给出具体量化指标与基准细节。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉生成的 agent 循环从无门控试错升级为因果验证、技能可累积的持续自我演化框架，属 agent 驱动生成/编辑的高相关性工作；但证据以宣称为主，需看实验与代码验证。

title: CLaW: Codec-Guided Adaptive Latent Watermarking for Traceable Diffusion Image Generation
summary: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image diffusion models, increasingly realistic AI-generated content has raised serious concerns about misuse and copyright infringement. Digital watermarking offers a promising solution by enabling user-level traceability, yet existing methods remain difficult to deploy at scale, hindered by costly model retraining or detection, poor effectiveness-fidelity trade-offs, and limited robustness to image transformations. To address these challenges, we propose CLaW (Codec-guided Latent Watermarking), a robust and efficient watermarking framework for traceable diffusion image generation with frozen diffusion backbones and inversion-free detection. Specifically, CLaW first uses a pretrained watermark codec to map each watermark message to a latent residual, enabling low-cost sampling-time injection. Then, the residual is injected within a late denoising window, where image semantics are better preserved and the watermark signal is less perturbed by subsequent denoising updates, yielding a better balance between watermark effectiveness and image fidelity. Furthermore, we introduce a decoder-guided adaptive injection mechanism that uses decoding confidence as feedback to dynamically calibrate watermark strength, reinforcing weak watermark signals and improving robustness under image transformations. Extensive experiments show that CLaW preserves high visual fidelity and achieves state-of-the-art robustness under image transformations, enabling reliable user-level traceability.

AI.tldr: CLaW 提出免训练、免反演的扩散模型图像水印框架：用预训练水印编解码器把消息映射为潜空间残差，在晚期去噪窗口注入，并用解码置信度反馈自适应调整水印强度，实现高保真与强鲁棒性的用户级溯源。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像水印方法难以规模化部署：需昂贵重训练或复杂检测、效果-保真度权衡不佳、对图像变换鲁棒性有限。
AI.method: 冻结扩散主干；(1) 预训练 watermark codec 将水印消息编码为 latent residual，实现低成本采样期注入；(2) 选择性在晚期去噪窗口注入，语义已较稳定且后续扰动小；(3) decoder-guided adaptive injection，用解码置信度作反馈动态校准水印强度。
AI.result: 实验显示保持高视觉保真度，在多种图像变换下取得 SOTA 鲁棒性，可支持可靠的用户级溯源。
AI.conclusion: CLaW 为可溯源扩散图像生成提供了高效、可即插即用的水印方案，但属生成内容安全/取证方向，与 Physical AI、VLA、3D 重建等核心关注领域无直接关联，优先级较低。

title: Joint Rigid Alignment and Morphable Reconstruction from Partial 3D Face Scans
summary: Aligning a partial, real-world 3D face scan to a canonical representation requires solving two coupled problems at once: estimating the rigid pose that brings the scan into a common frame, and completing the facial shape in regions the scan never observed. Existing pipelines typically decouple these steps, running a generic point-cloud registration front end followed by a separate non-rigid fitting or deformation stage. Building on the GeoTransformer superpoint-matching architecture, we propose a single network that predicts both a rigid pose and a shape-complete point cloud in one forward pass: a cross-attention regressor, conditioned on transformer point features and predicted coarse correspondences, maps a partial scan to per-patch coefficients of a 3D morphable face model learned offline from a corpus of 8,000 identities. The resulting morphed template is then used, in the same forward pass, as the target for fine-grained Sinkhorn matching and rigid pose estimation, supervised purely by geometric alignment to ground-truth morphed geometry, so no hand-labeled coefficients are required. Against six classical and learned non-rigid registration baselines on held-out identities, our method leads the strongest ones by 3-4 times on per-vertex error and baselines that collapse the head onto the visible region by more than an order of magnitude, and is simultaneously the most accurate and fastest method on ground-truth-free scans from two independent real-scan datasets, NoW and NPHM. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出单一GeoTransformer架构网络，一次前向同时预测刚性位姿与形状完整点云：用交叉注意力回归器输出3DMM逐patch系数完成补全，再以变形模板为Sinkhorn匹配目标估计位姿，仅用几何对齐监督。
AI.motivation: 部分真实3D人脸扫描对齐需同时解决刚性位姿估计与未观测区域形状补全，而现有流程通常将二者解耦（通用点云配准前端 + 独立非刚性拟合/变形），误差累积且慢。
AI.method: 基于GeoTransformer超点匹配结构构建端到端单网络：交叉注意力回归器以transformer点特征和粗匹配为先验，将部分扫描映射到离线从8000个身份学得的3DMM逐patch系数；变形后的模板在同一前向中作为Sinkhorn精细匹配与刚性位姿估计的目标；监督仅来自与GT变形几何的几何对齐，无需人工标注系数。
AI.result: 在留出身份上对比6个经典与学习型非刚性配准基线，逐顶点误差领先最强基线3–4倍，对将头部塌缩到可见区域的基线领先一个数量级以上；在NoW与NPHM两个真实扫描数据集的无GT扫描上同时最准确且最快。
AI.conclusion: 将补全与位姿估计统一为单次前向的可微流程，可在无需系数标注下实现更准且更快的部分人脸扫描对齐，代码将公开；但其为特定人脸域方法，非通用物体/场景重建。

title: A Novel Approach to Evaluating Evaluation Metrics for Multi-Output Structured Prediction
comment: Extended version of the AAAI 2026 paper, including the technical appendix. 18 pages, 8 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: In multi-output structured prediction tasks, while only one ground truth label may be provided in the training data, multiple equally valid outputs may be possible, making reliable evaluation a persistent challenge. We postulate that human evaluators implicitly use task-specific invariants, e.g., object boundaries in colorized images or named entities in translations, to judge if an output is acceptable. Under this assumption, we introduce a notion of approximate task-specific invariants and use them as diagnostic tools to evaluate a variety of existing metrics for vision and language tasks. We use these task invariants as part of a framework to systematically test metric reliability by encouraging domain-relevant invariants in model outputs via an augmented loss function. In our experiments, we observe that enforcing invariants with an augmented loss yields substantial improvements in popular distributional metrics while more traditional metrics change only marginally. Through this invariants-driven evaluation, we expose where standard metrics fail to detect meaningful differences, and we highlight the conditions under which distributional metrics succeed or still fall short.

AI.tldr: 提出用"任务特定近似不变量"作为诊断工具，系统评估视觉/语言多输出结构化预测任务的指标可靠性；并证明通过增强损失函数强制输出满足不变量，可显著提升分布型指标而传统指标变化甚微。
AI.motivation: 多输出结构化预测（如着色、翻译）中真实标签唯一但可接受输出多样，现有指标难以可靠评价；作者假设人类评估者依赖任务特定不变量（颜色化中的物体边界、翻译中的命名实体）判断输出是否可接受。
AI.method: 定义近似任务特定不变量的概念，将其作为诊断工具检验视觉与语言任务中多种已有指标；构建一个框架，通过增强损失函数鼓励模型输出包含领域相关不变量，从而系统性测试指标对有意义差异的敏感度。
AI.result: 施加不变量后，主流分布型指标出现显著提升，而传统指标几乎不变；据此揭示标准指标无法检测有意义的输出差异，并刻画了分布型指标成功或仍失效的条件。
AI.conclusion: 指标评估应结合任务不变量的诊断视角；分布型指标对不变量的敏感度优于传统指标，但仍存在失效情形，需据此慎用与改进评价方法。

title: EgoContact: Evaluating Physical Intelligence with Egocentric Video
summary: Egocentric video has emerged as one of the most scalable sources of data for learning generalizable manipulation priors. Yet, despite its growing use in pretraining robotic policies, it has been underutilized as a validation tool for physical intelligence, a key component of which is understanding where to make contact with an object to achieve an intended interaction. We present EgoContact, a large-scale egocentric dataset for evaluating the generalizability and precision of learned manipulation priors through future contact-point prediction. EgoContact contains 22.5K manually verified interaction events, each with a pre-contact observation, semantic intent, and pixel-precise contact locations. We find that current methods often struggle to predict precise interaction contacts and sometimes fail to localize the target object in diverse, in-the-wild scenes, even when allowed multiple predictions. Furthermore, we demonstrate the usefulness of EgoContact's annotated interactions for robotic manipulation: simply using EgoContact as the memory bank of an existing affordance-transfer policy improves grasp success from 14.2% to 31.2% in simulation and from 16% to 58% on a real robot.

AI.tldr: EgoContact：22.5K 手动校验的自中心交互事件数据集（接触前观测+语义意图+像素级接触点），用于以“未来接触点预测”评测操作先验的泛化与精度；现有方法难以精确定位接触，且将其作为 affordance-transfer 策略的记忆库可将仿真抓取成功率 14.2%→31.2%、真机 16%→58%。
AI.motivation: 自中心视频已成为可扩展的操作先验预训练数据源，但作为“物理智能”验证工具被严重低估——物理智能的关键之一是在何处与物体接触以实现意图交互。作者希望用未来接触点预测来检验学习到的操作先验的泛化性与精度。
AI.method: 构建 EgoContact 大规模自中心数据集：22.5K 个人工验证的交互事件，每个事件包含接触前观测、语义意图标注与像素级精确接触位置。并以“预测未来接触点”为任务，评测现有方法的泛化性与定位精度（含多假设设定）；同时将数据集作为记忆库接入现有 affordance-transfer 策略做真机/仿真验证。
AI.result: 现有方法常难以预测精确接触点，在多样野外场景中甚至在允许多个预测时仍可能无法定位目标物体。作为记忆库使用时，抓取成功率仿真 14.2%→31.2%（+17.0 个点），真机 16%→58%（+42 个点），提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 自中心视频可作为物理智能的有效验证与增强资源；接触点级标注既能揭示现有操作先验的精度短板，又能以记忆检索方式直接提升下游机器人操作性能，为后续数据驱动接触建模提供基准与工具。

title: Edited Endpoints as Partial Goals for Image-to-Video Generation
comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 28 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Edited endpoint images make the target of an image-to-video transition explicit and can improve transition completion, but also preserve context in the source image's layout. Full-frame endpoint conditioning turns this preserved context into requirements on the video's final state, potentially inducing temporal artifacts. We measure discontinuity with Hard-Cut (HC), late background reversal with Background Motion Reversal (BMR), and motion suppression with Dynamic Degree (DD). These artifacts appear across five video models spanning training-free and learned endpoint conditioning, in model-specific forms. We study Partial, a selective conditioning scheme that constrains only an edit-relevant region estimated from image-editor attention and leaves the remaining terminal content to the video model. Across three backbones on TC-Bench-I2V, Partial reduces temporal artifacts relative to full-frame conditioning, with no significant difference in Transition Completion Ratio (TCR); on Wan2.2-Turbo, uniformly weakening conditioning does not reproduce these reductions. A donor-context intervention keeps full-frame conditioning and replaces only the context outside the edit-relevant region with the final frame of a Partial video. It lowers HC and BMR on HunyuanVideo-1.5 and lowers BMR while restoring DD on Wan2.2-Turbo, with no significant difference in TCR, so constraint extent alone does not account for these artifacts. Together, these findings suggest that edited endpoints should serve as partial future goals, although edit relevance does not guarantee future validity. Code and data will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对图像到视频（I2V）中"编辑终点图像"全帧条件化会引入时序伪影的问题，提出选择性条件化方案 Partial：仅约束由图像编辑注意力估计出的编辑相关区域，其余末帧内容交给视频模型自由生成，从而在保持转场完成率的同时降低硬切、背景运动反转与运动抑制。
AI.motivation: 编辑后的端点图像能让 I2V 的目标显式化、提升转场完成度，但全帧条件化把源图保留的上下文变成了对视频末帧的硬性要求，导致 Hard-Cut、背景运动反转（BMR）、动态度（DD）下降等时序伪影。作者要回答：这些伪影是否源于"约束范围"本身，能否通过缩小约束区域消除。
AI.method: 1) 用 HC、BMR、DD 三项指标量化伪影，在 5 个模型（免训练与学习式端点条件化）上验证伪影普遍存在且形态各异；2) 提出 Partial：从图像编辑器的注意力图中估计"编辑相关区域"，仅对该区域施加终点条件，其余终末内容交给视频模型；3) 对照实验：在 Wan2.2-Turbo 上均匀弱化条件；4) 供体上下文干预（donor-context）：保留全帧条件，仅把编辑相关区域之外的上下文替换为 Partial 视频的末帧，以解耦"约束范围"与"约束内容"。
AI.result: 在 TC-Bench-I2V 上，Partial 在三个骨干模型中均降低时序伪影，且 Transition Completion Ratio (TCR) 无显著差异；Wan2.2-Turbo 上均匀弱化条件无法复现该收益。供体上下文干预在 HunyuanVideo-1.5 上降低 HC 与 BMR，在 Wan2.2-Turbo 上降低 BMR 并恢复 DD，TCR 均无显著差异——说明"约束范围"本身不足以解释伪影。
AI.conclusion: 编辑后的端点应作为"部分未来目标"而非全帧目标；但"编辑相关性"并不保证该内容在未来时间步仍然有效。代码与数据将开源。
