title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
summary: Experience can help embodied agents turn high-level plans into grounded actions, but transferring it across tasks remains challenging: previously effective strategies may be inapplicable to the current state or fail to produce their intended outcomes. We present EmbodiExp, a framework for constructing transferable experiences and composing them online during embodied task execution. Our key observation is that tasks often share subgoals whose completion can be assessed independently of overall task success. We therefore introduce an outcome-grounded subgoal experience that specifies a subgoal, applicability conditions, an adaptable policy, and a verifiable outcome. During execution, applicable experiences guide action generation, while verified outcomes can establish the conditions required by subsequent experiences, enabling online composition. Subgoal-level outcome attribution further enables failure utilization: failed trajectories can still contribute verified local successes and condition-specific guidance on actions to avoid. Experiments on multiple embodied benchmarks under a fold-based protocol with frozen experience banks demonstrate the effectiveness of EmbodiExp.

AI.tldr: EmbodiExp：以"可验证结果"为锚的子目标经验表示，支持跨任务迁移与在线组合，并利用失败轨迹中的局部成功。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体的经验跨任务迁移困难：先前有效的策略在新状态下可能不适用或无法达成预期结果；且完整成功信号稀疏，失败轨迹通常被整体丢弃。
AI.method: 观察到任务常共享可独立评估的子目标，故定义"结果锚定子目标经验"四元组：子目标、适用条件、可适配策略、可验证结果。执行时检索适用经验指导动作生成；已验证结果可作为后续经验的前置条件，实现在线组合。子目标级结果归因使失败轨迹贡献局部已验证成功与"应避免动作"的条件化指导。
AI.result: 在多个具身基准上，采用基于fold的协议与冻结经验库进行评测，验证了EmbodiExp的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 将经验粒度从任务级下移到可验证子目标级，可提升跨任务迁移性与在线组合能力，并把失败数据转化为可用监督信号。

title: Multi-level Constrained Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Underwater image enhancement aims to correct color and recover detail degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation, scattering, and noise. Paired-reference supervision constrains output similarity, but does not by itself specify the color mapping, the strength of local detail corrections, or consistency with the degraded observation. We propose MCL-UIE, a paired-supervised framework that addresses these requirements by constraining restoration operations and the training objective. Monotonic Chromatic Transform (MCT) restricts global color mapping in log-LMS space through positive diagonal entries and bounded cross-channel coefficients. Uncertainty-Gated Wavelet Reconstruction (UGWR) modulates high-frequency residuals with a learned confidence gate calibrated against normalized wavelet reconstruction errors. During training, Reference-Anchored Degradation Replay (RADR) renders the enhanced image and its paired reference using shared latent degradation proxies, encouraging both to reproduce the input. The three components share a restoration network that combines structured color correction, locally controlled detail recovery, and reference-anchored replay. MCL-UIE ranks first in thirteen of sixteen full-reference dataset-metric comparisons and produces competitive visual results on no-reference benchmarks. Objective ablations indicate that confidence calibration is most effective when combined with replay supervision. RADR is used only during training and adds no inference-time computation. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MCL-UIE：成对监督的水下图像增强框架，通过单调色度变换(MCT)、不确定性门控小波重建(UGWR)与参考锚定退化重放(RADR)约束恢复操作与训练目标。
AI.motivation: 水下图像受波长相关衰减、散射与噪声影响出现色偏与细节丢失；成对参考监督仅约束输出相似度，无法规定颜色映射方式、局部细节修正强度以及与退化观测的一致性。
AI.method: 在log-LMS空间用正对角元+有界跨通道系数的单调色度变换约束全局颜色映射；用小波重建误差标定的学习置信门调制高频残差；训练时RADR以共享潜在退化代理渲染增强图与其参考图，促使二者都能重建输入。三组件共享一个恢复网络，RADR仅训练期使用。
AI.result: 16项全参考数据集-指标比较中13项排名第一；无参考基准上视觉结果具竞争力；消融显示置信度标定与重放监督结合最有效。
AI.conclusion: 结构化颜色约束+局部可控细节恢复+参考锚定重放可提升水下增强的一致性，且不增加推理开销。

title: COGS: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Attribute-Aware Object-Level 3D Gaussian Splatting Perception
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027, Datasets and Benchmarks Track. 20 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is increasingly explored as an input representation for 3D perception. Yet it remains unclear how current 3D architectures exploit heterogeneous Gaussian attributes. This ambiguity makes accuracy hard to interpret and limits principled architecture design for 3DGS perception. However, existing object-level 3DGS datasets lack the appearance variation or artifact control needed for systematic attribute-level analysis. We introduce COGS, a large-scale 3DGS dataset with 15,675 artifact-filtered and appearance-rich objects across 40 categories. Built on COGS, we establish COGS-Bench for object classification and attribute-usage diagnosis, complemented by external validation. Our benchmark shows that Gaussian attributes are not uniformly beneficial: selected subsets can outperform the full attribute set, and the effects of appearance, opacity, and covariance-related attribute combinations vary substantially across architectures. We further study this finding with HALO, a reference model that preserves attribute-specific evidence before hierarchical aggregation. Experiments on COGS-Bench and external 3DGS datasets demonstrate that COGS supports systematic diagnosis of 3DGS attribute usage, while HALO highlights the value of role-preserving attribute organization. Our dataset is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出大规模物体级3DGS数据集COGS（15,675个物体、40类、含外观多样性与伪影过滤）及COGS-Bench基准，系统诊断不同3D架构对高斯各属性（外观、不透明度、协方差）的利用方式，并给出保留属性角色的参考模型HALO。
AI.motivation: 3DGS作为3D感知的输入表示日益流行，但现有架构如何利用异构高斯属性仍不清楚，导致精度难以解释、架构设计缺乏原则；而现有物体级3DGS数据集缺少外观变化与伪影控制，无法做属性级系统分析。
AI.method: 构建COGS数据集（伪影过滤、外观丰富的15,675物体/40类）；建立COGS-Bench用于物体分类与属性使用诊断，并做外部验证（属性子集消融、跨架构对比）；提出HALO参考模型，在层级聚合前保留属性专属证据。
AI.result: 基准显示高斯属性并非一致有益：属性子集可优于全属性集；外观、不透明度与协方差相关属性组合的效果随架构显著变化。COGS-Bench与外部3DGS数据集实验表明COGS可支持系统的属性使用诊断，HALO体现角色保留式属性组织的价值。
AI.conclusion: COGS为3DGS感知提供了可控的属性级诊断平台，揭示"全属性最优"的常见假设不成立，并示范了按属性角色组织证据的架构设计思路。

title: Event2Reward: Learning Robotic Rewards from Progress Relations
summary: Learning task progress from robot demonstrations provides a practical way to construct dense shaping rewards for robotic reinforcement learning. A common approach uses normalized demonstration time as progress labels, implicitly assuming monotonically increasing task progress. During policy exploration, however, actual task progress can stall or even regress. Such models may mistake regressions for progress, assigning positive shaping rewards to actions that cause progress loss. Real suboptimal and failed executions offer corrective experience, but assigning absolute progress values to their states is difficult. Our key observation is that stalls, regressions, and recoveries establish local relative progress relations even when absolute progress is unknown. We introduce Event2Reward, which uses normalized temporal labels to anchor the progress scale and these within-trajectory relations to constrain local changes, combining absolute and relative progress supervision. Its progress predictions serve as potentials for reward shaping. We curate an event-annotated dataset from approximately 100K raw real-robot execution records, covering successful, suboptimal, and failed executions, without requiring framewise absolute progress labels. Under the same training budgets, Event2Reward improves average policy success by 18.16 percentage points over a baseline using only sparse task rewards across 40 tasks in four LIBERO suites. On real robots, average success after 30 minutes of wall-clock training reaches 60.0% on three precise insertion tasks and 90.0% on three object manipulation tasks, exceeding the sparse-reward baseline under the same budget by 36.7 and 23.3 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies further show that absolute progress supervision and relative progress relations are complementary, with joint supervision yielding better downstream policy learning.

AI.tldr: Event2Reward 用"演示时间归一化标签"锚定绝对进度尺度，并用回放中停顿/回退/恢复事件建立的轨迹内相对进度关系作为约束，联合监督学习进度预测器，其预测值作为势函数用于稠密奖励塑形。
AI.motivation: 以归一化演示时间作为进度标签隐含"进度单调递增"假设，但策略探索中进度会停滞甚至回退，模型会把回退误判为进步并给出正奖励。失败/次优执行轨迹含纠错信息，但缺乏帧级绝对进度标注，难以直接利用。
AI.method: 核心观察：即使绝对进度未知，停滞、回退与恢复事件仍确立了局部相对进度关系。方法：将归一化时间标签作为绝对进度锚点确定尺度，用轨迹内相对关系约束局部变化，二者联合训练进度模型；在约10万条真实机器人执行记录上构建带事件标注的数据集（覆盖成功、次优、失败，无需帧级绝对进度标签）；进度预测作为势函数做奖励塑形。
AI.result: 同等训练预算下，LIBERO 四个套件40个任务相比仅稀疏奖励基线平均成功率提升18.16个百分点；真机上30分钟墙钟训练后，三个精密插入任务成功率60.0%、三个物体操作任务90.0%，分别超出稀疏奖励基线36.7和23.3个百分点。消融显示绝对进度监督与相对进度关系互补。
AI.conclusion: 将"相对进度关系"与"时间锚定绝对尺度"结合，可在无帧级标注下从成功/失败混合数据中学习可靠的进度模型，显著提升真实机器人强化学习样本效率与成功率。

title: Fast rigid rotational alignment of voxelized 3-D density maps in sliced Wasserstein distance
summary: We develop a fast method for the rigid alignment of voxelized three-dimensional density functions over $\mathsf{SO}(3)$ using sliced optimal transport. Our approach efficiently transforms each density map into a tensor of one-dimensional quantile functions, taken from central slices over the unit sphere, such that the Euclidean distance of the transformed volumes approximates the sliced 2-Wasserstein distance. Our formulation is therefore compatible with existing, fast, voxel-based Euclidean alignment algorithms. We provide theoretical analysis and numerical experiments demonstrating that the sliced 2-Wasserstein distance is a robust metric for comparing three-dimensional shapes and for computing their rigid alignment.

AI.tldr: 将体素化三维密度函数通过中心切片一维分位数张量转换，使欧氏距离近似sliced 2-Wasserstein距离，从而用现成的快速体素欧氏配准算法实现SO(3)上的刚性对齐。
AI.motivation: 三维密度图（如冷冻电镜密度、点云体素化表示）的刚性对齐通常依赖欧氏距离优化，迭代快但度量不稳健；Wasserstein距离对形状比较更鲁棒，但直接在三维上计算代价高。作者希望兼得两者优点。
AI.method: 对每个密度体沿单位球上的一组中心切片，计算一维分位数函数（quantile function），得到一个张量表示；在该表示下欧氏距离近似sliced 2-Wasserstein距离；随后可直接复用已有的快速体素欧氏配准（如FFT/穷举旋转+平移搜索）求解SO(3)对齐。文中给出理论分析（近似与度量性质）与数值实验。
AI.result: 理论与实验表明sliced 2-Wasserstein距离是稳健的三维形状比较度量，且其分位数张量表示可用于高效刚性对齐计算。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种快速、可插拔的OT-based刚性配准方法，适用于体素化密度函数，兼容现有快速欧氏体素对齐框架。

title: Seeing and Imagining as One: Unified Video Generation and 4D Perception for Embodied World Modeling
summary: Embodied world models should not only imagine plausible futures, but also perceive the geometric, semantic, and motion structure of the evolving world. We present GenSight, a unified embodied world model that brings future video generation and dense perception into a single pretrained video diffusion transformer. GenSight uses a unified spatiotemporal representation for video, depth, embodiment segmentation, and first-frame-relative 2D flow. Built on a shared DiT backbone, GenSight uses lightweight task modulation to predict all modalities within the same architecture. All tasks are jointly optimized within a unified velocity prediction space. At inference, GenSight supports two complementary modes: multi-step future video generation with aligned dense predictions and single-step dense perception from an observed video. By unifying modality representation, model architecture, and prediction space, GenSight avoids separate modality-specific pipelines and couples appearance, geometry, semantics, and motion in a shared representation. It promotes cross-modal consistency and allows dense perception to benefit from the spatiotemporal priors learned through video generation. Trained on embodied manipulation data spanning multiple robot embodiments and human-hand interactions, GenSight demonstrates strong performance in both video generation and dense 4D perception, highlighting the effectiveness of unifying seeing and imagining for embodied world modeling.

AI.tldr: GenSight：把未来视频生成与稠密感知（深度、实体分割、首帧相对2D流）统一到单个预训练视频扩散Transformer中的具身世界模型。
AI.motivation: 具身世界模型不仅需生成合理未来，还需感知演化世界的几何、语义与运动结构；现有方法多为分离的模态专用流水线，缺乏共享表示与跨模态一致性。
AI.method: 统一时空表示覆盖视频/深度/分割/流；共享DiT骨干+轻量任务调制；统一速度预测空间联合优化；推理支持多步未来视频生成（含对齐稠密预测）与单步稠密感知两种模式。
AI.result: 在多机器人实体与手物交互的具身操作数据上训练，视频生成与稠密4D感知均表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一表示、架构与预测空间，将"看见"与"想象"耦合，跨模态一致性提升，稠密感知受益于视频生成的时空先验。

title: DeCoRL: Decomposed Consistency Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Image Composition
summary: Multi-image composition (MICo) is a critical yet challenging capability for large-scale image editing models, where consistency degrades rapidly as the number of reference images increases. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip models with basic MICo ability, it provides only implicit supervision on the composed image and often fails to learn reliable object-level correspondence across multiple references. We propose DeCoRL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that improves MICo consistency by decomposing holistic MICo consistency into object-level consistency. DeCoRL first establishes instruction-relevant object correspondences across reference images and localizes the corresponding regions in the generated image. It then uses a VLM-based reward model trained on single-object consistency annotations to produce fine-grained, object-wise feedback, which is aggregated into a multi-object consistency reward to guide RL post-training. We further introduce DeCo-Bench, a benchmark covering compositions from 2 to 6 reference images. Experiments on DeCo-Bench and the public MICo-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements in MICo consistency.

AI.tldr: DeCoRL将多图组合(MICo)的整体一致性分解为物体级一致性，先用指令相关物体对应关系定位生成图中的对应区域，再用基于单物体一致性标注训练的VLM奖励模型给出物体级反馈并聚合为多物体一致性奖励，用于RL后训练；同时提出覆盖2-6张参考图的DeCo-Bench。
AI.motivation: 大规模图像编辑模型的多图组合能力随参考图数量增加而迅速退化；SFT只在整张合成图上提供隐式监督，难以学到可靠的多参考物体级对应关系。
AI.method: DeCoRL：建立跨参考图的指令相关物体对应并在生成图中定位对应区域；以单物体一致性标注训练的VLM奖励模型输出细粒度物体级反馈，聚合为多物体一致性奖励驱动RL后训练；配套构建2-6张参考图的DeCo-Bench。
AI.result: 在DeCo-Bench与公开MICo-Bench上，多图组合一致性取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 将整体一致性奖励分解为物体级可验证反馈，是一种有效的RL后训练监督方式；但论文聚焦图像编辑一致性，未涉物理AI/具身或3D重建。

title: RAIBO-Wagon: Real-Time Navigation System for a Legged Robot Towing a Wagon
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, 5 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Legged robots have demonstrated advanced capabilities across a wide range of real-world tasks, yet much of this progress concerns the robot controlling only itself. Once the robot is coupled to an external object -- particularly an underactuated one -- the dynamics of the combined assembly become more complex. Towing a wagon is a common practical scenario, where coupled dynamics make reliable navigation challenging. This difficulty is amplified in confined spaces, where collision-free navigation requires finding a narrow set of feasible paths under strict real-time constraints. To address this, we propose a navigation framework that combines Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) with Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control over a learned Forward Dynamics Model (FDM). The CFM model mitigates the initialization problem of MPPI and accelerates its convergence, while MPPI with the FDM recovers feasible solutions beyond the CFM model's training distribution by iterative refinement. We integrate the framework into a full-stack navigation system for RAIBO-Wagon, a quadruped towing a custom wagon, and validate it in real-world outdoor experiments on 15 m-long courses through confined spaces, with all sensing and computation performed fully onboard. The system achieves an 85% success rate across 40 trials, towing a total load of up to 40 kg -- nearly 100% of RAIBO's body weight.

AI.tldr: 提出将Conditional Flow Matching (CFM)与基于学习前向动力学模型(FDM)的MPPI控制相结合的导航框架，用于四足机器人牵引拖车的受限空间导航，实机40次试验成功率85%，牵引负载达40 kg（约本体重量）。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人自身运动已较成熟，但与外部欠驱动对象（如拖车）耦合后整体动力学复杂化；在受限空间中需在严格实时约束下寻找狭窄可行路径，传统MPPI随机初始化在长视界、窄可行域问题上收敛慢且易失败。
AI.method: CFM作为生成式先验给出可行轨迹初值，缓解MPPI初始化难题并加速收敛；MPPI在FDM上进行迭代滚动优化与轨迹精修，可外推到CFM训练分布之外的状态。集成到RAIBO-Wagon（四足+定制拖车）全栈导航系统，感知与计算全部机载运行。
AI.result: 在15 m级受限空间户外路线上完成40次实机试验，成功率85%；最大牵引总负载40 kg，接近RAIBO本体重量；全流程机载实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 生成式轨迹先验与基于学习动力学模型的采样优化相结合，可有效解决耦合欠驱动系统的受限空间实时导航；该"先验初始化+迭代精修"范式对具身导航具有较强可迁移性。

title: Efficient Covariance-Aware Vicinal Latent Diffusion for Continuous Conditional Image Generation
summary: Continuous Conditional Generative Modeling (CCGM) aims to synthesize high-dimensional data conditioned on continuously valued scalar labels. However, existing continuous diffusion models face severe data sparsity under imbalanced and long-tailed label distributions, which can lead to visual artifacts and condition inconsistency. Moreover, inference-time classifier-free guidance and dense pixel-space integration introduce substantial sampling overhead, limiting practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose CAViLD, an efficient latent diffusion framework for continuous conditional generation. CAViLD first constructs a purified condition-aware latent space through density-adaptive vicinal learning, auxiliary semantic regularization, and NIQE-guided negative data augmentation. It then internalizes the conditional guidance direction through an EMA teacher, enabling single-branch conditional inference, and introduces covariance-aware progressive distillation for label-dependent probability-flow ODEs, supporting sampling down to four NFEs. Experiments on RC-49, UTKFace, and Steering Angle demonstrate a favorable trade-off among generation fidelity, continuous condition consistency, and sampling efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 CAViLD，一个面向连续条件生成的高效潜空间扩散框架，通过净化条件感知潜空间、EMA 教师内化引导方向、协方差感知渐进蒸馏，实现单分支推理与低至 4 NFEs 的采样。
AI.motivation: 连续条件生成在标签不平衡、长尾分布下存在严重数据稀疏，导致视觉伪影与条件不一致；同时推理期无分类器引导与密集像素空间积分带来高昂采样开销，限制实际部署。
AI.method: (1) 通过密度自适应邻域学习、辅助语义正则和 NIQE 引导的负样本增广构建"净化"的条件感知潜空间；(2) 用 EMA 教师将条件引导方向内化，实现单分支条件推理；(3) 提出协方差感知渐进蒸馏，针对依赖标签的概率流 ODE 蒸馏，支持 4 步生成。
AI.result: 在 RC-49、UTKFace、Steering Angle 三个连续标签数据集上，在生成保真度、连续条件一致性与采样效率之间取得良好折中。
AI.conclusion: 通过潜空间净化与蒸馏结合的连续条件扩散框架，可在保持条件一致性的同时显著降低采样步数，为高效连续条件生成提供可行路径。

title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
summary: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: WorldFlow：统一生成式世界模型，联合预测未来视频与查询式3D轨迹；将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移token，用共享MoT骨干在rectified-flow目标下联合去噪，并在144万混合样本上训练，提出WorldFlowBench，ADE/FDE显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型隐含3D动力学；动作条件模型绑定特定机器人构型；3D运动预测仅有flow监督，物理动力学学习信号有限。目标是获得显式几何动态与视觉演化耦合的、与本体无关的物理世界模型。
AI.method: 以视频网格对齐的连续位移token参数化3D轨迹，采用统一Mixture-of-Transformers骨干在同一rectified-flow目标下联合去噪视频与3D轨迹两种模态；配合query-based 3D轨迹预测，复用预训练视频模型的物理常识。训练数据为144万对象级样本（仿真+真实、异构混合），并构建WorldFlowBench（11个数据源、1678样本、含空间推理任务）。
AI.result: 三套评测集上，学习类方法中ADE/FDE最低；SpatialCog集ADE=0.060 m，较最强外部基线降低54.2%；与其flow-only变体相比ADE、FDE分别降低55.9%和68.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式3D运动与视频联合建模可有效释放视频预训练模型中的物理常识，且该联合监督显著优于纯光流监督；统一架构在大规模异构数据上具备良好可扩展性。局限在于评价以离线指标为主，缺少真实机器人闭环执行验证。

title: CuBot-STT: Simultaneously Transport and Tighten for Lattice-type Modular Reconfiguration Robot
comment: 11 pages. Submitted to IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics
summary: Lattice-type modular reconfigurable robots rearrange standardized modules across tasks. Dedicated transport robots reduce module weight and cost by eliminating module level reconfiguration actuators. But existing systems use low capacity connections or internal fastening robots that occupy space for functional components. This paper presents CuBot-STT, which integrates module transport, interface locking, and release in one external robot. Cubic modules provide structural support and $24\,\mathrm{V}$ power distribution. On each face, a gear transmission converts one external input into motion of four helical locking points, preserving internal space. The robot uses alternating foot support, a gripper for module handling, and a tightening head for interface actuation. The controller coordinates two-foot support and module locking through continuous constraint transfers. The planner decomposes relocation costs into an analytical lower bound and a residual learned through expert-guided, goal conditioned Q-learning. Contact face $A^*$ search expands relocation sequences into robot primitives satisfying connectivity, asymmetric manipulation, and foot stance constraints. Experiments demonstrate normal and tangential interface capacities of $300\,\mathrm{N}$ and $490\,\mathrm{N}$, electrical continuity across six modules, and autonomous reconfiguration of an 11-module lattice. Planning benchmarks show superior search efficiency over analytical guidance and bidirectional heuristic search, with generalization beyond training lattice sizes without fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: CuBot-STT：单一外部机器人集成模块搬运、接口锁紧与释放的立方体晶格模块化自重构系统，含齿轮传动的四螺旋锁紧面、交替足支撑与约束转移控制、代价分解（解析下界+专家引导目标条件Q学习残差）规划与接触面A*搜索，实测法向/切向接口承载力300/490 N。
AI.motivation: 专用搬运机器人可省去模块内置重构执行器以降重降本，但现有系统受限于低承载连接，或依赖占用功能组件空间的内部紧固机器人。
AI.method: 立方模块承担结构与24V配电；每面齿轮传动将单一外部输入转为四螺旋锁点运动，保留内部空间；机器人以交替足支撑、夹持器搬运模块、拧紧头驱动接口；控制器通过连续约束转移协调双足支撑与锁紧；规划器将重定位代价分解为解析下界与专家引导目标条件Q学习残差，并以接触面A*把重定位序列展开为满足连通性、非对称操作与足部站姿约束的机器人基元。
AI.result: 法向与切向接口承载力300 N与490 N，六模块间电气连通，完成11模块晶格的自主重构；规划基准上搜索效率优于解析引导与双向启发式搜索，并可泛化到训练外晶格尺寸而无需微调。
AI.conclusion: 外部单机集成搬运—锁紧—释放的设计在保留模块内部空间的同时获得高承载接口，配合学习增强的代价估计与约束感知搜索，实现可扩展的自主晶格重构。

title: Cross-Controller Transfer via In-Context Behavior Adaptation
summary: Generalist robot policies increasingly learn from data collected across diverse tasks and embodiments, yet typically assume a single controller for each robot. This assumption limits transfer because different controllers can assign different physical meanings to the same action and may require different strategies to complete a task. We study how to transfer robot data across both embodiments and controllers without allowing conflicting action interpretations to interfere with learning. Our setting spans six controller types as well as variations in controller gains and compliance. We propose a framework that encodes behavioral interaction under a controller through examples of commanded actions and the resulting robot motions. A transformer context encoder summarizes these interactions, allowing a single policy to adapt in context. Across real-world experiments, our method improves average success by 33 percentage points over naive data pooling, achieves 50\% success on unseen controller modes and 52\% on unseen controller gains, and transfers to tasks with limited controller-specific data. On contact-rich tasks such as USB insertion and surface wiping, behavioral interaction context enables the policy to adapt not only its actions but also its strategy. Our results provide a path toward generalist robot policies that can leverage data collected across diverse action interpretations. For more information, visit \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨"本体+控制器"迁移的通用机器人策略框架：以"指令动作—实际运动"示例编码控制器下的行为交互，用Transformer上下文编码器实现单策略在线适配，无需冲突动作语义。
AI.motivation: 现有通用机器人策略虽跨任务、跨本体学习，但默认每个机器人仅有一个控制器。不同控制器（增益、柔顺性等）对同一动作赋予不同物理含义，直接混合数据会产生动作语义冲突，阻碍迁移。
AI.method: 将控制器下的行为交互表示为"指令动作+实际产生的机器人运动"样本对，用Transformer上下文编码器聚合为控制器上下文向量，使单一策略以in-context方式实时适配六类控制器及增益/柔顺性变化。
AI.result: 真机实验相对朴素数据池化平均成功率提升33个百分点；未见控制器模式达50%成功率，未见增益达52%；在控制器特定数据稀缺的任务上可迁移；在USB插入、表面擦拭等接触丰富任务中，行为交互上下文使策略能同时调整动作与策略。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模控制器层面的行为交互是消除动作解释歧义、复用异构数据的关键，为利用多动作语义数据训练通用机器人策略提供了可行路径。

title: PriorMaskMap: Robust Online Vectorized Map Construction with Biased Priors
summary: Online vectorized map construction provides autonomous vehicles with essential, real-time semantic and geometric scene understanding. While leveraging prior maps presents an opportunity to improve accuracy, they are often biased due to outdated information or temporary road changes. Existing methods, which typically treat priors as fully reliable or only consider limited noise patterns, suffer severe performance degradation when these priors are imperfect. To address this, we propose PriorMaskMap, a robust framework for prior-guided vectorized map construction. Its first innovation is a Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator (PACE) that evaluates the input rasterized map against current visual observations. It assigns confidence scores to regions classified as reliable, erroneous, or blank, creating a foundational mask that guides two subsequent branches. In one branch, the Dual-Prior Query Generator (DPQG) selectively filters and embeds both rasterized and vectorized priors to initialize informative queries from trustworthy map structures. In the other, the Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion (CGPF) module spatially propagates and refines the mask, using the refined version to govern the fusion of BEV features with the prior map, thereby providing rich contextual representations for the map decoder. Evaluation on the nuScenes dataset shows that PriorMaskMap achieves superior mapping precision over existing approaches and exhibits marked robustness when provided with priors containing apparent errors. Our code is released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PriorMaskMap: 面向先验地图不完美场景的鲁棒先验引导矢量化在线地图构建框架，通过先验置信度估计器(PACE)对先验区域分可靠性掩码，并用双分支(DPQG查询生成、CGPF置信度引导融合)选择性地利用先验。
AI.motivation: 现有先验引导矢量化地图构建方法将先验视为完全可靠或仅考虑有限噪声模式，当先验因过期信息或临时道路变更而不完美时性能严重下降。需要显式建模先验可信度以实现鲁棒融合。
AI.method: 提出PriorMaskMap框架。核心为先验感知置信度估计器(PACE)：将输入栅格化先验与当前视觉观测比对，为可靠/错误/空白区域分配置信度分数形成基础掩码。分支一为Dual-Prior Query Generator (DPQG)：选择性过滤并嵌入栅格与矢量先验，从可信地图结构初始化查询。分支二为Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion (CGPF)：对掩码进行空间传播与细化，以细化掩码控制BEV特征与先验地图的融合，为地图解码器提供上下文表征。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上，PriorMaskMap的地图构建精度优于现有方法，且在提供明显错误先验时表现出显著鲁棒性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 显式的先验置信度估计与掩码引导的选择性融合是提升先验引导矢量化地图构建鲁棒性的有效途径，可在先验不可靠时仍保持较高精度。

title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
summary: Human cognition flexibly draws on a shared perceptual foundation to understand environments, attend to referenced entities, reason about spatial relationships, and act. Endowing aerial robots with an analogous functional organization remains challenging, as existing systems are often specialized for individual capabilities, dependent on offboard computation, or unable to sustain closed-loop operation on resource-constrained platforms. We present OpenFlyV2, a unified onboard vision-language-action architecture that uses a shared vision-language representation to support semantic understanding, language-grounded perception, spatial reasoning, and continuous aerial control within a single model. A compact action expert converts the shared multimodal context into short-horizon flight waypoints, while motion-aware temporal memory and action priors reduce the computational cost of closed-loop execution. We construct \dataset{}, a simulation-based dataset comprising approximately 70,000 navigation trajectories and 60,000 vision-language instruction--response pairs. OpenFlyV2 generates action chunks, each comprising 12 waypoints, entirely onboard at 10 Hz using an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It transfers zero-shot from simulation to physical quadrotor flight, achieving a 48\% navigation success rate across four real-world environments without real-world aerial training data. Extensive results demonstrate that broad vision-language competence and continuous closed-loop flight can coexist within a single model on a resource-constrained aerial platform. Code will be made publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: OpenFlyV2 是一个统一的车载视觉-语言-动作架构，用共享视觉-语言表征在单一模型中支持语义理解、语言接地感知、空间推理与连续飞行控制，经仿真数据集训练后零样本迁移到真实四旋翼。
AI.motivation: 现有空中机器人系统多为单任务专用、依赖机外算力，或无法在资源受限平台上维持闭环运行，缺少类似人类认知的"共享感知基础"式统一功能组织。
AI.method: 以共享视觉-语言表征为骨干，接一个紧凑的动作专家将多模态上下文映射为短时域航点；引入运动感知时序记忆与动作先验以降低闭环推理开销；构建约7万条导航轨迹与6万条视觉-语言指令-响应对的仿真数据集；模型在机载 Jetson Orin NX 上以 10 Hz 生成 12 航点动作块。
AI.result: 全机载 10 Hz 闭环运行；仿真到真实零样本迁移，在四个真实环境中达到 48% 导航成功率，且未使用任何真实空中训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 宽泛的视觉-语言能力与连续闭环飞行可在同一资源受限空中平台上共存，验证了统一 VLA 架构用于具身空中导航的可行性。

title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026, Sydney as a poster
summary: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compatibility with the AR inference ecosystem (KV caching, vLLM) by construction. We argue that this cost is unnecessary. A pretrained raster-scan AR model has already learned the joint distribution over image tokens; what it lacks is not knowledge but the ability to express that knowledge through non-sequential conditional pathways. We propose a recipe for adapting pretrained raster-scan models into any-order generators using two components: future-aware positional embeddings that resolve a target-position identifiability problem at negligible overhead, and an ordering curriculum that traces a stable optimization path from the pretrained solution to a good any-order basin. Applied to four base models across two architectures and two scales (LlamaGen-L/XL, RAR-L/XL), the recipe substantially outperforms MaskGIT on ImageNet inpainting (FID 6.21 vs. 10.44) and outpainting, is competitive with MAR-L, trades a 1.2-1.9 increase in class-conditional FID for this flexibility, and costs 13-33% additional compute beyond pretraining, while leaving the standard AR inference stack untouched. Inpainting, outpainting, and editing, our results suggest, need not be added to autoregressive image models. They can be unlocked from the ones that exist. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出将预训练栅格扫描自回归图像生成器低成本改造为任意顺序生成器的方法：未来感知位置编码 + 顺序课程学习。
AI.motivation: 栅格扫描AR模型将固定的图像分布因子化硬编码进模型，推理时无法做图像修复/外扩/编辑；现有方案（离散扩散、多顺序混合训练）需从零训练，计算量约3倍，且破坏KV缓存、vLLM等AR推理生态。作者认为预训练模型已学到联合分布，缺的只是非顺序条件路径。
AI.method: 两个组件：(1) future-aware positional embeddings，以极小开销解决目标位置可识别性问题；(2) ordering curriculum，从预训练解出发沿稳定优化路径进入良好的any-order解域。在四种基座（LlamaGen-L/XL、RAR-L/XL，两种架构两种规模）上适配。
AI.result: ImageNet inpainting FID 6.21 显著优于 MaskGIT 10.44，outpainting亦优；与MAR-L相当；类条件生成FID增加1.2–1.9；额外计算仅比预训练多13–33%；标准AR推理栈保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 图像修复、外扩与编辑能力无需在AR模型中新增，可从已有预训练模型中"解锁"，避免从零训练多顺序模型的高成本。

title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
summary: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities. Its design rests on one encoder for every modality and one schema for every task. Youtu-Omni-Encoder, initialized from a pre-trained language model to strengthen text reading, encodes all modalities with shared weights in a unified space-time coordinate system, and a few fusion layers let video frames attend to concurrent audio, bringing cross-modal fusion and temporal alignment into perception itself. OmniSchema unifies the outputs of all ten parsing tasks, allowing a single self-evolving post-training procedure, OmniSchema-Aware On-Policy Distillation (OSAD), to provide a shared token-role-based objective across tasks. In each round, the model is trained on its own rollouts against token-level targets from a reference-conditioned copy of itself, which is then refreshed with the trained weights, so that the parser and its supervision co-evolve. With a single 5 B-parameter checkpoint, Youtu-Parsing-Omni achieves state-of-the-art performance on OmniDocBench v1.6 (96.96 Overall) and leads all open-weight models on OmniParsingBench (75.08 Avg.), with its advantage concentrated on audio and video. It also achieves the best overall chart-parsing score (95.02) and the highest exact chemical-fingerprint agreement among compared systems, and matches a dedicated optical-music model in character-level transcription of typeset sheet music while staying far ahead of general-purpose systems. Code and model weights are publicly available.

AI.tldr: Youtu-Parsing-Omni：单一编码器（从预训练语言模型初始化的 Youtu-Omni-Encoder）以共享权重编码文档、图像、音频、视频到统一时空坐标系，配合统一输出模式 OmniSchema 与自演化后训练 OSAD，单 5B 检查点覆盖十项解析任务。
AI.motivation: 为智能体提供可读、可定位、可引用的跨模态感知层，将跨模态融合与时间对齐下沉到感知阶段，并用统一 schema 让多个解析任务共享同一训练目标。
AI.method: 所有模态共享权重编码于统一时空坐标系，少量融合层使视频帧关注同期音频；OmniSchema 统一十项解析任务的输出；提出 OmniSchema-Aware On-Policy Distillation（OSAD），基于 token role 的共享目标，每轮用自身 rollouts 对参考条件副本的 token 级目标训练，并刷新参考模型，使解析器与监督协同演化。
AI.result: 单 5B 检查点在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上达 96.96 Overall（SOTA），OmniParsingBench 75.08 Avg. 领先所有开放权重模型，优势集中于音频与视频；图表解析 95.02 最优，化学指纹精确一致率最高，光学乐谱字符级转写媲美专用模型。
AI.conclusion: 统一编码器 + 统一 schema + 自演化蒸馏构成可扩展的全模态文档解析范式，可作为智能体的多模态证据感知层；但评测以基准为主，缺乏下游智能体任务的实证。

title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
summary: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe. We turn the hypothesis into a theorem. First, we prove a \emph{Platonic Representation Theorem}: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) trained separately on any number of modalities learn the same representation up to one rotation whenever their positive pairs are two observations of one scene--\emph{good views}--and their misalignment is bounded otherwise. Second, we show that next-token prediction is a JEPA with \emph{bad views}, parts of a single document, which explains why language models align with vision only through scale. Third, we validate the theory from 145k captions to the texts of 940M web images, and uncover a scaling law of alignment that predicts unseen runs within seed noise. Good views need 42 times fewer training samples than next-token prediction on the same corpus to reach the same alignment, and a 109M-parameter text JEPA aligns with DINOv2 and CLIP's image encoders better than every language model we evaluated, up to 72B parameters, and than CLIP's text encoder: next-token prediction is a remarkably inefficient route to platonic representations. As a showcase, one rotation turns separately trained encoders into an image captioner (CIDEr .838 on COCO). Even that rotation needs no pair: on the latest pair-free benchmark, our text JEPA beats every zero-shot accuracy reported with language models up to 8B parameters, e.g., 64\% against at most 56\% top-5 on ImageNet-100. Positive views, and not scale alone, are thus the lever to build platonic representations.

AI.tldr: 该文将Platonic Representation Hypothesis（PRH）形式化为定理：证明在良好视图（good views）条件下，分别训练于任意模态的JEPA会学得仅差一个旋转的同一表征；并指出next-token prediction等价于带"坏视图"的JEPA，从而解释语言模型只能靠规模才能与视觉对齐。
AI.motivation: PRH仅是一个猜想，缺乏证明与可操作配方；作者希望给出保证（定理）与实现路径（正样本构造/视图质量），并解释为何语言模型需极大规模才对齐视觉。
AI.method: 1）证明Platonic Representation Theorem：JEPA在正样本为同一场景的两次观测（good views）时分模态独立训练可学到仅差正交旋转的共同表征，错配受界约束；2）论证next-token预测是正样本为同文档片段（bad views）的JEPA；3）在145k人类标注caption到940M网络图像文本上做实证验证，拟合对齐度的scaling law；4）训练109M参数文本JEPA，与DINOv2、CLIP图像编码器及≤72B语言模型比较对齐度；5）利用单一旋转把独立训练的编码器转为图像描述器（COCO CIDEr .838），并在无配对基准上做零样本评测。
AI.result: good views 达到同等对齐所需样本量比 next-token prediction 少42倍；109M文本JEPA对齐DINOv2/CLIP图像编码器优于所有评测的语言模型（最大72B）及CLIP文本编码器；拟合的scaling law可在随机种子噪声内预测未跑过的实验；无配对设定下ImageNet-100 top-5达64%，超过所有≤8B语言模型报告的最佳56%；单旋转即可零配对实现图像描述。
AI.conclusion: 模态对齐的关键杠杆是正样本视图质量而非单纯规模；next-token prediction是通向platonic表征的低效路径，显式构造good views的JEPA可用极少参数与样本实现跨模态对齐，并可直接服务于生成式下游任务。

title: CAD-WAM: Anticipating Geometry for Text-to-CAD Generation
summary: Generating editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from text requires selecting operations that produce the intended changes to the geometry constructed so far. An incorrect operation can compromise subsequent steps, making reliable multi-step generation challenging. Existing methods based on large language models (LLMs) primarily learn to predict commands, without explicit supervision of the geometric states those commands should produce. Inspired by world-action models, we introduce CAD-WAM, which couples geometry-conditioned action generation with next-state prediction. We define complete modeling operations as actions in a CAD domain-specific language (DSL) and encode surface point clouds of intermediate solids into compact latent states using a pretrained variational autoencoder. An LLM backbone generates the next action from the target description and current geometric state, while an auxiliary head on the same backbone predicts the next state to provide geometric supervision during training. We construct step-wise training trajectories from parametric CAD models in the DeepCAD dataset, pairing each trajectory with an expert-level textual description. At inference, each generated action is executed by a CAD kernel, and the resulting solid is re-encoded to inform the next decision. On the DeepCAD test set, CAD-WAM outperforms the task-specific baselines in geometric accuracy and output validity, with larger gains on models requiring more operations, and produces more accurate geometry than general-purpose LLMs prompted with the same DSL. Ablations further show that next-state supervision reduces mean Chamfer distance by 13.2\% relative to an otherwise identical model trained only to predict actions. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CAD-WAM：用世界-动作模型（WAM）框架从文本生成可编辑CAD操作序列，LLM主干生成CAD DSL动作，辅助头预测下一几何状态（点云VAE隐状态）提供几何监督；DeepCAD测试集上几何精度与有效性优于基线，下一状态监督使Chamfer距离降低13.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的文本到CAD方法仅学习预测命令序列，缺乏对命令所应产生几何状态的显式监督；一步错误会累积影响后续步骤，导致多步生成的可靠性差。
AI.method: 将完整建模操作定义为CAD DSL中的动作；用预训练VAE把中间实体的表面点云编码为紧凑隐状态；LLM主干根据目标描述与当前几何状态生成下一动作，同一主干上的辅助头预测下一状态以提供几何监督；从DeepCAD参数化模型构建逐步轨迹并配专家级文本描述；推理时每个动作由CAD内核执行，结果实体重新编码以指导下一次决策。
AI.result: 在DeepCAD测试集上，几何精度与输出有效性优于任务专用基线，对需要更多操作的模型提升更明显；优于使用相同DSL提示的通用LLM；消融显示下一状态监督相较于仅动作预测使平均Chamfer距离降低13.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将动作生成与下一状态预测耦合可为CAD序列建模提供有效几何监督，显著提升多步可编辑CAD生成的准确性与有效性；该方法在CAD而非机器人平台上验证。

title: Unlimited OCR Works 2
summary: Unlimited OCR ushers the era of long-horizon parsing, substantially mitigating the growth of working memory as document lengthens. However, as document length scales to hundreds of pages, the visual context grows substantially, sharply increasing the computational cost of each decoding step and limiting the scalability of ultra-long document parsing. Inspired by human book transcription via localized focus without re-scanning preceding pages, we introduce Unlimited OCR 2, a document parsing model that looks only at what it transcribes. Building on Unlimited OCR, we upgrade all the decoder attention modules to Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA), bounding active reference tokens to a fixed capacity and thus sustaining constant computational costs across arbitrarily long documents. By combining SR-SWA with Unlimited-Horizon Decoding Paradigm, Unlimited OCR 2 enables document parsing over virtually unlimited lengths without prohibitive memory overhead. At the hundred-page scale, Unlimited OCR 2 achieves 7.0$\times$ and 5.6$\times$ per-step speedups over Full Attention and R-SWA, respectively. Furthermore, it delivers state-of-the-art end-to-end performance on both MPDocBench and MarathonDocBench, our newly proposed benchmark targeting hundred-page document parsing. Ultimately, the capacity for uninterrupted, one-shot document parsing signifies a fundamental paradigm shift into the OCR 3.0 era.

AI.tldr: Unlimited OCR 2 将解码器全部注意力改为稀疏参考滑窗注意力(SR-SWA)，把活跃参考 token 限定在固定容量，使任意长度文档的每步解码计算量恒定，配合 Unlimited-Horizon 解码范式实现近乎无限长度的一次性文档解析。
AI.motivation: 现有 Unlimited OCR 虽缓解了工作记忆随文档增长的问题，但视觉上下文随页数（数百页）线性膨胀，导致每个解码步的计算成本急剧上升，超长文档解析的扩展性受限。模仿人类逐页局部聚焦抄录而不回扫前页的行为。
AI.method: 将所有解码器注意力模块升级为 Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA)：用稀疏参考 + 滑动窗口把活跃参考 token 数量约束为固定容量；再与 Unlimited-Horizon Decoding Paradigm 结合，使内存开销与文档长度解耦。
AI.result: 百页规模下，每步解码相对 Full Attention 提速 7.0x、相对 R-SWA 提速 5.6x；在 MPDocBench 与新提出的百页级 MarathonDocBench 上取得 SOTA 端到端性能。
AI.conclusion: 以常数级计算代价实现不间断、一次性超长文档解析，作者将其定位为 OCR 3.0 范式的转折点。

title: Language-Grounded Force/Torque Pretraining for Extrinsic Contact Perception
summary: Fine manipulation requires robots to recognize when a grasped object makes or changes contact with its environment, yet such extrinsic contact is not always directly observable from vision or local contact geometry. Force and torque signals carry this information, but also vary with object weight, grasp configuration, and robot motion, leaving it unclear whether they can provide a reusable representation of physical state. Here we show that bilateral six-axis force/torque histories can be pretrained as a semantically structured physical representation by aligning them with a frozen language space using supervision generated from simulated pick-and-place interactions. On unseen objects in simulation, the learned representation supports text-prototype readout of robot action, object weight, and grasp interaction. In real-world placement, unlabeled calibration enables contact and support-state recognition without updating the encoder, outperforming a vertical-force sign-reversal rule baseline. For connector insertion, an event absent from pretraining, low-rank adaptation improves data-efficient learning over training from scratch. These results show that force/torque histories can support both direct readout of known physical states and efficient adaptation to new extrinsic-contact events.

AI.tldr: 双侧六轴力/力矩时序可通过与冻结语言空间对齐进行预训练，形成语义结构化的物理表征，支持动作、重量、抓取状态读出，并可通过少量标定或LoRA迁移到真实场景的接触/支撑状态识别与连接器插入任务。
AI.motivation: 精细操作要求机器人判断抓取物体何时与环境的接触建立或改变，但外在接触难以从视觉或局部接触几何直接观测；力/力矩信号虽含此信息，却随物体重量、抓取构型与运动变化，能否构成可复用的物理状态表征尚不明确。
AI.method: 在仿真pick-and-place交互中生成监督信号，将双侧六轴力/力矩历史与冻结语言编码空间对齐，获得语义结构化的力觉表征；下游采用文本原型读出（text-prototype readout）；真实世界放置任务用无标签标定实现接触与支撑状态识别，编码器不更新；连接器插入任务采用低秩适配（LoRA）做数据高效迁移。
AI.result: 仿真未见物体上可读出机器人动作、物体重量与抓取交互；真实放置任务中无需更新编码器的无标签标定优于垂直力符号反转规则基线；连接器插入这一预训练未包含的事件上，LoRA相较从零训练显著提升数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 力/力矩时序可作为可复用的物理表征，既支持已知物理状态的直接读出，也支持向外在接触新事件的高效适配，为力觉基础模型提供了语义对齐式预训练范式。

title: ProLoop: Progress-Aware Closed-Loop Framework via Structured State Relations for Long-Horizon Robotic Task Planning
summary: Long-horizon robotic tasks are commonly decomposed into semantic subgoals to simplify planning. However, subgoal progress in LLM-based planning is typically inferred implicitly from interaction histories. Inaccurate estimates can misguide execution and allow local errors to propagate. To address this, we propose ProLoop, a Progress-Aware Closed-Loop framework that derives explicit subgoal progress from structured relations between desired and execution states. A learned State-Relation Monitor assesses these relations, which are then aggregated into subgoal progress as ongoing, deviated, or completed. The resulting progress guides execution adaptation, enabling reliable progress-aware control throughout execution. Experiments on AgentBoard ALFWorld and a real-world robotic platform show that ProLoop improves success rate by 12.94% overall and by 15.46% on Hard tasks, while reducing environment interactions by 32.3%.

AI.tldr: ProLoop：从期望状态与执行状态的结构化关系中显式推断子目标进度（ongoing/deviated/completed），用学习的状态关系监控器闭环指导长程机器人任务执行。
AI.motivation: LLM 规划器通常从交互历史隐式推断子目标进度，不准确的估计会误导执行并让局部错误在长程任务中累积传播。
AI.method: 提出进度感知闭环框架：学习一个 State-Relation Monitor，评估期望状态与执行状态之间的结构化关系；将关系聚合成子目标进度标签（ongoing / deviated / completed），据此驱动执行自适应与重规划，形成闭环控制。
AI.result: 在 AgentBoard ALFWorld 与真实机器人平台上验证：总体成功率提升 12.94%，Hard 任务提升 15.46%，环境交互次数减少 32.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模子目标进度可显著提升长程 LLM 规划任务的可靠性，并降低交互成本；含真实机器人平台验证，但方法层级偏高层规划与状态监控，缺可视化/3D 表征创新。

title: MemoryFusion: Cross-Temporal Memory Learning for Multimodal Video Fusion
summary: Multimodal videos contain rich temporal cues that can facilitate faithful fusion. However, existing video fusion methods mainly rely on short-range temporal interactions, leaving valuable long-term information underexplored. Moreover, inconsistent fusion representations can cause flickering artifacts, undermining temporal coherence. To address these coupled challenges, we propose MemoryFusion, a two-stage framework integrating cross-temporal memory learning with progressive temporal refinement. Considering the complementary roles of adjacent and distant frames, the first stage combines a Short-Term Memory Bank for local temporal guidance with a Long-Term Memory Bank that preserves reliable historical information through a fusion-oriented update strategy. To mitigate temporal fluctuations, a Temporal Smoothing Module leverages soft motion cues for coarse background stabilization. Building upon the resulting fusion prior, The second stage further employs a lightweight 3D residual Temporal Refinement Module to correct remaining temporal inconsistencies while enhancing structural details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemoryFusion achieves superior fusion quality and temporal consistency over existing frame-based and video-based fusion methods. The source code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MemoryFusion：两阶段多模态视频融合框架，用短期/长期记忆库做跨时序记忆学习，再用轻量3D残差时序精化模块抑制闪烁并提升结构细节。
AI.motivation: 现有视频融合方法依赖短程时序交互，长期信息未被利用；且融合表示不一致导致闪烁伪影，破坏时序一致性。
AI.method: 第一阶段：短期记忆库提供局部时序引导，长期记忆库经面向融合的更新策略保存可靠历史信息；时序平滑模块用软运动线索做粗背景稳定，得到融合先验。第二阶段：轻量3D残差时序精化模块修正残余时序不一致并增强结构细节。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法的融合质量与时序一致性优于现有基于帧和基于视频的融合方法，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨时序记忆学习与渐进式时序精化的两阶段设计，可同时缓解长程信息缺失与闪烁伪影两类耦合问题，实现高质量、时序一致的多模态视频融合。

title: MRC-MMAgent: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Role Collaboration in Multimodal Tool-Using Agents
summary: Multimodal tool-using agents augment vision-language models with access to external information and capabilities, enabling them to solve knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks that cannot be addressed using visual context alone. However, existing reinforcement learning pipelines largely train single-role agents to search and answer using terminal rewards, overlooking how humans inspect retrieved evidence, reformulate queries, and revise conclusions during search. Consequently, they fail to optimize this self-corrective process over complete interaction trajectories. We propose MRC-MMAgent, a multi-role collaborative reinforcement learning framework that incorporates trajectory assessment and continuation directly into the executable agent loop. First, the framework establishes a multi-role collaborative loop that integrates solving, inspection, and continuation, enabling the agent to acquire evidence through tools, evaluate the preceding trajectory, and resume problem solving when the current answer is insufficiently supported. Second, we introduce a role-coupled learning objective that combines task success, interaction validity, and successful correction with full-trajectory policy optimization across the decisions generated by all roles. Extensive experiments show that, using only the original baseline training set without constructing additional datasets, our method consistently outperforms the corresponding base models and achieves leading or highly competitive performance across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MRC-MMAgent 多角色协同强化学习框架，将解题、检查、续解三阶段闭环纳入可执行 agent 循环，并用角色耦合的整轨迹策略优化提升多模态检索式答题的自纠错能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态工具型 agent 的 RL 训练多为单角色、仅依赖终端奖励，忽视了人类检索时审查证据、改写查询、修正结论的自纠错过程，因而无法对完整交互轨迹上的自纠正行为进行优化。
AI.method: 构建 solve–inspect–continue 的多角色协同循环：agent 通过工具获取证据、评估前序轨迹、在答案支撑不足时恢复求解；设计角色耦合学习目标，融合任务成功、交互有效性、成功纠正三项信号，并对所有角色决策做全轨迹策略优化；仅使用原始基线训练集，不额外构造数据。
AI.result: 在多基准上稳定优于对应基座模型，取得领先或极具竞争力的性能，且无需额外数据集。
AI.conclusion: 将轨迹评估与续解显式嵌入 agent 循环并进行多角色耦合的整轨迹 RL，是一种无需扩充数据的有效自纠错训练范式。

title: SONIC-K1: Porting a Universal Humanoid Motion Tracker to a Small Humanoid on a Single GPU
summary: We present SONIC-K1, to our knowledge the first open-weights whole-body motion tracker for the Booster K1 humanoid, obtained by adapting the SONIC framework to this smaller robot. The policy is trained from scratch on a single shared GPU with a small fraction of the compute reported for SONIC. In MuJoCo simulation, it tracks nearly all held-out motion clips and performs well on external benchmarks under SONIC's success criterion. On the real K1, it tracks upper-body and slow motions, while stepping and turning remain less reliable, and simulation experiments show a sensitivity to action latency. These results show broad motion-tracking capability on a modest training budget and point to quantitative hardware evaluation as the main next step. Code, policy weights and evaluation tools are publicly available.

AI.tldr: SONIC-K1 是首个开源的 Booster K1 人形机器人全身运动跟踪策略，通过把小算力适配 SONIC 框架、单卡从零训练得到；仿真跟踪能力强，真机仅上半身与慢速动作可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有 SONIC 类全身运动跟踪框架面向较大机器人、算力开销高；缺少面向小型人形平台（Booster K1）的低成本开源运动跟踪方案与量化硬件评估基线。
AI.method: 将 SONIC 框架适配到 Booster K1，在单个共享 GPU 上以远低于 SONIC 的算力从零训练全身运动跟踪策略；在 MuJoCo 中按 SONIC 成功准则评测留出动作片段与外部基准，并在真机 K1 上测试，另做动作延迟敏感性仿真实验。开源代码、策略权重与评测工具。
AI.result: MuJoCo 中几乎跟踪全部留出动作片段，外部基准表现良好；真机上上半身与慢速动作可跟踪，迈步与转向可靠性不足；仿真显示对动作延迟敏感。
AI.conclusion: 在有限训练预算下展示了较广的全身运动跟踪能力；主要不足是 sim-to-real 差距（迈步/转向、延迟敏感），下一步重点是系统化的真机定量评估。

title: Can Image Agents Complete Visual Commissions? A Benchmark and Modular Framework
summary: Visual commissions require image agents to integrate heterogeneous source materials, preserve requirements across dependent stages, and produce coordinated deliverables. Existing evaluations examine specific capabilities and execution settings, leaving end-to-end commission completion less understood. We introduce Visual Commission Bench (VCB), comprising 600 tasks across 12 categories and three complementary tiers, from capability-focused tasks to complete commissions. VCB uses 5,039 requirement checks and separate visual quality ratings to assess content correctness, visual realization, constraint preservation, and delivery completeness without prescribing an internal workflow. We present V-Protocol, a reference agent that dynamically composes reusable task, cognitive, and expression modules at inference time. Task modules organize delivery, cognitive modules derive content, and expression modules guide visual realization. The modules exchange structured intermediate artifacts, while a shared execution harness tracks artifact revisions and dependencies, manages tool execution, and checks completion. With the same controller and image generator as the agent baselines, V-Protocol achieves 69.0\% strict task success on VCB, compared with 42.0\% for SCOPE. On Mind-Bench, strict accuracy increases from 39.2\% to 45.4\%.

AI.tldr: 提出Visual Commission Bench（VCB）基准（600任务/12类/三层级，5,039条需求检查+视觉质量评分）与V-Protocol参考智能体：推理时动态组合任务/认知/表达模块，模块间交换结构化中间产物，共享执行框架追踪修订与依赖，VCB严格成功率69.0%（SCOPE为42.0%）。
AI.motivation: 视觉委托类任务要求图像智能体整合异质素材、在依赖阶段间保持约束并产出协调一致的交付物，但现有评测只考察单一能力与特定执行设置，端到端任务完成度缺乏理解与度量。
AI.method: 构建VCB三段式层级基准，用需求检查+视觉质量双轨评估内容正确性、视觉实现、约束保持与交付完整性，不规定内部工作流；V-Protocol按需组合可复用模块：任务模块组织交付、认知模块推导内容、表达模块引导视觉实现，模块交换结构化中间制品，执行框架负责制品版本、依赖管理、工具调用与完成度校验。
AI.result: 在与基线相同的控制器和图像生成器条件下，V-Protocol在VCB上取得69.0%严格任务成功率（SCOPE 42.0%）；在Mind-Bench上严格准确率由39.2%提升至45.4%。
AI.conclusion: 端到端视觉委托可通过模块化组合+显式制品与依赖管理显著提升约束保持与交付完整性，VCB提供了细粒度、工作流无关的评估手段。

title: Telling Is Not Seeing: Textual Personas Rarely Make Vision-Language Models Answer Like the People They Describe
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly prompted with personas, such as "You have low vision", to stand in for people in user studies. We ask whether a persona makes a model see like the person it describes. We compare persona answers with measured people with low vision, color blindness or hearing loss, and with simple rules that use only the facts the persona states. The persona never beats these rules, and it erases the real differences between groups and individuals. Describing blur leaves recognition unchanged in all 14 models we test, while blurring the photo lowers it as it does for people. Inside open models, the description changes neither the image information nor the answer probabilities. Yet the models know the effects they fail to show: they can estimate how blur and illusions affect people. Telling is not seeing: a persona makes a model say what it knows about people, not see what they see.

AI.tldr: 该文检验"人格化提示"(persona prompting)能否让VLM"看见"所描述人群的视觉体验，发现persona只让模型复述其对人群的先验知识，而不改变视觉处理。
AI.motivation: VLM越来越多被赋予"低视力用户"等人格来替代真实被试做用户研究，但人格化是否真正复现了对应人群的感知与行为差异尚不清楚，需要验证其有效性。
AI.method: 将persona回答与真实测量的低视力、色盲、听力损失人群对比，并对照"仅使用persona所述事实的简单规则"基线；在14个模型上比较文字描述模糊与真实图像模糊的效果；并用可解释性手段检查开放模型内部图像表征与答案概率是否改变。
AI.result: persona从不优于简单规则基线，且抹平了群体间与个体间真实差异；描述模糊在全部14个模型中不改变识别表现，而真实模糊图像则如人类一样降低识别；开放模型内部图像信息与答案概率均无变化，但模型能正确估计模糊与视错觉对人的影响。
AI.conclusion: "告知不等于看见"：人格化提示只让模型说出它关于人的知识，而非重现其视觉感知；用人格化模型替代真实用户研究存在效度风险。

title: PicturePerfect: Diffusion-based Same-identity Facial Replacement
comment: Camera-ready version (ECCV 2026 workshop - Third Workshop on Foundation and Generative Models in Biometrics)
summary: With the growing success of diffusion models in computer vision, we explore their potential for same-identity facial replacement in photographs. Specifically, we propose a diffusion-based method, built on top of a pre-trained text-to-image model, that takes as input a portrait image of a person and a second reference image of the same individual, potentially captured under different conditions. The goal is to seamlessly replace the input face with the reference face, while keeping the background intact. Surprisingly, despite the clear real-world utility of this task, no recently published work has directly addressed face replacement in this specific setting. To support this goal, we construct a large dataset of image pairs depicting the same person under varying facial expressions and poses. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach produces more realistic and identity-consistent results than existing face reenactment models.

AI.tldr: 提出基于预训练文本到图像扩散模型的同身份人脸替换方法：输入人物肖像与同一人的参考图（拍摄条件可能不同），将输入人脸无缝替换为参考人脸并保持背景不变，并构建了同人不同表情/姿态的大规模图像对数据集。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在计算机视觉中表现突出，但同身份人脸替换（same-identity face replacement）这一有明确实用价值的设定尚无近期工作直接研究，因此填补该空白。
AI.method: 在预训练文本到图像扩散模型基础上构建的人脸替换方法，接收肖像图与同一人的第二张参考图作为条件，实现人脸区域的身份替换而保留背景；为此采集/构建了同一人在不同表情与姿态下的大规模图像对数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比现有人脸重演（face reenactment）模型，该方法生成的替换结果更真实、身份一致性更好。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型可用于高质量的同身份照片级人脸替换，且优于人脸重演基线；但该工作属人脸编辑/生成范畴，与 Physical AI、VLA、世界模型、具身导航、前馈3D重建、物理仿真器等核心关注方向无直接关联，属通用CV应用工作，优先级较低。

title: Semantic Mismapping in Generalized Category Discovery: Evaluation and Mitigation
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to perform old-category recognition and novel-category discovery in the same unlabeled set. Early methods address both objectives through clustering and evaluate the exchangeable predicted indices with global Hungarian (GH) matching. Recent methods adopt trainable parametric heads, using supervision for old-category recognition and discovery-oriented objectives for new categories. In this way, the output space becomes partially exchangeable: old indices are semantically anchored, while new indices remain exchangeable. However, these methods still apply global matching, which can reassign anchored old indices to other categories and hide some prediction errors. Empirically, we are surprised to observe that this reassignment can induce an overestimation of new-category accuracy by up to 25.63 points. We term this phenomenon semantic mismapping and further derive a permutation-cycle condition that characterizes when semantic mismapping can increase the global matching score. To fix this issue, we propose Semantics-Preserving Evaluation (SPE), which preserves the supervised semantics of old indices and restricts Hungarian matching to the new region. Furthermore, we propose Mismapping-Mitigating Optimization (MMO) to alleviate the prediction errors that can give rise to semantic mismapping, combining a region-balance loss (RBL) for old/new routing with a novel-diversity loss (NDL) that encourages orthogonality among new prototypes. Theoretically, we show that minimizing the two losses can tighten an upper bound on spurious accuracy gains from semantic mismapping, with controllable residual terms. Empirical results under both GH and SPE demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 论文指出广义类别发现(GCD)中全局匈牙利匹配会把已锚定的旧类索引重映射到其他类别，造成“语义错配”，使新类准确率被高估最多25.63点；提出保留语义的评估协议SPE与缓解错配的优化MMO。
AI.motivation: 近期GCD方法采用可训练参数头，旧类索引经监督锚定语义、新类索引仍可交换，输出空间因此"部分可交换"。但评测仍沿用全局匈牙利匹配，会错误重分配已锚定的旧类索引，掩盖预测错误并虚高新类准确率，作者称之为semantic mismapping，并观察到最高25.63点的虚高。
AI.method: 1) 给出置换环(permutation-cycle)条件，刻画语义错配何时能抬高全局匹配得分；2) 提出SPE：固定旧类索引的监督语义，仅对新类区域做匈牙利匹配；3) 提出MMO优化：区域平衡损失RBL用于旧/新路由，新类多样性损失NDL促使新原型正交，理论证明最小化两者可收紧虚假准确率增益上界且残差项可控。
AI.result: SPE下揭示全局匹配导致的新类准确率高估可达25.63个点；在GH与SPE两种评测下实验均验证所提方法有效，且理论给出虚假增益上界的收紧与残差可控性。
AI.conclusion: GCD评测应尊重部分可交换输出空间的语义锚定，采用区域内匹配；同时需从优化侧抑制引发错配的预测错误。该工作兼具评测协议修正与方法改进，但属于表示学习/聚类评测范畴，未涉及具身或3D感知任务。

title: Utility-WAM: Correcting Future-Induced Action Changes
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) can condition robot actions on generated visual futures, but this additional context is neither cost-free nor uniformly beneficial. We examine what a predicted future actually changes: the action delta $\Delta a$ between the future-conditioned and future-free execution paths of the same model. Under a shared WAM checkpoint, this delta barely shifts average benchmark success ($+0.8$ points on LIBERO, $-0.8$ on RoboTwin~2.0), while generating visual futures increases inference latency by 1.7--1.9$\times$. These aggregate metrics conceal a concentrated failure mode that we term \emph{future-induced negative transfer}: while predictive deltas benefit long-horizon tasks ($+2.4$ points on LIBERO-Long) and remain negligible on most routine manipulations, they induce severe degradation on precision tasks---with \emph{Press Stapler} and \emph{Place Can Basket} losing 54.0 and 34.0 points, recurring as top failure modes across independently trained WAM variants. We introduce \textbf{Utility-WAM} for in-place correction of future-conditioned control. Its primary learning component is a residual adapter that repairs future-induced velocity deltas under a frozen shared WAM by aligning them with ground-truth dynamic guidance and penalizing excess error beyond the future-free baseline. The adapter selectively eliminates the majority of severe task drops (reducing losses to 6.0 and 14.0 points) while preserving long-horizon foresight. To eliminate superfluous video computation, a lightweight pre-generation gate reuses counterfactual action outcomes to selectively bypass video generation on 75.5\% of RoboTwin queries, cutting latency by 38\% while improving average success to 93.3\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and 98.9\% on LIBERO. On physical bimanual manipulation across three real-world tasks, Utility-WAM succeeds in 53 of 60 trials, compared to 43 for FAST-WAM.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析World Action Model中"预测未来视觉"带来的动作增量Δa，揭示出未来条件化导致的负迁移（future-induced negative transfer）集中于精密操作任务，并提出Utility-WAM：残差适配器修复未来诱导的速度偏差 + 预生成门控跳过冗余视频生成，在LIBERO/RoboTwin 2.0及真实双臂任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: WAM以生成的视觉未来作为条件虽常用，但其代价（推理延迟1.7–1.9×）与收益并不对等；平均指标掩盖了任务间的异质效应，作者希望明确"预测未来究竟改变了什么"，并针对其失效模式做就地修正与计算裁剪。
AI.method: 1) 反事实分析：在同一共享WAM检查点下比较未来条件路径与无未来路径的动作差Δa，跨独立训练的WAM变体统计失效分布；2) Utility-WAM：在冻结主干上训练残差适配器，将未来诱导的速度增量对齐到真值动态引导，并对超出无未来基线的超额误差施加惩罚；3) 轻量预生成门控复用反事实动作结果，选择性跳过视频生成。
AI.result: 平均成功率变化极小（LIBERO +0.8，RoboTwin 2.0 −0.8）但延迟增1.7–1.9×；长程任务LIBERO-Long +2.4；精密任务严重退化（Press Stapler −54.0，Place Can Basket −34.0），且在多个WAM变体中复现。适配器将两项损失分别收窄至6.0与14.0；门控在RoboTwin 75.5%查询上跳过视频生成，延迟降38%，成功率升至93.3%（RoboTwin 2.0）与98.9%（LIBERO）；真实双臂三任务60次试验成功53次，FAST-WAM为43次。
AI.conclusion: 预测未来并非普遍有益，其收益集中于长程规划、风险集中于精密操作；通过冻结主干上的残差对齐修正与反事实门控，可同时抑制负迁移、保留前瞻能力并显著降低推理延迟，具备真实机器人验证。

title: Limit Theorems and Optimal Policies for Flock Flight through Poisson Forests
summary: Inspired by birds flying through cluttered environments, Karaman and Frazzoli showed that high-speed flight through an ergodic random forest exhibits an ultimate speed limit: above a critical speed, almost surely no infinite collision-free trajectory exists for a single bird. This paper formulates a corresponding bulk-transport problem for many birds. We construct an explicit directed corridor network in a Poisson disk forest and impose a common temporal headway at its waypoints. The maximum current equals a minimum vertex-cut capacity and is achieved by repeated flight along vertex-disjoint paths. The same schedule maximizes completed traversals at every finite horizon, with constant forward speed and no internal waiting. For a forest belt of fixed depth, exact transverse superadditivity yields an almost-sure deterministic current-density limit. A uniform shape theorem for an asymmetric planar dual identifies the current when depth and width grow together. For diverging depth bounded by a constant times width, this current equals the width-first, depth-second limit and is independent of the positive aspect ratio. When diagonal corridors are available, bulk current is positive at sufficiently low obstacle intensity and zero at sufficiently high intensity. For stochastic demand, an upstream admission queue is stable at every rate below the finite-network capacity.

AI.tldr: 该文将单鸟穿行随机森林的速度极限问题推广为多鸟的"体输运"问题，在Poisson disk森林中构造显式有向走廊网络并施加统一时间头距，证明最大流等于最小顶点割容量、该调度在每个有限时域最大化完成穿越数，并在深度固定/深度与宽度同增等情形下给出几乎必然的电流密度极限与形状定理。
AI.motivation: Karaman与Frazzoli已证明单只鸟在遍历性随机森林中存在临界速度上限：超过该速度几乎必然不存在无限无碰撞轨迹。本文希望把这一单智能体可达性结论提升为多智能体（群体）的吞吐/输运能力刻画，即为大量飞行个体建立对应的体输运问题及其容量极限。
AI.method: 在Poisson disk森林中显式构造有向走廊网络，并在路径点处施加共同的时间头距约束；用最小顶点割容量刻画最大电流，并通过重复沿顶点不相交路径飞行实现；采用"前向恒速、无内部等待"的调度；对固定深度森林带证明精确的横向超可加性以得到确定性电流密度极限；对非对称平面对偶建立一致的形状定理以确定深度与宽度同时增长时的电流；另分析对角走廊可用性对障碍强度阈值的影响，以及随机需求下上游准入队列的稳定性。
AI.result: 最大电流等于最小顶点割容量，并由沿顶点不相交路径的重复飞行达到；同一调度在每个有限时域均最大化完成穿越数，且为恒速前向、无内部等待；固定深度森林带具有几乎必然的确定性电流密度极限；深度受常数倍宽度约束时，电流等于"先宽度、后深度"极限且与正长宽比无关；存在对角走廊时低障碍强度下体电流为正、高强度下为零；随机需求下上游准入队列在低于有限网络容量的任意速率下稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为随机森林中的群体高速飞行提供了完整的容量—调度理论框架，把单智能体速度极限扩展为多智能体的体输运极限，并给出流—割对偶、最优性、形状定理与队列稳定性等严格结论；但其为纯理论/渐近结果，缺少真实机器人平台验证与算法实现层面的计算可行性讨论。

title: Information-Driven Collaborative Autonomy for Heterogeneous UAV/UGV Teams
summary: This paper considers coordinating a heterogeneous team of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) traversing a domain containing an unknown number of potentially hazardous targets. The UAVs provide aerial sensing using onboard optical cameras, adapting their trajectories to ground routes and target information. We formulate the aerial search problem using ergodic control, which distributes sensing effort according to a spatial information density to balance exploration and target localization. The formulation incorporates dynamic camera field-of-view footprints and pose-dependent probabilistic detection models. Angles-only measurements are processed through Bayesian inference and marginalization over data-association hypotheses to obtain a Poisson multi-Bernoulli (PMB) approximation of the target posterior, representing both detected and undetected targets. This belief directs aerial sensing toward unexplored regions along the ground routes and viewpoints that improve target localization. Ground planning combines chance-constrained target avoidance, enforced through confidence sets, with a void-probability objective that favors routes unlikely to contain threats. We solve each team's optimization problem in a fully decentralized manner using a nested SCvx*--C-ADMM scheme, with outer sequential convex programming iterations and inner distributed consensus optimization, accounting for nonlinearities, nonseparable objectives, and continuous-time inter-agent separation constraints. A closed-loop scheme updates both fleets' trajectories as information becomes available and permits ground motion when the remaining route risk falls below a prescribed threshold. Numerical case studies examine sensing geometry and target uncertainty, compare decentralized and centralized solvers, and demonstrate full closed-loop collaboration between multiple UAVs and UGVs.

AI.tldr: 空地下异构UAV-UGV协同搜索：UAV用遍历控制(ergodic control)按信息密度分配光学侦察，结合动态FOV与位姿相关检测模型，经贝叶斯推断与数据关联边缘化得到PMB后验；UGV用置信集机会约束避障+空概率目标规划路径，以嵌套SCvx*-C-ADMM完全去中心化求解并闭环更新。
AI.motivation: 未知数量潜在危险目标环境下的空地协同搜索需要同时兼顾探索与定位，且多智能体非凸、非可分目标与连续时间安全约束难以集中求解。
AI.method: 遍历控制(基于信息密度的空间遍历)+动态相机FOV足迹与位姿相关概率检测模型；angles-only量测的贝叶斯推断+对数据关联假设边缘化得PMB近似随机有限集后验；地面规划为机会约束目标规避(置信集)+void-probability目标；嵌套SCvx*-C-ADMM(外层序列凸规划、内层分布式共识)去中心化求解，闭环风险阈值触发地面运动。
AI.result: 数值算例考察传感几何与目标不确定性，比较去中心化与集中式求解器，并演示多UAV-多UGV完整闭环协同。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一套理论完备的空地异构协同搜索框架（遍历控制+PMB信念+分布式SCvx/C-ADMM），但验证仅为数值仿真，缺乏实机与开源证据。

title: UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection
summary: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices allow human experts to demonstrate tasks for robot learning without teleoperating physical robots. Using these demonstrations as training data still requires a consistent hardware setup, calibration, and data processing. We present UMI-Live, a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system for in-the-wild data collection. We design our custom UMI-Live hardware to integrate camera and LiDAR--inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power, without external tracking equipment or calibration within the collection environment. We implement a simple user interface for recording data while an asynchronous pipeline performs parallel SLAM reconstruction and publishes training-ready datasets. We also release software that supports dual-YAM teleoperation and VLA policy training and inference. We validate UMI-Live data quality by fine-tuning $\pi_{0.5}$ and MolmoAct2, achieving success rates of 10/10 and 8/10, respectively on a bimanual pick-and-place task. Furthermore, we release 40 hours of UMI-Live data across three tasks, and complete hardware designs, software, and reproduction guides at our $\href{ this https URL }{\text{project website}}$.

AI.tldr: UMI-Live 是一套全栈开源双臂 UMI 数据采集系统，集成相机+LiDAR-惯性、板载计算与供电，无需外部动捕/标定，异步 SLAM 重建后直接输出可训练数据集，并附带遥操作与 VLA 训练/推理软件，微调 π0.5 与 MolmoAct2 在双臂抓放任务上达 10/10 与 8/10 成功率。
AI.motivation: UMI 类手持示教装置虽免去遥操作实体机器人，但实际使用仍需固定硬件配置、标定与繁琐数据处理流程，制约了野外（in-the-wild）大规模数据采集。
AI.method: 自研双臂 UMI-Live 硬件：集成相机与 LiDAR-惯性融合传感、板载算力与电池，采集现场无需外部跟踪设备或标定；提供简洁录制 UI，后台异步流水线并行执行 SLAM 重建并发布可直接训练的格式；开源双 YAM 遥操作、VLA 策略训练与推理软件栈。
AI.result: 在双臂 pick-and-place 任务上，用 UMI-Live 数据微调 π0.5 与 MolmoAct2 分别取得 10/10 与 8/10 成功率；开源 40 小时、覆盖 3 个任务的数据集及完整硬件设计与复现指南。
AI.conclusion: 该系统把采集-标定-重建-训练链路工程化打通并全栈开源，是具身数据基础设施层面的实用贡献；但任务类型有限、缺乏跨任务/跨环境泛化与规模效应验证，方法新颖性主要在系统集成而非算法。

title: CASE: Concept-Aware Segmentation from Positive and Negative Visual Exemplars
summary: Few-shot semantic segmentation typically identifies target objects based on positive support examples of a single semantic class. In practice, however, positive cues alone are often underspecified: for instance, "red cars" may be confused with cars of all colors, "vehicles" may include cars that should be excluded, and "material-defined objects" may span multiple categories. Fulfilling precise requests requires positive exemplars to provide inclusion evidence and negative exemplars to act as intent-defining constraints for exclusion and disambiguation. We formulate this setting as Specified Visual Prompt Segmentation (SVPS), where the target concept is specified by both positive and negative visual prompts. In this work, visual exemplars refer to support-image regions specified by bounding-box prompts. To study SVPS, we introduce CASE (Concept-Aware Segmentation from Positive and Negative Visual Exemplars), a benchmark built on COCO and PACO. CASE encompasses six category- and attribute-level task families: exclusion, isolation, union, attribute exclusion, attribute isolation, and attribute union. We evaluate SAM 3 under this setting and find that, despite its powerful positive-only few-shot segmentation capability, frozen SAM 3 does not consistently treat negative visual prompts as exclusion evidence. To address this, we present Concept Prompt Adaptation (CPA), a conservative LoRA-based adaptation baseline that improves positive-negative prompt interpretation on CASE while remaining competitive under positive-only few-shot segmentation. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Specified Visual Prompt Segmentation (SVPS) 设定：目标概念由正/负视觉提示（bbox 指定的支持图区域）共同界定；构建 COCO/PACO 上的 CASE 基准（6 类任务族：排除、隔离、并集及其属性版），并发现冻结的 SAM 3 无法稳定将负提示作为排除证据，提出基于 LoRA 的 Concept Prompt Adaptation (CPA) 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 few-shot 语义分割仅依赖单一类别的正样本提示，正证据常欠定义：如"红车"会混淆所有颜色车辆、"车辆"会包含应排除的类别、材质定义物体跨多类，因此需要负样本作为意图约束，实现排除与消歧。
AI.method: 形式化 SVPS 任务（正+负 bbox 视觉提示）；基于 COCO 与 PACO 构建 CASE 基准，覆盖类别级与属性级的 exclusion/isolation/union 六族任务；评估冻结 SAM 3 的正负提示行为；提出 CPA——保守的 LoRA 适配，仅微调提示解释部分，以同时保持正样本 few-shot 分割性能。
AI.result: 冻结 SAM 3 具备较强正样本 few-shot 分割能力，但不能一致地将负视觉提示当作排除证据；CPA 在 CASE 上提升正负提示的解释能力，同时在正样本-only few-shot 分割上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 视觉提示分割需显式建模正负证据；负提示是意图定义的必要约束；轻量 LoRA 适配可有效修正基础模型对负提示的忽略，为提示可指定化的分割奠定基线。

title: ACD-GS: Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for real-time photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, its training-time densification remains largely heuristic, often resulting in redundant Gaussian proliferation and inaccurate geometric reconstruction. Existing methods predominantly rely on first-order screen-space gradients to trigger cloning and splitting, which fail to distinguish true geometric discontinuities from high-frequency textures or noisy residuals. To address this limitation, we propose ACD-GS, an Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification framework for compact and geometry-aware 3D Gaussian optimization. Our key insight is that second-order depth responses provide a more reliable structural prior for density control, enabling asymmetric regulation of cloning and splitting to better capture geometric discontinuities. Building on this, we introduce a multi-view photometric consistency constraint to suppress transient single-view errors, together with a capacity-aware adaptive regulation strategy that balances densification and pruning during training. Unlike post-hoc compression or quantization-based approaches, ACD-GS directly prevents redundant Gaussian generation during training, yielding inherently compact representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces nearly 60% of Gaussian count and storage while maintaining competitive rendering fidelity, consistently outperforming existing methods across multiple datasets. Our code is available in this https URL .

AI.tldr: ACD-GS proposes curvature-aware (second-order depth response) densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting, with asymmetric cloning/splitting, multi-view photometric consistency, and capacity-aware adaptive regulation, cutting ~60% Gaussians/storage while keeping rendering fidelity.
AI.motivation: 3DGS densification is heuristic and relies on first-order screen-space gradients, which cannot distinguish true geometric discontinuities from high-frequency textures and noisy residuals, causing redundant Gaussians and poor geometry.
AI.method: Uses second-order depth response (curvature) as a structural prior to trigger densification; applies asymmetric regulation of cloning vs. splitting; adds multi-view photometric consistency to suppress transient single-view errors; introduces capacity-aware adaptive regulation balancing densification and pruning during training (no post-hoc compression).
AI.result: Reduces Gaussian count and storage by nearly 60% while maintaining competitive rendering fidelity; consistently outperforms existing methods on multiple datasets. Code released.
AI.conclusion: Training-time, geometry-aware density control yields inherently compact 3DGS representations, preferable to post-hoc compression/quantization.

title: SymKL: A Unified Representation-Space Measure of Signal Degradation
summary: Quantifying degradation between a pristine signal and its degraded observation is fundamental to signal processing, yet existing full-reference measures are inherently modality-specific. We introduce SymKL, a unified full-reference degradation measure based on implicit neural representations (INRs). An INR is fitted once to the pristine reference and characterized by its diagonal Fisher information, which captures the local information geometry of the learned representation. Evaluating the Fisher information with the pristine reference and a degraded observation yields two parameter-sensitivity profiles whose symmetric KL divergence defines the degradation score. The proposed formulation requires only the reference and degraded observation, without knowledge of the corruption process or degradation severity, making it applicable across images, audio, and 3D data. We further derive an exact closed-form expression for the diagonal Fisher of SIREN, enabling efficient computation. Experiments on image, speech, and volumetric 3D benchmarks demonstrate that SymKL accurately tracks degradation severity, remains monotonic where conventional metrics saturate or fail, and provides a unified modality-agnostic measure of signal degradation. Code will be made publicly available after the review process.

AI.tldr: SymKL：用隐式神经表示(INR)的Fisher信息几何定义跨模态全参考退化度量，对称KL散度作为退化分数，并给出SIREN对角Fisher的闭式解。
AI.motivation: 现有全参考质量/退化度量都与模态强绑定（图像用PSNR/SSIM、音频用PESQ等），缺乏统一、无需知道退化类型与强度的度量。
AI.method: 对纯净参考信号拟合一次INR；用对角Fisher信息表征该表示的局部信息几何。分别以参考与退化观测评估Fisher，得到两个参数敏感度剖面，其对称KL散度即为退化分数。推导SIREN对角Fisher的精确闭式表达式以加速计算。
AI.result: 在图像、语音、体素3D三类基准上，SymKL能准确跟踪退化严重程度，在传统指标饱和或失效区间仍保持单调性。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种模态无关的统一全参考退化度量，仅需参考与退化观测，代码将公开。

title: YOLOF-MLD: A Multi-Level Distillation Framework for Efficient Object Detection
summary: Efficient object detection on resource-constrained edge devices is essential for safety-critical applications such as fire-smoke monitoring. However, current lightweight frameworks, such as YOLO26, still rely on the parameter-dense multi-branch Feature Pyramid Network (FPN), preventing full exploitation of their lightweight advantage. Replacing FPN with YOLOF's single-input-single-output (SiSo) neck is a promising solution but causes substantial accuracy loss. To alleviate this, we propose YOLOF-MLD, a CPU-efficient multi-level distillation (MLD) framework that combines a YOLO26n backbone, a SiSo neck, and MLD. It aligns features at the backbone via sliced-semantics matching, neck with receptive-field matching, and response levels. On D-Fire and Annotated Fire-Smoke (AFS) datasets, YOLOF-MLD reduces the parameter count of YOLO26n by 35.7\% and achieves a 62.3\% speedup on Raspberry Pi 5, attaining 71.6% and 59.9% mAP@50, respectively, compared with 75.5% and 60.0% for YOLO26n. These results demonstrate a competitive accuracy--latency trade-off for edge deployment. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: YOLOF-MLD：用YOLO26n主干+SiSo颈+多层蒸馏（骨干切片语义匹配、颈部感受野匹配、响应层对齐）实现CPU/边缘高效火烟检测。
AI.motivation: 轻量检测框架（如YOLO26）仍依赖参数密集的多分支FPN，削弱了轻量化优势；直接用YOLOF的SiSo颈替换FPN虽降低参数，但精度损失明显。
AI.method: 提出YOLOF-MLD多层蒸馏框架：backbone采用YOLO26n，neck换成单输入单输出（SiSo）颈；通过骨干层切片语义匹配、颈部感受野匹配以及响应层蒸馏三部分对齐师生特征，弥补SiSo颈的表征损失。
AI.result: 在D-Fire与Annotated Fire-Smoke数据集上，参数量较YOLO26n降低35.7%，树莓派5上加速62.3%，mAP@50分别为71.6%和59.9%（YOLO26n为75.5%和60.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 以轻度精度代价换取显著参数与延迟收益，为边缘端安全监测提供有竞争力的精度—延迟折中方案，代码开源。

title: Anatomical Prior-Guided Routing for 3D Lung Tumor Segmentation
summary: Accurate lung tumor segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for treatment planning, response assessment, and quantitative imaging analysis. However, 3D lung tumor segmentation remains challenging because tumors occupy only a small portion of the whole volume and exhibit heterogeneous appearances across anatomical locations. In patch-based training and sliding-window inference for 3D medical image segmentation, location-dependent heterogeneity is further amplified because cropped image patches provide limited global anatomical context, making it difficult for a model to adapt its feature processing according to the anatomical region from which each patch is extracted. To address this limitation, we propose an Anatomical Prior-guided Routing Module (APRM) for lung tumor segmentation. For each image patch, we obtain anatomical prior information of regional occupancy and deterministically select an anatomical routing gate. The selected gate then performs sparse feature routing over a shared expert adapter pool, enabling anatomy-specific feature adaptation while sharing expert capacity across regions. We evaluate APRM on two datasets with various backbone networks and demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline models. Furthermore, feature visualizations show that APRM produces different feature responses depending on patch location, indicating that the proposed routing mechanism effectively adapts feature processing according to anatomical context.

AI.tldr: 提出解剖先验引导路由模块(APRM)，利用每个图像块的区域占用先验确定性地选择解剖路由门，在共享专家适配器池上做稀疏特征路由，实现按解剖区域自适应的肺肿瘤3D分割特征处理。
AI.motivation: 3D肺肿瘤分割中肿瘤占比小、外观异质性强；patch训练与滑窗推理削弱全局解剖上下文，使位置相关异质性被放大，模型难以根据patch所在解剖区域自适应处理特征。
AI.method: 基于解剖先验的确定性路由门选择 + 共享专家适配器池上的稀疏特征路由(top-k门控混合专家式适配)，作为可插拔模块接入多种骨干；在滑窗推理时依据patch位置逐块路由。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、多种骨干网络上取得一致相对基线的提升；特征可视化显示不同位置patch的特征响应不同，佐证路由按解剖上下文调整特征处理。
AI.conclusion: 解剖先验路由是一种轻量、可迁移的医学分割增强思路，但仅验证于医学CT领域，缺乏与具身/3D重建等核心方向的直接关联。

title: Decoding Geometry, Not Tokens: Efficient VLMs for Robot Affordance and Trajectory Prediction
comment: IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary: Predicting where to grasp and how to move is fundamentally a geometry problem. Vision-language models treat it as language generation instead. They tokenize spatial coordinates into text and decode them autoregressively. This mechanism ignores spatial structure and truncates continuous precision. Errors compound across coordinate tokens during decoding. In this paper, we show that compact off-the-shelf VLMs with 0.5-2B parameters already encode rich spatial information in their intermediate hidden states. Autoregressive decoding is the dominant bottleneck for trajectory prediction, while affordance prediction depends additionally on feature depth and decoder architecture. We expose the latent spatial information with a lightweight, geometry-compatible prediction head that attaches to a frozen backbone. It reads features from an intermediate hidden layer, conditions a learned query on the task instruction and refines it via cross-attention over the visual tokens to regress affordance boxes and trajectory waypoints directly as continuous values, without modifying the backbone. We evaluate on ShareRobot-Bench and AGD20K. Our 2B variant reduces trajectory error by over 60% and improves ShareRobot-Bench affordance mAP by 85% relative to the autoregressive baseline. It approaches RoboBrain on trajectory prediction (0.251 vs 0.191 DFD) at 3.8x higher throughput. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for instruction-conditioned 2D geometric prediction.
