AI.tldr: 该文指出VLM把抓取/轨迹预测当作坐标token自回归生成是错误的几何问题建模方式，并提出冻结骨干+轻量几何预测头，从中间隐层特征直接回归affordance框与轨迹路点连续值。
AI.motivation: 指令条件下的抓取位置与轨迹预测本质是二维几何回归问题，而现有VLM将空间坐标token化为文本并自回归解码：忽略空间结构、截断连续精度、坐标token间误差累积。作者主张自回归解码是轨迹预测的主要瓶颈，并希望验证小规模（0.5–2B）VLM隐状态中是否已含丰富空间信息。
AI.method: 冻结VLM骨干，从中间隐层读取视觉token特征；以任务指令条件化一个可学习query，通过cross-attention在视觉token上迭代精化，末端接轻量几何兼容预测头，直接连续回归affordance框与轨迹路点；不改动骨干、不生成坐标token。
AI.result: 在ShareRobot-Bench与AGD20K上，2B变体相较自回归基线轨迹误差降低>60%、affordance mAP提升85%；轨迹预测DFD 0.251 vs RoboBrain 0.191，但吞吐量高3.8倍。消融显示affordance预测还依赖特征深度与解码器结构。
AI.conclusion: 中间层隐特征已编码充分的空间信息，瓶颈在于解码方式而非表征能力；用轻量回归头替换自回归坐标解码可在精度-效率间取得更优权衡，也为指令条件二维几何预测提供了简洁范式。

title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this gap. We introduce ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks in which the scene, question, and answer are fixed and only the reference varies. Results show that task-matched references improve accuracy by up to 25\%, while mismatched references provide little benefit or even hurt performance. These findings identify the reference gap as a bottleneck distinct from visual perception and show that constructing task-appropriate visual references can serve as a training-free visual skill for improving multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出"指称鸿沟"(reference gap)概念：多模态大模型在视觉推理中的失败常被归因于感知，实为语言未能绑定到相关视觉实体/区域/位置。基于视觉 routines 理论引入 ReGap-Bench（五个视觉推理任务，场景/问题/答案固定，仅改变指称方式），发现任务匹配的指称（如编号）可提升准确率至多25%，不匹配指称则无益甚至有害。
AI.motivation: MLLM 能"看到"却难以多步可靠推理（如计数时丢失已计对象），作者主张这并非感知缺陷，而是语言-视觉实体绑定失败，即指称鸿沟；借鉴视觉 routines 理论检验外部指称能否弥合该鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建配对基准 ReGap-Bench：五类视觉推理任务，固定场景、问题与答案，仅操纵指称形式（加编号等），对比任务匹配与不匹配指称下模型表现的差异。
AI.result: 任务匹配指称带来最高约25%的准确率提升；不匹配指称收益很小，甚至导致性能下降，说明指称需与任务结构对齐才有效。
AI.conclusion: 指称鸿沟是与视觉感知相区别的独立瓶颈；构造任务适配的视觉指称可作为免训练的"视觉技能"提升多模态推理。

title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 24 pages (11 main + 13 supplementary). Project page: this https URL
summary: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. We propose Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning (FDSML), which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters beyond discrete class labels. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. This objective trains embeddings to respect parameter-derived relative similarity orderings. Experiments show that FDSML improves transferability to image retrieval while remaining competitive on downstream classification and improving robustness under several corruption settings. On ResNet-50, Recall@1 improves from 65.6% to 74.0% on Stanford Online Products and from 56.2% to 78.4% on Stanford Cars over FDSL pre-training. These results suggest that parameter-derived relational supervision provides a stronger synthetic pre-training signal than label-based classification for transfer beyond recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出FDSML，用迭代函数系统(IFS)生成参数空间中的相对距离构造三元组监督，替代FDSL的离散标签分类预训练，在细粒度检索上显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有Formula-Driven Supervised Learning（如FractalDB）把无真实图像的预训练建模为对离散化标签的分类，丢失了生成过程本身的连续性与参数间结构关系，导致预训练信号受限、迁移到识别以外任务（如检索）时效果弱。
AI.method: 1) 构建FineFractalDB精细分形数据集，提高类内变化并增强结构稳定性；2) 提出Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss，按IFS参数空间中的距离分配正负样本，使embedding遵循由参数导出的相对相似度排序；3) 以度量学习目标替代离散分类目标进行合成预训练。
AI.result: ResNet-50上Stanford Online Products Recall@1由65.6%提升至74.0%，Stanford Cars由56.2%提升至78.4%；下游分类保持竞争力，多种corruption设定下鲁棒性提升。
AI.conclusion: 参数导出的关系型监督比基于标签的分类提供更强的合成预训练信号，尤其利于向检索等非识别任务迁移，为无真实数据的预训练提供了新的监督范式。

title: ScheduleGen: Demonstration Generation via Skill Scheduling for Multi-Arm Imitation Learning
comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Project website and videos: this https URL
summary: Multi-arm robot platforms, including bimanual and humanoid robots, have the capability to complete tasks with lower cycle times than single-arm systems, but they are more difficult to safely control due to the presence of multi-arm constraints. The paradigm of training generalist robot policies from massive datasets is a promising approach to address general-purpose multi-arm manipulation, but the acquisition of large multi-arm manipulation datasets remains a bottleneck. Automated demonstration generation can alleviate this burden by synthesizing new demonstrations from a handful of source demonstrations, but existing algorithms ignore multi-arm constraints and as a result often induce unsafe and unsuccessful behaviors. We address this limitation by introducing ScheduleGen, an integrated planning & scheduling algorithm for multi-arm demonstration generation. We evaluate ScheduleGen on 28 simulation task variants, including seven externally authored RoboDojo tasks and settings inaccessible to prior systems; it achieves 79.6% mean data-generation success and trains policies with 65.5% mean success. ScheduleGen policies outperform those trained on a state-of-the-art data generation baseline, and achieve 50-80% success across eight real-world variants through zero-shot sim-to-real and real-to-sim-to-real transfer. Videos and more at: this https URL

AI.tldr: ScheduleGen：面向多臂机器人（双臂/人形）演示生成的统一规划+调度算法，在生成过程中显式加入多臂约束，从少量源演示合成大量安全可行演示。
AI.motivation: 多臂平台跨臂约束（碰撞、同步、互锁）使安全控制困难，且多臂演示数据稀缺成为训练通才策略的瓶颈；现有演示自动生成算法忽略多臂约束，产生不安全与失败行为。
AI.method: 提出集成式 planning & scheduling 算法 ScheduleGen：从少量源演示出发，将跨臂约束纳入规划/调度中合成新演示，用于训练多臂通用策略。
AI.result: 在28个仿真任务变体（含7个外部作者RoboDojo任务及先前系统不可达设置）上，平均数据生成成功率79.6%，训练策略平均成功率65.5%；优于SOTA数据生成基线；经零样本sim-to-real及real-to-sim-to-real，在8个真实变体上达到50-80%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模多臂约束的规划+调度是高效扩展多臂演示数据的可行路径，并可迁移到真实平台。

title: PathCowork: Learning from real-world pathology practice to build AI copilots
comment: 56 pages, including supplementary information. Code, models and demonstration videos: this https URL
summary: Medical AI learns from the answers doctors record, but rarely from how they interpret the evidence to reach them. Here we introduce PathCowork, a framework that turns pathologists' narrated examinations into supervision for visual grounding and procedures that guide diagnostic AI agents. Synchronized gaze, narration and navigation link visual findings to the process of interpreting them. Across 48 sessions from 16 pathologists, the platform captured 1,028 minutes of slide review. Using these data, we trained PathCowork-1T for server deployment and PathCowork-27B for local deployment, with improved visual grounding. Across five organ-specific evaluations, agents combining this grounding with recorded diagnostic procedures achieved primary task scores averaging 17.9 and 24.1 percentage points higher than Claude Code and Codex, respectively, with shorter processing times and lower inference costs. Compared to the state-of-the-art multiple-instance learning AIs, the PathCowork agent-proposed regions achieved higher prostate-grading scores with limited slide labels. PathCowork can also help construct pathology AI benchmarks where questions derived from the recordings identified difficulties in recognizing viewing context and rejecting inapplicable premises. In summary, PathCowork proposes a new paradigm to scale up the data collection and train pathology AI through transparent reasoning from diagnostic sessions, opening a path towards systems that learn directly from routine clinical practice.

AI.tldr: PathCowork 将病理医生检查切片时的注视、口述与导航同步记录，转成视觉 grounding 与诊断流程监督，训练 PathCowork-1T/27B，在五个器官的任务上显著优于 Claude Code 与 Codex。
AI.motivation: 医学 AI 通常只学习医生记录的最终答案，而丢弃了医生"如何解读证据"的过程信息；作者希望把常规临床阅片过程本身变成可扩展的监督信号。
AI.method: 构建同步采集注视/口述/导航的阅片平台，覆盖 16 位病理医生 48 次会话、共 1028 分钟；以此数据监督视觉 grounding 与诊断流程，训练服务器端 1T 模型与本地 27B 模型，并与记录下来的诊断流程结合形成 agent；另用于构建病理 AI 基准。
AI.result: 五个器官专项评测中，结合 grounding 与记录流程的 agent 主任务得分分别比 Claude Code、Codex 高 17.9 和 24.1 个百分点，处理时间更短、推理成本更低；相比 SOTA 多实例学习模型，agent 提出的区域在少量切片标签下取得更高的前列腺分级分数。
AI.conclusion: 提出以透明推理过程为监督的新范式，可扩展地采集数据并训练病理 AI，为直接从常规临床实践中学习的系统提供路径。

title: Ask to Evolve: A Unified Harness for Lifelong Embodied Navigation with Hybrid Action Space and Persistent Memory
summary: Giving embodied agents the freedom to act autonomously, initiate interactions, and understand their surroundings through experience is a step toward bringing them to life in the physical world. Realizing this vision requires action, interaction, and memory to work together, so that each encounter can inform current decisions and contribute experience for future tasks. We present EvoLife, a unified navigation harness that enables a multimodal embodied agent to choose how to move, when to ask, and what experience to carry forward. Its hybrid action space supports waypoint navigation, local discrete adjustments, pixel-based navigation, and object-directed navigation. Active interaction allows the agent to seek clarification or assistance when it encounters ambiguity or difficulty, while persistent spatial memory binds observations and dialogue to places, retaining useful experience to guide subsequent visits. We evaluate eight benchmarks across four task families: vision-language navigation, object navigation, interactive instance navigation, and continuous multi-task navigation. With an average of only 1.87 active interactions per episode, our method achieves a first-visit success rate (SR) of 100% across four 100-episode sets spanning vision-language navigation and object navigation. Complete-sequence SR reaches 98% on 50 LHPR-VLN sequences and 94% on 50 GOAT-Bench sequences. In the R2R revisit setting, success weighted by path length (SPL) increases from 82.23% to 93.31% with retained experience. Multi-day physical navigation further demonstrates exploration, proactive help-seeking, and revisiting remembered places. Together, these results advance the vision of bringing embodied agents to life through autonomous action, proactive interaction, and the accumulation and reuse of experience.

AI.tldr: EvoLife：统一具身导航框架，融合混合动作空间、主动交互与持久空间记忆，在8个基准上实现首次访问100%成功率。
AI.motivation: 让具身智能体自主行动、主动提问并通过经验积累改进决策，需要将动作、交互与记忆统一，而现有导航方法通常割裂这三者。
AI.method: 提出统一导航harness：混合动作空间支持waypoint导航、局部离散调整、像素级导航与目标导向导航；主动交互机制在歧义/困难时请求澄清或协助；持久空间记忆将观测与对话绑定到地点，复用经验。在4类任务族共8个基准上评测（VLN、物体导航、交互式实例导航、连续多任务导航）。
AI.result: 平均每回合仅1.87次主动交互，VLN与物体导航四组100回合首次访问SR达100%；LHPR-VLN序列完整SR 98%、GOAT-Bench 94%；R2R复访设置下SPL从82.23%提升至93.31%；多日物理导航展示探索、主动求助与重访记忆地点能力。
AI.conclusion: 验证动作—交互—记忆协同可带来的经验累积与复用收益，为自主具身导航提供统一范式。

title: Smooth Action Chunking Via Movement-Primitive Representations for Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning has become a widely adopted approach for vision-based robot policies, owing to its conceptual simplicity, scalability, and ability to leverage large-scale datasets. As these policies have grown more capable, action chunking has become their standard interface. At each decision step the policy outputs several future actions at once. Backbones from diffusion policies to large vision-language-action models all share it. Whatever backbone produces the chunk, its temporal structure is learned only implicitly. The commanded trajectory is therefore jerky both within a chunk and between successive chunks. On real hardware this appears as visible vibration and as repeated saturation of the follower's velocity limit. We address this issue by incorporating a movement-primitive-based trajectory representation into action chunking. Specifically, a trajectory segment is represented as a linear combination of smooth basis functions, yielding smooth trajectories by construction while leaving the policy architecture, training objective, and inference procedure unchanged. The same representation also yields a closed-form, inference-time correction for the second source of jerk. We condition the predicted coefficients so that the new chunk passes through a via-point at the previous chunk's last commanded action. This correction needs no retraining and, unlike asynchronous Real-Time Chunking, applies to policies queried in one shot. We instantiate it on a one-shot (ACT) and an iterative (DiT) backbone and evaluate in simulation and on a real bimanual ALOHA platform. The representation lowers within-chunk jerk by an order of magnitude on the one-shot backbone and by 2.4 times on the iterative one, with task success statistically non-inferior. The conditioning then removes 73-84% of the boundary discontinuity, at negligible per-step cost.

AI.tldr: 将轨迹表示为平滑基函数线性组合（运动基元）嵌入动作分块，并以闭式via-point条件消除相邻chunk边界跳变，无需重训、适用于one-shot策略。
AI.motivation: 动作分块（action chunking）虽为VLA/扩散策略的标准接口，但其时间结构仅被隐式学习，导致chunk内部与chunk之间轨迹抖动，实机上表现为可见振动与跟随器速度限幅饱和。
AI.method: 把每个chunk轨迹段参数化为平滑基函数（运动基元）的线性组合，从构造上保证平滑；策略架构、训练目标与推理流程均不变。另对预测系数施加闭式条件，使新chunk通过上一chunk最后指令动作所在via-point，实现推理时边界连续性修正，无需重训，且可处理one-shot查询（区别于异步RTC）。在ACT（one-shot）与DiT（迭代）骨干上实例化。
AI.result: 仿真与真实双臂ALOHA平台验证：chunk内jerk在one-shot骨干上降低一个数量级，在迭代骨干上降低2.4倍，任务成功率统计非劣；via-point条件消除73–84%的边界不连续，每步开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 以运动基元轨迹表示替代隐式时间结构，是低成本、即插即用的动作分块平滑方案，同时解决chunk内与chunk间两类抖动，兼容one-shot与迭代式策略，具备实机部署价值。

title: Kairos: Semantics-Aware Orchestration of Planning Engines across Classical, Numeric, Temporal and Hybrid PDDL
comment: 32 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research. Code: this https URL ; benchmark, scripts and results: this https URL
summary: Planning at run time, as in robots that re-plan while they act, needs a planner that reads the PDDL its users write (durative actions, numeric resources, time windows, continuous change), answers quickly, and delivers only validated plans. Specialised planners are strong on individual fragments of PDDL, but they differ in coverage, latency and in what their failures mean. We study whether selecting heterogeneous engines from the semantics of each task can give broad coverage of PDDL, from STRIPS to PDDL+, while remaining competitive with specialised planners and making explicit what each answer guarantees. Kairos profiles each task to decide which of five engines apply (ground heuristic search, compressed and snap-action temporal search, time steps for hybrid dynamics, lifted search) and schedules them under one budget of time and memory. Every candidate plan is checked by a validator independent of the planner's transformations, and "unsolvable" is reported only when a search whose exhaustion is a proof exhausts its space. On 1,756 tasks from nine comparative suites, Kairos solves more tasks at the full limits than the strongest evaluated planner of each suite, with the largest differences on numeric, temporal, PDDL3 and PDDL+ planning, and it also solves the most tasks at 100 ms and 1 s. Resampling over domains, the gain is above zero in six of the nine suites, while on classical planning against LAMA it is within the noise. A further 450 feature-oriented tasks and 26 one-feature probes show that Kairos handles all seventeen features probed, where no other planner evaluated handles more than eight. Ablations identify compressed temporal search and the novelty fallback as major contributors, and a comparison with VAL traces every disagreement to a PDDL+ convention or to a documented VAL defect. Planner and benchmark are open source.

AI.tldr: Kairos：按任务语义选择并调度五种PDDL规划引擎（接地启发式搜索、压缩/瞬动动作时序搜索、混合动力学时间步、提升搜索），在统一时间/内存预算下求解，所有计划经独立验证器校验，"不可解"仅在搜索做穷举证明时报告。
AI.motivation: 运行时重规划需要能读取用户书写的完整PDDL（durative action、数值资源、时间窗、连续变化）的规划器，快速返回且只输出已验证计划。现有专用规划器只覆盖PDDL的单个片段，且在覆盖度、延迟、失败含义上各不相同。作者希望从任务语义出发选择异构引擎，以在保持与专用规划器竞争力的同时实现从STRIPS到PDDL+的广覆盖，并明确每种答案的保证。
AI.method: Kairos对每个任务做特征剖析（profiling），据此判断五种引擎是否适用，并在统一的时间与内存预算下调度；候选计划由与规划器变换无关的独立验证器检查；不可解结论仅在穷举即证明的搜索空间耗尽时给出。实验覆盖九个比较套件共1756个任务（含100 ms与1 s时限），另有450个特征导向任务与26个单特征探针，并做消融及与VAL验证器的对比。
AI.result: 在完整时限下，Kairos在九个套件中解出的任务数均不少于各套件最强的被测规划器，数值、时序、PDDL3与PDDL+差别最大；在100 ms与1 s下同样解出最多任务。按域重采样，九个套件中六个增益显著（高于零），仅与传统规划LAMA对比时处于噪声范围内。特征探针中Kairos覆盖全部17个特征，其他规划器最多8个。消融显示压缩时序搜索与新颖性回退贡献最大；与VAL的差异全部归因于PDDL+约定或已记录的VAL缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 在语义层面做引擎选择与统一预算调度，可在不牺牲延迟与验证保证的前提下显著扩展PDDL覆盖度，是面向运行时重规划的可行通用架构；规划器与基准已开源。

title: Calibrating Attention-Based Token Pruning for Efficient Multi-Image Synthesis in UMMs
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) enable powerful multi-image synthesis but incur substantial computation from long visual contexts. While token pruning offers a direct route to accelerating inference, existing methods are primarily adapted from understanding tasks, suffering from insufficient reference image exploration, confused conditional guidance, and pooling-induced ambiguity that degrades generation quality. To address these issues, we propose CATP, the first training-free context-compression method tailored to UMM generation, which \textbf{C}alibrates the discrepancies of general \textbf{A}ttention-based \textbf{T}oken \textbf{P}runing for better quality-efficiency trade-off. Concretely, building on independent layer-wise pruning during denoising, we introduce Guidance-Consistent Pruning (GCP) to synchronize pruning decisions across conditioning branches, and a Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric (TCAM) that derives a theoretically grounded second-order correction for pooling-induced bias. In addition, a Fast Scoring Operator (FSO) fuses the calibration into tiled online Softmax to reduce pruning cost. Extensive experiments across representative UMMs and benchmarks demonstrate that CATP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art token-reduction methods, achieving up to 2.09$\times$ attention-core speedup.

AI.tldr: CATP：首个面向统一多模态模型（UMM）生成的免训练上下文压缩方法，通过校准通用注意力型token剪枝的偏差，在保证生成质量的同时实现最高2.09倍注意力核心加速。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型支持多图合成，但长视觉上下文带来巨大计算开销。现有token剪枝方法多沿用自理解任务，在生成场景下存在参考图探索不足、条件引导混乱、池化引入歧义等问题，损害生成质量，因此需要专为UMM生成设计的免训练压缩方案。
AI.method: 提出免训练上下文压缩CATP，基于去噪过程中逐层独立的剪枝：1）Guidance-Consistent Pruning（GCP）跨条件分支同步剪枝决策，保持引导一致性；2）Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric（TCAM）针对池化偏差给出有理论依据的二阶修正；3）Fast Scoring Operator（FSO）将校准融合进分块在线Softmax，降低剪枝开销。
AI.result: 在多个代表性UMM与基准上，CATP持续优于现有token缩减方法，注意力核心部分最高获得2.09倍加速。
AI.conclusion: CATP表明针对生成任务校准注意力剪枝指标可有效缓解通用剪枝的偏差，实现免训练、即插即用的质量-效率折中，适用于多图条件下的统一多模态生成加速。

title: Regional Anchor Routing for Multi-Object Motion Transfer
summary: Compositional motion transfer requires a model to extract motions from multiple reference videos, and apply each motion to a user-specified object in one target scene. Existing methods normally struggle to reliably assign different reference motions to the correct target objects, thus a motion intended for one object may affect another. Meanwhile, some motion-specific tuning approaches are still facing another issue: they must run a new optimization whenever the reference video changes, making repeated transfers inefficient. To address these limitations, we propose RART, a framework that unifies object-wise motion extraction, target-region anchoring, and frame-aligned injection into a frozen video Diffusion Transformer for multi-object motion transfer. For each reference motion, RART extracts temporally ordered features from the masked reference video, and then conditions them on the target first-frame mask to form mask-anchored motion tokens. Frame-aligned motion cross-attention allows each generated frame to read only the motion tokens at the corresponding time slots, composing all object motions in one denoising process. During training, a motion-attention routing loss encourages each target region to attend to its corresponding motion tokens and reduces interference between objects. Therefore, RART can handle novel reference-target combinations without per-video optimization. Experiments show that RART achieves accurate motion preservation, efficient inference, and strong compositional generalization.

AI.tldr: RART：在冻结的视频扩散Transformer中统一「对象级运动提取—目标区域锚定—帧对齐注入」，实现多参考视频的组合式运动迁移，无需逐视频优化。
AI.motivation: 组合式运动迁移需从多个参考视频提取运动并分别施加到同一目标场景中的指定对象；现有方法难以可靠地把参考运动绑定到正确目标（串扰），且运动微调类方法换参考视频就需重新优化，效率低。
AI.method: 对被掩码的参考视频提取时序有序特征，并以目标首帧掩码为条件生成“掩码锚定的运动token”；采用帧对齐运动交叉注意力，使每个生成帧仅读取对应时间槽的运动token，在单次去噪中组合多对象运动；训练时加入运动注意力路由损失，约束各目标区域关注自身运动token、抑制对象间干扰；整体注入冻结的视频DiT，无需逐视频优化。
AI.result: 实验表明可实现准确的运动保持、高效推理与较强的组合泛化能力，并能处理新的参考—目标组合，避免逐视频优化。
AI.conclusion: 通过区域锚定与时间对齐的注意力路由，将多对象运动组合问题化为token级绑定问题，是高效组合式运动迁移的有效范式，但证据以生成质量为主，缺少真实机器人与物理一致性验证。

title: Does Federated Training Degrade Explainability? A Comparative Analysis of Grad-CAM Faithfulness in Centralized vs. Federated Deepfake Detection
comment: 10 Pages, 3 figures, Muhammad Uzair Shahid and Muhammad Zabil Mehboob contributed equally to this work
summary: Automated detection has become the essential safeguard against realistic synthetic media, but deploying it at scale requires training on sensitive data from multiple organizations, putting privacy and the transparency demanded by forensic review in direct conflict. Federated learning resolves the privacy side by sharing only model updates rather than raw data, but whether this comes at the cost of trustworthy gradient-based explanations, which analysts rely on to decide whether or not to trust a flagged clip, has not been studied. We present the systematic study of Grad-CAM explanation faithfulness under federated deepfake detection, evaluating an EfficientNet-B4 detector on FaceForensics++ across five federated clients under varying degrees of data heterogeneity. We find that the relationship between federation and explanation quality is non-monotonic: at near-IID (Independent and Identically Distributed Data) and moderate heterogeneity, federated models match or exceed the faithfulness of a centralized baseline, but at extreme heterogeneity, explanations break down entirely, becoming spatially incoherent and, on average, causally misleading. This degradation is not a general cost of federated training but a threshold effect tied to client heterogeneity, and we offer practical guidance for identifying when privacy-preserving deepfake detection can be deployed safely and when its explanations can no longer be trusted. Code and data partitions are available for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 研究联邦学习下深度伪造检测器 Grad-CAM 解释的忠实性，发现联邦与解释质量呈非单调关系：近IID/中等异质时可持平或优于集中式基线，极端异质时解释完全失效且具因果误导性。
AI.motivation: 大规模部署深度伪造检测需跨机构敏感数据训练，隐私与取证透明性冲突。联邦学习解决隐私问题，但其是否牺牲分析师依赖的梯度解释可信度尚未被研究。
AI.method: 在 FaceForensics++ 上以 EfficientNet-B4 检测器做五客户端联邦训练，覆盖不同数据异质度；系统评估 Grad-CAM 的空间一致性与因果忠实性（如随机化/扰动检验），与集中式基线对比。
AI.result: 近IID与中等异质度下联邦模型忠实性持平或超过集中式基线；极端异质度下解释空间混乱、平均上因果误导，表现为阈值效应而非联邦训练的普遍代价。
AI.conclusion: 解释退化与客户端异质度阈值绑定，给出判定隐私保护式深伪检测何时可安全部署、何时解释不可信的实践指引；代码与数据划分开放。

title: Agent-Wise Test-Time Normalization for Camera-Based Cooperative Perception with Corrupted Collaborators
summary: Intermediate-fusion cooperative perception lets a vehicle detect objects beyond its own field of view by fusing features shared by nearby agents. When only a collaborator's cameras are degraded by fog, motion blur or exposure errors, the features it shares drift away from the training distribution while the ego input stays clean, and cooperation can become worse than not cooperating at all. Test-time batch-normalization adaptation, the standard training-free remedy, estimates statistics over the pooled batch of all agents and therefore normalizes both the clean ego and the corrupted collaborator with a mixture of two distributions. We show that this mixing harms even the clean ego: when the ego shares BN statistics with a corrupted collaborator, its detection from its own features drops by 3.58 to 6.68 AP@0.5 points although its cameras are untouched. We propose AgentNorm, an agent-wise test-time normalization that i) estimates the normalization statistics of every collaborator from its own current observation and ii) anchors the ego to its source statistics, so that the ego path remains exactly the original model. AgentNorm has no learnable parameters, needs no gradients or labels, is independent of the order of test frames, and runs locally on each agent without changing the transmitted features. On camera-based OPV2V with four fusion checkpoints and collaborator-only corruptions, AgentNorm raises AP@0.5 under severity-5 fog from 29.42-37.25 to 43.32-58.86 and outperforms pooled normalization by 5.53-12.94 points under fog and motion blur, at an extra latency of 2.3 ms per frame. On the real-world DAIR-V2X-C dataset, it outperforms pooled normalization in all ten infrastructure-corruption settings. We also report the cases it does not fix: occlusion, which removes image content rather than shifting feature statistics, and the case in which all agents share the same shift.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentNorm，一种面向中间融合协同感知的"智能体级"测试时归一化：各协同者用自身当前观测估计 BN 统计量，自车锚定源域统计量保持不变，从而避免"池化 BN"把干净自车与退化协同者的分布混合；相机端 OPV2V 上严重雾霾 AP@0.5 从 29.42–37.25 提升至 43.32–58.86，DAIR-V2X-C 十种路侧退化设置全部优于池化归一化。
AI.motivation: 协同感知中仅协同者相机被雾、运动模糊、曝光错误退化时，其共享特征偏离训练分布，而自车输入仍干净，协同反而可能比不协同更差。标准免训练补救（测试时 BN 自适应）在所有智能体上池化估计统计量，会把干净自车与退化协同者的分布混合，作者指出这种混合甚至损害自车：自车检测从自身特征下降 3.58–6.68 AP@0.5。
AI.method: AgentNorm：对每个协同者仅用其当前帧（或当前观测）特征估计各自的归一化统计量，实现智能体间统计量解耦；同时将自车 BN 锚定回源域统计量，使自车通路严格等价于原模型。方法无参数、无梯度、无需标签、与测试帧顺序无关、各智能体本地执行且不改变传输的特征内容；额外延迟 2.3 ms/帧。
AI.result: 在相机 OPV2V 上使用四个融合检查点、仅协同者受损：严重度 5 雾霾下 AP@0.5 由 29.42–37.25 提升至 43.32–58.86；雾与运动模糊下比池化归一化高 5.53–12.94 点。真实数据 DAIR-V2X-C 上在全部十种路侧（infrastructure）损伤设置均优于池化归一化。作者明确报告失效情形：遮挡（移除图像内容而非偏移统计量）以及所有智能体共享同一分布偏移的情况。
AI.conclusion: 协同感知的测试时自适应应按智能体分离统计量而非池化，这对异构退化（部分 agent 受损）是有效且近零开销的免训练修复，但对内容缺失型损伤和全体同质偏移无效。

title: Robust LIDAR Sensor-to-Sensor Domain Generalization via Accumulated-Point Scene Completion
summary: We study domain generalization for LIDAR semantic segmentation. Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on 3D point clouds, yet real-world LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific sampling patterns that hinder transfer across datasets. In many applications, performance on completely unseen sensors is crucial. A model should preferably work on a new setup without prior access to its data or labels. To this end, we introduce a source-only training scheme that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective. We aggregate source-domain scans into a simple world model and use it as the supervision signal, replacing single-scan standard segmentation training. A key property of our approach is that it does not alter the input scan. During training and testing the network consumes the same single-frame LIDAR input, only the supervision signal is enriched via the occupancy objective. At deployment, there is no runtime overhead as the auxiliary head can be dropped for pure segmentation, or kept to obtain scene completion alongside semantic segmentation. In an experimental evaluation across distinct LIDAR datasets, we demonstrate that a model's generalization to new domains can be significantly affected by how it is supervised. In certain setups, performance on unseen domains improves without any explicit domain adaptation (no target scans, no target labels, no sensor priors) and without prediction refinement. At the same time, our method maintains competitive source-domain segmentation performance and incurs no additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用源域训练的LiDAR语义分割域泛化方案：将源域多帧扫描聚合为世界模型并生成占用预测辅助监督，输入仍为单帧扫描，部署时可丢弃辅助头。实验表明在无目标数据/标签/传感器先验下可提升未知域泛化且零推理开销。
AI.motivation: 真实LiDAR存在传感器相关的采样模式差异，导致跨数据集迁移困难；许多应用需要模型在无新传感器数据或标签的前提下直接工作于全新传感器配置，即仅源域的域泛化。
AI.method: 源域多帧扫描聚合构建简单世界模型作为监督信号，替代单帧标准分割监督，加入占用预测（occupancy prediction）辅助目标；不改动输入扫描，训练与测试均输入同一单帧点云；辅助头不引入运行时开销，可按需保留以同时输出场景补全。
AI.result: 在多个不同LiDAR数据集上的实验显示，模型对新域的泛化显著受监督方式影响；部分设置下未见域性能提升，且无需显式域适应（无目标扫描、无目标标签、无传感器先验）、无需预测细化，同时保持有竞争力的源域分割性能与零额外推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 监督信号的丰富化（占用辅助目标+聚合世界模型）本身即可作为提升LiDAR语义分割跨传感器泛化的有效手段，方法简洁、无推理开销，可与其它域泛化/适应策略互补。

title: FFAI: Flow Matching with Feedback Training and Adaptive Initialization for CT Reconstruction
summary: Although low-dose, sparse-view, and limited-angle CT involve distinct degradation mechanisms, all three pose reconstruction challenges due to limited measurement information and can therefore be addressed within a unified framework. In iterative image restoration with flow matching, prediction errors may cause inference states to deviate from the prescribed training path, while a fixed initialization may be unsuitable for inputs with varying degradation severity. We propose a unified conditional flow matching method that conditions on the initial reconstruction and combines feedback-aware training with degradation-adaptive initialization. During training, a teacher network simulates inference updates to generate shifted states, from which a student network learns to recover high-quality reference images, improving its ability to handle prediction errors. During inference, the starting time is selected based on the noise level or extent of missing projection data, and the noise added to the initial state is adjusted accordingly to adapt the starting point to the input. Experiments on public benchmark datasets show that the proposed method achieves better quantitative results than the compared methods across all three reconstruction tasks, effectively suppressing noise and artifacts while preserving anatomical structures and details.

AI.tldr: 提出统一条件流匹配方法处理低剂量、稀疏视角与有限角度CT重建：以初始重建为条件，训练中引入教师网络模拟推理更新产生偏移状态、学生网络学习恢复高质量图像（反馈感知训练），推理时按噪声水平/投影缺失程度选择起始时间并调整加噪强度（退化自适应初始化）。
AI.motivation: 三类CT退化虽机制不同，但都因测量信息有限而困难，可统一建模；而基于流匹配的迭代图像复原存在两个问题：预测误差使推理状态偏离训练轨迹，且固定初始化不适合不同退化程度的输入。
AI.method: 条件流匹配（以初始重建为条件）+ 反馈感知训练（教师网络模拟推理步产生偏移状态，学生网络学习从偏移状态恢复参考图像）+ 退化自适应初始化（依噪声强度或投影缺失范围选择推理起始时间，并相应调整初始状态加噪量）。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集上，三类重建任务（低剂量、稀疏视角、有限角度）定量指标均优于对比方法，有效抑制噪声与伪影，同时保持解剖结构与细节。
AI.conclusion: 单一统一框架可覆盖多种CT退化模式；显式建模推理期轨迹偏差与退化自适应初始化是提升流匹配复原鲁棒性的关键。

title: BRIDGE: Learning Brain-Gut Metabolic Evidence for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis may benefit from gut metabolic information associated with brain-gut interactions, yet existing models largely analyze cerebral glucose metabolism alone. Although whole-body fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) can provide paired brain-gut observations, routine brain examinations rarely include gut imaging, limiting direct use of this information for diagnosis. In this paper, we present BRIDGE (Brain and Gut Representation Integration via Distribution-Guided Enhancement), a two-stage framework for transferring brain-gut metabolic knowledge to brain-only diagnosis. Specifically, BRIDGE integrates a conditional brain-to-gut latent transport module and a disease-evidence-guided cerebral pathway to capture subject-specific cross-organ correspondence and disease-relevant cerebral representations. For the cerebral pathway, a large language model (LLM) helps organize literature-derived descriptors into human-approved semantic anchors that guide feature learning. Additionally, we introduce a counterfactual-guided residual fusion mechanism, which uses matched and non-matched virtual-gut evidence to supervise a confidence gate and dynamically regulate the contribution of transported cross-organ information. At inference, BRIDGE exploits complementary gut-related context using brain PET alone, without measured gut PET. Extensive experiments across public and private cohorts demonstrate that BRIDGE outperforms brain-only and cross-organ baselines, achieving AUC gains of 6.0% and 5.2% over its brain-only counterpart for CN/MCI and CN/AD diagnosis, respectively. Notably, its ability to transfer complementary brain-gut metabolic context while preserving brain PET as the sole inference input highlights its potential for clinically practical diagnosis. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架 BRIDGE，将全身FDG-PET中的脑-肠代谢知识迁移到仅用脑PET的阿尔茨海默病诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有AD诊断模型只分析脑部葡萄糖代谢，忽略了脑-肠互作信息；全身FDG-PET虽可提供脑-肠配对数据，但常规脑部检查几乎不含肠道成像，限制了该信息在诊断中的直接可用性。
AI.method: BRIDGE包含：条件式脑→肠隐空间传输模块与疾病证据引导的脑通路，捕获受试者特异性的跨器官对应关系与疾病相关脑表征；用LLM将文献描述整理为人工认可的语义锚点以引导特征学习；引入反事实引导的残差融合机制，用匹配/非匹配虚拟肠证据监督置信门控，动态调节迁移信息的贡献；推理阶段仅需脑PET。
AI.result: 在公开与私有队列上优于仅脑与跨器官基线，CN/MCI与CN/AD诊断的AUC较仅脑对照分别提升6.0%与5.2%。
AI.conclusion: BRIDGE可在推理时仅使用脑PET而受益于迁移来的脑-肠代谢互补上下文，具备临床实用诊断潜力；代码开源。

title: PRIME W0: Physical Priors from World Models for Embodied Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at instruction following, yet most remain feed-forward: they condition actions only on the current observation and discard both long-horizon temporal context and the hierarchical structure of VLM representations. We present PRIME W0, a hierarchical conditional flow-matching framework that closes this gap through three synergistic designs: (1)per-layer KV injection from a pretrained VLM into an Adaptive MoE action expert; (2)dynamics-aware conditioning via asynchronous world-model subgoal-image prediction and a DINOv2 historical-frame semantic bridge; and (3)Action Dynamic Manifold (ADM) flow matching with covariance-structured noise that respects robot kinematic coupling. PRIME W0 is trained in four stages---VLM pre-training, DAT/NTP visuomotor pre-training, DiT flow-matching decoder assembly with WM injection, and end-to-end SFT---and achieves state-of-the-art results on LIBERO and real-robot benchmarks, with systematic ablations validating each architectural component.

AI.tldr: PRIME W0：分层条件流匹配VLA框架，通过逐层KV注入、异步世界模型子目标与DINOv2时序语义桥、协方差结构化噪声的ADM流匹配，实现长时程时序建模，在LIBERO与真机达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型多为前馈式，仅以当前观测为条件，丢弃长时程时序上下文与VLM表征的层次结构，导致长程任务能力受限。
AI.method: 三个设计：(1)将预训练VLM逐层KV注入自适应MoE动作专家；(2)动力学感知条件化——异步世界模型预测子目标图像，并用DINOv2构建历史帧语义桥；(3)动作动态流形(ADM)流匹配，采用协方差结构化噪声以尊重机器人运动学耦合。四阶段训练：VLM预训练、DAT/NTP视运动预训练、DiT流匹配解码器装配并注入世界模型、端到端SFT。
AI.result: 在LIBERO及真机基准上取得SOTA，且系统性消融验证了各架构组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: 分层条件流匹配+世界模型条件化+运动学耦合噪声是提升VLA长时程性能的有效路线，但需进一步验证真实开放场景泛化与推理开销。

title: MorphSIG: Subject-Driven Image Generation via Decoupled Anchoring and Feature Transport
summary: We propose MorphSIG, a training-free framework that reformulates subject-driven image generation (SIG) as pseudo-video feature transport. MorphSIG contains two core modules: Progressive Decoupled Anchoring, which uses frequency-domain decoupling and structural scrambling during early denoising to break structural locking and enable a gradual transition from free composition to identity alignment; and Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport, which constructs a latent-space pseudo-flow field to mimic Image-to-Video temporal coherence and transport subject semantics precisely. To address stylistic homogeneity and the lack of ground truth in existing benchmarks, we further introduce a benchmark with diverse stylized subjects. Extensive experiments show that MorphSIG significantly improves pose diversity and subject fidelity over baselines without additional training. Overall, MorphSIG bridges static generation and dynamic propagation, providing a cost-effective paradigm for high-fidelity subject consistency.

AI.tldr: MorphSIG：将主体驱动图像生成（SIG）重构为伪视频特征传输的无训练框架，含渐进解耦锚定与伪光流引导特征传输两模块，并提出多样风格化主体基准。
AI.motivation: 现有SIG方法在保持主体身份一致性的同时牺牲姿态多样性，存在结构锁定与风格同质化问题；且基准缺乏真实标注与风格多样性。
AI.method: 训练-free框架：1) Progressive Decoupled Anchoring 在早期去噪阶段通过频域解耦与结构扰乱打破结构锁定，实现从自由构图到身份对齐的渐进过渡；2) Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport 在潜空间构建伪光流场，模仿I2V时序连贯性以精确传输主体语义。
AI.result: 实验表明在无需额外训练情况下，姿态多样性与主体保真度显著优于基线；新基准提供多样风格化主体以缓解风格同质化与GT缺失。
AI.conclusion: MorphSIG 桥接静态生成与动态传播，为高保真主体一致性提供低成本范式。

title: MOSAIC-Flow: Orthogonal-Axis and Status-Conditioned Fusion for Missing-Sequence Completion in Brain Tumor MRI
summary: Missing-sequence completion is important for comprehensive brain tumor characterization, but cross-modal fusion can obscure sequence-specific contrast and lose fine-grained three-dimensional tumor detail. To address this challenge, we introduce Modality-aware Orthogonal-axis Status-conditioned Attentive Integration for Completion (MOSAIC-Flow), a unified framework for missing-sequence completion that learns a target-conditioned velocity field while keeping the seven acquired volumes fixed throughout the transport. Specifically, modality-aware stems independently encode each sequence, and orthogonal-axis refinement captures axial, coronal, and sagittal dependencies while retaining the three-dimensional representation. Status-conditioned prototype fusion uses compact modality and availability tokens to route and modulate pooled queries from the fused visual representation, enabling target-adaptive conditioning without dense voxel-to-voxel attention. A conditional flow matching objective transports target-channel noise toward the single missing sequence, while four Heun trajectories are averaged to produce the completion. Evaluation across structural, diffusion, and contrast-enhanced MRI in UCSF-PDGM demonstrates consistent whole-brain and tumor-region fidelity across all eight single-target completion tasks, with the strongest performance on structural sequences. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 MOSAIC-Flow 统一框架完成脑肿瘤 MRI 缺失序列补全：模态感知茎独立编码各序列，正交轴细化保留三维细节，状态条件原型融合以少量 token 实现目标自适应调制，并用条件流匹配（flow matching）加四次 Heun 轨迹平均生成缺失序列。
AI.motivation: 跨模态融合易掩盖序列特异性对比度，且丢失三维肿瘤细粒度细节；需在保持已获取七个体数据不变的条件下补齐缺失序列。
AI.method: 1) 模态感知独立编码器（modality-aware stems），避免早期跨模态混合；2) 正交轴细化（axial/coronal/sagittal）保留 3D 表征；3) 状态条件原型融合：用紧凑的模态/可得性 token 路由并调制融合视觉特征中的池化查询，替代稠密体素级注意力；4) 条件流匹配目标，将目标通道噪声传输至单一缺失序列，推理时对 4 条 Heun 轨迹取平均。
AI.result: 在 UCSF-PDGM 的结构、扩散与增强 MRI 上，全部 8 个单目标补全任务均取得一致的全脑与肿瘤区域保真度，结构序列表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 以目标条件化的生成式流匹配替代跨模态稠密融合，可在保持已获取模态不变的前提下实现高保真缺失序列补全；属医学影像专用方法，对通用三维生成/重建的可迁移性尚未验证。

title: ROAD: Modern Adversarial Training for Simple One-Step Distillation at Scale
summary: One-step distillation turns pretrained diffusion models into fast generators, but strong results often require substantial training machinery and compute. Pure adversarial distillation offers a simpler route, yet has struggled at modern text-to-image scale. To address this limitation, we propose ROAD (Representation-grounded One-step Adversarial Distillation), a one-stage framework that distills text-to-image models with one adversarial objective and a lightweight representation-space critic. First, we replace the classical convolutional head with a Lipschitz-controlled Transformer head with token-level text conditioning, which matches the semantic tokens of modern visual encoders. Second, we observed a fixed random feature mixing leads to long-horizon degradation. We attribute it to generator-critic co-adaptation around one realization-specific view, and periodically re-draw the mixing to keep the randomization effective. Third, for our dense and vector-valued logits, we introduce Jacobian R1 which penalizes the full input-logit Jacobian, overcoming pooled R1's limitation of neglecting most of logit sensitivities. A single adversarial objective then suffices: in one step, ROAD reaches 11.03 FID on SDXL and 13.73 on SD3.5-M on COCO-10K, surpassing the multi-step teachers at a fraction of distribution matching's training compute.

AI.tldr: ROAD：单阶段纯对抗蒸馏框架，将T2I扩散模型蒸馏为一步生成器，采用Lipschitz约束的Transformer判别头、周期性重采样随机特征混合、Jacobian R1正则，SDXL上COCO-10K一步FID 11.03。
AI.motivation: 一步扩散蒸馏效果好但依赖大量训练机制与算力；纯对抗蒸馏虽简单，却在现代大规模文生图模型上难以奏效。
AI.method: 提出ROAD单阶段对抗蒸馏：(1) 用Lipschitz控制的Transformer判别头替换卷积头，并与文本token级条件对齐视觉编码器语义token；(2) 发现固定随机特征混合导致长程退化，归因于生成器-判别器围绕单一随机实现的观点共适应，故周期重抽混合以维持随机化有效性；(3) 针对稠密向量化logits引入Jacobian R1，惩罚完整输入-logit雅可比，弥补pooled R1忽略多数logit敏感性的缺陷。
AI.result: 仅用单一对抗目标，一步生成在COCO-10K上SDXL达11.03 FID、SD3.5-M达13.73 FID，超越多步教师模型，且训练算力远低于分布匹配方法。
AI.conclusion: 轻量表示空间判别器加单一对抗损失即可在T2I规模上实现高质量一步蒸馏，无需复杂训练机制。

title: From Reasoning to Action: Consequence-Grounded Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Reasoning informs decision-making by connecting intended actions with their expected consequences. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models incorporate embodied chains of thought (ECoTs) to guide action generation. However, such guidance remains implicit, as actions are conditioned on ECoTs rather than explicitly optimized to align with them. We introduce CoRAct, a consequence-grounded reasoning-to-action alignment framework that explicitly aligns reasoning and action through reward-guided optimization in action noise space. CoRAct formulates two physically grounded ECoT components as verifiable signals: movement specifies intended motion, while waypoints encode expected spatial consequences. A unified Mixture-of-Transformers jointly models ECoT reasoning, action generation, and action-conditioned future prediction. For candidate actions generated from sampled noise, CoRAct computes alignment rewards based on movement consistency and agreement between predicted outcomes and specified waypoints. These rewards guide group-relative optimization of the initial noise distribution, steering action generation toward consistency with intended actions and expected consequences. Experiments across RoboCasa, VLABench, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements in task success, generalization, and reasoning-execution alignment over strong ECoT-based VLA baselines. CoRAct also grounds externally provided ECoTs in executable behavior, enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel scenarios by leveraging knowledge from powerful vision-language models. Project page and dataset: this https URL

AI.tldr: CoRAct：在动作噪声空间用奖励引导优化，把ECoT推理（运动指令+路点）与动作生成显式对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型引入具身思维链（ECoT）引导动作，但仅以条件化方式隐式使用，动作并未被显式优化以与推理保持一致，导致推理-执行偏差。
AI.method: 将ECoT拆为两类可验证物理信号：movement（意图运动）与waypoints（空间后果预期）。用统一的Mixture-of-Transformers联合建模ECoT推理、动作生成与动作条件未来预测。从噪声采样生成候选动作，依据运动一致性与预测结果-路点一致性计算对齐奖励，用组相对优化（类GRPO）更新初始噪声分布，从而在噪声空间把动作生成导向与意图及预期后果一致。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa、VLABench及真实机器人操作任务上，任务成功率、泛化性与推理-执行一致性均优于强ECoT基线；并能将外部（强大VLM提供的）ECoT落地为可执行行为，实现新场景零样本适配。
AI.conclusion: 将推理信号设计为可验证奖励并对噪声分布做组相对优化，是显式对齐推理与动作的有效途径，兼具性能提升与外部推理的可执行接地能力。

title: Assuring Learning-Enabled Cyber-Physical Systems with Foundation Models: A Neuro-Symbolic Agenda for Testing, Verification, and Runtime Assurance
summary: Learning-enabled cyber-physical systems (CPS), including autonomous vehicles and UAVs, increasingly incorporate foundation models, yet fragmented assurance practices provide insufficient support for system-level guarantees. We argue that restoring engineering control across stochastic neural, symbolic, and physical boundaries requires a shift from model-centric evaluation to system-level assurance. We introduce the Foundation Model Assurance Stack, connecting three directions: (i) neuro-symbolic architectures that constrain foundation models through explicit symbolic world models, reasoning layers, and interfaces; (ii) semantically grounded, conformance-based testing that combines formal specifications and symbolic world models with foundation-model-assisted specification mining, scenario generation, and test synthesis; and (iii) compositional verification and runtime assurance that target formally tractable components and interfaces through modular contracts, equivalence checking, verified synthesis, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and runtime monitoring and enforcement. Symbolic abstractions establish assurance boundaries between stochastic learning and formal reasoning, connecting testing, verification, and runtime evidence across the system lifecycle. Foundation models serve as constrained assistants whose outputs are independently checked wherever correctness can be formally specified. We identify research challenges in specification engineering, abstraction fidelity, evidence composition, and lifecycle certification, and outline a staged agenda toward trustworthy, deployable, and certifiable learning-enabled CPS.

AI.tldr: 提出"基础模型保障栈"(FM Assurance Stack)，用符号抽象作为随机学习与形式推理之间的保障边界，串联神经符号架构、基于一致性(conformance)的语义化测试、以及组合式验证与运行时保障，将基础模型限定为"受约束的助手"，推动学习使能CPS从模型中心评估转向系统级保障。
AI.motivation: 自主车辆、无人机等学习使能CPS越来越多地集成基础模型，但当前保障实践碎片化，无法支撑系统级保证；需要在神经、符号与物理边界之间恢复工程可控性。
AI.method: 以立场/议程论文形式提出三层框架：(i) 神经符号架构——用显式符号世界模型、推理层与接口约束基础模型；(ii) 语义落地的一致性测试——结合形式规约与符号世界模型，并用基础模型辅助规约挖掘、场景生成与测试合成；(iii) 组合式验证与运行时保障——通过模块化契约、等价性检查、经验证的综合、不确定性感知推理与运行时监控/执行，针对形式可处理的分量与接口。
AI.result: 无实验或定量结果；给出概念架构与三条研究路线的整合逻辑，提出规约工程、抽象保真度、证据组合与全生命周期认证四类研究挑战，并勾勒分阶段议程。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型应在可形式化界定正确性的环节上接受独立校验并作为受约束助手使用；符号抽象负责在其与学习分量之间划出保障边界，从而在系统全生命周期内联通测试、验证与运行时证据，走向可信任、可部署、可认证的学习使能CPS。

title: Comprehensive empirical evaluation of feature extractors in computer vision
summary: Feature detection and matching are fundamental components in computer vision, underpinning a broad spectrum of applications. This study offers a comprehensive evaluation of traditional feature detections and descriptors, analyzing methods such as Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF), Binary Robust Independent Elementary Features (BRIEF), Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB), Binary Robust Invariant Scalable Keypoints (BRISK), KAZE, Accelerated KAZE (AKAZE), Fast Retina Keypoint (FREAK), Dense and Accurate Invariant Scalable descriptor for Yale (DAISY), Features from Accelerated Segment Test (FAST), and STAR. Each feature extractor was assessed based on its architectural design and complexity, focusing on how these factors influence computational efficiency and robustness under various transformations. Utilizing the Image Matching Challenge Photo Tourism 2020 dataset, which includes over 1.5 million images, the study identifies the FAST algorithm as the most efficient detector when paired with the ORB descriptor and Brute-Force (BF) matcher, offering the fastest feature extraction and matching process. ORB is notably effective on affine transformed and brightened images, while AKAZE excels in conditions involving blurring, fisheye distortion, image rotation, and perspective distortions. Through more than 2 million comparisons, the study highlights the feature extractors that demonstrate superior resilience across various conditions, including rotation, scaling, blurring, brightening, affine transformations, perspective distortions, fisheye distortion, and salt-and-pepper noise

AI.tldr: 对SIFT、SURF、BRIEF、ORB、BRISK、KAZE、AKAZE、FREAK、DAISY、FAST、STAR等传统特征检测器与描述子进行大规模评测，在IMC2020 Photo Tourism数据集（150万+图像、200万+次比较）上分析架构复杂度、效率与各类变换下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统特征检测与匹配是计算机视觉的基础组件，但缺乏在现代大规模数据上、跨多种图像变换条件（旋转、尺度、模糊、亮度、仿射、透视、鱼眼、椒盐噪声）的系统性横向评测；作者希望厘清各方法架构设计对计算效率与鲁棒性的影响，为下游应用选型提供依据。
AI.method: 纯实验性基准评测：梳理11种传统检测器/描述子（SIFT、SURF、BRIEF、ORB、BRISK、KAZE、AKAZE、FREAK、DAISY、FAST、STAR）的架构设计与计算复杂度；在IMC2020 Photo Tourism（150万+图像）上做超200万次匹配比较，采用ORB描述子配Brute-Force匹配器，逐一施加旋转、缩放、模糊、增亮、仿射、透视、鱼眼畸变、椒盐噪声等扰动并统计表现。
AI.result: FAST+ORB+BF组合特征提取与匹配速度最快、效率最高；ORB在仿射变换与增亮图像上表现突出；AKAZE在模糊、鱼眼畸变、旋转与透视畸变条件下最优；并给出各提取器在八类变换条件下的鲁棒性排序。
AI.conclusion: 传统手工特征在计算效率上仍具明显优势，FAST+ORB适合实时场景，AKAZE适合几何与模糊退化严重场景；方法选择应依据具体变换类型与效率约束权衡，而非单一指标。属基准/综述型工作，无新算法提出。

title: BEACON: Distilled Begin/End-Aware Structured Decoding for Continuous Sign Language Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 12 pages, 4 figures, including supplementary material
summary: In segmentation-based continuous sign language recognition, an untrimmed video is first partitioned into lexical units; segmentation is therefore a means to an end---downstream recognition. However, segmenters are usually judged by local boundary detection rather than by the quality of the lexical segments and the recognition they enable. We present BEACON, a begin/end-aware segmenter that combines four-class Outside/Begin/Inside/End (BIOE) labeling, constrained Viterbi decoding over eight legal transitions, and boundary knowledge distilled from a binary teacher into a shared student. Under strict no-cut evaluation with validation-based model selection, BEACON improves segment-F1 by 14.58/14.59 points and boundary-F1 by 2.17/1.22 points, and reduces the downstream word error rate (WER) by 9.10/4.15 points relative to the state-of-the-art in the PHOENIX-14/BSL Corpus. To examine which segmentation metric better reflects downstream recognition, we evaluated five distinct architecture families. Segment-F1 aligns more consistently with lower WER than boundary-F1 in both corpora (Spearman $\rho=-1.0/-0.9$ versus $-0.9/-0.8$). These results support evaluating sign language segmentation in terms of segment quality and downstream recognition utility rather than local boundary accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: BEACON：面向连续手语识别的BIOE四类标注+约束Viterbi解码+边界知识蒸馏分段器，并提出以segment-F1而非boundary-F1评价分段质量。
AI.motivation: 分段式连续手语识别中，分段只是服务于下游词级识别的手段，但现有分段器多以局部边界检测精度（boundary-F1）评估，忽略了词法片段的整体质量及其对下游识别的作用。
AI.method: 提出BEACON：四类Outside/Begin/Inside/End（BIOE）标注；在8种合法状态转移上做约束Viterbi解码；将二分类教师模型的边界知识蒸馏到共享学生模型。采用严格no-cut评测与基于验证集的模型选择。
AI.result: PHOENIX-14与BSL Corpus上，segment-F1提升14.58/14.59点，boundary-F1提升2.17/1.22点，下游WER降低9.10/4.15点。跨五个架构族的分析显示segment-F1与WER的相关性更稳定（Spearman ρ=-1.0/-0.9 vs -0.9/-0.8）。
AI.conclusion: 手语分段应以词法片段质量及下游识别效用作为评价标准，而非仅凭局部边界准确率。

title: SimTO-Robust: Automated Design of Soft Grippers Robust to Grasp Pose and Object Geometry
summary: Robotic grippers operating in unstructured environments must robustly grasp objects of different shapes and sizes despite perception and positioning errors. Soft grippers that can achieve this robustness through intelligent mechanical design rather than sophisticated control software offer a promising solution. However, no existing computational design framework explicitly optimises soft gripper morphology for robustness across object geometries and grasp poses. We introduce SimTO-Robust, a generalisation of simulation-driven topology optimisation (SimTO) that simulates grasps across multiple objects and poses and aggregates their contact forces to guide gripper morphology optimisation. We generate 6,646 designs and physically evaluate 24 of them alongside 10 specialised SimTO designs, two rigid baseline grippers, and a baseline generalist soft gripper produced using conventional topology optimisation. All 37 grippers are tested in a pick-and-place task involving five feature-rich objects and six grasp poses, with external disturbances of increasing magnitude applied during the task. On average, SimTO-Robust designs complete pick-and-place more reliably than specialised SimTO designs and the rigid baselines. The best SimTO-Robust designs also withstood more of the applied disturbances than any other tested gripper. These results show that incorporating diverse grasp conditions into simulation-driven topology optimisation is a simple and effective approach to improving real-world soft gripper robustness. More broadly, they show that robust robotic grasping can be achieved through intelligent mechanical design rather than sophisticated sensing and control.

AI.tldr: SimTO-Robust 扩展仿真驱动拓扑优化，在多物体、多抓取位姿下聚合接触力以指导软夹爪形态优化，并在真机上验证其扰动鲁棒性优于专用设计与刚性基线。
AI.motivation: 非结构化环境中的软夹爪需在感知与定位误差下鲁棒抓取多样物体；现有计算设计框架未显式针对几何多样性与抓取位姿的鲁棒性优化形态。
AI.method: 将 SimTO 推广为多物体、多抓取位姿的仿真抓取，聚合各条件接触力作为优化目标指导形态拓扑优化；生成 6,646 个设计，物理制造并评估其中 24 个，与 10 个专用 SimTO 设计、2 个刚性基线、1 个常规拓扑优化通用软夹爪对比；37 个夹爪在含 5 个复杂物体、6 个抓取位姿的拾放任务中接受递增幅度外部扰动测试。
AI.result: SimTO-Robust 设计平均拾放成功率高于专用 SimTO 设计与刚性基线；最优设计承受的扰动幅度超过所有其他被测夹爪。
AI.conclusion: 把多样化抓取条件纳入仿真驱动拓扑优化是提升真实世界软夹爪鲁棒性的简单有效途径，表明鲁棒抓取可由机械设计而非复杂感知与控制实现。

title: Kinematic-Tactile Aligned Dexterous Retargeting with Contact Wrench Space Alignment
summary: Human demonstrations provide a natural and scalable source of data for learning dexterous manipulation policies. However, existing retargeting methods primarily transfer human kinematics, while the tactile information underlying physical interaction is rarely preserved across embodiments. To address this limitation, we present a hierarchical three-stage framework for kinematic-tactile aligned dexterous retargeting. We use object-centric contact wrench space as a physical representation for tactile alignment between human and robot hands. The framework first aligns hand kinematics and contact geometry, and then constructs a human wrench support profile from tactile forces and contact geometry. Robot fingertip force targets are subsequently optimized to cover the human wrench support and converted into joint position corrections, yielding directly replayable robot hand trajectories. We evaluate the framework in simulation and real robot experiments across three pouring conditions. In the real robot experiments, our method achieves a 96.7\% replay success rate and higher wrench transfer fidelity than representative retargeting baselines. The framework enables physically grounded transfer of kinematic and tactile information from human demonstrations to robot hands, providing a path toward scalable learning of contact-rich dexterous manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段分层框架，以物体为中心的接触力旋量空间作为物理表示，将人类演示中的运动学与触觉信息对齐并重定向到机器人手，生成可直接回放的关节轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有重定向方法只迁移人类运动学，缺乏跨本体保留物理交互背后的触觉信息，限制了接触丰富灵巧操作的学习。
AI.method: 先用物体中心接触力旋量空间作为跨本体物理表示；第一阶段对齐手部运动学与接触几何；第二阶段由人类触觉力与接触几何构造人类力旋量支撑剖面；第三阶段优化机器人指尖力目标以覆盖该支撑集，并转换为关节位置修正，得到可回放轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真与真机三类倾倒条件下验证，真机回放成功率96.7%，力旋量传递保真度高于代表性重定向基线。
AI.conclusion: 实现了从人类演示到机器人手的运动学与触觉物理一致性迁移，为可扩展的接触丰富灵巧操作学习提供路径。

title: DOSE: Dominance-Guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 8 pages, 4 figures. Adjust the counts if you add the supplementary material
summary: Medical severity estimation commonly relies on absolute grade annotations, which are fundamentally ordinal, yet existing methods often treat the grades as independent categories. Learning-to-rank methods, which can be trained using relative annotations based on severity comparisons of image pairs, can provide continuous severity rankings but cannot directly predict discrete severity grades. We propose Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations (DOSE), a framework for learning ordinal medical severity from sparse pairwise comparisons without using absolute annotations. DOSE aggregates the observed comparisons through a global comparison graph to estimate a dominance score for each image. Differences between dominance scores set cumulative margins in the embedding space, so that pairs with larger estimated severity differences are separated more strongly, and also generate pseudo-pairs that supervise a scalar severity head alongside the observed comparisons. The learned continuous severity axis is converted into discrete grades via label-free score calibration, with tie-anchored segmentation as the main calibration method. In the experiment, DOSE consistently outperformed pairwise-ranking baselines on ACNE04, IDRiD, and LIMUC under different pair budgets. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 DOSE 框架，仅用稀疏成对比较标注学习有序医学严重程度：用全局比较图聚合出 dominance score，构造累积 margin 与伪对监督标量严重度头，并用无标签的分位数/并列锚定分段校准为离散等级。
AI.motivation: 医学严重程度本质是序数（ordinal），但现有方法多把等级当独立类别；而 learning-to-rank 虽可用成对比较标注，却只能输出连续排序、无法直接给出离散等级。作者希望在不使用任何绝对标注的前提下，同时获得连续严重度轴与离散等级预测。
AI.method: 1) 构建全局比较图聚合稀疏成对观察，估计每张图像的 dominance score；2) 以 dominance score 之差设定嵌入空间中的累积 margin（严重度差越大、分离越强）；3) 由 dominance score 生成伪对（pseudo-pairs），与观测对一起监督标量严重度头；4) 通过无标签分数校准把连续严重度轴转成离散等级，主打 tie-anchored segmentation 校准。
AI.result: 在 ACNE04、IDRiD、LIMUC 三个医学数据集上，于不同 pair 标注预算下，DOSE 均稳定优于成对排序（pairwise-ranking）基线。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏相对标注足以学习有序医学严重度，且经无标签校准可得到离散等级；相对监督 + dominance 建图的思路为缺乏绝对标注的临床场景提供了可行替代。局限在于仅限医学影像域内验证，未与使用绝对标注的方法做同等对比，也无跨域泛化证据。

title: TactoHand: Learning Geometry-Based Dense Hand-Surface Interaction Fields from Video
summary: Understanding how humans interact with the world requires a representation of physical interactions at the hand surface. Tactile sensing captures these interactions, but collecting tactile data at scale requires specialized hardware. We introduce TactoHand, a model that predicts three dense hand-surface interaction fields---contact, proximity, and 3D force---from monocular video. We derive geometry-based contact and proximity labels and motion-derived force labels from eligible training data within a curated collection spanning approximately 50 million source frames. TactoHand uses a temporal transformer to aggregate visual evidence across frames, while three learned queries decode the corresponding hand-surface fields. A differentiable physics layer further constrains force predictions using observed object motion. Across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, TactoHand improves contact and proximity estimation over prior methods. In addition, physics supervision reduces position and rotation errors in motion rollouts, and the predicted contact and proximity fields improve downstream hand-object reconstruction. Together, these results show a scalable, low-cost path to learning hand-surface interaction fields without collecting tactile measurements. Code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TactoHand 从单目视频预测手-表面交互的三个稠密场：接触、邻近与3D力，利用几何标签与运动导出的力标签（约5000万帧训练集），并用可微物理层约束力的一致性。
AI.motivation: 大规模采集真实触觉数据需要专用硬件，成本高；希望用视觉（单目视频）替代触觉传感，获得手表面物理交互的稠密表征。
AI.method: 基于几何推导接触/邻近标签、由运动学导出力标签，构建约50M帧的筛选训练集；用时间Transformer聚合跨帧视觉证据，三个可学习query解码对应手-表面场；额外可微物理层利用观测到的物体运动约束力预测。
AI.result: 在域内与域外基准上，接触与邻近估计优于先前方法；物理监督降低运动rollout中的平移与旋转误差；预测的接触/邻近场提升下游手-物体重建。
AI.conclusion: 无需采集触觉测量即可可扩展、低成本地学习手-表面交互场；对视频到触觉代理、手-物交互重建有直接价值。

title: Operator-Aware Posterior Sampling for Multivariate Weather Downscaling
summary: Statistical downscaling is the task of reconstructing high-resolution meteorological fields from coarse inputs. A principled approach formulates downscaling as a Bayesian inverse problem, using a diffusion prior over high-resolution fields and incorporating the coarse field only at inference through a likelihood. This decouples the prior from the coarse source, allowing one pretrained model to adapt to different sources. However, two challenges limit this flexibility: (1) when coarse and target fields come from different reanalysis systems, no fixed coarsening operator can capture their relationship; and (2) guidance gradients can differ by orders of magnitude across variables, making a single guidance strength ineffective. This paper addresses both challenges within the guidance loop, leaving the prior unchanged. We learn the forward operator from paired data and normalize the gradient per channel. We show that this normalization corresponds to steepest descent under a block-max norm, allowing a single guidance strength across variables. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文将统计降尺度表述为贝叶斯逆问题：以扩散模型作为高分辨率场先验，并从配对数据中学习前向（粗化）算子，同时对引导梯度逐通道归一化（可证明等价于块最大范数下的最速下降），使单一引导强度适用多变量、可适配不同粗尺度来源。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散先验的贝叶斯降尺度可将先验与粗源解耦，使一个预训练模型适配多种粗输入。但现有方法存在两点局限：(1) 粗场与目标场来自不同再分析系统时，固定粗化算子无法刻画二者关系；(2) 不同变量的引导梯度量级相差数个数量级，单一引导强度失效。
AI.method: 在不改动先验的前提下，于引导环节内解决上述问题：用配对数据学习前向算子（替代手工指定的粗化算子），并对引导梯度做逐通道归一化；理论上证明该归一化对应于块最大范数（block-max norm）下的最速下降，从而允许跨变量共享同一引导强度。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验指标；作者报告方法在保持先验不变的情况下可同时克服算子失配与梯度尺度异质性问题，并开源代码。
AI.conclusion: 把前向算子的学习与梯度归一化纳入引导回路，是一种"只改推理侧、不动预训练先验"的轻量适配方案，提升了扩散式降尺度在跨源、多变量场景下的通用性。

title: GC-LIF: Spiking Group-Equivariant Neural Network With Group-Coupled Membrane Dynamics
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) promise event-driven, low-power inference, but on vision tasks they still acquire rotation invariance only through data augmentation. Group-equivariant CNNs build such symmetries into the architecture, yet a faithful spiking analogue is missing: a leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron placed after a $G$-equivariant convolution can break equivariance through its membrane recurrence. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for this not to happen. The layer is equivariant at every time step if and only if the neuron parameters $(\beta, v_{\mathrm{th}})$ are constant along the joint orbits of the group action on the (group, space) index. We solve it in closed form, and it covers any elementwise stateful neuron. Its sufficiency half specialises a known result for equivariant recurrent networks; its necessity half rules out the heterogeneous per-neuron parameters common in SNNs. The per-channel parameterisation that satisfies it, Group-Coupled LIF (GC-LIF), is combined with $p4$ and $p4m$-equivariant convolutions and a spike-rate group max-pool into SGE-Net. On MNIST, KMNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, evaluating each checkpoint on the clean test set and all its group-transformed copies, SGE-Net trained without rotations is invariant under $C_4$ and $D_4$ and outperforms a plain SNN trained with rotations in nine of ten dataset-group pairs, whereas non-equivariant baselines lose up to $72$ percentage points in the worst case. Operator-level tests confirm the theory before and after training, and an analytical estimate places SGE-Net at $1.7\times$ the arithmetic energy of a standard CNN and $2.3\times$ below its ANN counterpart at eight time steps.

AI.tldr: 论文给出脉冲神经网络（SNN）中 LIF 神经元与 G-等变卷积组合后保持严格等变性的充要条件：神经元参数须沿群作用的联合轨道恒定；据此提出 GC-LIF 与 SGE-Net。
AI.motivation: SNN 具备事件驱动低功耗推理优势，但视觉任务上的旋转不变性只能靠数据增广获得；而将群等变卷积与脉冲神经元直接组合时，LIF 的膜电位递推会破坏等变性，缺少"脉冲版群等变网络"的理论支撑。
AI.method: 对 LIF 层进行等变性的充要条件推导：当且仅当 (β, v_th) 在（群、空间）索引的联合轨道上为常数时，每步时序均保持等变；闭式求解该约束，结论适用于任意逐元素有状态神经元。满足约束的逐通道参数化称为 Group-Coupled LIF（GC-LIF），与 p4/p4m 等变卷积、脉冲率群最大池化组合成 SGE-Net。
AI.result: 在 MNIST/KMNIST/Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 上对每个 checkpoint 及其全部群变换副本评估：无旋转增广训练的 SGE-Net 在 C4、D4 下严格不变，十组"数据集–群"对中九组优于带旋转增广的普通 SNN；非等变基线最差下降达 72 个百分点。算子级测试在训练前后均验证理论；能量估计为 8 时间步下约 1.7×普通 CNN、比同构 ANN 低 2.3×。
AI.conclusion: 将群等变原理正确迁移到脉冲域需约束神经元参数的轨道一致性，该条件既充分又必要，排除了 SNN 中常见的逐神经元异构参数；GC-LIF+SGE-Net 在理论、精度与能效三方面给出可验证证据。

title: Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Editing in Vision-Language Models
summary: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently fail to recognize culture-specific concepts, especially from underrepresented regions. Effectively injecting this long-tail knowledge into existing models remains a challenge. In this work, we investigate knowledge editing as a targeted alternative by introducing CulturalBind, a benchmark comprising 3.2K images of 1K concepts from 6 domains, designed to evaluate culture-aware cross-modal knowledge as well as concept-level knowledge editing in VLMs. Pre-edit evaluation reveals that textual and visual knowledge is decoupled: models often demonstrate text-based knowledge of cultural concepts but fail to identify them from images. We then evaluate editing methods in single and sequential scenarios. Although current methods successfully correct individual visual recognition errors, they exhibit low cross-modal portability, failing to integrate edits into the model's broader parametric knowledge. Furthermore, performance degrades rapidly under sequential editing, highlighting the need for comprehensive adaptation approaches that better consolidate multimodal knowledge over time.

AI.tldr: 提出 CulturalBind 基准（3.2K 图像、1K 概念、6 个文化域），评测 VLM 的文化跨模态知识与概念级知识编辑；发现文本知识≠视觉知识，现有编辑方法跨模态迁移性差且顺序编辑下迅速退化。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 对欠代表区域的文化特定概念识别能力差，且长尾知识注入困难；作者希望验证"知识编辑"作为一种定向注入手段是否可行。
AI.method: 构建 CulturalBind 基准：3.2K 图像、1K 概念、6 个领域；先做编辑前诊断，评估模型文本知识与视觉识别的一致性；再在单次与顺序两种设定下评测现有知识编辑方法，考察跨模态可移植性与长期知识巩固。
AI.result: 编辑前评测显示文本与视觉知识解耦——模型"知道"概念名称却无法从图像中识别；现有编辑方法能修正单条视觉识别错误，但跨模态可移植性低，未能把编辑融入参数化知识；顺序编辑下性能快速衰减。
AI.conclusion: 概念级知识编辑不足以实现多模态知识整合，需要能随时间巩固跨模态知识的整体适配方案。

title: DiFuse: Fusing Native Diffusion Representations for Spatial Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) jointly support visual understanding and image generation, yet information flow between these two capabilities remains largely asymmetric: understanding representations routinely condition generation, whereas generative representations are rarely reused for multimodal reasoning. In this work, we investigate whether intermediate representations from a UMM's native diffusion branch can enhance spatial reasoning without compromising general multimodal understanding. We propose DiFuse, which selectively incorporates intermediate diffusion representations into the understanding pathway of UMMs. Through systematic layer-wise analysis, we identify which diffusion representations are most informative and where they can be integrated with minimal interference to semantic processing. Guided by these findings, DiFuse spatially aligns diffusion features with visual tokens and injects them into selected multimodal decoder layers via residual fusion. Extensive experiments on UniWorld-V1 show that, DiFuse consistently improves spatial reasoning over a matched SFT baseline while maintaining broadly comparable performance on general multimodal benchmarks. Further analyses show that these gains depend critically on the choice of diffusion representations, injection positions, and the preservation of spatial correspondence between diffusion features and visual tokens. Results on OmniGen2 further demonstrate the transferability of DiFuse across unified multimodal architectures. Overall, our findings show that native diffusion representations can provide complementary spatial cues for multimodal reasoning when selectively integrated in a structure-preserving manner.

AI.tldr: DiFuse selectively injects intermediate diffusion-branch features into the multimodal understanding pathway of unified models, improving spatial reasoning with minimal loss on general benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Unified multimodal models exhibit asymmetric information flow: understanding features condition generation, but generative (diffusion) representations are rarely reused for reasoning. The authors ask whether native diffusion intermediates can supply complementary spatial cues.
AI.method: Layer-wise analysis of a UMM (UniWorld-V1) to identify which diffusion representations are most informative and which decoder layers tolerate injection with minimal semantic interference; then spatially align diffusion features with visual tokens and fuse them into selected multimodal decoder layers via residual connections.
AI.result: Consistent gains in spatial reasoning over a matched SFT baseline with comparable general multimodal benchmark performance; ablations show gains hinge on representation choice, injection depth, and preserved spatial correspondence; transferability shown on OmniGen2.
AI.conclusion: Structure-preserving, selective integration of native diffusion representations provides complementary spatial cues for multimodal reasoning, suggesting a route to more symmetric cross-capability information flow in UMMs.

title: UniTele: Learning Device-Conditioned Degradations for Unified Smartphone Telephoto Super-Resolution
summary: Super-telephoto imaging on mobile phones suffers from complex, device-dependent degradations that are poorly captured by conventional handcrafted pipelines. Collecting large-scale aligned training pairs across different phones and diverse scenes, however, is both costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study whether device-specific degradations can be learned from only a small number of physical captures and transferred for training a unified super-resolution (SR) model. Our key idea is to factor degradation learning into two learnable components: one captures the device-specific imaging characteristics under well-resolved conditions, while the other captures the additional information loss and artifacts that arise in super-telephoto imaging. We build a paired benchmark across three phone brands (Huawei, Apple, and vivo) by photographing the same content at two display sizes and zoom settings. The larger displayed image is captured at the phone's maximum optical zoom setting, while the smaller image is photographed directly at the phone's highest native zoom setting through the phone's native imaging pipeline. The benchmark contains 519 training and 60 held-out pairs. We use the benchmark to learn device-specific degradation, then apply it to external images to synthesize thousands of additional pairs to train our UniTele SR model. Relative to the pretrained Qwen and FLUX backbones before adaptation, the full UniTele training recipe substantially improves paired restoration fidelity and perceptual similarity on the held-out benchmark and yields markedly more stable and visually faithful restorations.

AI.tldr: 提出把手机超级长焦退化分解为“设备成像特性”与“超长焦附加信息损失/伪影”两个可学习组件，仅用少量真实拍摄对学习退化，再迁移合成数千对数据训练统一SR模型UniTele。
AI.motivation: 手机超长焦成像退化复杂且强依赖具体设备，手工建模管线难以刻画；跨设备、跨场景的大规模对齐训练对采集成本高、难以扩展，试图用少量物理拍摄替代大规模配对采集。
AI.method: 退化因子分解为设备成像特性与超长焦信息损失/伪影两项；构建华为、Apple、vivo三品牌配对基准（同一内容两种显示尺寸与变焦设定，519训练对+60留出对），学习设备特异性退化后外推到外部图像合成大量配对，训练基于Qwen与FLUX骨干的统一超分模型。
AI.result: 相对微调前的Qwen和FLUX骨干，完整UniTele训练配方在留出基准上显著提升配对复原保真度与感知相似度，复原结果更稳定、视觉更忠实。
AI.conclusion: 少量真实物理拍摄即可学习并迁移设备特异性退化，替代大规模配对采集，为移动端长焦超分提供可扩展的数据合成与统一模型方案。

title: FutureWorld: A Plug-and-Play Causal Next-State Predictor for Interactive Video World Exploration
summary: Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的因果下一片段预测器（C-NCP），在生成下一交互视频块前，由当前潜表示与下一动作预测未来场景状态作为先验引导，以抑制历史复用导致的三类误差回流。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型依赖历史潜变量复用维持场景一致性，但历史潜变量本身含模糊细节、几何畸变与语义漂移；即使检索到的历史内容与当前场景匹配，其错误仍会被带入下一块；新输出又成为后续历史，形成误差循环累积。
AI.method: 在先预测、后生成：以当前生成潜表示和下一动作输入预测未来场景状态，作为未来状态先验对下一视频块施加预测引导调制；C-NCP 为即插即用模块，具跨模型适配性，被集成进四种基座生成器。
AI.result: 在三个基准（交互式长视频生成、动作条件世界建模）上，四个基座模型增强后均观察到误差累积减少、长时程一致性提升，跨多种生成设置表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 用"预测未来状态"替代被动复用历史，可有效打断误差再循环，为长时程交互视频世界模型提供通用、轻量的增强范式。

title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
summary: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. A decomposition of the reverse-KL field into a Gaussian moment component and a non-Gaussian residual identifies statistics that can be constrained explicitly. We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder. Experiments use full-parameter and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning on Z-Image-Turbo 6B and Qwen-Image 20B. At two network evaluations, IDM reaches 94.25% and 90.20% on Chinese and English LongText-Bench, the highest scores among the compared methods at this budget. Controlled ablations show gains from the added moment loss, while generator EMA features perform competitively with an external DINOv2 encoder across the five reported metrics. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: IDM在DMD框架中显式约束生成分布的高斯矩（特征均值与逐坐标标准差），用生成器EMA副本作特征源，免外部编码器；2 NFE下长文本渲染达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 一步/少步文生图必须在极少的精修机会下准确还原提示词细节。DMD依赖学到的分数差监督，作者追问：对reverse-KL场的分布约束中，显式的矩约束是否能改进这一监督信号的有效性。
AI.method: 将reverse-KL场分解为高斯矩分量与非高斯残差；在保留完整DMD校正项的前提下，额外加入矩匹配损失，用生成器EMA副本作为特征提取器匹配特征均值与逐坐标标准差，无需外部特征编码器。在Z-Image-Turbo 6B与Qwen-Image 20B上做全参数与LoRA微调。
AI.result: 2 NFE时中/英文LongText-Bench分别达94.25%/90.20%，为同预算对比方法中最高；消融显示矩损失带来增益，且生成器EMA特征与外部DINOv2编码器在5项指标上表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 显式矩约束为分数蒸馏提供有效的补充监督，可在极低NFE下显著提升文本细节还原，且无需额外编码器，工程成本低。

title: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
summary: Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object. To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%, but reveals a further difficulty: its answers about the most common colors remain inconsistent with its own per-color counts. Supplying those counts as text improves its judgments, showing that recovering a property does not mean using it consistently. Reasoning, scaling, and added visual cues each improve individual judgments, but none makes exact answers reliable. To locate the difficulty, we probe Qwen3.5-27B: exact per-color counts remain recoverable at the language model's input, yet the model's answers rarely recover them (65.0% for the probe vs. 3.0% for the model). Image-removal controls further show that some apparent successes require no visual evidence. These findings motivate evaluating 3D reasoning by exact correctness, consistent use, and image dependence, rather than accuracy alone. Code and dataset are publicly available: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 BedBench（13 个程序化生成任务）评测 VLM 对 3D 对象属性的精确恢复与一致使用；发现逐色计数人类 93.3% vs 最佳模型 7.2%，微调可升至 68.6% 但答案与自身计数不一致，探针显示计数信息在 LLM 输入端可恢复。
AI.motivation: VLM 常在单项判断上正确，却无法恢复并一致使用 3D 对象的精确属性；现有评测只看准确率，无法刻画"恢复属性"与"一致使用属性"之间的差距。
AI.method: 构建 BedBench：13 个程序化生成的受控任务，区分单项判断与组合答案；评测 12 个开源权重模型与 4 个前沿模型；对单模型做定向微调与"文本提供计数"实验；用线性探针检查 Qwen3.5-27B 内部可恢复性；加入移除图像的对照实验检验视觉依赖。
AI.result: 逐色计数人类 93.3%，最佳模型 7.2%；微调使某模型从 3.0% 升至 68.6%，但其"最常见颜色"答案与自身逐色计数不一致；文本注入计数可改善判断；推理、模型缩放、视觉提示均改善单项判断但无法可靠给出精确答案；探针 65.0% vs 模型 3.0%；部分"成功"在移除图像后仍存在。
AI.conclusion: VLM 具备属性恢复能力却缺乏一致性使用能力；3D 推理评测应同时考察精确正确性、一致性与图像依赖性，而非单一准确率。

title: FlexTry-On: A Time-Efficient Framework for Multi-Scenario Virtual Try-on
summary: Virtual try-on has achieved remarkable progress in recent years, yet most existing methods are designed for a specific scenario, such as cloth-to-person or person-to-person try-on, and often require separate conditioning strategies and processing pipelines for different settings. We present FlexTry-On, a unified and time-efficient diffusion-based framework for diverse virtual try-on scenarios, including cloth-to-person, person-to-person, cross-domain, and in-the-wild settings. FlexTry-On adopts a common conditioning formulation, where a text-aware condition extraction strategy converts heterogeneous garment sources into a unified representation, and a dual-conditioning diffusion transformer jointly models garment appearance and person identity. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance on both cloth-to-person and person-to-person benchmarks while maintaining fast inference. Moreover, the same framework can be directly applied to unseen cross-domain scenarios without requiring separate architectures or scenario-specific processing pipelines. These results highlight the potential of unified and efficient virtual try-on frameworks as a practical step toward more flexible and widely applicable virtual try-on systems.

AI.tldr: FlexTry-On: 一个统一的扩散Transformer虚拟试衣框架，通过文本感知条件提取将异构服装源转为统一表示，配合双条件扩散Transformer同时建模服装外观与人物身份，支持衣到人、人到人、跨域及野外场景，且推理速度快。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟试衣方法多为特定场景定制（衣到人或人到人），不同设置需分别设计条件策略与处理流程，缺乏统一、高效、可跨域泛化的框架。
AI.method: 采用统一条件形式化：1) 文本感知条件提取策略，将异构服装来源转换为统一表示；2) 双条件扩散Transformer联合建模服装外观与人物身份；单一架构与流程覆盖多种试衣设置，无需场景专用处理。
AI.result: 在衣到人与到人两类基准上取得有竞争力的性能，同时保持快速推理；同一框架可直接应用于未见的跨域场景，无需额外架构或专用预处理流程。
AI.conclusion: 统一且高效的虚拟试衣框架可行，可作为迈向更灵活、更广泛适用试衣系统的实用一步；但摘要未给出定量指标与代码/真实部署证据。

title: Annotation-Free Representation Learning for Polyp Retrieval in Colonoscopy Videos
summary: Colonoscopy is inherently comparative: reliable visual assessment of polyps often depends on complementary views acquired under different viewpoints and imaging conditions. Retrieving such views requires polyp tracklet representations, which recent contrastive methods learn from temporal cues but still build from manually annotated bounding boxes. We propose an annotation-free framework that constructs tracklet views directly from raw colonoscopy videos, enabling temporal self-supervised learning on full-procedure videos, including frames without visible polyps. On REAL-Colon, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on tracklet retrieval and re-identification, outperforming both self-supervised and supervised baselines. We then introduce few-shot polyp retrieval, a task closer to clinical use, where a few observations of a target polyp are used to retrieve its remaining tracklets: with only two examples, our method surpasses most competing methods given ten. Finally, we show that a modest number of unlabeled procedures suffices for competitive performance, making on-site model development more practical. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出免标注的结肠镜视频tracklet（轨迹片段）自监督表示学习框架，直接从原始全程视频构建多视角tracklet视图，并引入few-shot息肉检索任务。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜下的视觉评估本质是比较性的，可靠判断需依赖不同视角/成像条件下的互补视图；检索这些视图依赖tracklet表示，而现有对比学习方法仍需人工标注边界框。
AI.method: 无需人工边界框：从原始结肠镜视频自动构建tracklet视图，在含无息肉帧的完整手术视频上进行时序自监督对比学习；据此提出few-shot息肉检索设置，用少量目标息肉观测检索其其余tracklet。
AI.result: 在REAL-Colon上，tracklet检索与重识别均达SOTA，优于自监督与监督基线；few-shot检索中仅用2个示例即超过多数方法用10个示例的表现；少量未标注手术视频即可获得有竞争力性能。
AI.conclusion: 明确了无需标注的全程视频时序自监督可用于结肠镜tracklet表示与少样本检索，降低标注成本、便于院内落地建模；代码开源。

title: Look at Where You Think: Localization-Head Alignment for Fine-Grained Perception in Thinking VLMs
summary: Thinking vision-language models reason for thousands of tokens, yet still miss small details in high-resolution images. Zooming methods pay for extra inference passes, and outcome rewards never tell the model where to look at. In Qwen3.5-4B, we find that the bottleneck is selection, not seeing: a few attention heads, which we call localization heads, pick the evidence out of thousands of visual tokens; ablating four of them costs 13.2 points more than ablating four random heads, and their focus fades as the reasoning grows. We therefore propose Localization-Head Alignment (LHA), which makes attention a training signal: whenever the reasoning states a visual fact, these heads learn to look at the focal region rather than the background, as an auxiliary loss in both SFT and RL training. On benchmarks of V*, HR-Bench 4K and TreeBench, LHA lifts Qwen3.5-4B from 74.1% to 76.6% accuracy, the best single-pass 4B result we evaluate, ahead of multi-pass zooming and released 7B models. Alignment alone adds 1.8 points over otherwise identical training while shortening reasoning by 20%, and the gains carry over to Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

AI.tldr: Qwen3.5-4B中定位瓶颈在于注意力头"选择"而非"看见"，提出Localization-Head Alignment（LHA），用注意力作为辅助训练信号对齐少量定位头，单次推理即提升高分辨率细粒度VQA。
AI.motivation: 思维链数千token的推理仍漏看高分辨率图像细节；zoom类方法需多次推理付出额外代价，outcome reward无法告诉模型"该看哪里"。作者发现少量"localization heads"负责从数千视觉token中选出证据，且其注意力随推理变长而衰减。
