AI.method: 分析注意力头：定位头消融使性能下降13.2点（远超随机4头消融）；提出LHA，在SFT与RL训练中以辅助损失形式，使当推理陈述视觉事实时这些头聚焦到对应focal region而非背景。
AI.result: V*、HR-Bench 4K、TreeBench上Qwen3.5-4B从74.1%提升至76.6%，为所评测最佳单次pass 4B结果，优于多pass zooming与部分已发布7B模型；纯对齐训练带来1.8点提升并将推理长度缩短20%；可迁移到Qwen2.5-VL-3B。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度视觉推理的瓶颈是证据选择而非感知；将注意力定位头显式作为训练信号可低成本、单次推理地提升高分辨率视觉推理，并缩短思维链，具跨模型可迁移性。

title: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but the quadratic cost of 3D full attention dominates their inference. Dynamic block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing exact attention only on key/value blocks selected from current activations. However, its fidelity degrades under aggressive sparsity: blocks are scored from coarse summaries or formed by costly global clustering, pruned blocks vanish from the softmax, and whole tiles are kept or dropped even when only a few of their keys matter. To address these limitations, we propose Accurate Block Attention (AB-Attention), a training-free method that accurately approximates dense attention at high sparsity. Its Intra-Block Clustering Selector (IBCS) estimates block importance faithfully yet cheaply by clustering queries only within each query block, without permuting tokens. Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting (SIP) then samples blocks in proportion to these estimates and reweights them by inverse inclusion probability, so that one pass estimates dense attention rather than truncating it. Finally, its kernel gathers key/value blocks much smaller than a tile into full tensor-core tiles, refining selection at no extra tensor-core cost. On Wan2.1 and HunyuanVideo, AB-Attention skips 89--92\% of attention, whereas the baselines compute 1.8--3.6$\times$ as much, yet it still improves PSNR by up to 4.4~dB over the strongest baseline and achieves up to 2.23$\times$ end-to-end speedup. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: AB-Attention：免训练的动态块稀疏注意力方法，通过块内查询聚类打分、逆包含概率加权重采样、以及将小块聚合成完整tensor-core tile，在高稀疏度下精确逼近稠密注意力，在Wan2.1与HunyuanVideo上跳过89–92%注意力计算，PSNR最高提升4.4 dB，端到端加速2.23倍。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer的3D全注意力开销呈二次方增长，主导推理成本。现有动态块稀疏注意力在激进稀疏下保真度下降：块重要性由粗糙摘要估计或依赖昂贵全局聚类、被裁剪块从softmax中消失（非无偏估计）、整块粗粒度保留/丢弃导致细粒度关键key被误伤。目标是免训练、高稀疏、仍能准确近似稠密注意力。
AI.method: 三点设计：(1) Intra-Block Clustering Selector（IBCS）仅在每个query块内对查询聚类、不做token置换，廉价且忠实地估计块重要性；(2) Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting（SIP）按估计重要性比例采样KV块，并以逆包含概率重加权，使单次前向成为稠密注意力的无偏估计而非截断；(3) 自定义kernel将远小于tile的KV块收集拼装为满tensor-core tile，在不增加tensor-core开销下细化选择粒度。整体为training-free插件。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1与HunyuanVideo视频扩散模型上，AB-Attention仅计算约8–11%的注意力（跳过89–92%），而基线需多计算1.8–3.6倍，却仍将PSNR相对最强基线提升至多4.4 dB，并带来至多2.23倍端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: AB-Attention以无偏重要性估计+逆概率加权估计替代硬截断，配合tile级聚合kernel，在极高稀疏度下实现更接近稠密注意力的保真度，可作为视频DiT推理加速的即插即用方案；主要验证限于生成质量指标与速度，未涉及下游视频生成以外任务。

title: EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing
summary: Agentic image editors decompose complex requests into steps, but when a step fails, they mostly retry with the same narrow set of tools and a judge that scores each output by eye directly. We argue that such agents are bounded by two spaces: the action space of what the agent can do, and the observation space of what its judge can see. On our expert-annotated benchmark, a general-purpose editor yields no usable result in over 40% of the cases, and no judge is reliable across edit types. We present EditAgent, which expands both spaces. It routes each step to general editors and specialized methods, and attaches to each candidate a verification record. With these records, off-the-shelf VLM judges outperform finetuned reward models. Candidates are generated in parallel and judged in one listwise call: experts prefer this to sequential refinement in 78.5% of decided comparisons, at no more than half the judge calls. EditAgent improves two open-weight editors on three benchmarks and serves as a data engine for training stronger editors.

AI.tldr: EditAgent通过扩展智能体图像编辑的"动作空间"与"观测空间"提升可靠性：将每步路由至通用编辑器与专用方法，并为候选附上验证记录，使现成VLM评审器优于微调奖励模型；并行生成候选、单次listwise评判。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体式图像编辑器把复杂请求分解为步骤，但步骤失败时多以同一窄工具集重试，且评审器仅靠"肉眼"直接打分。作者认为智能体受限于动作空间（能做什么）与观测空间（评判器能看见什么）两个空间，二者共同构成性能天花板。
AI.method: 构建专家标注基准，量化两大空间瓶颈（通用编辑器>40%案例无可用结果、无单一评审器跨编辑类型可靠）；提出EditAgent：逐步在通用编辑器与专用方法间路由，为每个候选生成"验证记录"（verification record）；候选并行生成、在单次listwise调用中统一评判。
AI.result: 借助验证记录，现成VLM评审器超过微调奖励模型；在78.5%的有效对比中专家更偏好并行+listwise评判而非顺序迭代精修，且评审调用次数不超过前者一半；EditAgent在三个基准上提升两款开源编辑器，并可作为数据引擎训练更强编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体瓶颈形式化为动作空间与观测空间，并通过工具路由与显式验证记录同时扩展二者，可显著提升图像编辑智能体的成功率与评判可靠性；该框架兼具推理时性能增益与数据生成价值。

title: Event-SAMA: Language-Grounded Video Object Segmentation on Neuromorphic Event Streams
summary: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range and no motion blur, but referring video object segmentation (RVOS) lacks event-stream datasets and models. We introduce Event-SAMA-239K, a synthetic-event conversion of the SAMA-239K grounded video-chat corpus and all additional SAMA training data: 30,650 video clips and 392,162 images. Optical-flow, FILM or saccade upsampling followed by a linear event generator preserves all mask, referring-expression and dialogue annotations. We also introduce Event-SAMA, adapting SAMA-4B with a two-channel polarity patch embedding initialised from pretrained RGB weights and a zero-initialised event adapter. End-to-end training yields 24.37 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on MeViS valid_u and 22.33 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on the converted ReVOS valid subset, establishing the first event-native RVOS baseline (RGB SAMA-4B: 55.4 on MeViS). Frozen RGB SAMA-4B with pseudo-RGB renderings or E2VID reconstructions of the same events scores 13.23 and 15.94 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$. Without retraining, Event-SAMA works on real event-camera recordings when the accumulation window matches their event density. A seed-controlled ablation with a measured noise floor of 0.47 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ finds gains from diverse training sources over MeViS alone (+4.99), RGB-mean event-stem initialisation (+4.33), and a trainable SAM2 mask decoder (+2.76); the event adapter, partial ViT unfreezing and event polarity are within noise at this budget. An earlier, partially converted corpus snapshot trained with the identical recipe scores 1.38 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ higher on MeViS and 1.12 higher on ReVOS. Both are single runs that also differ in schedule length, so we draw no conclusion about corpus scale.

AI.tldr: 该文构建首个事件相机RVOS数据集Event-SAMA-239K（由SAMA-239K等RGB语料经光流/FILM/扫视上采样后线性事件化，保留掩码、指代与对话标注），并提出Event-SAMA：以RGB预训练权重初始化的双极性事件patch嵌入加零初始化事件适配器微调SAMA-4B，给出首个事件原生RVOS基线。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围与无运动模糊优势，但指代视频目标分割（RVOS）领域缺乏事件流数据集与相应模型，RGB帧模型无法直接利用事件信号。
AI.method: 合成事件化：对30,650段视频与392,162张图像用光流、FILM插帧或扫视上采样至高频帧后，经线性事件生成器转换，标注（掩码、指代表达式、对话）完整继承；模型侧将SAMA-4B改造为双通道极性patch嵌入（由RGB预训练权重初始化）并加入零初始化事件适配器，端到端训练。
AI.result: MeViS valid_u 24.37 J&F、转换版ReVOS valid子集22.33 J&F（RGB SAMA-4B在MeViS为55.4）；冻结RGB模型配伪RGB渲染/E2VID重建仅13.23/15.94；不重训练时在真实事件录制上于匹配事件密度的累积窗下可工作。消融（噪声底0.47）：多源训练数据+4.99、RGB均值事件stem初始化+4.33、可训练SAM2掩码解码器+2.76，事件适配器、部分ViT解冻与极性编码处于噪声内。
AI.conclusion: 建立了首个事件原生RVOS基线与配套数据管线，证明事件端到端训练显著优于冻结RGB模型的替代渲染方案；但绝对性能与RGB仍有大差距，单次运行且配置混杂，无法就语料规模得出结论。

title: AI for Science in Space: Orbital Laboratories, Planetary Fieldwork, and Embodied Autonomy
comment: 47 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Ancillary evidence files included
summary: Artificial intelligence for science (AI4S) is extending from interpretation of existing data to the design and execution of experiments. Space offers distinctive scientific opportunities while restricting physical support. Microgravity and extraterrestrial environments expose phenomena that terrestrial experiments cannot fully reproduce; finite samples, constrained resources, and limited opportunities for intervention complicate sustained investigation. This critical review examines orbital laboratories and planetary in situ science across biology, materials, fluid and thermal physics, and adaptive exploration. We distinguish learning from space-derived data, selecting scientific actions, executing them, and preserving experimental validity. Terrestrial self-driving laboratories provide complementary evidence on optimization, dedicated automation, robotic manipulation, and the support needed for unattended operation. The synthesis connects scientific gains already demonstrated by bounded AI systems to gaps in observation, executable actions, and continuity of valid evidence. Space robots can expand the attainable scope of autonomous science when necessary interventions exceed validated instrument capabilities and timely human support is unavailable. Their value must be established against dedicated mechanisms, redundancy, and human-supported operation. We develop a framework connecting sample history, scientific decisions, physical execution, and claim-specific validity. A worked orbital design, a planetary extension, and matched evaluation schemes separate the contributions of sensing, decision policies, and physical actions. The resulting agenda measures autonomy through valid scientific return, task coverage, intervention costs, and evidence integrity across complete campaigns.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇批判性综述，梳理AI4S在轨道实验室与行星原位科学中的应用，区分"从空间数据学习、选择科学行动、执行行动、维持实验有效性"四个环节，并结合地面自驱动实验室经验，提出连接样本历史—科学决策—物理执行—主张特异性有效性的框架，倡导以有效科学回报、任务覆盖、干预成本、证据完整性度量自主性。
AI.motivation: AI4S正从解读已有数据走向设计与执行实验；太空提供独特科学机遇但物理支持受限（微重力/地外环境不可地面复现、样本有限、资源受限、干预机会稀少），亟需厘清自主科学在空间中的可行边界与评估方式。
AI.method: 批判性综述与框架构建：横跨生物学、材料、流体与热物理、自适应探测；区分四类能力环节；借地面自驱动实验室（优化、专用自动化、机器人操作、无人值守支撑）作为互补证据；提出样本历史—科学决策—物理执行—主张有效性框架，并给出一个轨道设计实例、一个行星扩展案例及配对评估方案。
AI.result: 综合指出有界AI系统已展示的科学收益，与观测、可执行动作、有效证据连续性三方面缺口；论证空间机器人在必要时干预超出已验证仪器能力且无及时人工支持时可扩展自主科学边界，但其价值须对照专用机构、冗余与人工支持方案来确立。
AI.conclusion: 自主性应以有效科学回报、任务覆盖、干预成本与完整任务周期内的证据完整性来度量，而非仅以自动化程度；所提框架可用于分离感知、决策策略与物理执行的贡献。

title: Smartphone Indoor Localization Enhanced by Hierarchical Multi-Sensor Context Recognition
summary: Smartphone indoor localization requires low-cost, robust positioning across scene transitions and phone-use variations. Pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) enables infrastructure-free deployment but accumulates errors from heading drift, structural transitions, and carrying-mode changes. Existing methods often treat contextual cues as a single event stream or local correction signal, limiting their ability to address distinct localization errors. This paper presents a framework enhanced by hierarchical multi-sensor context recognition. A jointly data- and model-driven recognition model predicts environment, scene, and activity probabilities, which are converted into scene-event and action-context segments. Scene-event segments guide scene-constrained PDR correction through corridor heading constraints, landmark attraction, fixed-lag backtracking, and vertical-transition handling. Action-context segments drive action-aware RoNIN-based position compensation for carrying-mode-dependent drift. Experiments on cross-floor and multi-action trajectories against LiDAR-SLAM references show that the proposed framework outperforms PDR and representative learned inertial odometry baselines, demonstrating that hierarchical semantics provide reliable, localization-specific correction cues.

AI.tldr: 提出分层多传感器情景识别增强的智能手机室内定位框架：预测环境/场景/活动概率并切分为"场景事件"与"动作上下文"两类语义片段，分别驱动场景约束PDR校正（走廊航向约束、地标吸引、固定滞后回溯、垂直过渡处理）与基于RoNIN的动作感知位置补偿。
AI.motivation: PDR无需基础设施但存在航向漂移、结构过渡与携带模式变化导致的误差累积；已有方法把上下文线索作为单一事件流或局部修正信号，无法针对不同类型的定位误差分别建模与纠偏。
AI.method: 数据+模型联合驱动的分层情景识别模型（环境/场景/活动概率）→语义分段为scene-event与action-context两条支路：scene-event支路做约束型PDR校正（走廊航向约束、地标吸引、固定滞后回溯、垂直楼层过渡）；action-context支路做动作感知的RoNIN漂移补偿。
AI.result: 在跨楼层与多动作轨迹上，以LiDAR-SLAM为参考基准，优于纯PDR及代表性学习式惯性里程计基线。
AI.conclusion: 分层语义上下文能够提供定位专用、可靠的校正线索，验证了按误差类型分解上下文信息的设计思路。

title: DEQ-Stereo: Deep Euilibrium Video Stereo Matching via Adaptive Convergence
summary: Iterative refinement models have significantly improved stereo matching accuracy, but their rigid, fixed update schedules incur heavy computational costs and a strict trade-off between speed and accuracy. This challenge is magnified in video streams, where traditional online methods resort to reducing feature channels or relying on expensive temporal warping. To address this, we propose \textbf{DEQ-Stereo}, a novel video stereo matching framework based on the Deep Equilibrium (DEQ) paradigm. Instead of unrolling a fixed number of iterations, DEQ-Stereo reformulates the refinement as an implicit fixed-point problem, adaptively terminating once convergence is met. To ensure fast and stable intra-frame convergence, we introduce the \textbf{Convolutional Simplified Gated Unit (ConvSGU)}, which eliminates unnecessary non-linearities by modeling the latent state as a gated, element-wise sum of inputs. Furthermore, to exploit cross-frame temporal coherence, we propose \textbf{Temporal State Transfer (TST)}, a warm-start strategy that propagates the converged hidden state to the next frame without requiring explicit pose or warping priors. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DEQ-Stereo delivers state-of-the-art performance with a superior accuracy-to-latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: DEQ-Stereo 将视频立体匹配的迭代精化重构为深度均衡（DEQ）隐式不动点问题，用 ConvSGU 保证帧内快速稳定收敛，用 Temporal State Transfer 做无位姿先验的跨帧热启动。
AI.motivation: 现有迭代精化立体匹配采用固定步数的展开更新，计算开销大且速度—精度折衷僵硬；在视频流中，在线方法只能削减特征通道或依赖昂贵的时序 warping。作者希望用自适应收敛替代固定迭代，并以隐状态传递获得时序一致性。
AI.method: (1) 以 DEQ 范式把精化建模为隐式不动点，收敛即终止，取代固定次数 unroll；(2) 提出 ConvSGU，将隐状态建模为门控的逐元素输入求和，去除多余非线性以加速并稳定帧内收敛；(3) 提出 Temporal State Transfer 温启动策略，把上一帧收敛的隐状态传播为下一帧初值，避免显式位姿或 warping 先验。
AI.result: 摘要仅声称在广泛评测中取得 SOTA 性能，并具有更优的精度—延迟折衷比；未给出具体数据集、指标数值或加速倍数。
AI.conclusion: DEQ-Stereo 表明隐式不动点求解与跨帧状态热启动可替代固定迭代展开，在视频立体匹配中同时改善精度与时延；但摘要缺少定量证据，需核对实验细节与公开代码。

title: Confidence Filtering in Video-Based Gait Assessment: Measurement Error versus Selection Shift
comment: 6 pages + 2-page appendix, 4 figures, 2 supplementary figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Rehabilitation Robotics (ICORR)
summary: Video-based gait assessment often keeps only high-confidence pose observations, which can lower measurement error but change the movement assessed. We compared confidence selection with budget-matched random selection in a Parkinson-related cohort (n = 96) and an NF2-related replication cohort (n = 18). In the Parkinson-related cohort, confidence selection produced a small but consistent shift in the observed movement summary (+0.05 SD, 95% CI 0.03 to 0.07), while held-out Mini-BESTest error stayed flat (-0.04 points, -0.13 to 0.05); a policy preserving motion-group proportions reduced the shift, while NF2 showed no shift and its predictor did not beat a constant baseline. Because this shift mixes measurement error with selection shift, we decompose and simulate both on the cohort's window structure. Filtering lowers local error when error depends on confidence, but biases the endpoint once confidence tracks movement more than error. In the Parkinson-related data, confidence was only weakly tied to movement (rho = 0.14). There, filtering is harmless if well-tracked windows are unbiased. If instead systematic error only redistributes within participants, filtering can add up to 0.58 degrees. Unchanged clinical error from such small-cohort predictors therefore cannot show that quality filtering preserves the assessed movement.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了视频步态评估中"高置信度姿态筛选"与"预算匹配的随机筛选"，通过分解误差与选择偏移、并基于窗口结构模拟，表明置信度筛选在误差随置信度变化时降低局部误差，但当置信度与运动相关时会使观测运动摘要产生偏倚。
AI.motivation: 视频姿态估计的步态评估通常只保留高置信度观测以降低测量误差，但这可能改变被评估的运动本身；既有工作中"临床预测误差不变"常被误读为筛选无害，缺乏对测量误差与选择偏移的区分与量化。
AI.method: 在帕金森相关队列（n=96）与NF2复制队列（n=18）中，将置信度筛选与预算匹配的随机筛选对比；分析观测运动摘要偏移与留出Mini-BESTest误差；提出保持运动组比例的策略；对测量误差与选择偏移进行显式分解，并在队列的窗口结构上做模拟。
AI.result: 帕金森队列中置信度筛选引起小而一致的观测运动摘要偏移（+0.05 SD，95% CI 0.03–0.07），下游Mini-BESTest误差基本不变（−0.04分，−0.13–0.05）；保持运动组比例的策略减小了偏移；NF2队列无偏移且其预测器未超过常数基线；帕金森数据中置信度与运动仅弱相关（rho=0.14）；若系统误差仅在受试者内重分配，筛选可引入高达0.58度的偏差。模拟显示：误差依赖置信度时筛选降低局部误差，但置信度更多反映运动而非误差时则产生端点偏倚。
AI.conclusion: 小队列中观察到的临床误差不变并不能证明质量筛选保留了所评估的运动；需要同时报告选择偏移并采用比例保持等策略，才能支持筛选下结论的稳健性。

title: AFast Robot Localization Method Based on Monte Carlo Sampling
summary: Localization is an essential capability of intelligent robots. However, in real-world constrained environments, robots often cannot rely on external localization systems. Therefore, this paper proposes an online particle-filter localization method based on Monte Carlo sampling. The method is applied to the localization of a mobile robot in a maze environment and requires only four range sensors mounted on the front, rear, left, and right sides of the vehicle, without the need for any heading information. Simulation experiments demonstrate that even in a maze where local regions are highly similar, the vehicle can still achieve relatively accurate localization, thereby providing a fast and effective approach for robot localization in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 提出仅依赖车体前后左右四个测距传感器的在线蒙特卡洛粒子滤波定位方法，用于迷宫环境下的移动机器人定位，无需航向信息。
AI.motivation: 真实受限环境中机器人往往无法依赖外部定位系统（如GPS、外部基站、动捕），需要在无航向信息、传感极简条件下实现自主定位。
AI.method: 基于蒙特卡洛采样的在线粒子滤波；观测仅为四个方向（前/后/左/右）测距传感器读数，不使用IMU/航向角；在地图（迷宫栅格）中对粒子进行传播与权重更新，实现位姿估计。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，即使迷宫存在高度相似的局部区域，车辆仍能获得较准确的定位结果。
AI.conclusion: 为复杂环境下机器人定位提供了一种快速、有效、低传感成本的方案；但仅在仿真验证，缺乏实物实验与计算复杂度、粒子数、重采样策略等细节。

title: NIF: Normal-Intersection Fields for Geometrically Consistent Oriented Box Refinement
summary: Accurate oriented detection requires a box to follow object boundaries, yet a standard regression head predicts its center, size, and angle from a pooled region representation. Small errors in these coupled parameters can displace long boundaries even when the object is correctly classified. We propose NIF, a refinement module that replaces an additional box regressor with normal-intersection fields. Given a coarse oriented box, the module observes local features at 20 boundary anchors and predicts signed distances along their outward normals. These observations admit an exact affine representation in five geometric variables. A differentiable, reliability-weighted least-squares fit projects the predicted field onto this representation and analytically recovers a refined rectangle. Tangential pooling preserves the normal position profile, while shared projection limits the added network to 0.132M parameters. On DOTA-v1.0, NIF reaches 78.00%, 79.11%, and 79.02% mAP with Oriented R-CNN, LSKNet-S, and Strip R-CNN, respectively, achieving the highest single-scale SOTA result in Table 1. It reaches 68.19% on DIOR-R, improves matched FAIR1M/DIOR-R baselines by 0.30/0.68%, and raises HRSC mean IoU from 0.867 to 0.888 while reducing field error by 24.5%. Across four different detector frameworks with the detectors frozen, relative AP75 improves by 1.57-4.18% and COCO-style mAP by 0.42-3.74%, without detector retraining. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出NIF精化模块，用20个边界锚点外法向有符号距离场替代额外边框回归头，经可靠性加权最小二乘仿射拟合解析恢复精化定向框，仅增0.132M参数。
AI.motivation: 定向检测中回归头从池化区域特征直接预测中心、尺寸、角度，参数耦合导致小误差即可造成长边界位移；且额外回归头增量成本高、泛化性弱。
AI.method: 给定粗框，在20个边界锚点处提取切向池化特征，预测沿外法向的有符号距离；该观测在5个几何变量下具有精确仿射表示，通过可微的可靠性加权最小二乘投影解析求解精化矩形；各检测器共享同一投影，参数增量仅0.132M。
AI.result: DOTA-v1.0上分别搭配Oriented R-CNN/LSKNet-S/Strip R-CNN达78.00%/79.11%/79.02% mAP，单尺度SOTA；DIOR-R 68.19%，FAIR1M/DIOR-R基线提升0.30/0.68%；HRSC平均IoU 0.867→0.888，场误差降24.5%；冻结检测器下四框架AP75相对提升1.57–4.18%，COCO式mAP提升0.42–3.74%。
AI.conclusion: 以几何场+解析拟合替代回归头是轻量、可插拔且免重训检测器的定向框精化方案，在多数据集、多框架上一致有效。

title: WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration
summary: Video world models generate future visual observations from camera or action inputs, with the goal of synthesizing persistent 3D worlds that can be explored across time and space. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate short interactions or rely on camera trajectories fixed before generation. The performance of video world models under long-horizon exploration with extensive camera motion remains under-explored. We introduce WorldProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that uses a goal-conditioned multimodal agent to adapt camera actions online during generation. WorldProbe comprises 164 test cases across four probing families. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, we generate more than 1,600 rollouts totaling approximately 800 minutes, with horizons up to 180 seconds. Our evaluation across four dimensions reveals both the degradation of local measures and the emergence of long-range inconsistencies. We find that recent models sustain visual and content quality for longer, while long-range memory and evolution remain weak. These results expose a gap between locally stable generation and persistent world consistency that is largely missed by existing benchmarks. Code and benchmark resources are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldProbe 诊断基准，用目标条件多模态智能体在生成过程中在线调整相机动作，评估视频世界模型在长时程、大范围相机探索下的持续3D世界一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准只评测短交互，或使用预先生成前就固定的相机轨迹，无法考察长时程探索与大相机运动下的持久世界一致性，这一能力缺口未被充分刻画。
AI.method: WorldProbe 包含 164 个测试用例、4 类 probing family；核心是目标条件多模态 agent，在生成 rollout 过程中根据已生成帧在线决策相机动作，而非固定轨迹。对 10 个 SOTA 模型生成 1600+ 条 rollout、约 800 分钟、最长 180 秒时程，并从四个维度评测。
AI.result: 评测显示局部指标（视觉与内容质量）随时间退化，同时出现长程不一致；近期模型能在更长时间维持视觉与内容质量，但长程记忆与世界演化能力仍弱，暴露出"局部稳定生成"与"持久世界一致性"之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了现有基准普遍忽略的关键评估维度，为视频世界模型的长时程一致性研究提供了诊断性工具，但本身不提供方法层面的改进方案。

title: Cross-Encoder Anchor Refinement for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to transfer anomaly discrimination from auxiliary training domains to unseen categories while localizing subtle defects. A key challenge is to construct discriminative references that combine contextual representations with complementary local evidence. We present Cross-Encoder Anchor Refinement (CEAR), which connects two visual encoding paths for the same image at the anchor stage, before normal and anomalous prototypes are constructed. An independent convolutional encoder pretrained for industrial product recognition builds an image-specific memory shared across selected vision transformer (ViT) layers. Spatial anchors read from ViT patch features query this memory through cross-attention and undergo residual refinement. Image-conditioned normal and anomalous queries then gate anchor aggregation to construct prototypes for anomaly scoring. Across 13 industrial and medical datasets, CEAR achieves the best performance in 57 of 68 evaluations spanning image-level detection and pixel-level localization. Notably, CEAR surpasses all other state-of-the-art methods in 41 of 44 pixel-level comparisons. Across 11 localization datasets, mean gains in pixel-level maximum F1 score and average precision are 4.45 and 3.79 percentage points, respectively. This study shows how cross-encoder interaction at the anchor stage can integrate complementary visual representations for fine-grained anomaly localization across domains.

AI.tldr: CEAR在原型构建之前的“锚点”阶段交叉连接两条视觉编码路径：用工业预训练的卷积编码器构建图像专属记忆，ViT patch特征作为空间锚点经交叉注意力检索并残差精化，再由图像条件化的正常/异常查询门控锚点聚合以构建原型评分。
AI.motivation: 零样本异常检测需将异常判别从辅助训练域迁移到未见类别并定位细微缺陷，核心难点是构建融合上下文表示与局部证据的判别性参考（原型）。
AI.method: 双编码器锚点精化（CEAR）：独立卷积编码器（工业产品识别预训练）构建图像特定记忆，被多个选定ViT层的patch特征作为空间锚点通过交叉注意力查询；残差精化后，图像条件化的正常/异常查询对锚点聚合进行门控，生成原型用于异常打分。
AI.result: 13个工业与医疗数据集、68项评测中57项最优；44项像素级比较中41项超越所有SOTA；11个定位数据集上像素级max-F1与AP平均提升4.45和3.79个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 锚点阶段的跨编码器交互可有效整合互补视觉表示，实现跨域细粒度异常定位；思路对其他需融合多源特征的定位任务有一定借鉴意义。

title: Quantum-Inspired Convolutional Networks for High-Resolution Pseudo-Label Generation from Multimodal Earth Observation Data
summary: Accurate land-cover mapping from multimodal Earth observation (EO) data remains a challenge in regions where high-resolution annotations are scarce or costly to obtain. This work introduces a quantum convolutional encoder-decoder network for pseudo-label generation using Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, guided only by coarse MODIS-derived land-cover maps. The proposed framework uses quantum-inspired convolutional blocks to enhance feature extraction and cross-sensor fusion, enabling the model to infer a fine-scale semantic structure from heterogeneous inputs. Experiments were conducted on the DFC2020 dataset, which provides a quadruple of Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 multispectral, low-resolution MODIS labels and high-resolution reference land-cover maps. The proposed training framework first learns a robust representation of multimodal inputs through the reconstruction branch before any supervision from low-resolution labels is applied. This self-supervised stage enables the model to capture a fine-scale spectral-spatial structure, which is then used to generate high-resolution pseudo-labels. These pseudo-labels are subsequently evaluated through classification metrics on the test data, demonstrating that the proposed approach produces more spatially coherent and class-consistent compared to classical baselines. The results highlight the potential of quantum-inspired deep learning to improve label generation in low-annotation remote sensing scenarios, offering a scalable path towards high-quality land-cover products for EO applications.

AI.tldr: 提出量子启发卷积编码-解码网络，用自监督重建分支融合Sentinel-1 SAR与Sentinel-2多光谱影像，在仅有MODIS粗标签条件下生成高分辨率土地覆盖伪标签。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率土地覆盖标注稀缺且昂贵，多模态对地观测数据难以在弱监督（粗分辨率MODIS标签）下获得精细尺度语义结构。
AI.method: 量子启发卷积块 + 编码器-解码器生成伪标签；先以重建分支做自监督预训练学习跨传感器融合表示，再引入低分辨率标签监督，最后生成高分辨率伪标签并在DFC2020上评测。
AI.result: 在DFC2020（S1 SAR + S2 多光谱 + MODIS标签 + 高分辨率参考图）上生成的伪标签相比经典基线在空间一致性与类别一致性上更优，分类指标更好。
AI.conclusion: 量子启发深度学习有潜力改善少标注遥感场景下的标签生成，为高质量土地覆盖产品提供可扩展路径。

title: Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay
summary: Autonomous mobile robots commonly pair a global planner with a local model predictive controller (MPC), but nonconvex obstacle avoidance and a limited horizon can make the robot freeze in complex layouts. Deciding whether to replan, wait, or call for help is a supervisory decision. Recent work queries a large language model (LLM) supervisor on every anomaly, which is slow and costly. We instead distill the LLM online into a decision tree. After each training episode, counterfactual replay labels recoveries as needed, unnecessary, or harmful. These labels retire unhelpful rules. In simulation, on 20 unseen layouts where the MPC alone freezes, the tree handles at least 18 correctly across all seeds, either by reaching the goal or by calling for help when no feasible path exists. The tree matches both an always-query LLM supervisor and expert-designed rules, while issuing no LLM queries at test time. Handwritten rules cannot anticipate the long tail of situations a physical robot will encounter. Online distillation is a promising remedy: the tree handles familiar cases, and the LLM is consulted only for new ones, whose validated recoveries become new rules. Language models can thus also serve as designers of supervisors rather than only as runtime supervisors.

AI.tldr: 将LLM监督器在线蒸馏为决策树，用反事实重放标签判定恢复动作（必要/无用/有害）并淘汰无用规则；仿真中MPC冻结的20个未见布局上至少18个正确处理，测试时零LLM调用。
AI.motivation: 全局规划器+局部MPC在非凸避障和有限预测时域下易冻结，需要监督层决定重规划/等待/求助。每次异常都查询LLM太慢太贵，而手写规则无法覆盖长尾情形。
AI.method: 在线蒸馏：每轮训练后通过反事实重放为恢复动作打标签（needed / unnecessary / harmful），据此淘汰无用规则并生成决策树；新情形才查询LLM，验证后的恢复动作沉淀为新规则。
AI.result: 仿真20个未见布局（全部为MPC单独冻结的场景）中，所有随机种子下决策树至少18个正确（到达目标或路径不可达时求助），效果匹配always-query LLM监督器和专家规则，且测试时无LLM查询。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为监督器的"设计者"而非仅运行时监督者；在线蒸馏兼顾熟悉场景的快速决策与新颖场景的LLM兜底，具备持续规则增长的潜力。局限是仅在仿真验证、规模小、依赖反事实重放的标签质量。

title: SCOPE: Semantic COdec Pre-Editing for Object-Preserving Compression
summary: Image compression is increasingly used before machine vision systems, yet standard codecs are mainly optimized for human perception rather than downstream task accuracy. We propose SCOPE (Semantic COdec Pre-Editing), a conditional image pre-editor that modifies images before compression to improve the bitrate and detection accuracy trade-off. The model is conditioned on the codec family and compression severity, allowing a single trained network to adapt to multiple compression settings without retraining or loading codec-specific weights. Instead of uniformly preserving the whole image, the pre-editor learns to protect task-relevant regions while simplifying less important background content to improve compressibility. The resulting rate-accuracy curves show consistent gains across different codec families and detector architectures, together with strong transferability to unseen learned and wavelet-based compression families.

AI.tldr: SCOPE：一种条件式图像预编辑器，在压缩前修改图像以提升下游检测精度与码率的权衡，并以编解码器族与压缩强度为条件，单网络适配多种压缩设置。
AI.motivation: 标准图像编解码器以人眼感知为优化目标，而机器视觉流水线关注下游任务精度，二者目标错位，导致压缩严重时检测性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出 SCOPE（Semantic COdec Pre-Editing），在编码前对图像做条件化预编辑：以编解码器族与压缩强度为条件输入，单个训练好的网络即可泛化到多种压缩设置，无需重训或加载编解码器专用权重；编辑策略为保护任务相关区域、简化次要背景以提升可压缩性，而非整图均匀保真。
AI.result: 率-精度曲线在多种编解码器族与检测器架构上均获得一致增益，并对未见过的学习式及小波域压缩族表现出较强迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过在压缩前注入语义感知的自适应预处理，可在不改变标准编解码器的情况下改善机器视觉任务的率-精度折衷，且具备跨编解码器与跨检测器的通用性。

title: Data-Driven or Model-Constrained? Comparing Airflow Estimation Methods under Sparse Sensing
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, accepted at IEEE SENSORS Conference 2026
summary: Airflow-driven advection is the primary mechanism for gas and aerosol dispersion in real-world scenarios, making accurate airflow estimation essential for ventilation monitoring, gas source localization, and contaminant spread analysis. Since obtaining airflow maps via high-resolution spatial sensing is usually infeasible in practice, flow field estimation methods must cope with sparse measurements by introducing statistical or physical priors to compensate for limited data. Existing approaches mainly differ in how they incorporate fluid-flow constraints and environmental geometry. However, due to the lack of systematic comparisons across this spectrum of methods, the potential benefits of physics-based priors for airflow estimation under sparse sensing remain underexplored. To address this question, we quantitatively evaluate four airflow estimators across three simulated 2D scenarios under steady-state conditions and varying sampling densities. The methods range from Gaussian Process Regression and graph-based Gaussian Markov Random Fields to two Navier-Stokes-based approaches, including a novel strong-form residual minimization variant. Our results show that physical priors provide the greatest benefit at low sampling densities by compensating for missing spatial information. Although data-driven Gaussian Process Regression becomes increasingly competitive as sensor coverage increases, model-based estimators retain an accuracy advantage across the evaluated scenarios.

AI.tldr: 在稳态二维仿真场景下，定量比较四类稀疏传感下的气流估计器（GPR、图GMRF、两种Navier-Stokes方法，含一种新的强形式残差最小化变体），发现物理先验在低采样密度下优势最大，而GPR随覆盖度提升逐渐接近，但基于模型的方法各场景仍保持精度优势。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率空间气流图在实际中难以获得，需依赖稀疏测量配合统计或物理先验进行流场估计；但现有方法在引入流体约束与环境几何的方式上各异，缺乏系统性对比，物理先验在稀疏传感下的潜在收益因此未被充分认识。
AI.method: 在三个模拟二维场景、稳态条件及多种采样密度下，对四类估计器做定量评估：高斯过程回归（纯数据驱动）、基于图的高斯马尔可夫随机场（结构化先验），以及两种基于Navier-Stokes方程的方法——包括一种新颖的强形式（strong-form）残差最小化变体。
AI.result: 物理先验在低采样密度时收益最大，可补偿缺失的空间信息；随传感器覆盖率提高，GPR竞争力增强；但在所有评估场景中，基于模型的估计器仍保持精度优势。
AI.conclusion: 物理/流体动力学先验是稀疏气流估计的关键增益来源，值得在实用系统中优先考虑；当前结论限于稳态二维仿真，三维、时变流场及真实传感器噪声下的泛化仍需验证。

title: Surrogate Uncertainty for Black-box Visual Grounding
comment: A preprint rejected by RSS 2026 AND CoRL 2026
summary: Visual grounding is crucial for robots to understand language instructions with visual observations. This paper addresses the problem of visual grounding uncertainties, where a robot uses a black-box vision-language model (VLM) to ground free-form natural-language instructions to target objects. Prevailing methods derive uncertainty from the VLM itself. Yet, outputs of the VLM, e.g., generated uncertainties, are from the same parameters and structures producing the predictions, and inherit the bias. We give a formal Bayesian definition of the problem that treats the VLM prediction as an observation. An external surrogate Bayesian model then quantifies per-query uncertainty over a local neighborhood of a held-out calibration set, decomposed into aleatoric and epistemic components. A hierarchical retrieval across input modalities realizes a compact joint-space neighborhood, mitigating the curse of dimensionality. The estimator further integrates with conformal prediction or model-based planning for active visual grounding, where robots are allowed to take verbal or physical actions to ground targets. Across grounding benchmarks and state-of-the-art VLMs, it consistently improves both calibration and task performance. On a real Fetch robot under open-world instructions, it enables principled trade-offs between confident action and information gathering, substantially improving robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出一种外置的代理贝叶斯模型来量化黑盒VLM视觉定位的不确定性：将VLM预测视为观测，在留出校准集的局部邻域上做逐查询的偶然/认知不确定性分解，并用分层跨模态检索缓解维度灾难；可结合共形预测或基于模型的主动规划实现主动视觉定位，在Fetch真机上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接从VLM自身输出导出不确定性，但不确定性输出与预测共享同一参数与结构，因而继承同样的偏差，无法提供可靠的不确定性估计。机器人用黑盒VLM将自由语言指令定位到目标物体时，这种不确定性尤为关键。
AI.method: 1) 给出问题的形式化贝叶斯定义，把VLM预测当作观测；2) 用外部的代理贝叶斯模型在留出校准集的局部邻域上估计逐查询不确定性，并分解为偶然（aleatoric）与认知（epistemic）两部分；3) 通过跨输入模态的分层检索构建紧凑的联合空间邻域，缓解维度灾难；4) 估计器可接入共形预测保证覆盖率，或接入基于模型的规划做主动视觉定位（机器人可执行语言或物理动作收集信息）。
AI.result: 在多个grounding基准与SOTA VLM上，标定质量与任务性能均一致提升；在真实Fetch机器人上用开放世界指令验证，可在“自信行动”与“信息采集”之间做有原则的权衡，鲁棒性显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性不应从VLM内部导出，而应由外部代理贝叶斯模型基于局部校准邻域量化；该框架可与共形预测、主动规划结合，提升真机视觉定位的可靠性与鲁棒性。

title: GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon consistency is essential for video world models, yet it becomes difficult to maintain once observed content falls outside the context window. Existing memory mechanisms either retrieve history as implicit context, which remains constrained by context capacity and entangles static and dynamic information or consolidate history into explicit global representations, which struggle to model evolving dynamics and accumulate geometric errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce \textbf{GROME}, a novel factorized memory framework that augments video world models for long-horizon coherence across both static scenes and dynamic entities. GROME operates via three synergistic components: 1)~\emph{Static-Dynamic Factorization} decouples historical evidence into static and dynamic components, preserving static scene geometry and dynamic entity states separately; 2)~\emph{Local Memory Retrieval} selects spatially aligned static history to eliminate geometric drift alongside the latest dynamic entity states to ensure temporal continuity; 3)~\emph{Training-Free Memory Injection} seamlessly grounds the factorized memory into video world models via their native conditioning pathways. Experiments on long-horizon revisit scenarios demonstrate that GROME substantially enhances scene persistence and dynamic entity fidelity over existing methods, all while preserving the visual quality and controllability of the frozen backbone without additional training. Beyond self-rollouts, GROME readily accommodates external observations as plug-and-play memory, unlocking flexible and controllable video continuation and scene exploration.

AI.tldr: GROME 提出因子化记忆框架：将历史证据解耦为静态场景几何与动态实体状态，通过局部空间对齐检索与免训练的原生条件注入，使视频世界模型在超出上下文窗口后仍保持长时程一致性，并可即插即用地接入外部观测。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型在观测内容滑出上下文窗口后难以维持长时程一致性。隐式上下文检索受限于上下文容量且静态/动态信息纠缠；显式全局记忆难以刻画演化的动态并累积几何误差。
AI.method: 三组件协同：1) 静态-动态因子化，将历史证据拆分为静态场景几何与动态实体状态；2) 局部记忆检索，选取空间对齐的静态历史消除几何漂移，并取最新动态状态保证时间连续；3) 免训练记忆注入，经冻结主干的原生条件通路注入因子化记忆。外部观测可作为即插即用记忆。
AI.result: 在长时程重访场景实验中，场景持久性与动态实体保真度显著优于现有方法，同时保持冻结主干的视觉质量与可控性，且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 因子化记忆是解决视频世界模型长时程一致性的有效途径，兼具免训练、可扩展与可插拔特性，支持可控视频续写与场景探索。

title: PASA-KV: Attacking Action-Facing Visual Routes in World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) increasingly couple internal visual or world representations with action generation, making their world-to-action pathways a critical yet poorly understood source of robustness. We investigate when perturbations to these internal representations actually become behaviorally consequential, and uncover a pronounced mismatch between representation perturbability and closed-loop vulnerability: attack effectiveness varies sharply across visual K/V routes, while larger representation displacement does not reliably imply stronger control failure. Our analysis attributes this mismatch to the action-conditioned readout, where keys determine where action queries read and values determine what content they receive. This motivates an action-facing view of vulnerability, in which the effect of a perturbation depends on how it is routed into action generation rather than on representation-space magnitude alone. We instantiate this view with Tail-AV, a short-probe signal for identifying vulnerable routes, and operationalize it in PASA-KV, which selects action-facing K/V targets before training a fresh task-shared attack. Experiments across multiple WAM systems and a physical robot validate readout-informed target selection, demonstrate strong closed-loop attacks, and reveal substantial system-level differences in resistance.

AI.tldr: 该文研究世界动作模型(WAM)中"世界表示→动作"通路的鲁棒性，发现表示可扰动性与闭环行为脆弱性不匹配，并提出面向动作的K/V路由目标选择方法(Tail-AV + PASA-KV)以构造更强闭环攻击。
AI.motivation: WAM日益将内部视觉/世界表示与动作生成耦合，"世界→动作"通路成为关键的鲁棒性来源却理解不足；作者希望澄清内部表示扰动何时真正转化为行为层面的失效。
AI.method: 先做扰动分析发现：攻击有效性在视觉K/V路由间差异显著，且表示空间位移更大并不必然导致更强控制失效；将不匹配归因于动作条件读出(key决定动作查询读取位置、value决定接收内容)。据此提出动作面向的脆弱性视角，并实例化为Tail-AV短探测信号识别脆弱路由，再用PASA-KV在训练新任务共享攻击前选择动作面向的K/V目标。
AI.result: 在多个WAM系统与一台真实机器人上验证了读出信息导向的目标选择，实现强闭环攻击，并揭示系统间抗扰能力的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 表示空间扰动幅度不能作为脆弱性代理指标；应以扰动如何被路由进动作生成来评估和攻击WAM，这一读出视角可指导有效的闭环对抗目标选择。

title: Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia Asia 2026 (MMAsia 2026). 10 pages, 4 figures
summary: Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization (DBPO) concentrates learning on this calibrated boundary region. Second, we distill reusable clinical rubrics from boundary trajectories and activate them according to prediction entropy. Entropy Gated Grounded Policy Optimization (EGPO) rewards answer correctness, anatomical grounding, and reasoning fidelity while suppressing rubric noise on reliable samples. A reference policy anchored to the boundary-aligned model couples population-level boundary priors with instance-level uncertainty, making diagnostic reasoning more accurate and clinically grounded. Experiments on six medical benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong general, specialized, and reinforcement learning baselines, reaching 61.2% average accuracy with the largest gains on challenging differential diagnosis tasks. Ablations show super-additive gains: combining the two stages exceeds the sum of their individual improvements.

AI.tldr: MedCBR 是一个两阶段医学视觉语言模型对齐框架：先用能力前沿上的反事实边界偏好（DBPO）聚焦难题，再用熵门控的评分细则强化学习（EGPO）奖励解剖学接地与推理保真，六大基准平均准确率 61.2%。
AI.motivation: 医学诊断推理需要视觉证据与临床知识的可验证联系，但现有医疗 VLM 的对齐目标奖励了错误行为：均匀 SFT 使简单样本主导更新，临床关键边界样本过早饱和；仅基于最终答案的稀疏奖励无法评估解剖接地与临床逻辑，导致走答案捷径的奖励黑客。
AI.method: 两阶段对齐框架。阶段一：依据经验通过率在模型能力前沿构建反事实边界偏好对（共享推理前缀、在关键诊断分支处分叉），用难度加权的边界偏好优化（DBPO）将学习集中在校准后的边界区域。阶段二：从边界轨迹中蒸馏可复用临床评分细则，依据预测熵激活，用熵门控接地策略优化（EGPO）奖励答案正确性、解剖接地与推理保真，并在可靠样本上抑制细则噪声；以边界对齐模型为参考策略锚点，耦合群体级边界先验与实例级不确定性。
AI.result: 在六个医学基准上一致优于强通用、专用及强化学习基线，平均准确率达 61.2%，在困难的鉴别诊断任务上增益最大；消融显示两阶段具有超加性（super-additive）增益，组合效果超过各自提升之和。
AI.conclusion: 将边界感知偏好优化与基于评分细则的强化学习耦合，可同时提升诊断准确性与临床接地性；难度加权与熵门控分别解决样本分布失衡与奖励稀疏问题，两阶段互补且协同。

title: LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models
summary: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware suite of state-of-the-art attacks, including PGD and Square Attack for segmentation, and point perturbation, point removal, point injection, and LiDAttack for detection. This enables systematic exposure of corner cases and vulnerabilities across heterogeneous LiDAR backbones. The LiDAR-Shield codebase is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LIDARSHIELD：全Docker化的统一LiDAR对抗攻击框架，通过/info、/forward、/gradient三个HTTP端点解耦模型与攻击工具，新模型/数据集只需接入一个loader函数。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR 3D感知对抗攻击实现分散在各仓库中，与特定架构/任务绑定，需手工重建环境并编写模型专用集成代码，难以在异构骨干与任务间系统化评估鲁棒性。
AI.method: 反转部署范式：不在工具包内安装目标模型，而以HTTP协议（/info、/forward、/gradient）将任意模型作为外部服务暴露；采用engine–service协议统一3D语义分割与3D目标检测；任务感知攻击集成分割侧的PGD、Square Attack，检测侧的点扰动、点移除、点注入与LiDAttack。
AI.result: 实现单一框架内跨任务、跨异构LiDAR骨干的攻击评测，可系统化暴露corner case与脆弱性；通过单一loader/adapter即可接入新模型与数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该工作主要贡献是工程化与标准化（可复现、易扩展的评测基础设施），而非新的攻击算法或感知方法，代码已开源。对安全性与攻击类论文，缺少跨骨干攻击成功率/迁移性等量化结果，实用性受限；定位为鲁棒性评测工具。

title: Open-set multi-view seahorse re-identification from underwater photograph sequences
summary: Automated animal re-identification from photograph sequences can facilitate minimally invasive Capture-Mark-Recapture studies at scale. Yet, photographs taken during an observation session can vary greatly in quality, not always providing the necessary information for accurate re-identification. In this paper, we present new methods for taxonomic classification, sex determination, and open-set re-identification from image sequences. We train and evaluate our models on a dataset of 35,914 photographs of 474 individual seahorses observed in the wild. We demonstrate that our approach, by combining information from multiple photographs, yields state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于图像序列的物种分类、性别判定与开放集重识别新方法，在35,914张474只野生海马照片上训练评估，融合多图信息取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 单张野外照片质量差异大，常缺少可靠重识别所需信息；需要利用观测会话内的多张照片来提升识别稳健性，以支持规模化、微创的捕获-标记-重捕（CMR）研究。
AI.method: 面向图像序列学习：将同一会话多张照片的线索融合用于三项任务——分类学分类、性别判定与开放集重识别；在真实野外海马数据集上训练与评测。
AI.result: 多图融合策略在分类、性别判定和开放集重识别上均达到当时最优性能（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: 多图序列聚合明显优于单图方案，可作为野外生态监测中可扩展、非侵入式个体识别的实用流程；但缺乏方法细节与通用性验证。

authors: Udaya Sampath K. Perera Miriya Thanthrige
title: M-PFT: Angular Margin for Calibrated Prompt-Tuning of Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
summary: Prompt-tuning has emerged as a parameter-efficient technique for adapting large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. However, prompt-tuned VLMs often suffer from a base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem, where models typically show underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes. Current VLM calibration approaches address this dual miscalibration either separately or jointly, but lack a geometric understanding of the hyperspherical embedding space and thus fail to exploit angular discriminative properties to adjust distorted decision boundaries. To address this, we propose M-PFT, a novel angular-margin approach for prompt tuning that introduces two complementary objectives to promote class discriminability and semantic anchoring. This enlarges the angular margin by 1) minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings to reduce embedding collapse and 2) minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding to preserve semantic geometry. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning methods with various backbones on 15 diverse datasets show that our approach reduces the average calibration error on novel classes, while remaining competitive on base classes and maintaining comparable accuracy. Further analyses reveal that M-PFT effectively adjusts distorted decision boundaries induced by prompt tuning while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, improving calibration with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 M-PFT，一种角度间隔（angular-margin）提示调优方法，通过最大化可学习类嵌入间的最小余弦相似度惩罚（最小化最大余弦相似度）与约束其到零样本嵌入的角度距离，缓解 prompt-tuned VLM 的 base-to-novel 双重误校准问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 校准方法分别或联合处理 base 类欠自信与 novel 类过自信，但缺乏对超球面嵌入空间的几何理解，未能利用角度判别性质来修正失真的决策边界。
AI.method: 两个互补目标：(1) 最小化可调类嵌入之间的最大余弦相似度，增大角度间隔、缓解嵌入塌缩；(2) 最小化每个可调嵌入与其对应零样本嵌入的角度距离，实现语义锚定并保持预训练语义几何。冻结主干权重，仅训练提示与类嵌入。
AI.result: 在 15 个数据集、9 种 prompt-tuning 方法与多种骨干网络上实验，novel 类平均校准误差下降，base 类保持竞争力，准确率相当；分析显示其在保持预训练嵌入空间的同时有效修正 prompt tuning 造成的失真决策边界，额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 角度间隔正则化是无需重训练主干、低开销的即插即用校准手段，适用于任意 prompt-tuning 流程；不足在于仅验证图像分类场景，未涉及机器人/具身感知中的开放集或布局任务。

title: Parametric Gaussian Noise Mixer (PGNM): Unified Synthesis of Camera Noise and Film Grain
comment: Technical report. 49 pages: 9-page main paper and 40-page supplementary material; 29 figures, 33 tables
summary: Noise synthesis is commonly approached through physical models of image formation or neural networks trained to generate noisy images. We explore a middle ground: an explicit statistical model fitted directly from paired clean and noisy images. A normalized convolution correlates a Gaussian field across pixels and color channels, and a lookup maps each Gaussian value to a residual given the clean intensity. Because the field stays standard Gaussian, the two components are fitted separately, without reproducing the physical process or training a neural generator. With one formulation for camera noise from SIDD and simulated film grain from Newson, the model has the lowest average distribution and correlation errors on SIDD among the evaluated methods and remains competitive on film grain. A denoiser trained on its noise comes closest to one trained on real noise, and a 1080p frame renders in 10 ms on GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从成对干净/噪声图像直接拟合的显式统计噪声模型：用归一化卷积在像素与颜色通道上相关一个高斯场，再用查找表将高斯值映射为残差，两部分可独立拟合；在SIDD相机噪声与Newson胶片颗粒上统一建模，分布与相关性误差最低，训练去噪器接近真实噪声效果，1080p单帧GPU渲染10ms。
AI.motivation: 现有噪声合成依赖物理成像模型或神经网络生成器，前者需复现物理过程、后者需训练生成网络；作者希望在两者之间取中间路线，用直接从真实成对数据拟合的显式统计模型来生成噪声。
AI.method: 显式统计模型：1）归一化卷积（normalized convolution）将标准高斯场在像素邻域与颜色通道间进行相关，得到空间-通道相关的中间场；2）查找表以干净图像强度为条件，将该高斯值映射为噪声残差。由于中间场保持标准高斯，相关核与查找表两部分可解耦、分别拟合，无需物理建模或神经生成器训练。统一公式同时用于SIDD相机噪声与Newson模拟胶片颗粒。
AI.result: 在SIDD上，所评估方法中平均分布误差与相关性误差最低；在胶片颗粒上保持有竞争力。用其合成噪声训练的去噪器性能最接近用真实噪声训练的去噪器；1080p帧在GPU上渲染耗时10ms，具备实时性。
AI.conclusion: 噪声合成可由轻量、可解释、可解耦拟合的显式统计模型完成，兼顾真实性与效率，可作为物理模型与神经生成器之间的实用替代方案，并便于用于去噪器训练数据扩增。

title: Compressed Orientation Reachability Maps for Sub-Second Robotic Needle Entry Point Planning
summary: In the context of multi-stage trajectory planning for robotic percutaneous liver interventions, identifying a kinematically feasible entry point remains a critical computational bottleneck. Existing methods rely on exhaustive inverse kinematics or randomized searches, incurring delays of 13 to 27 seconds per target and limiting real-time intraoperative adaptation. This paper introduces an Orientation-Based Reachability Map (ORM) that precomputes the kinematic feasibility of a 6 Degrees of Freedom (DoF) serial manipulator across 188,873 workspace positions and encodes orientation feasibility into a compact, indexed 83 MB map. A Just-In-Time (JIT) compiled runtime pipeline replaces live optimization with near-instantaneous array lookups. Experimental evaluation demonstrates a reduction in planning latency from 13.5-26.9 s to 0.289-0.349 s per target while maintaining high geometric fidelity, achieving a mean convex hull volume overlap ratio of 0.933 and a mean alpha-shape volume ratio of 0.976 relative to the baseline reachable point cloud. The proposed ORM framework enables sub-second entry point planning and provides an efficient computational framework for robotic needle insertion in percutaneous liver ablation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于朝向的可达性图(ORM)，离线预计算6-DoF机械臂在188,873个位姿上的运动学可行性，将朝向可行性编码为83MB索引表，配合JIT编译流水线实现近即时查表，把经皮肝穿刺入针点规划延迟从13.5-26.9s降至0.29-0.35s，几何保真度保持0.933/0.976。
AI.motivation: 机器人经皮肝脏介入需多阶段轨迹规划，可行入针点的筛选是计算瓶颈；现有方法依赖穷举逆运动学或随机搜索，每个目标耗时13-27秒，无法术中实时适配。
AI.method: 构建朝向可达性图(ORM)：离线对6自由度串联机械臂在188,873个 workspace 位置预计算运动学可行性，将可解朝向压缩为带索引的83MB数据结构；运行时用JIT编译的查表流水线替代在线优化求解，实现常量时间查询。
AI.result: 每目标规划延迟从13.5-26.9s降至0.289-0.349s（约50-90倍加速）；相对基线可达点云，凸包体积重叠比均值0.933，alpha-shape体积比均值0.976，几何保真度高。
AI.conclusion: ORM框架实现亚秒级入针点规划，为经皮肝消融等机器人针刺任务提供高效计算框架；但验证限于仿真可达性几何比较，缺少真实机器人部署与临床场景实测。

title: What Survives Label Downsampling? Exact Region Survival for Coarse Segmentation Targets
summary: Segmentation networks that predict at an output stride are trained against label maps downsampled by strided sampling, nearest-neighbor resampling or majority pooling. These methods label each coarse grid cell on its own, so a region that wins no cell is absent from the target and receives no positive label. We present MatchDown, which builds the coarse target from a minimum-cost matching between regions and the grid cells they occupy. It keeps as many regions as any one-region-per-cell target can, certifies how many losses are unavoidable, and with priority tiers (MatchDown-P) keeps every evaluated region (a region that a metric scores) of at least one cell's area. On COCO, Cityscapes and BBBC038 at factors 2 to 16, MatchDown-P loses exactly the minimum number of regions, whereas the downsampling used by StarDist, nnU-Net and connectomics pyramids loses four to five times as many on COCO at factor 8. Keeping a region in the target and reconstructing its shape are different problems: we show that no region lost by majority pooling can be reconstructed above IoU 0.5 by upsampling any coarse target, yet on BBBC038 a star-convex head trained on MatchDown targets segments 35% of the nuclei that majority pooling loses above IoU 0.5, against 15% when trained on majority targets and 24% on StarDist's strided target. On two nucleus datasets, with thresholds cross-validated for count error, this head has instance accuracy at IoU 0.5 (Acc50) 2.6 to 4.2 points above the strided target and at most 2.8 points below cell-center sampling, and a lower count error than the strided and cell-center targets on BBBC039. On BBBC039, an affinity head, which outputs one label per cell, lowers count error relative to majority targets by 9.3 nuclei per image at 7.2 points lower Acc50. MatchDown runs once, before training, in place of the label-downsampling step.

AI.tldr: MatchDown用区域与网格单元之间的最小费用匹配来构造分割网络的粗粒度标签，在最坏情况下最大化被保留的区域数，并在BBBC038/BBBC039/COCO/Cityscapes上证明其优于strided、最近邻和多数池化下采样。
AI.motivation: 预测在输出stride上的分割网络需要使用下采样标签图训练，而strided采样、最近邻重采样和多数池化都独立地为每个粗网格单元打标签，导致未赢得任何单元的小区域在目标图中消失、得不到正标签，进而使这些区域无法被检测。
AI.method: 将粗标签构造建模为区域集合与网格单元之间的最小费用匹配问题；MatchDown保证达到"每单元一标签"约束下可保留区域数的上界，并给出不可避免损失区域数的证书；其优先层级版本MatchDown-P进一步保证所有被评测区域（面积至少一个单元）都被保留。方法在训练前一次性运行，替代标签下采样步骤；作者还分析了"保留区域"与"由粗目标上采样重建形状"是两个不同问题，并用星凸头和亲和头进行验证。
AI.result: 在COCO、Cityscapes、BBBC038上、因子2–16下，MatchDown-P恰达到最小损失区域数，而StarDist、nnU-Net和连接组学金字塔使用的下采样在COCO因子8时损失多4–5倍；证明多数池化丢失的区域无法通过任何粗目标上采样达到IoU>0.5；在BBBC038上，用MatchDown目标训练的星凸头在IoU>0.5下分割出35%的多数池化丢失细胞核（多数目标15%、StarDist strided目标24%）；在两个细胞核数据集上，Acc50比strided高2.6–4.2点、比cell-center至多低2.8点，BBBC039上计数误差更低；亲和头相对多数目标降低计数误差9.3个核/图，但Acc50低7.2点。
AI.conclusion: 标签下采样本身是可优化的组合问题，最小费用匹配式标签构造可显著缓解小区域在训练目标中的丢失，且与重建能力解耦；但其收益随输出头形式（星凸 vs 亲和）差异较大，主要适用于密集小目标的医学/细胞实例分割场景。

title: sDMD: Sinkhorn Distribution Matching Distillation
summary: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) distills multi-step diffusion models into few-step generators by minimizing reverse KL divergence. Despite its strong performance, DMD guides samples by local density alone, which introduces two limitations: teacher scores can be unreliable in regions of low teacher density, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the student onto a subset of the teacher modes. We first connect DMD to Wasserstein gradient flow, showing that its gradient follows from a fixed-point formulation with integral KL (IKL) as the energy functional. This perspective motivates augmenting IKL with an optimal transport term that addresses these limitations by guiding outlier samples toward the target and promoting mode coverage. We realize this term using Sinkhorn divergence estimated from finite batches. In practice, however, errors in the estimated Sinkhorn velocity can perturb in-domain samples for which IKL guidance is already accurate. To this end, we introduce sDMD, which adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction based on discriminator outputs, focusing on outlier samples where IKL may be unreliable. With 2--4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image-20B, and Wan2.1-14B, sDMD outperforms distillation baselines on GenEval, DPG, WISE, and VBench while improving sample diversity over DMD2.

AI.tldr: 将DMD与Wasserstein梯度流和积分KL（IKL）势函数联系起来，提出用熵正则最优传输（Sinkhorn散度）项补充IKL，并用判别器输出自适应激活校正，形成sDMD，实现少步扩散蒸馏。
AI.motivation: DMD仅靠局部密度引导采样，存在两个缺陷：教师在低密度区分数不可靠，反向KL的众数寻求性会使学生塌缩到部分教师众数。需要一种能拉回离群样本并提升模式覆盖的能量泛函。
AI.method: 首先把DMD梯度推导为以IKL为能量泛函的不动点形式（对应Wasserstein梯度流）。在IKL上加入最优传输项，用有限批次估计的Sinkhorn散度实现。为避免Sinkhorn速度估计误差扰动已准确的域内样本，引入判别器输出自适应门控，仅在离群样本处激活Sinkhorn校正（sDMD）。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image-20B、Wan2.1-14B上以2–4步采样，sDMD在GenEval、DPG、WISE、VBench上优于蒸馏基线，且相比DMD2样本多样性更好。
AI.conclusion: 把DMD解释为IKL能量下的Wasserstein梯度流，并以Sinkhorn传输项+判别器自适应门控修补其低密度区与模式塌缩问题，是一种理论有据、工程可行的少步蒸馏改进。

title: TokenRepel: Generating Diverse Image Sets Without Compromising Quality
summary: We present an inference-time approach that enhances the visual diversity of image sets generated by text-to-image models, without compromising the average image quality. Our method leverages the intrinsic geometry of hidden representations in pretrained models to diversify images generated from the same prompt. First, we introduce a token repulsion mechanism that increases the angle between feature tokens across samples. It takes a negative Riemannian gradient step on a von Mises-Fisher mixture distribution of tokens on the unit hypersphere. Second, to preserve the quality of each output image, we propose a token density preservation mechanism that projects the repulsion-induced prediction change onto a half-space aligned with the model's score direction. This encourages the updates to remain within the high-density regions learned by the generative model. We further extend this mechanism to the output of each intermediate layer, enabling finer-grained iterative guidance. We evaluate our method on three types of pretrained text-to-image models. Experiments show substantial gains in visual diversity under identical prompts, while maintaining a comparable level of image fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出推理时方法，利用预训练文本到图像模型隐表示的几何结构提升同提示图像集多样性：令牌排斥机制（在单位超球面上对von Mises-Fisher混合分布做负黎曼梯度步）配合令牌密度保持机制（将更新投影到与模型score方向对齐的半空间），并扩展到各中间层输出实现细粒度迭代引导。
AI.motivation: 缓解文本到图像模型在同一提示下生成结果多样性不足的问题，同时避免以牺牲单图保真度为代价。
AI.method: 推理时引导、无需重训练：1）token排斥，在单位超球面上对特征token的vMF混合分布取负黎曼梯度步以增大样本间token夹角；2）token密度保持，将排斥引起的预测变化投影到与模型score场方向对齐的半空间，使更新停留在高密度区域；3）将该机制逐层扩展至中间层输出，实现更细粒度的迭代引导。
AI.result: 在三类预训练文本到图像模型上实验，相同提示下视觉多样性显著提升，图像保真度保持相当水平。
AI.conclusion: 基于隐空间几何的推理时多样性引导是有效且模型无关的，可在不重训练的前提下同时兼顾多样性与质量。

title: PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets
summary: Generating interactive 3D assets from a single image requires realistic appearance, fidelity to the depicted object, and plausible physical behavior. Yet detailed geometry alone does not determine how an object should move or deform. We introduce PhysAg3D, which couples 3D generative models with agentic reasoning and tool use. A vision-language agent first infers semantic parts, candidate interactions, and physical priors from the image; a 3D generator then produces a textured whole-object mesh from the same image. A hierarchical interaction representation links these revisable priors to mechanisms and the generated surfaces they control, organizing interaction construction and refinement. Guided by this representation and observations of the mesh, the agent uses geometric and physical tools to construct parts, joints, deformable regions, and surface bindings while retaining useful generated geometry and materials. Rendered interactions and execution measurements guide targeted revisions within a fixed budget. The framework accommodates both rigid articulation and compliant deformation. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real photographs and external benchmarks demonstrate detailed, image-aligned assets with plausible interactions. Ablations support bounded refinement and source-surface preservation. Project Page: this http URL .

AI.tldr: PhysAg3D 将三维生成模型与视觉语言智能体推理/工具调用耦合，从单张图像生成兼具外观细节、图像对齐性和合理刚体铰接/柔顺形变交互的可交互 3D 资产。
AI.motivation: 单图生成可交互 3D 资产需同时满足真实外观、对图示对象的保真度与合理物理行为；但精细几何本身并不决定物体如何运动与形变，纯生成模型缺少物理先验与部件级交互结构。
AI.method: VL 智能体先从图像推断语义部件、候选交互与物理先验；3D 生成器由同一图像产出带纹理的整体网格；以分层交互表示把可修订先验与机构及其控制的生成表面关联，指导交互构建与精化；智能体借助几何与物理工具在观测网格基础上构建部件、关节、形变区域与表面绑定，并保留有效生成几何与材质；再以渲染交互与执行测量在固定预算内做定向修订。
AI.result: 在真实照片与外部基准上，定量与定性评估均得到细节丰富、与图像对齐且交互行为合理的资产；消融实验支持有界精化与源表面保持的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式 3D 与智能体化工具推理结合，可在统一框架内实现刚体铰接与柔顺形变的可交互资产生成，是"智能体驱动重建/生成 + 物理可交互资产"方向的有价值进展。

title: Spectral Invariant Fusion and Refinement for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
summary: Domain generalized semantic segmentation is challenging because it requires accurate dense prediction on unseen domains without any access to target-domain data during training. Existing methods improve transferability through data diversification, invariant learning, or direct use of foundation models, but they often struggle to simultaneously suppress domain-sensitive interference and preserve fine-grained spatial cues. In this work, we propose SIFR, a frequency-aware dual-stream framework that tackles domain shift at both the fusion and decoding stages. SIFR uses spectral modeling as a unified principle to regulate both heterogeneous prior interaction and dense decoder refinement. Instead of directly fusing frozen CLIP and DINOv2 features, SIFR performs spectral-guided invariant fusion to filter out domain-sensitive responses while preserving complementary semantic and structural information. In addition, SIFR incorporates a spectral decoder refinement module that stabilizes multi-scale decoder features through low-frequency statistics-based normalization and adaptive frequency selection, thereby reducing the propagation of residual domain bias in dense prediction. This design enables SIFR to jointly improve domain robustness and segmentation precision under severe distribution shifts. Extensive experiments on multiple DGSS benchmarks, including synthetic-to-real, real-to-real, and adverse-weather settings, demonstrate consistent improvements over previous state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SIFR频率感知双流框架，用频谱建模统一调控CLIP/DINOv2异质先验的融合与解码器细化，以抑制域敏感干扰并保留细粒度空间线索，用于域泛化语义分割(DGSS)。
AI.motivation: 现有DGSS方法（数据多样化、不变性学习、直接使用基础模型）难以同时抑制域敏感干扰与保留细粒度空间结构；CLIP与DINOv2直接融合亦会放大域偏置。
AI.method: SIFR以频谱建模为统一原则，分两阶段治理域偏移：(1) 谱引导不变融合——在频谱域筛选/抑制域敏感响应后再融合冻结的CLIP与DINOv2特征，保留互补语义与结构信息；(2) 谱解码器细化——基于低频统计的归一化与自适应频率选择稳定多尺度解码特征，降低残差域偏置传播。
AI.result: 在合成到真实、真实到真实、恶劣天气等多类DGSS基准上，一致性超越先前SOTA方法，在严重分布偏移下同时提升域鲁棒性与分割精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 频谱域是统一调控异质基础模型先验与密集预测解码的可行原则，能在融合与解码两阶段协同抑制域偏移；但方法面向2D语义分割，缺少机器人/具身任务验证。

title: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: MLLM-GS 将冻结的多模态大模型视觉先验用于退化场景的新视角合成：用轻量校正网络修正 MLLM 输出偏移，再以优化后的 3DGS 快速重建 3D 场景。
AI.motivation: 现有退化场景 NVS 方法依赖特定退化类型的模型，跨极端环境泛化差；生成模型虽有丰富先验，但输出存在像素错位与色偏并传播至 3D 重建；且 3D 重建计算与显存开销大，难以实际部署。
AI.method: 双分支框架：(1) MLLM 先验引导视图增强——冻结 MLLM 增强严重退化视图，配合轻量校正网络减小像素位移与色彩失真，仅需少量成对干净视图监督，为所有退化观测生成伪 GT；(2) 快速 3D 场景重建——改进 3DGS 的光栅化、高斯内存布局与参数更新，降低冗余计算、访存开销与优化成本。
AI.result: 在多类退化场景实验中，方法可处理多种严重退化，显著缩短重建时间、降低显存占用，同时保持高质量 NVS。
AI.conclusion: 以 MLLM 视觉先验替代退化专用模型，可获得跨退化类型的统一增强能力；配合高效 3DGS 实现，可在极端环境下实用化部署退化鲁棒的新视角合成。

title: BiHashFormer: Hash-Driven Dual-Branch Transformer for Efficient Object Detection in HRW Shots
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages including supplementary material and the NeurIPS checklist. Code: this https URL
summary: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and interleaving of foreground and background. This causes traditional detectors and attention mechanisms to be hindered by background, resulting in inefficiency and inaccuracy. To tackle this problem, we propose BiHashFormer, a dual sparsified branch transformer built on hashing. RoI Selector will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selecting target-containing windows. The compression branch processes windows selected and refines attention into HashAttention by discarding half of the key-value pairs, reducing cost and improving efficiency. The compensation branch uses HashMiner to perform low-cost hash searches in the remaining regions, recovering features of missed objects. Experiments confirm that the selection relationship in HashAttention is one-way and reveal the preference of different queries for keys. In experiments on the gigapixel benchmark PANDA, BiHashFormer reduces 37.5% backbone FLOPs while improving AP50 to 81.0%. Moreover, this parallel dual-branch structure allows the model to avoid inference delays caused by inter-branch dependencies, while achieving much greater stability than single-branch models, specially with low rates of RoI selection.

AI.tldr: BiHashFormer：面向十亿像素级高分辨率广角图像的双分支稀疏哈希Transformer检测器，通过RoI选择器定位前景窗口、压缩分支用HashAttention丢弃半数KV对降本、补偿分支用HashMiner做低成本哈希检索找回漏检目标。
AI.motivation: 十亿像素级（gigapixel）广角图像存在前景极度稀疏、分辨率极高、前景与背景交织等问题，传统检测器与注意力机制被背景淹没，导致计算低效与精度下降。
AI.method: 1) RoI Selector 预测前景比例，top-k 选取含目标窗口；2) 压缩分支对选中窗口做HashAttention，丢弃一半key-value对以降低开销；3) 补偿分支用HashMiner在剩余区域进行低成本哈希搜索，恢复漏检目标特征；4) 两分支并行、无跨分支依赖。
AI.result: PANDA十亿像素基准上，backbone FLOPs 降低37.5%，AP50 提升至 81.0%；实验验证HashAttention中选择关系为单向，并揭示不同query对key的偏好；并行双分支结构无分支依赖推理延迟，在RoI选择率低时稳定性显著优于单分支模型。
AI.conclusion: 哈希化稀疏注意力+双分支补偿为超大幅图像目标检测提供了高效、稳定的方案，但属特定域（遥感/监控式广角检测）工程改进，与具身智能/3D重建核心方向关联有限。

title: ElasticFormer: Detecting Objects in HRW Shots via Elastic Computing Vision Transformer
comment: Published at CVPR 2026. 14 pages including supplementary material. Code: this https URL
summary: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and diverse target counts. This makes traditional close-up detectors inaccurate and slow as they are overwhelmed by the background. Although previous research has explored sparse backbones, their fixed sparsity patterns lack the adaptability required to handle diverse target numbers. To address this, we introduce ElasticFormer, a sparse backbone that dynamically allocates computational resources based on foreground proportion. After scoring windows based on variance, proposed ElasticSelector module will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selection. The mechanism guides the model to select target-containing windows, scaling resources in areas where objects are clustered. We introduce a novel loss function combined with the 3-phase training strategy for ElasticSelector, allowing it to function properly when bounding box annotations are missing. A WSOD study is carried on PASCAL VOC 2007 to evaluate its extensibility. Further, ElasticNet is created to verify its backbone-agnostic nature. In experiments on the PANDA gigapixel benchmark, ElasticFormer reduces backbone FLOPs by 80% while achieving a significant improvement in AP50 when compared to fixed-ratio sparse methods.

AI.tldr: ElasticFormer：一种根据前景比例动态分配算力的稀疏骨干网络，用于千兆像素级高分辨率宽幅图像的检测，在PANDA基准上以80%的FLOPs削减取得显著AP50提升。
AI.motivation: 千兆像素（gigapixel）宽幅图像前景极度稀疏、分辨率极高且目标数量差异巨大，传统近景检测器被背景淹没，既慢又不准；已有稀疏骨干的固定稀疏模式无法适应目标数量变化。
AI.method: 1）基于方差对窗口打分；2）ElasticSelector模块预测各窗口前景比例，据此进行top-k选择，引导模型聚焦含目标窗口并在目标聚集区扩展算力；3）设计配套新损失函数与三阶段训练策略，使ElasticSelector在缺少边界框标注时仍能工作（弱监督）；4）在PASCAL VOC 2007上做WSOD研究验证可扩展性；5）构建ElasticNet验证方法的骨干无关性。
AI.result: 在PANDA千兆像素基准上，骨干FLOPs减少80%，同时相较固定比例稀疏方法AP50显著提升；WSOD实验与ElasticNet验证了可扩展性和骨干无关性。
AI.conclusion: 动态、由前景比例驱动的稀疏计算分配优于固定稀疏模式，可作为通用稀疏骨干集成到多种检测框架中，适用于超大幅遥感/监控类图像分析。

title: UniRA: Unified Representation Alignment and Auto-Encoding for Efficient Diffusion Generation
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image synthesis, yet they suffer from slow training convergence and high computational cost. Two recent lines of work address this from complementary angles: Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates DiT training by aligning intermediate features with a pretrained external representation model (e.g., DINOv2), while Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) replace the pixel-space VAE with a compact representation-space tokenizer learned from self-supervised features. However, these approaches are developed and applied in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, and RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the diffusion backbone. We present \textbf{UniRA}, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. UniRA learns a representation-space tokenizer whose output serves simultaneously as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized. We give a theoretical result showing that this joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model while accelerating diffusion convergence, and we derive a principled weighting that balances the reconstruction, alignment, and generation objectives. On ImageNet class-conditional generation at 256*256 and 512*512, UniRA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art DiTs (SD3, REPA, RAE) in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5*. We further show that the unified representation space supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a shared, aligned latent space.

AI.tldr: UniRA统一了表征对齐(REPA)与表征自编码(RAE)，用表征空间tokenizer同时作扩散目标与对齐锚点，联合优化tokenizer、DiT骨干与外部表征模型，理论上证明保持外部表征质量并加速收敛；ImageNet 256/512上FID持平或超越SD3/REPA/RAE，训练步数最多减少5倍。
AI.motivation: REPA通过将DiT中间特征与DINOv2等外部表征对齐来加速训练，RAE用自监督特征学到的表征空间tokenizer替代像素VAE；但两者孤立发展——REPA仍依赖像素空间VAE，RAE未利用对齐信号加速扩散骨干，因此需要统一框架。
AI.method: 提出统一目标：学习一个表征空间tokenizer，其输出同时作为扩散目标和对齐锚点，从而协同优化tokenizer、扩散骨干与外部表征模型；给出理论分析说明联合优化在保持外部模型表征质量的同时加速扩散收敛，并推导重建/对齐/生成三项损失的原理性加权。
AI.result: 在ImageNet类条件生成256×256与512×512上，FID匹配或超过SD3、REPA、RAE等SOTA DiT，训练步数最多减少5倍；统一表征空间还提升了零样本分类与线性探测性能。
AI.conclusion: 表征对齐与表征自编码可合并为单一目标，共享的对齐潜空间让生成与理解互相受益，为DiT高效训练提供了统一范式。

title: Mind The Gap (MTG-AD): Dataset and Fine-grained Evaluation for End-to-End Inline Audio Descriptions
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track, camera ready
summary: Audio descriptions (AD) are essential for making visual media accessible to blind and low-vision (BLV) users. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a scalable solution for generating audio descriptions on-demand, their performance on ``inline'' audio descriptions -- which must fit within existing silences in a video -- remains under-explored, particularly for diverse user-generated content (UGC). We present a comprehensive investigation into MLLM-generated inline audio descriptions. First, we introduce MTG-AD, a professionally annotated dataset of 36 hours of videos, each averaging $\sim$5 mins. and 8k+ descriptions in total, co-created by paired blind and sighted AD professionals to provide a high-quality benchmark for this task. Second, we propose MTG-AD-Eval, an evaluation framework based on audio description expert guidelines that provides fine-grained, reference-free actionable metrics for model improvement. Crucially, our framework evaluates the end-to-end task: it renders the generated scripts into audio tracks to assess their fit within the original video's natural silences, minimizing disruptive overlaps. Our analysis across frontier MLLMs reveals that while models accurately describe visual events and substantially reduce speech overlaps, gaps persist in narrative pacing and flow. Finally, we empirically validate that our automated and reference-free metrics correlate significantly with human quality ratings from sighted raters and 7 BLV participants, finding that while users narrowly prefer human-authored audio descriptions, they find MLLM-generated audio descriptions highly beneficial for comprehension. We provide actionable system design guidance and release MTG-AD at this https URL and MTG-AD-Eval at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出MTG-AD数据集（36小时UGC视频、8k+专业内联音频描述）与MTG-AD-Eval无参考评测框架，端到端渲染语音并衡量其在原视频静音段内的嵌入效果，系统评测前沿MLLM生成内联音频描述的能力。
AI.motivation: 音频描述（AD）是盲人与低视力用户获取视觉媒体的关键，MLLM可低成本按需生成，但其"内联"AD（须塞进视频原有静音间隔）在多样化UGC上的表现缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 构建MTG-AD：由盲人与视力正常AD专家配对标注的36小时视频、平均约5分钟、共8k+条描述；提出MTG-AD-Eval：基于AD专家准则的细粒度、无参考、可操作指标，并将生成的脚本合成为音轨，评估其与原始视频自然静音段的契合度与语音重叠。
AI.result: 前沿MLLM能准确描述视觉事件并显著降低语音重叠，但在叙事节奏与流畅度上仍有差距；自动化无参考指标与视力正常评分者及7名BLV参与者的人工评分显著相关；用户略偏好人类撰写AD，但认为MLLM生成AD对理解高度有益。
AI.conclusion: 为MLLM内联音频描述提供高质量基准与可操作评测框架，并给出系统设计建议，公开数据集与评测工具。

title: Blind Video Denoising for Vocal Tract rtMRI using a Self-Supervised Ensemble
summary: Real-time magnetic resonance imaging of the vocal tract makes speech articulation directly observable, but the trade-off between temporal resolution and signal quality introduces substantial noise and obscures fine articulatory detail. Since clean references cannot be acquired for a moving vocal tract, supervised denoising approaches are not applicable in this setting. We propose a self-supervised denoising framework that combines spatiotemporal super-resolution learning with pseudo-supervision derived from a variance-stabilized non-local means filter. A dual-model fusion strategy balances noise suppression and preservation of high-frequency articulatory structure. Experiments on the USC-75 multi-speaker dataset under natural noise conditions show that the ensemble raises the signal-to-noise ratio by 11.9 dB on unseen subjects while attaining more high-frequency articulatory content in the frames. Among tuned implementations of anisotropic diffusion, block-matching filtering, non-local means and pre-smoothed non-local means, every configuration that achieves comparable noise suppression does so at the cost of high-frequency content or of structural fidelity. Under severe added Gaussian, Rayleigh and Rician noise, peak signal-to-noise ratio improves by 7.6 to 11.8 dB and structural similarity roughly triples. An ablation shows that the variance-stabilized pseudo-supervision is an essential element for denoising, and that the effect is attributable to the hard thresholding contained in the stabilization transform.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督去噪框架，用时空超分辨率学习+方差稳定化非局部均值伪监督，双模型融合平衡抑噪与高频结构保留，用于实时MRI声道成像。
AI.motivation: 实时MRI可观测发音器官运动，但时间分辨率与信噪比的权衡引入大量噪声；运动声道无法获得干净参考，监督式去噪不可用。
AI.method: 自监督去噪框架：结合时空超分辨率学习与由方差稳定化非局部均值滤波生成的伪监督；采用双模型融合策略：一个模型侧重组理噪声，另一个侧重保留高频发音结构，在方差稳定化域中做硬阈值处理。
AI.result: USC-75多说话人数据集上SNR提升11.9 dB（未见被试），且保留更多高频发音内容；在同等抑噪水平下优于各向异性扩散、块匹配滤波、NLM与预平滑NLM；严重高斯/瑞利/莱斯噪声下PSNR提升7.6–11.8 dB，SSIM约提升三倍；消融显示方差稳定化伪监督是必要成分，效果归因于稳定化变换中的硬阈值。
AI.conclusion: 提出的自监督+伪监督融合去噪方案可在无干净参考条件下有效抑噪并保留声道高频细节，为实时语音成像分析提供可行预处理手段。

title: Gaze-Assisted Supervisory Control for Lunar Robotic Arm Teleoperation Under Concurrent Monitoring
summary: Rover-mounted robotic arms can extend human reach during lunar sample handling, but continuous joystick teleoperation requires repeated visual-motor alignment while operators may also need to monitor system states. This paper presents a gaze-assisted supervisory control framework in which gaze nominates a rock or placement target, explicit confirmation authorizes the action, and the robot performs bounded autonomous grasp-and-place execution. The framework was evaluated against manual joystick teleoperation in a mission-analog virtual reality study with 16 participants. The study used a 2 x 2 x 3 within-subject design varying control mode, placement difficulty, and concurrent monitoring load. Mean recorded task completion time decreased from 47.65 to 18.43 s per rock, with 72.5% of this difference arising during grasping. Under the tested auditory monitoring conditions, gaze-assisted supervisory control showed less average proportional slowing, with no detected control-mode difference in monitoring-response accuracy or speed. The rate of gaze shifts between core areas of interest decreased from 49.98 to 27.73 shifts/min, while the raw NASA Task Load Index score decreased from 32.54 to 18.26. However, the benefit was task dependent. In precision placement, manual control yielded lower mean placement error and a higher placement success rate. These findings support a mixed-initiative allocation in which gaze enables rapid task-level intention specification and autonomous execution, while precision-critical stages retain manual refinement.

AI.tldr: 提出注视辅助监督式控制框架：眼动选择目标、显式确认授权，机器人执行有界自主抓取-放置；16人VR实验（2×2×3被试内设计）对比手动摇杆遥操作。
AI.motivation: 月球采样中机械臂遥操作需反复进行视觉-运动对齐，同时操作员还要监控系统状态，连续摇杆遥操作负担重。
AI.method: 以注视点提名岩石或放置目标、显式确认后由机器人进行受限的自主抓取-放置执行；在任务类比VR环境中进行被试内实验，变量为控制模式、放置难度、并发监控负荷。
AI.result: 单块岩石任务时间由47.65 s降至18.43 s（72.5%差异来自抓取阶段）；注视辅助条件下监控任务的相对减速更小，监控响应准确率与速度无显著控制模式差异；注视切换率由49.98降至27.73次/min，原始NASA-TLX由32.54降至18.26；但精度放置中手动控制的平均误差更低、成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 支持混合主动式分配：注视用于快速指定任务级意图并由机器人自主执行，精度关键阶段保留人工微调。

title: How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) policies write a reasoning trace and then decode the action from it. A wrong trace yields a wrong action, and even a correct-looking trace can mislead the plan. Existing remedies ask whether the reasoning is right. We ask how strongly it should steer. CoC-CFG applies classifier-free guidance between the policy's context and the same context without the reasoning span. One weight per Euler step attenuates or amplifies the reasoning, and w=1 recovers the original policy. We treat the choice of this weight as a Markov decision process whose action values are measured, not bootstrapped. With the expert frozen and the noise fixed, applying a weight for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that weight's value exactly. Q-adaptive guidance fits these values with small critics and improves the controller conservatively. In the Alpasim driving simulator it outperforms every fixed weight and online RL (SAC, GRPO) in open loop, and in closed loop it passes 262 of 300 scenes, against 252 for the original policy. On held-out frames of the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, its first three stages outperform every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO. On the hidden test set, a frozen Alpamayo 1.5 with rule-based camera and vehicle conversions and Q-adaptive guidance sets a new state of the art among published methods: 8.135159 rater feedback score, against 8.079 for the best published method.

AI.tldr: CoC-CFG将推理VLA的"推理轨迹引导强度"建模为每步Euler采样的CFG权重选择问题，并把该选择视为MDP，用小型critic拟合精确可测的动作价值（专家冻结、噪声固定时可精确回溯），从而在线自适应地调节引导强度；在Alpasim闭环驾驶中300场景通过262（原策略252），Waymo端到端基准隐藏测试集上以8.1352超过最好公开方法的8.079。
AI.motivation: 推理型VLA策略先生成推理轨迹再解码动作，错误轨迹会直接导致错误动作，即使表面正确的轨迹也可能误导规划。现有方法只判断推理"对不对"，未回答"应当以多强的力度让推理去引导动作"。
AI.method: CoC-CFG在策略原始上下文与去掉推理span的上下文之间做classifier-free guidance，每个Euler步一个权重w（w=1即还原原策略），用于衰减或放大推理影响。将权重选择构造为MDP：冻结专家、固定噪声时，施加某权重一步并在当前控制器下完成后续规划，可精确回报该权重的价值（测量而非bootstrap）。Q-adaptive guidance用小型critic拟合这些价值，并对控制器做保守式改进。
AI.result: Alpasim开环优于所有固定权重及在线RL（SAC、GRPO），闭环300场景通过262（原策略252）；Waymo端到端驾驶基准留出帧上前三阶段优于所有固定权重、四种自适应引导方法、SAC与GRPO；隐藏测试集上冻结的Alpamayo 1.5结合规则式相机/车辆转换与Q-adaptive guidance，获得8.135159评分，超过最佳公开方法的8.079。
AI.conclusion: 把"推理引导强度"作为可精确估值的控制变量而非二值判断，是提升推理VLA可靠性的有效且轻量途径；方法在仿真闭环与真实驾驶基准隐藏测试集上均取得SOTA。

title: Humanoid Dodgeball: Learning Fast Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Motions for Humanoids
summary: Humanoids have become increasingly agile and capable in real-world environments. To operate safely in dynamic scenarios, they must rapidly evade fast-moving obstacles while maintaining stability and physically feasible whole-body motion. Learning such behaviors remains challenging due to the high-dimensional dynamics of humanoid systems and the need to jointly balance reactive obstacle avoidance, motion naturalness, and control robustness. In this work, we present Humanoid Dodgeball, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for agile dynamic obstacle avoidance in humanoids. Our method enables highly dynamic whole-body evasive maneuvers against incoming projectiles through threat-aware reward shaping, while multiple direction-specific adversarial motion priors regularize the learned behaviors toward stable and diverse human-like motions. Extensive simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves dynamic obstacle avoidance performance across diverse obstacle speeds and launch distances, while preserving robust and physically plausible humanoid motions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Humanoid Dodgeball 强化学习框架，通过威胁感知奖励塑形与多方向对抗性运动先验，实现人形机器人全身敏捷避障并保持自然稳定动作。
