AI.motivation: 人形机器人在动态环境中需快速躲避高速移动障碍物，同时保持稳定与物理可行的全身运动；高维动力学与避障、自然性、鲁棒性的联合平衡使学习困难。
AI.method: 基于强化学习：采用威胁感知（threat-aware）奖励塑形驱动高动态全身规避动作；引入多方向特化的对抗性运动先验（adversarial motion priors）正则化策略，使行为趋向稳定、多样且类人。
AI.result: 大量仿真与真实硬件实验表明，在不同障碍物速度与发射距离下，动态避障性能显著提升，同时保持鲁棒且物理合理的类人运动。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高动态场景下人形机器人全身反应式避障提供了有效方案，兼具敏捷性与运动自然性，并通过真机验证其可行性。

title: Greenscapes: Optimized Vegetation Configurations in Cities
comment: 18 pages (11 main paper + 7 supplementary material), 15 figures, 5 tables. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Vegetation plays a central role in cities, serving functional roles such as balancing shade and sky exposure, shaping the microclimate, carbon sequestration, and providing acoustic screening. Furthermore, aesthetic choices in landscape styles (formal, modernist, picturesque) are important for citizens' well-being and should be considered in the design of urban landscapes. In this paper, we present a novel method for placing vegetation, ranging from shrubs to large trees, in 3D urban scenes. Our method uses individual lots as input and employs a conditioned Vision-Language Model (VLM) to generate a top-down rendering of vegetation, placing large trees, small trees, and shrubs on lawn areas. This rendering is then converted into a 3D scene by detecting individual plants and selecting appropriate 3D assets. To refine the proposed configurations, we define an optimization loop that keeps the VLM-generated positions fixed after a deterministic feasibility repair and uses CMA-ES to optimize per-instance scale transformations along with discrete vegetation asset substitutions. To define the objective function for the optimization, we evaluate the generated 3D scenes with efficient surrogate models of shade and path-based acoustic exposure. Furthermore, we render in-scene views at each optimization step to compute view-dependent perceptual descriptors, enabling the generation of both aesthetic and functional vegetation layouts for urban scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向城市地块(individual lots)的3D植被布局生成方法：用条件VLM生成俯视植被渲染图（大乔木/小乔木/灌木落在草坪上），检测单体植株并匹配3D资产转为场景，再以CMA-ES在固定位置下优化单株尺度变换与离散资产替换，目标函数由遮荫与路径声暴露的高效代理模型及视图相关感知描述子构成。
AI.motivation: 城市植被既承担遮荫/天空可视、微气候调节、碳汇与声屏障等功能性作用，又承载景观美学风格（formal/modernist/picturesque）对居民福祉的影响，现有3D城市绿化布置多依赖手工或缺乏美学与功能联合优化的自动化手段。
AI.method: VLM条件生成俯视图 → 2D检测解析单体 → 3D资产检索与实例化；确定性可行性修复后锁定位置，用CMA-ES优化逐实例尺度与离散资产替换；用遮荫与路径声暴露的轻量代理模型加逐优化步的视点渲染感知描述子构造目标函数。
AI.result: 摘要仅声明可生成兼具美学与功能性的植被布局，未给出定量指标、基线对比或用户研究结果。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式VLM与演化式离散-连续优化结合，可用于城市地块级3D绿化自动布置；核心局限在于布局由固定的俯视2D生成结果主导、位置不参与优化，且当前仅为代理模型的仿真评估。

title: LOGIV: Graph-Verified Execution with Causal Local Repair for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks
summary: Agentic robots must turn a high-level goal into actions while keeping the physical conditions needed for future steps valid. A completed action does not ensure that its effects will persist: a later disturbance can invalidate support that the remaining plan still assumes. We present LOGIV, a graph engineering framework for agentic robot execution that uses an explicit task graph to connect symbolic planning, observation-based verification, and embodied action. LOGIV compiles a validated plan into condition-support and resource-ordering edges, checks their physical validity during execution, and uses dependency tracing to determine what must be restored after a failure. Repair is constrained by retained unfinished actions, and the combined continuation is symbolically validated before execution resumes. The framework operates above existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Model (WAM) policies without adding trainable components. Across 20 dual-arm tasks from RoboTwin~V2 and BiCoord with three execution backbones, LOGIV improves mean task success without injected disturbances by 10.67 and 15.33 percentage points, respectively. Under predefined perturbations, it achieves higher task completion and condition restoration than three adapted recovery baselines for every backbone on both benchmarks. On three real-robot tasks, successful trials increase from 12/30 to 17/30. These results support explicit, continuously checked task dependencies as a practical interface for reliable agentic robot execution.

AI.tldr: LOGIV是一个面向智能体机器人执行的图工程框架：将已验证的符号计划编译为"条件支撑边"和"资源序边"的显式任务图，在执行中持续校验物理有效性，并基于依赖追踪确定失败后需恢复的前置条件；修复受未完成动作约束，续接方案在执行前再次符号验证。无需新增可训练模块，可叠加于VLA/WAM策略之上。
AI.motivation: 动作完成不等于效果持久：后续扰动可能使剩余计划所依赖的支撑条件失效，因此需要在执行期持续维护"未来步骤所需物理条件"的有效性，而现有VLA/WAM策略缺乏显式的任务依赖建模与恢复机制。
AI.method: 显式任务图连接符号规划、基于观测的验证与具身动作；计划编译为条件-支撑边与资源序边；执行期物理有效性检查；失败后依赖回溯定位需恢复项，并在保留未完成动作的约束下生成修复，统一续接方案经符号验证后恢复执行；零可训练组件。
AI.result: RoboTwin V2与BiCoord共20个双臂任务、3种执行骨干下，无扰动平均成功率分别提升10.67与15.33个百分点；预定义扰动下，在两个基准、全部骨干上任务完成率与条件恢复率均优于3个适配的恢复基线；3个真机任务成功试验由12/30提升至17/30。
AI.conclusion: 显式且持续校验的任务依赖可作为可靠智能体机器人执行的实用接口，以规划-验证-修复闭环弥补端到端策略在长程条件维护上的不足。

title: DINOv2 for PET: A Pre-Training Domain Benchmark Across Classification, Segmentation, and Prognosis
summary: DINO (self-DIstillation with NO labels) has become a stan- dard for self-supervised pre-training, producing features that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks. In medical imaging it has been adopted mainly for radiology (X-ray, CT and MRI), where even natural- image DINO features transfer well. In the literature, these features have been reported to transfer worse to functional imaging such as PET. Yet PET-specific DINO models have barely been introduced, and even less validated across multiple tasks and datasets. We present PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 model pre-trained on 2D PET, and benchmark it against open-source encoders: the origi- nal DINOv2 (pre-trained on the LVD-142M natural-image dataset) and OmniRad (pre-trained on CT, MRI and ultrasound). Using the same lightweight heads for every backbone, and despite far less pre-training data, PET-DINOv2-2D matches or outperforms both on three down- stream PET tasks: normal/abnormal classification, lesion segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. Its advantage is largest when few labels are available, suggesting that PET pre-training gives more transferable, label-efficient features. Code is made available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 PET-DINOv2-2D，首个在 2D PET 数据上自监督预训练的 DINOv2 模型，在三个 PET 下游任务（正常/异常分类、病灶分割、无复发生存预测）上以更少预训练数据匹配或超过 DINOv2 与 OmniRad 基线，小样本优势最明显。
AI.motivation: 文献报告自然图像 DINO 特征迁移到功能成像（如 PET）效果较差，而 PET 专用自监督模型极少，且缺少跨任务、跨数据集验证，因此需要针对性预训练与系统基准评测。
AI.method: 在 2D PET 切片上以 DINOv2 自监督目标（无标签自蒸馏）预训练骨干网络；与原始 DINOv2（LVD-142M 自然图像预训练）和 OmniRad（CT/MRI/超声预训练）对比，所有骨干统一使用相同轻量下游头，以公平评估特征质量。
AI.result: 尽管预训练数据量远小于对比模型，PET-DINOv2-2D 在三个下游 PET 任务上达到或超过 DINOv2 与 OmniRad；标签稀缺时优势最大，显示更好的可迁移性与标签效率。
AI.conclusion: 模态匹配的自监督预训练对功能成像特征迁移优于自然图像或跨模态医学预训练，且在小样本场景尤为有效；代码已开源。属医学影像领域 CV 工作，方法为域内直接应用 DINOv2 范式加基准评测。

title: RoboSeed: Multidimensional Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action and World-Action Models: Capability, Resource Affordability, and Research Evidence
summary: Choosing a robot action model requires evidence about task capability, adaptation cost, deployment requirements, and the reliability of reported conclusions. Success rates alone offer limited guidance to researchers with different computing budgets and goals. We propose RoboSeed, a multidimensional evaluation framework for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM), within a continuing program to train, evaluate, and openly release robot models with verifiable evidence for model selection. The framework defines five dimensions: capability, downstream training affordability, deployment affordability, locally verified research value, and reproduction evidence. It maps empirical measurements and audit criteria to 0-100 profiles using fixed normalization anchors, with balanced, training-constrained, and deployment-constrained preference settings. Interface and protocol checks establish when comparisons are appropriate. Missing measurements remain explicit, incomplete aggregate scores are withheld, and weighted input coverage identifies evidence gaps. We apply the framework to representative VLA and WAM models, drawing on local training, released-weight evaluation, task-level audits, and an evaluation-system study. The results reveal budget-dependent backbone choices, sensitivity to adaptation recipes, and differences between language and visual task interfaces. Reproducible scoring code and machine-readable evidence support extension to additional models. The study provides dimension-level assessments and priorities for further measurement, while incomplete serving traces and heterogeneous protocols preclude overall numerical rankings.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 RoboSeed，一个面向 VLA/WAM 模型选择的多维评估框架，包含能力、下游训练可负担性、部署可负担性、本地可验证研究价值与复现证据五个维度，以固定归一化锚点映射到 0-100 剖面，并在部分模型上给出预算相关的骨干选择与适配配方敏感性结论。
AI.motivation: 单一成功率指标无法指导不同算力预算与目标的研究者进行模型选择；需要同时刻画任务能力、适配成本、部署需求以及已报告结论的可信度，并提供可审计的复现证据。
AI.method: 定义五维评估框架（能力、下游训练可负担性、部署可负担性、本地可验证研究价值、复现证据）；用固定归一化锚点将实测数据与审计准则映射为 0-100 剖面；设置均衡、训练受限、部署受限三种偏好配置；通过接口与协议一致性检查判定比较是否成立；缺失测量显式标注、证据不足时暂不给出聚合分数，并以加权输入覆盖率标识证据缺口。应用于若干代表性 VLA 与 WAM 模型，结合本地训练、开放权重评测、任务级审计与评估系统研究。
AI.result: 揭示骨干网络选择随预算条件变化、对适配配方敏感、语言与视觉任务接口之间存在差异；提供可复现评分代码与机器可读证据。由于 serving trace 不完整及协议异质，未给出总体数值排名，仅给出维度级评估与后续测量优先级。
AI.conclusion: RoboSeed 提供了可审计、可扩展的模型选择证据体系，强调缺失证据的显式化与协议可比性前提；但当前证据不足以支持整体数值排序，后续需补齐服务性能追踪并统一评测协议。

title: Segment Anything Model Based Context Guided Mamba Unet for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, requiring both global contextual understanding and fine-grained structural precision. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, its direct application to medical images often lacks domain-specific adaptability. Meanwhile, State Space Models (SSMs)-based methods, such as Mamba, efficiently capture long-range dependencies but may struggle with preserving fine anatomical details. To address these challenges, we propose a segment anything model based context guided mamba unet, SAMBA-UNet, a novel framework that integrates SAM's context knowledge with Mamba's hierarchical feature learning to enhance both global representation and local detail refinement. Specifically, we introduce the Hierarchical Context Enhancement Module (HCEM), an attention-based fusion module that deeply incorporates the multi-level features of SAM and Mamba to improve detail perception and segmentation precision. Additionally, we employ LoRA and Adapter-based fine-tuning to adapt SAM to medical imaging tasks, further enhancing its domain-specific segmentation capability and robustness. We conducted a comprehensive study on several medical segmentation datasets, including Synapse, ISIC17, and ISIC18, evaluating our method across multiple metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMBA-UNet achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing generalization, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: SAMBA-UNet将SAM的上下文知识与Mamba的长程建模能力结合，通过层次化上下文增强模块（HCEM）融合多级特征，并用LoRA/Adapter微调SAM以适配医学分割任务，在Synapse、ISIC17/18上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割需兼顾全局上下文与细粒度结构精度。SAM泛化强但缺乏领域适配性；Mamba类SSM能高效捕捉长程依赖，却易丢失细微解剖细节，二者需要互补融合。
AI.method: 提出SAMBA-UNet框架：以SAM提供上下文知识、Mamba U-Net进行层次化特征学习；核心是HCEM（基于注意力的融合模块），深度融合SAM与Mamba的多层级特征以增强细节感知与分割精度；同时采用LoRA与Adapter对SAM进行参数高效微调，提升医学域适配与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Synapse、ISIC17、ISIC18等多个医学分割数据集、多指标评测中达到SOTA，在泛化性、分割精度与计算效率之间取得较好平衡。
AI.conclusion: SAM上下文先验与Mamba层次化建模的融合是提升医学分割性能的有效路径，参数高效微调可低成本实现SAM的领域适配；代码将在录用后开源。

title: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis
summary: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at this https URL .

AI.tldr: EPC-RawDC：结合同一扫描器前向模型的两个物理约束（几何等变投影约束 + 原始投影数据一致性）的条件3D潜扩散框架，用于CBCT→CT定量合成。
AI.motivation: CBCT广泛用于图像引导与自适应放疗，但散射、噪声、重建伪影和HU不准确限制其定量应用；现有扩散式CBCT→CT合成多为纯图像驱动，未充分利用采集物理，且缺乏扫描器特异性的监督信号。
AI.method: 条件3D潜扩散生成框架。约束一：几何等变投影约束，利用CBCT前向算子的旋转等变性，用相应变换后的参考投影监督合成CT；约束二：原始数据一致性，用单次采集的含噪投影测量作为扫描特异性监督参与训练。在JUST（Elekta实测临床投影）与SynthRAD2025（Varian几何+泊松光子统计仿真投影）两个独立临床队列上评测。
AI.result: 两个队列SSIM均达0.97；相对DDPM，PSNR在SynthRAD2025提升2.66 dB、JUST提升2.10 dB；MAE平均降低20.3%与19.0%；SynthRAD2025上投影一致性与等变误差分别降低55.0%和41.4%。
AI.conclusion: 将体数据扩散先验与扫描器几何、扫描特异投影测量结合，可在仿真与实测投影域上一致提升定量CBCT→CT合成效果，说明把采集物理写入生成模型约束是有效方向。

title: Don't Risk It!: Trajectory-Conditioned Distributional Risk for LiDAR-Only Crowd Navigation
summary: Efficient crowd navigation requires anticipating dynamic collision-free space without relying on fragile object tracking. We propose the Don't Risk It Planner (DRIP), an end-to-end LiDAR-only planning framework that couples occupancy forecasting with trajectory-conditioned clearance and uncertainty estimation. Operating directly on LiDAR-derived occupancy grid histories, DRIP predicts a distribution over minimum robot-obstacle clearance for candidate control sequences to evaluate collision risk. The model is trained using a risk cost that grounds predictive uncertainty directly in empirical collision outcomes rather than geometric regression alone. In closed-loop experiments with up to 45 pedestrians, DRIP achieves higher success rates with fewer collisions and reduced freezing behavior compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: DRIP：仅用LiDAR占据栅格历史的端到端规划框架，对未来候选控制序列预测最小“机器人-障碍物”间隙分布（含不确定性），并用与真实碰撞结果挂钩的风险代价训练，实现人群导航的动态碰撞风险预判。
AI.motivation: 人类密集场景导航需要预判动态可达空间；依赖显式目标跟踪的方法在遮挡、拥挤下易失效。因此希望以占据预测替代脆弱的目标跟踪，并让预测的不确定性直接对应碰撞风险，而非仅做几何回归。
AI.method: 输入LiDAR导出的占据栅格历史序列，端到端预测未来占据；对每条候选控制序列，由轨迹条件头输出该轨迹下最小无碰间隙（clearance）的分布（含不确定性）；训练采用基于经验碰撞结果标定的风险代价函数，将预测不确定性锚定在真实碰撞统计上；推理时以该风险分布评估并选择控制序列。
AI.result: 闭环实验（最多45名行人）中，相较SOTA基线成功率更高、碰撞更少，且“卡死/冻结”行为减少。
AI.conclusion: 以轨迹条件化的间隙-不确定性联合预测替代显式跟踪，是提升拥挤人群导航安全性与流畅性的可行路径；将不确定性直接以碰撞结果做监督是关键设计。局限：仅摘要级信息，缺少与学习式端到端策略、真实机器人大规模部署的对比细节。

title: Localizing Concepts in Visual Autoregressive Models
summary: Understanding the internal routing of visual concepts is crucial for the safe and controllable adaptation of generative models. While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework to localize where and when specific concepts emerge within autoregressive models. Driven by the native coarse-to-fine nature of next-scale generation, our method precisely maps conceptual knowledge across three distinct dimensions: Layer, Scale, and Position. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. Extensive probing on image and video autoregressive models like Infinity, HunyuanImage-3.0, and InfinityStar shows that the localized positions are both interpretable and causally related to concept emergence. Building on these insights, we apply our localization method to three key applications: concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial concept injection. Experiments demonstrate that our targeted intervention achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially reducing computational overhead while preserving benign utility. Overall, our findings offer insights into how conceptual knowledge is routed during autoregressive generation, introducing a practical pathway for more interpretable, efficient, and secure adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出LoCo——首个模型无关框架，用于在next-scale视觉自回归模型中沿Layer、Scale、Position三个维度定位概念涌现的位置与时序，并发布LoCoBench基准，应用于概念擦除、个性化与对抗概念注入。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型中的概念定位已被广泛研究，但新兴的next-scale视觉自回归范式中的概念路由机制基本未被探索；理解视觉概念内部路由对生成模型的安全可控适配至关重要。
AI.method: 利用next-scale生成天然的由粗到细特性，在层、尺度、位置三维精确定位概念知识；构建无上下文偏置的LoCoBench（10类）系统评估；在Infinity、HunyuanImage-3.0、InfinityStar等图像/视频自回归模型上探测；并以定位结果驱动靶向干预。
AI.result: 探测表明定位位置可解释且与概念涌现存在因果联系；在概念擦除、模型个性化、对抗概念注入三项应用中达到SOTA，显著降低计算开销并保持良性效用。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了自回归生成中概念知识的路由规律，为更可解释、高效、安全的模型适配提供了实践路径。

title: BRACHIO: Broad Representations Across Centres for Head-and-neck Imaging Oncology (HECKTOR 2026)
comment: HECKTOR Challenge 2026, MICCAI, head and neck cancer, PET imaging
summary: The HECKTOR 2026 challenge benchmarks machine learning for head and neck cancer, where teams delineate primary and nodal tumour volumes, perform TN staging, and predict recurrence-free survival (RFS). This report describes the submissions for the HECKTOR challenge of team nucli. As the three tasks span both dense and global information from multicentric PET/CT scans, we utilise self-supervised pre-trained encoders, training a 2D DINOv2 encoder (PET-DINOv2-MIPs) on HECKTOR 2026's PET scans. Our final test submission ensembles a DynUNet trained from scratch with a SwinUNETR whose Swin trunk was initialised from a SimMIM-pre-trained checkpoint for segmentation, reaching a mean Dice of 0.5409. For TN staging, GTVp/GTVn geometric features from the segmentation masks are fit to stage probabilities by logistic regression (LR) and fused with PET-DINOv2-MIPs deep features (PCA + LR) via a second-level LR, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.3962 (T-stage) and 0.6432 (N-stage). For the RFS prognosis task, we fine-tune the last two blocks of the PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S encoder jointly with an MLP head under a CoxPH loss, concatenating clinical covariates with the imaging features, reaching a test Harrell's C-index of 0.6577 and a weighted challenge score of 0.5802. The prognosis result is comparable to the best entry of the previous edition and consistent with our internal cross-validation, while our segmentation result is well below it and limits the staging results that depend on it.

AI.tldr: HECKTOR 2026挑战赛team nucli方案：PET-DINOv2-MIPs自监督编码器 + DynUNet/SwinUNETR集成分割、几何特征+深度特征LR融合的TN分期、CoxPH回归的RFS预后。
AI.motivation: 头颈癌PET/CT多中心数据上同时处理体素级分割、全局分期与生存预测三类任务，需兼顾密集与全局信息，因此探索自监督预训练编码器能否在数据有限的多中心医学场景中复用。
AI.method: 在HECKTOR PET扫描上训练2D DINOv2编码器（PET-DINOv2-MIPs）；分割用从零训练的DynUNet与SimMIM预训练Swin主干初始化的SwinUNETR集成；T/N分期用掩膜GTVp/GTVn几何特征LR与PET-DINOv2-MIPs PCA+LR深度特征二级LR融合；RFS用PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S后两块联合MLP头以CoxPH损失微调，并拼接临床协变量。
AI.result: 分割平均Dice 0.5409；T分期平衡准确率0.3962、N分期0.6432；RFS测试Harrell C-index 0.6577、加权挑战分数0.5802，与上届最佳接近且与内部交叉验证一致；分割明显低于上届水平，并拖累依赖它的分期结果。
AI.conclusion: 自监督预训练+集成+特征级融合的轻量方案在预后任务上具竞争力，但分割精度不足是主要瓶颈；医学影像领域竞赛报告，方法可迁移性对通用视觉/机器人问题有限。

title: Uncertainty-aware Coarse-to-Fine Main Pancreatic Duct Segmentation for Width Measurement in 3D MRCP
summary: Assessment of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) from volumetric magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) scans is an essential task for ductal dilatation diagnosis and pancreatic cancer analysis. However, manual assessment is affected by reader variability in which automated analysis may assist. Nevertheless, fully automated and uncertainty-aware MPD analysis from volumetric MRCP remains underexplored area of research. In this study, we propose an automatic and uncertainty-aware deep learning-based pipeline for MPD segmentation and maximum-width analysis from MRCP scans. A coarse localisation model first identifies the ductal region-of-interest, followed by a fine model that segments the MPD within the region. The dataset consists of 256 MPD-segmented MRCP scans from 69 patients. A randomly selected holdout test subset of 14 patients with 55 MRCP volumes was used for evaluation. We employed a five-model cross-validation ensemble for improved performance and uncertainty estimation. The best MPD segmentation performance was 0.634 DSC, 0.744 precision, and 0.593 recall. The mean absolute error for maximum MPD width prediction was 0.355~mm and dilated MPD ($\geq 5$~mm) was detected with 75.0\% sensitivity and 74.4\% specificity. These novel results suggest that automated MPD segmentation can be used to aid MRCP-based duct measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出粗定位+精细分割的两阶段深度学习流水线，实现MRCP上主胰管(MPD)的自动分割与最大宽度测量，并用五模型交叉验证集成给出不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: MRCP上主胰管(MPD)的人工评估存在观察者间差异，自动化分析可辅助诊断胰管扩张与胰腺癌，但面向容积MRCP的全自动、不确定性感知MPD分析研究仍很缺乏。
AI.method: 粗定位模型先圈定胰管感兴趣区域，精细模型在区域内分割MPD；数据为69例患者的256个MPD标注MRCP体数据，留出14例55个体做测试；采用五模型交叉验证集成提升性能并估计不确定性，同时进行最大宽度回归与扩张(≥5mm)判定。
AI.result: 分割最佳DSC 0.634、精确率0.744、召回率0.593；最大MPD宽度预测MAE为0.355 mm；扩张MPD检出灵敏度75.0%、特异度74.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自动化MPD分割可辅助基于MRCP的胰管测量，为不确定性感知的容积医学影像分割与定量分析提供了可行范式；但精度仍属中等，需更大数据验证。

title: Learning Safe Flow Matching Robot Policies from Binary Feasibility Oracles
summary: Robot foundation models increasingly rely on flow-based action generation for general-purpose manipulation, yet the generated actions are not guaranteed to satisfy physical constraints such as joint limits and collision avoidance. This problem is especially challenging when the feasible set cannot be described analytically and is accessible only through black-box feasibility oracles. We study this practical oracle-only setting and propose an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for safe flow-matching robot policies. The safeguard uses binary feasibility queries to correct unsafe updates in the forward pass, while extracting local boundary information to provide constraint-aware learning signals in the backward pass. Combined with discrete-time flow matching, the same safeguard is used during training and inference, enabling forward--backward aligned policy learning without explicit or differentiable constraint models. Experiments on obstacle-aware robotic manipulation demonstrate 100% constraint satisfaction while preserving task performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅依赖黑盒可行性判据（oracle-only）的可微安全防护模块，用于流匹配机器人策略，实现训练与推理一致的安全约束满足。
AI.motivation: 流匹配/扩散式机器人基础模型生成的动作不保证满足关节限位、避障等物理约束，且可行集往往无法解析表达，只能通过黑盒可行性查询获得。
AI.method: 前向传播中用二值可行性查询修正不安全的更新步；反向传播中从局部边界信息提取约束感知梯度信号；与离散时间流匹配结合，同一防护模块在训练与推理阶段共用，实现前向-反向对齐的策略学习，无需显式或可微约束模型。
AI.result: 在障碍物感知机器人操作实验中达到100%约束满足率，同时保持任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 黑盒可行性判据即可为流匹配策略提供有效安全防护，训练-推理一致的对齐设计是关键；但证据以实验环境为主，缺真实机器人部署与开源验证。

title: Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Accurate multi-organ segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for computer-aided diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. However, substantial variations in organ shape and size, together with low tissue contrast and ambiguous boundaries, complicate the modeling of heterogeneous anatomical structures. To address these challenges, we propose a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network (MCDNet), which integrates adaptive local structural enhancement with channel-decoupled long-range modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space (MCSS) block that divides feature channels into separate processing groups, allowing differentiated structural representations to be learned within an efficient state-space framework. Within each group, a Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module (MAEM) combines deformable convolutions with channel attention to adapt local feature extraction to anatomical shape variations. Group-wise state-space modeling then captures long-range spatial dependencies, and channel gating adaptively integrates the resulting features. Experiments on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MCDNet, achieving an average Dice Similarity Coefficient of 81.61% for multi-organ segmentation.

AI.tldr: MCDNet：面向CT多器官分割的形态感知通道解耦Mamba网络，用分组状态空间建模+可变形卷积局部增强，Synapse上平均Dice 81.61%。
AI.motivation: CT多器官分割面临器官形状尺度差异大、组织对比度低、边界模糊等问题，同质化的通道建模难以兼顾各向异性解剖结构的不同表征需求。
AI.method: 提出MCSS模块，将特征通道划分为多个处理组独立建模；组内MAEM结合可变形卷积与通道注意力实现形态自适应的局部特征提取；组间以状态空间模型捕获长程空间依赖，并通过通道门控自适应融合特征。
AI.result: 在Synapse腹部CT数据集上平均Dice为81.61%，验证了方法的有效性；摘要未给出与其他方法的完整对比、消融细节或计算开销数据。
AI.conclusion: 通道解耦的状态空间建模与形态自适应局部增强相结合，可有效提升多器官分割精度，但缺乏外部数据集验证与效率分析，方法迁移性（如机器人/3D场景）尚未论证。

title: Neural Blind Deconvolution for Image Scanning Microscopy
summary: Image scanning microscopy (ISM) acquires one scanned image per detector element, which are then fused into a single image by multi-image deconvolution to obtain a super-resolved image. Its accuracy, however, depends on point spread function (PSF) models that sample- and system-induced aberrations often invalidate. Since differences between the scanned images encode aberration information, we propose a training-free blind Deep Image Prior (DIP) framework that jointly estimates the specimen and the detector-dependent PSFs. The PSFs are parametrised through the detector geometry and shared excitation and emission PSFs, reducing the unknowns while preserving the physical ISM model, and a Gaussian pre-initialisation stabilises the blind optimisation. On experimental tubulin data, blind DIP recovers finer filamentous structures than multi-image deconvolution and DIP with fixed theoretical PSFs, while adapting the PSFs to the measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练盲DIP框架,联合估计样本与探测器相关PSF以改进ISM超分辨重建。
AI.motivation: ISM通过多图像反卷积融合实现超分辨,但依赖理论PSF模型;样本与系统像差使模型失真,导致重建不准确。扫描图像间的差异本身蕴含像差信息。
AI.method: 以Deep Image Prior同时优化样本图像与PSF;PSF按探测器几何参数化并共享激发/发射PSF,大幅减少未知量且保持物理一致性;高斯预初始化稳定盲优化过程,全程无需训练数据。
AI.result: 在实验微管(tubulin)数据上,盲DIP恢复出比多图像反卷积及固定理论PSF的DIP更精细的丝状结构,且PSF能自适应测量数据。
AI.conclusion: 参数化盲PSF估计是缓解ISM像差失配的有效手段;但仅单一生物样本验证,泛化性与定量评估有限。

title: RepConTUR: A Report-Conditioned Volumetric Multimodal Model for Abdominal Tumor Segmentation
summary: Tumor delineation is required for radiotherapy planning, yet automatic segmentation is limited by errors, predominantly false positives, that distort dose and increase editing time. The radiology report accompanies the scan and localizes disease at the suborgan level, but existing text-promptable models condition on short referring phrases, and most operate in 2D. We present RepConTUR, a single native-3D early-fusion multimodal model that conditions volumetric abdominal tumor segmentation on the narrative report. We extend AbdomenAtlas 3.0 to a suborgan-level promptable segmentation dataset and generate report-based VQA pairs, yielding four report-derived tasks on the same annotations: referring segmentation (RES), report-grounded segmentation (GSEG), report generation (RRG), and visual question answering (VQA). We train RepConTUR, comprising a 3D CT encoder, an early-fusion language model, and a native-3D segmentation module, jointly on the four tasks. Across liver, kidney and pancreas, RepConTUR attains the highest Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), instance-wise precision, and detection F1 among the text-promptable baselines, and adding the report raises mean precision while leaving recall comparable. Against two vision-only specialists, nnU-Net and the report-supervised R-Super, RepConTUR attains the highest value on every in-domain metric for liver and pancreas and the highest mean DSC, recall, precision, and detection F1 over the four out-of-distribution public cohorts. Ablations indicate that conditioning on the narrative report raises detection F1 from 0.499 to 0.528 within the same model, that joint GSEG training raises RES F1 from 0.450 to 0.482, and that the native-3D segmentation module raises GSEG F1 from 0.139 to 0.528 over its 2D counterpart. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RepConTUR：单一原生3D早期融合多模态模型，以长篇放射报告为条件做腹部肿瘤体积分割，并在同一标注上联合训练RES/GSEG/RRG/VQA四任务。
AI.motivation: 自动肿瘤分割误差以假阳性为主，扭曲剂量分布并增加勾画编辑时间；放射报告已包含亚器官级病灶定位信息，但现有可文本提示模型仅用短语提示且多为2D。
AI.method: 将AbdomenAtlas 3.0扩展为亚器官级可提示分割数据集并生成报告VQA对；模型由3D CT编码器、早期融合语言模型、原生3D分割模块组成，四任务联合训练。
AI.result: 肝肾胰三器官上DSC、实例精度、检测F1均优于文本提示基线；加入报告提升精度而召回相当；对nnU-Net与R-Super在肝胰全部in-domain指标最优，四个OOD队列均值DSC/召回/精度/F1最优；消融：报告条件使F1 0.499→0.528，联合GSEG使RES F1 0.450→0.482，原生3D使GSEG F1 0.139→0.528。
AI.conclusion: 长篇叙事报告条件是降低假阳性、提升3D体积肿瘤分割检测质量的有效手段，原生3D架构与多任务联合训练均有实质增益。

title: Coupled Guidance for Flow Matching
summary: Guidance methods are essential tools for steering the generation process in diffusion models, improving the generalizability of stochastic robotic controllers and enabling high-quality controlled image synthesis. Despite strong parallels between flow-matching and diffusion, integrating guidance into flow-matching models remains quite challenging. Recent work has proposed general guidance frameworks for flow-matching, however, they are direct adaptations of diffusion guidance methods and can prove unstable. In this work, we conduct a theoretical analysis of guidance in flow-matching and show that a naive translation of diffusion-based guidance to flow-matching breaks the coupling distribution used during training, resulting in weaker control over sampling accuracy. Building on this insight, we propose Coupled Guidance, a flow-matching-specific guidance mechanism derived from a geometric perspective that leverages the coupling structure inherent to flow-matching training. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we conduct extensive experimentation on a custom robotic collision avoidance task using ManiSkill3, four robotic dexterous manipulation tasks from the Adroit benchmark, and three image generation tasks, namely inpainting, super-resolution, and deblurring, using the ImageNet-128 and CelebA-HQ-256 datasets. Our findings show that our framework improves sample quality and guidance stability across all tasks, without imposing any additional overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 Coupled Guidance，从几何视角推导适用于 flow-matching 的引导机制，避免直接照搬扩散引导导致训练耦合分布被破坏的问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的引导方法已较成熟，但直接迁移到 flow-matching 上不稳定。作者通过理论分析指出：朴素迁移会破坏 flow-matching 训练时的耦合（coupling）分布，从而削弱采样控制的准确性。
AI.method: 理论分析 flow-matching 引导与耦合分布的关系；据此从几何角度构造 Coupled Guidance，显式利用 flow-matching 训练中固有的耦合结构，实现专用引导机制，且不增加额外计算开销。
AI.result: 在 ManiSkill3 自建机器人避障任务、Adroit 四个灵巧操作任务，以及 ImageNet-128 / CelebA-HQ-256 上的 inpainting、超分、去模糊三类图像任务中，均提升样本质量与引导稳定性，且无额外开销。
AI.conclusion: flow-matching 引导需尊重其耦合结构，直接套用扩散引导并非最优；Coupled Guidance 以零额外开销统一改善机器人与图像生成任务。

title: SelfThinker: Self-Evolving Reasoning via Reliability-Verified Intrinsic Visual Thoughts
summary: Unified multimodal models can both generate and understand images within a single set of weights, offering an opportunity to use image synthesis as training supervision for visual comprehension. However, existing visual chain-of-thought methods rely on human-annotated helper images during training and require slow image generation at test time. We present SelfThinker, the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified model's self-generated visual thoughts into stronger understanding without human image annotations. Given a visual problem, SelfThinker samples candidate helper images from its generation pathway and uses its frozen understanding pathway to score each candidate via conditional pointwise mutual information. High-utility visual thoughts then refine the generator via flow matching and serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation. At inference, SelfThinker reasons directly from the original image in text without generating intermediate images. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation datasets, SelfThinker transfers broadly to natural-image and spatial benchmarks, raising the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 (+11.3 points). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial perception tasks. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SelfThinker：让统一多模态模型用自生成“视觉思维”自我进化，无需人工辅助图标注，推理时也不再生成中间图，显著提升多模态理解与空间感知。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉思维链方法依赖人工标注的helper图像进行训练，且测试时需逐步生成图像，速度慢。作者希望把统一模型的图像生成本身转化为理解能力的监督信号，实现自进化、免标注。
AI.method: 给定视觉问题，从生成通路采样候选辅助图像，用冻结的理解通路以条件逐点互信息（conditional PMI）打分筛选高效用视觉思维；这些思维一方面通过flow matching微调生成器，另一方面作为特权教师上下文进行on-policy自蒸馏。推理时仅从原图直接文本推理，不生成中间图像。训练仅使用小型合成视觉搜索与导航数据。
AI.result: 在七个基准上ThinkMorph-7B平均分由52.7提升至64.0（+11.3）；图像扰动探针显示在细粒度与空间感知任务上相对ThinkMorph-7B最多+40.4分、相对BAGEL-7B骨干最多+23.2分，并泛化到自然图像与空间基准。
AI.conclusion: 自生成视觉思维可作为有效的自监督信号同时改进生成与理解，且可将多步视觉推理内化到纯文本推理路径，兼顾性能与推理效率；代码已开源。

title: SynthFaces: Balanced Large Scale Human Dataset
comment: accepted at BMVC 2026 github: this https URL
summary: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation. In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning. We achieve this by expanding foundational Arc2Face diffusion model with a flow matching generative model in the manifold of identity embeddings. We demonstrate that such approach achieves both goals of generative fidelity and label diversity not present in real human-centric datasets. As a result we collect and further contextualize a highly balanced identity-centric dataset of humans named SynthFaces. By design, our released images and identities are synthetic, reducing direct reliance on real personal images; we empirically check identity separation with a nearest-neighbor non-leakage metric. We purpose it for training and tuning of fair models for various downstream tasks, and showcase its usability in finetuning an existing adapter-based method for personalized generation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Arc2Face + identity embedding空间流匹配生成模型的可控人脸数据集合成pipeline，构建身份均衡的合成数据集SynthFaces，并用最近邻非泄漏指标验证身份分离。
AI.motivation: 真实人脸数据集存在身份表征不均衡与隐私风险，导致生成模型在保身份生成上表现不公平；需要可替代的均衡合成数据。
AI.method: 在Arc2Face扩散模型基础上，于身份嵌入流形上引入flow matching生成模型，实现可控、多样化的合成人脸生成；采用最近邻非泄漏度量检验身份可分性。
AI.result: 所合成SynthFaces在生成保真度与身份多样性上同时达标，身份分布高度均衡，并通过非泄漏指标验证与真实身份无直接对应。
AI.conclusion: 合成身份中心数据集可用于公平模型训练与微调，作者在适配器式个性化生成方法上展示了微调可用性。

title: Learning a Motion Manifold to Constrain Ambiguity in Unsupervised 4D Medical Image Interpolation
summary: Unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation reconstructs intermediate anatomical states from temporally sparse observations without intermediate supervision. Distinct motion fields may attain comparable endpoint agreement while producing different intermediate anatomy, giving rise to motion ambiguity. This ambiguity is difficult to constrain when many independently adjustable motion variables must be estimated from the observed endpoints. We develop a framework that learns a motion manifold to restrict candidate motion fields while retaining sample-specific variation. Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning extracts recurring motion structure from endpoint-derived dense estimates and encodes it in a shared spectral basis. Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation uses predicted motion coordinates to rotate the effective motion directions for each endpoint pair without increasing the number of independent coordinates. Their composition defines a nonlinear family of complete velocity fields across endpoint pairs, accommodating anatomical and motion-state differences within a restricted representation. Integrating each predicted field supports bidirectional reconstruction at arbitrary intermediate times. Theoretical analysis establishes sufficient conditions under which endpoint observations distinguish nearby motions within the learned family. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods trained without intermediate volumes and competitive results against methods using intermediate supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出从端点观测重建4D医学影像中间帧的无监督框架：用跨样本谱基提取共享运动流形，再用样本条件Cayley基重定向在坐标数不变的前提下旋转各样本运动方向，构成受限非线性速度场族，并给出端点可辨识性的理论条件。
AI.motivation: 时序稀疏的4D医学影像插值缺少中间帧监督，而可达相同端点的一致性下存在多种运动场（运动歧义）；当需从端点估计大量独立可调运动变量时，该歧义难以约束。
AI.method: (1) Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning：从端点导出的稠密估计中学习反复出现的运动结构，编码为共享谱基；(2) Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation：用预测的运动坐标对每对端点的有效运动方向做Cayley旋转，不增加独立坐标数；(3) 二者复合得到端点对上的完整速度场非线性族，逐场积分实现任意中间时刻的双向重建；(4) 理论分析给出端点观测在所学族内区分邻近运动的充分条件。
AI.result: 在ACDC与4D-Lung数据集上，无中间体监督训练的方法中达到SOTA，并接近使用中间监督方法的表现。
AI.conclusion: 以低维谱基流形+样本条件旋转约束运动假设空间，是缓解无监督4D插值运动歧义的有效途径，并具备可辨识性理论支撑。

title: It Takes Two to Probe, Thousands to Retrieve: Putting Vision--Language Probes to the Retrieval Test
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) are tested for fine-grained understanding with image--text matching probes, a model must prefer the correct image or caption over handcrafted negative. In retrieval, the correct item must beat thousands of alternatives. We measure how these two evaluation methods relate by using two probing benchmarks, \svo{} and SugarCrepe, for retrieval tasks. For 100 image and caption queries we judge the top-10 retrievals from full dataset of six VLMs, with human annotators and an LLM assessor. We than compare how well models rank pool of items on the same queries, while changing only where the negatives comes from: the benchmark, a random draw, or the judged-incorrect retrievals of other models. On \svo{} the accuracy of retrieving a positive over handcrafted negatives is significantly higher than for retrieved ones (the correct item is preferred in 85\% against 77\% of the time). Using pool of ten retrieved negatives leads to same accuracy as when one uses pool of 200 to 430 random negatives. On SugarCrepe the order is reversed: its handcrafted negatives are harder than the retrieved ones. Incomplete relevance labels explain most of the low retrieval scores on \svo{}, where the top-ranked item is correct for 54--90\% of the queries under human labels against 6--21\% under the benchmark's labels. However, we detect no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. The LLM assessor o3 agrees with individual annotators ($\kappa$ 0.57--0.61) slightly less than they agree with each other (0.64--0.68).

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了图像-文本匹配探针（handcrafted negatives）与检索评估（retrieved negatives）两种方式的关系：在SVO上探针准确率显著高于检索（85% vs 77%），而SugarCrepe上顺序相反；SVO上检索分数低主要源于标注不完整；探针通过与否与能否检索到正确首位无关；LLM评审o3与人工标注一致性略低于标注者之间的一致性。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）细粒度理解常用"探针"式评估（正确样本对比手工构造的负样本），而实际检索需要正确项战胜成千上万个候选。两种评估方式之间的关系尚不清楚，可能导致探针分数无法真实反映检索能力的误导性结论。
AI.method: 以SVO与SugarCrepe两个探针基准改造成检索任务：对六个VLM、100个图像/文本查询，用人工标注者与LLM评审（o3）判定全数据集top-10检索结���；随后在相同查询下仅改变负样本来源（基准手工负样本、随机抽取、其他模型检索错误的样本），比较模型的排序能力；并分析标注完整性对检索分数的影响及探针通过与否与检索正确性的关联。
AI.result: SVO上检索相对手工负样本的准确率显著更高（85% vs 77%）；10个检索负样本组成的负样本池达到与200–430个随机负样本相同的准确率；SugarCrepe上顺序相反，其手工负样本更难；SVO上检索分低主要由标注不完整解释，人工标注下top-1正确率为54–90%，而基准标签下仅6–21%；未发现探针通过与否和检索到正确首位的关联；o3与单个人工标注者一致性κ=0.57–0.61，略低于标注者间一致性0.64–0.68。
AI.conclusion: 探针式评估与检索式评估不可互换，二者对负样本分布高度敏感，且探针通过不能预测检索正确性；基准的标注不完整会严重低估真实检索性能。建议评估时报告负样本来源与标注完整性，并谨慎使用LLM评审替代人工。

title: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now process hour-long videos, making extended multi-turn dialogue over a single video a natural mode of use. Sustaining such a dialogue requires more than answering each question in isolation: the model must retrieve and reuse information established earlier in the conversation, both what it has seen and what it has said, an ability we term in-context video memory. Existing video QA benchmarks leave this ability unmeasured: their questions are mutually independent, never reference one another, and each is answerable from the video alone, so nothing ever requires carrying information across turns. We introduce VideoMemBench, in which each sample pairs a single video with a long multi-turn dialogue, whose turns are connected by typed cross-turn dependencies: an Episodic Dependency refers back to a visual episode described in an earlier turn, probing memory of what the model has seen, while an Answer Dependency builds on the model's own earlier answer, probing memory of what the model has said. Every dependency is verified considering two properties: 1) necessity, meaning the question cannot be answered without its earlier turns, and 2) non-leakage, meaning the question does not restate the information from its earlier turns. To enforce these properties, we design a construction pipeline with three LLM roles: a planner, a generator, and a judger, with each dialogue reviewed by human experts. VideoMemBench comprises 326 videos with 2,476 turns, of which 1,387 depend on earlier turns, including multi-parent dependencies and long-range call-back. Among over 20 evaluated open- and closed-source MLLMs, Claude Opus 5 performs the best with an overall score of only 45.7\%, highlighting the challenge of in-context video memory. Our dataset and evaluation are released.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoMemBench，一个面向"上下文视频记忆"的长多轮对话视频问答基准，每轮问题通过"情节依赖"与"答案依赖"与前文耦合，并要求满足必要性与非泄漏性；20+ 个多模态大模型上最高仅 45.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有视频问答基准的问题彼此独立、单轮可答，无法测量模型在长多轮对话中"记住看过什么、说过什么"并跨轮复用信息的能力，因此需要专门基准来量化 in-context video memory。
AI.method: 每个样本为"单视频 + 长多轮对话"，轮间依赖分两类：Episodic Dependency（回指之前轮描述过的视觉片段）与 Answer Dependency（基于模型自己此前的回答）。每条依赖都校验必要性（缺前文不可答）与非泄漏（不重述前文信息）。构建流水线设三类 LLM 角色：planner、generator、judger，并由人类专家逐条审核；规模为 326 段视频、2,476 轮，其中 1,387 轮依赖前文，含多父依赖与长程回溯。
AI.result: 在 20 余个开源与闭源 MLLM 上评测，最优的 Claude Opus 5 总体得分仅 45.7%，显示上下文视频记忆仍是显著短板。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把"跨轮信息复用"从隐含能力变成可测量指标，揭示了当前 MLLM 在长时视频对话记忆上的巨大差距；但贡献限于基准与评测，未提出方法层面的记忆机制改进。

title: NeurEO: dissecting Earth observation embeddings with computational neuroscience
comment: Originally published at the EurIPS 2025 REO workshop
summary: Earth embeddings are compressed representations of rich Earth observation data that enable downstream models to tackle a wide range of complex geospatial tasks. Yet, this increase in performance comes at the cost of decreased interpretability, as the semantic meaning of Earth embeddings is unknown. To address this challenge, we borrow methods from the field of computational neuroscience, which aim to interpret activity in (biological) neurons. Here, we adapt and apply these methods to assign meaning to AlphaEarth embeddings. We analyse embedding features both as stand-alone data, equivalent to spontaneous neural activity, and in relation to land cover and elevation correlates, equivalent to stimulus-response neural activity. We demonstrate correlational and multi-scale structure in the embedding features. Embedding features can display highly specific and directional tuning to land cover and elevation, such as a `North vs South woodland edge' response. When we remove the main trends of combined land cover responses (like water versus land tuning), we discover fine-grained representational details with increased effective dimensionality. Together, our analyses start to unravel what these Earth embeddings represent, which is critical for developing trustworthy downstream applications.

AI.tldr: 借鉴计算神经科学中"神经元活动解读"的方法，将AlphaEarth地球观测嵌入特征当作神经活动来分析：既分析其自发活动（独立结构），也分析其对土地覆盖与高程刺激的响应，发现嵌入特征具有相关性、多尺度结构以及高度特异、有方向性的调谐（如"北向vs南向林地边缘"响应）；剔除主要土地覆盖趋势后可揭示更高有效维度的细粒度表征细节。
AI.motivation: 地球观测嵌入（Earth embeddings）在下游地理空间任务中性能强，但语义不可解释，威胁下游应用的可信度。作者希望为这些嵌入赋予以人类可理解的含义。
AI.method: 跨领域迁移计算神经科学方法：把嵌入特征视为"神经元放电"(1)作为独立数据（等价于自发神经活动）分析；(2)与土地覆盖、高程等关联变量建立刺激–响应关系（等价于刺激–响应神经活动）；并进行相关性分析、多尺度结构分析与趋势剔除（回归去除主要响应成分）以考察残余表征。
AI.result: 嵌入特征呈现相关性与多尺度结构；对土地覆盖与高程表现出高度特异且带方向性的调谐（例如"北向 vs 南向林地边缘"响应）；去除水/陆等主要土地覆盖组合趋势后，暴露出更细粒度、有效维度更高的表征细节。
AI.conclusion: 神经科学式分析可用于解读地球观测嵌入的语义内容，为构建可信的下游地理空间应用提供基础；结论主要基于相关性证据而非因果/机制证据。

title: Hierarchical Step Decomposition for Training-free Online Video Step Grounding
summary: Given a set of procedural steps, Video Step Grounding (VSG) aims to identify which steps occur in a video and localize when they are performed. Existing methods are either offline, requiring access to the full video before making predictions, or online, but relying on fixed-length video segments producing noisy, over-segmented outputs. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Step Decomposition (HSD), a training-free framework for online VSG that leverages the semantic understanding capabilities of Large Multimodal Models. HSD addresses two central challenges in online grounding: constructing semantically coherent temporal segments from a streaming video, and bridging the semantic gap between coarse procedural step descriptions and visual observations. To construct elementary temporal units, HSD incrementally groups incoming segments into semantically consistent events, using an anchor caption that is continuously validated against the visual stream. Based on these events, we perform zero-shot procedural step classification and selectively refine uncertain predictions by decomposing candidate steps into finegrained substeps that capture more nuanced visual evidence. By operating on semantically coherent events rather than every fixed-length segment, HSD reduces redundant computation and produces more stable predictions. Experiments on HT-Step, Ego4D Goal-Step, and CrossTask show that HSD substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, overall achieving better step recognition, more accurate temporal localization, and faster inference.

AI.tldr: HSD：免训练在线视频步骤定位框架，用大模型增量聚合语义一致事件并按需分解细粒度子步骤，构建稳定时序单元以弥合粗描述与视觉的语义鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有在线VSG依赖固定长度片段，输出过分割且噪声大；离线方法需完整视频。需同时解决流式视频语义单元构建与粗粒度步骤描述到视觉观察的语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 训练免费的层级步骤分解框架：增量将流入片段聚为语义一致事件，用持续视觉校验的锚定caption维持事件边界；在事件级做零样本步骤分类，并对不确定预测将候选步骤分解为细粒度子步骤进行选择性精化。基于LMM的语义理解，在语义事件而非每片段上推理以减少冗余计算。
AI.result: 在HT-Step、Ego4D Goal-Step、CrossTask上显著优于SOTA，步骤识别更准、时序定位更精确、推理更快。
AI.conclusion: 以语义一致事件为基本单元、配合不确定性驱动的层级步骤分解，是一种有效的免训练在线步骤定位范式。

title: EventSeeColor: Learning to Reconstruct Color from Monochrome Events
summary: Event cameras capture visual brightness changes under challenging lighting conditions. However, traditional event-based image reconstruction targets grayscale intensity and produces images without scene color. Color distinguishes surfaces with similar intensity. Reconstructing color from events can reveal appearance differences that reconstructed grayscale images cannot express. Although monochrome event cameras do not directly measure color, their event-triggering patterns depend on surface reflectance, illumination, and the sensor's spectral response. These patterns may contain cues that support color reconstruction. In this paper, we present EventSeeColor, which uses event-reconstructed grayscale and aligned events to jointly guide a diffusion colorizer. Grayscale-derived semantic context supports color inference, while region-balanced chroma supervision and local RGB refinement improve color distribution, brightness, and texture. In the combined evaluation on two real event datasets, EventSeeColor achieves the best structural similarity, learned perceptual scores, and chromatic-region color difference among the external methods.

AI.tldr: EventSeeColor 用事件重建的灰度图与对齐事件联合引导扩散着色器，实现单色事件相机的色彩重建，在结构相似度、感知分数与色度区域色差上优于外部方法。
AI.motivation: 单色事件相机不直接测色，但事件触发模式依赖表面反射率、光照与传感器光谱响应，隐含色彩线索；重建灰度图丢失了区分同强度不同表面所需的颜色信息。
AI.method: 两阶段式：先用事件重建灰度强度，再将灰度图与其对齐事件共同作为条件输入扩散着色器（灰度提供语义上下文，事件提供细节/色度线索）；引入区域均衡的色度监督与局部RGB细化以改善颜色分布、亮度与纹理。
AI.result: 在两个真实事件数据集上联合评测，取得最优SSIM、学习感知指标（LPIPS类）与色度区域色差。
AI.conclusion: 表明单色事件流经扩散着色可恢复有意义的场景色彩，为事件视觉提供超越灰度的外观表达；但方法依赖灰度重建前端且未涉实时性与下游任务验证。

title: Beyond CCT: Multi-channel SPD recovery for per-shot camera color correction
summary: Modern cameras correct color via two or three pre-calibrated 3x3 matrices interpolated by Correlated Color Temperature (CCT). This collapses the illuminant SPD to a scalar. LEDs, fluorescents, and mixed sources sit off the Planckian locus, and metameric illuminants with the same chromaticity demand different optimal CCMs that a CCT pipeline cannot distinguish. We recover the illuminant SPD instead using non-negative least squares against a basis dictionary, conditioned on the camera white point and a multi-channel ambient-light sensor (ALS). A closed-form 3x3 CCM is then fit per shot. On a synthetic benchmark of 300 illuminants and 3,100 reflectances, mean angular error drops from 1.89 to 1.20 degrees, with a 1.7x tail reduction on the LED-like off-Planckian group (n=45) where metameric ambiguity is tangible. The gain holds under realistic ALS imperfections and observation noise, and the same off-Planckian advantage carries over to 1,684 real measured SPDs.

AI.tldr: 用多通道环境光传感器+白点约束，通过非负最小二乘法恢复光源SPD，再逐张闭式拟合3x3 CCM，突破CCT两点插值的同色异谱歧义，角误差1.89°→1.20°。
AI.motivation: 相机用2~3个预标定3x3矩阵按CCT插值做色彩校正，把光源SPD压缩为标量色温；LED、荧光灯与混合光源偏离普朗克轨迹，且同色度异谱光源需要不同最优CCM，CCT流水线无法区分，导致偏色。
AI.method: 以相机白点和多通道环境光传感器(ALS)读数为条件，在基字典上做非负最小二乘(NNLS)反演光源光谱功率分布SPD；随后对每张图像闭式求解最优3x3 CCM。
AI.result: 300种光源、3100条反射率合成基准上，平均角误差由1.89°降至1.20°；LED类离普朗克组(n=45)尾部误差降低1.7倍；在真实ALS偏差与观测噪声下增益保持，并在1684条实测SPD上复现离普朗克优势。
AI.conclusion: 光谱层面反演替代标量CCT插值，可显著缓解同色异谱误差，且推理成本低、对传感器不完美鲁棒，具备相机ISP端实用价值；但属计算摄影ISP模块，与具身/3D核心方向关联弱。

title: AdMuse: Skill-Guided Creative Advertising Image Generation
summary: An outstanding creative advertising image should both attract attention and communicate a product's positioning. How to choose a persuasive conceptual bridge before rendering begins is challenging for advertising generation. We present AdMuse, a skill-guided multi-agent framework that distills high-quality advertisements into reusable creative skills for cross-domain advertising strategy. Rather than retrieving isolated exemplars, AdMuse abstracts recurring bridge patterns into a skill library that can guide new product briefs. At generation time, AdMuse coordinates skill routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided visual refinement: diverse skills propose alternative concepts, relative judgment selects the most promising direction, and vision-language feedback helps realize the selected intent in the final image. This design treats advertising creativity as a structured decision process rather than a single prompt-writing step. Experiments across diverse product and brand positionings show that AdMuse produces visually compelling advertisements that faithfully communicate product positioning.

AI.tldr: AdMuse：将高质量广告抽象为可复用的"创意技能"库，用多智能体（技能路由、多候选构思与相对判断、VLM引导视觉精修）生成兼具吸引力与产品定位表达力的广告图像。
AI.motivation: 广告图像需同时抓注意力并传达产品定位，而"概念桥梁"（如何用视觉隐喻连接产品与诉求）在渲染前难以选择；单一提示词写作难以胜任这种策略性决策。
AI.method: 技能引导的多智能体框架：从高质量广告中抽取反复出现的概念桥梁模式，构建技能库；生成时先做技能路由，由不同技能提出多个候选概念，再用相对判断（成对比较）选出最优方向，最后由VLM反馈迭代精修视觉呈现。
AI.result: 在多种产品类别与品牌定位上的实验显示，生成广告在视觉吸引力与产品定位忠实传达两方面均表现良好（摘要未给出量化指标与基线对比）。
AI.conclusion: 把广告创意视为结构化决策过程而非一次性提示词写作，是可行的多智能体生成范式。

title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
comment: website: this https URL github: this https URL
summary: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.

AI.tldr: 该报告以"agent harness"（可执行运行时）为统一视角，系统梳理智能体化视频生成、智能体化世界模型、以及视频模型开发中的递归自我改进（RSI）三条路线，并归纳所需智能体能力与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 视频生成正从端到端合成转向由规划、工具调用与反馈驱动的智能体化生成；同时视频世界模型作为动作条件化的交互环境。二者交汇处的"harness"层缺乏系统化梳理，作者希望明确其角色、能力需求与评估难题。
AI.method: 综述/立场报告（无新方法）。以harness为组织框架：(1) 智能体化视频生成——编排剧本、分镜、素材、制作与剪辑，并讨论评估挑战；(2) 智能体化世界建模——harness中介观测、控制、执行与状态，讨论游戏引擎/智能体编写程序维持世界状态、视频模型渲染观测的混合设计，以及智能体与世界模型互评互促；(3) RSI——区分输出修订、harness状态更新、生成器参数更新、评估器更新与改进流程本身的改变，并分析反馈回路。最后归纳视听感知、长程规划、记忆、代码交互、反馈引导控制、技能复用、多智能体协同等能力及挑战（自主制作、终身记忆、可编程混合控制、自主模型开发、溯源、成本核算、视频质量与任务表现的联合评估）。
AI.result: 无实验或定量结果；产出为分类体系、混合控制设计思路、RSI分层改进框架，以及对评估与成本/溯源问题的挑战清单。
AI.conclusion: 智能体与视频世界模型的结合应围绕harness工程化：关键技术瓶颈在于长时记忆、可编程混合控制、反馈闭环评估与自主模型改进，需将视频质量与下游任务表现统一度量。

title: Decision-Level Error Attribution and Depth-Aware Safety Evaluation of Monocular RGB Human Tracking for Autonomous Robot Navigation
summary: Monocular RGB tracking is useful for robots operating near people, but perception errors affect binary stop/proceed decisions in ways that geometric accuracy metrics do not capture. We examine how much decision error arises from the safety rule versus perception. We prove that lateral-only distance is a lower bound on planar distance: with accurate positions, it cannot miss dangers identified by the planar rule, but it produces unnecessary stops. We introduce a two-factor Shapley attribution separating rule and perception contributions, and further distinguish missed detections from localization errors. Experiments use ETH and UCY pedestrian videos with simulated stationary robots, disjoint calibration and evaluation pedestrians, and time-block bootstrap intervals. Across 898 pedestrians in three scenes, the lateral rule missed no dangers on annotated positions but achieved only 5.6-31.9% stop precision. In two scenes with RGB perception, calibrated ground-plane localization achieved 0.59 m and 0.51 m planar RMSE, compared with 1.72 m and 1.39 m for a geometric baseline and 0.81 m and 0.68 m for calibrated Depth Anything V2. Detection recall of 0.43 and 0.26 made missed detections the leading source of missed danger. A two-standard-deviation safety margin with ground-plane localization matched or improved on the lateral rule's missed-danger rate in all eight scene-threshold settings and reduced unnecessary stops in seven. All robot interactions are simulated, and outcomes are offline decision classifications, not demonstrations of collision avoidance.

AI.tldr: 论文用双因素Shapley归因将单目RGB行人跟踪中机器人“停/行”决策错误拆分为安全规则与感知两部分，并区分漏检与定位误差，证明“仅横向距离”规则是平面距离的下界（不漏报但多误停），实验表明检测召回（0.43/0.26）是漏报危险的主因，而带2σ安全裕度的地平面定位可匹配甚至改善漏报率并减少误停。
AI.motivation: 机器人近人作业依赖单目RGB跟踪，但几何精度指标（如RMSE）无法反映感知误差如何影响二元停/行决策；作者希望量化“决策错误中多少来自安全规则、多少来自感知”，从而判断该优化规则还是优化感知。
AI.method: 形式化证明横向距离规则相对平面距离规则的下界/保守性；提出双因素Shapley归因分解规则贡献与感知贡献，并进一步将感知侧拆为漏检与定位误差；在ETH/UCY行人视频上模拟静止机器人，采用不重叠的标定/评估行人集与时间块自助法置信区间；对比地平面标定定位、几何基线与Depth Anything V2校准结果，并测试2σ安全裕度。
AI.result: 898名行人、三个场景：横向规则在标注位置上零漏报，但停行精度仅5.6%–31.9%；两场景中地平面定位平面RMSE为0.59 m/0.51 m，优于几何基线（1.72/1.39 m）与校准Depth Anything V2（0.81/0.68 m）；检测召回0.43/0.26使漏检成为漏报危险的首要来源；2σ裕度+地平面定位在全部8个场景-阈值设置中不劣于横向规则的漏报率，并在7个设置中减少误停。
AI.conclusion: 对停/行类安全决策，感知侧的主要瓶颈是检测召回而非定位精度，规则侧的保守性带来大量不必要停机；引入显式安全裕度可同时缓解两方面。局限：交互为模拟、结果为离线决策分类，未验证实际避障能力。

title: RoboAtom: Large-scale Atomic-Action Supervision for Robot Learning
comment: 31 pages, 12 figures, including references and appendices
summary: Fine-grained action annotations can support skill reuse and compositional generalization in robot policies. However, robot datasets typically provide task-level instructions without subtask annotations. Although some include subtask labels, inconsistent formats and conventions hinder cross-source joint training. We propose RoboAtom-Data, which adds unified, time-aligned atomic-action annotations to existing data from multiple sources, covering 1.45 million trajectories, 6.88 million skill-labeled segments, and 16,882.1 hours. Our pipeline combines a unified protocol, large-scale manual annotation, propagation across repeated executions with the same ordered skill sequence, and multi-stage quality control. We evaluate the dataset through automatic atomic-action annotation and robot control. We construct RoboAtom-Bench to standardize evaluation of skill recognition and temporal boundary localization. Trained on the annotated data, RoboAtom-Anno achieves better automatic annotation performance than all evaluated open- and closed-source models on both RoboAtom-Bench and the external WGO-Bench. For robot control, atomic-action supervision paired with hierarchical execution improves task success over task-level baselines on LIBERO-Long, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin. We will release the data, benchmark, model, and construction pipeline to support further research on skill-level robot learning.

title: AcrossDEX 1.0: From Human Motion Pretraining to Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation across Hand Embodiments
summary: Bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of wrist motion, finger contact, and object motion. Human videos provide rich manipulation experience. Using this experience for robot control requires aligning human poses with robot commands and accounting for embodiment-specific kinematics and contact dynamics. We present AcrossDEX 1.0, a learning system that connects human motion pretraining, simulation-based expert learning, robot demonstration collection, and visual closed-loop execution. Pretraining on HOT3D Aria predicts one second of bimanual motion from five images and thirty annotated hand states over the preceding second. Robot adaptation preserves the visual encoder, temporal backbone, and wrist parameters. Shared wrist representations, separate finger fields, and validity masks support both six-channel Inspire hands and sixteen-joint Allegro hands. The robot policy predicts sixty control targets from frontal images, command history, and task conditions. It executes a prefix and replans from updated observations. We compare direct regression, diffusion, and flow matching on lid opening and return and closed-lid object reorientation. Direct regression achieves success rates of 40.6\% for opening and return, 100.0\% for Inspire reorientation, and 93.3\% for Allegro reorientation. Flow matching achieves 90.0\% on Allegro reorientation. Paired comparisons further show that constraining replanning with the previous plan improves the continuous execution of generative policies. These results demonstrate a common adaptation pipeline for two hand embodiments and highlight the roles of contact coordination and action-chunk continuity.

AI.tldr: AcrossDEX 1.0 提出一个连接人类视频预训练、仿真专家学习、机器人演示采集与视觉闭环执行的双手灵巧操作学习系统，跨两种手部本体（Inspire 6通道、Allegro 16关节）共享手腕表征。
AI.motivation: 双手灵巧操作需协调手腕运动、手指接触与物体运动；人类视频蕴含丰富操作经验，但需解决人体姿态与机器人指令的对齐、本体特定运动学与接触动力学差异问题。
AI.method: 在 HOT3D Aria 上预训练：由30帧手部状态+5张图像预测未来1秒双手运动；机器人适配时冻结视觉编码器、时序骨干与手腕参数，采用共享手腕表征+独立手指场+有效性掩码以兼容两种手。策略从正面图像、指令历史与任务条件预测60个控制目标，执行前缀后基于更新观测重规划。对比直接回归、扩散与流匹配。
AI.result: 开盖与复位任务直接回归成功率40.6%；Inspire重定向100.0%、Allegro 93.3%；流匹配在Allegro上达90.0%。配对实验表明用上一规划约束重规划可提升生成式策略的连续执行质量。
AI.conclusion: 验证了跨两种手部本体的统一适配流水线，凸显接触协调与动作块连续性的作用；但直接回归在开盖等接触密集任务上明显偏弱。

title: Benchmarking color judgment in multimodal LLMs with CIE-computable ground truth
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now used as zero-shot judges of image quality, but their color judgments are rarely tested with colorimetric ground truth. We present a five-task benchmark based on the CIE colorimetric framework: AWB pair judgment, skin-tone bias direction, CCT estimation, CIE Delta E 2000 pair ordering, and color naming under changing illuminants. We test eight MLLM endpoints, including four Qwen3-VL variants, GLM-4.5V, GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3.1-Pro. The models often solve coarse binary AWB judgments, but they remain weak on numeric CCT estimation and on some fine color-difference judgments. On ColorChecker-24 stimuli, the three closed-weight frontier models reach CCT MAE of 715-1056 K, compared with 1358-2133 K for the five open-weight models. A non-ColorChecker control shows that this advantage is partly template-dependent. The results suggest that current MLLMs have useful color words and coarse visual priors, but their color judgments are not reliably calibrated to CIE-computable color differences.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了一个基于CIE色度学框架的五任务基准，评测8个MLLM端点的颜色判断能力（AWB配对、肤色偏色方向、CCT估计、ΔE2000配对排序、变光源下颜色命名），发现模型擅长粗糙二值判断但数值色差校准弱。
AI.motivation: MLLM被广泛用作零样本图像质量评判者，但其颜色判断几乎没有用色度学真值检验过，存在评测空白。
AI.method: 以CIE色度学框架设计五项任务基准；测试Qwen3-VL四个变体、GLM-4.5V、GPT-5.4、Claude-Opus-4.7、Gemini-3.1-Pro共8个端点；并加入非ColorChecker对照刺激以分离模板依赖效应。
AI.result: 模型在粗略AWB二值判断上表现较好，但数值CCT估计与部分精细色差判断薄弱；在ColorChecker-24刺激上三个闭源前沿模型CCT MAE为715–1056 K，五个开源模型为1358–2133 K；非ColorChecker对照表明该优势部分模板依赖。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLM具备有用的颜色词汇与粗略视觉先验，但其颜色判断未能可靠校准到CIE可计算的色差度量上。

title: LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots
summary: Robotic navigation typically assumes a collision-free route to the goal exists; in cluttered environments with movable obstacles, however, reaching the goal may require physical interaction. Classical solutions encode these behaviors through geometric rules and task-specific logic, while learning-based approaches often constrain the decision space to low-dimensional motion commands or predefined action sets. We instead consider a broader decision space, jointly selecting the skill, relevant object, and geometric target. Our language-conditioned task planner, fine-tuned with LoRA on synthetic data, maps natural-language tasks and a structured scene representation to variable-length sequences of parameterized actions, executed by low-level reinforcement-learning policies. The planner learns the geometric relations underlying interactive navigation and outperforms a classical planner and a prompted frontier model on interactive navigation tasks. Comparisons with models trained from scratch indicate that composition does not require pretraining when the representation is structured, whereas pretraining yields more reliable geometric targets. At the low level, we introduce an end-to-end whole-body planar pushing policy that achieves a 93.3% success rate in simulation, versus 83.5% for a hierarchical baseline, while reducing completion time by more than 60%. On hardware, the hierarchy yields the correct skill composition in 44/45 trials and end-to-end success in 34/45. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出语言条件的分层交互式导航框架：LoRA微调的任务规划器在结构化场景表示上输出变长参数化动作序列（技能+对象+几何目标），由低层全身平面推压RL策略执行。
AI.motivation: 杂乱环境中的可移动障碍使无碰撞路径不存在，导航需物理交互；经典方法依赖几何规则与任务专用逻辑，学习式方法常将决策空间压缩到低维运动指令或预定义动作集，限制了技能组合的表达能力。
AI.method: 高层：以合成数据LoRA微调的语言条件规划器，输入自然语言任务与结构化场景表示，联合选择技能、相关物体与几何目标，输出变长参数化动作序列；对比从头训练与预训练模型、经典规划器与prompted前沿模型。低层：端到端全身平面推压策略，与分层基线对比。
AI.result: 高层规划器在交互式导航任务上优于经典规划器与frontier模型；对比实验显示结构化表示下组合泛化不依赖预训练，而预训练带来更可靠的几何目标。低层推压策略仿真成功率93.3%（基线83.5%），完成时间缩短60%以上；真机上技能组合正确44/45次，端到端成功34/45。
AI.conclusion: 扩大决策空间到技能、物体与几何目标的联合选择，配合结构化表示与分层执行，可有效实现交互式导航；拆分高层组合与低层控制的证据表明结构化表示比规模化预训练更关键于组合能力，而预训练主要提升几何目标精度。

title: Learned Terminal Costs for Short-Horizon Model Predictive Control of Autonomous Trucks in Interactive Highway Traffic
summary: Autonomous highway driving for heavy-duty trucks is a challenging control problem. The greater mass, dimensions and intricate dynamics increase the requirements for cooperation from surrounding traffic in critical maneuvers, requiring a careful balance between safety constraints and efficient long-horizon decision making. Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides rigorous constraint satisfaction but relies on terminal cost which can limit its effectiveness at short, computationally affordable horizons. Reinforcement Learning (RL) captures long-term driving behavior but offers no constraint guarantees and tends toward overly conservative policies when trained under sparse collision penalties. In this paper, we propose a hybrid MPC and RL framework for highway driving in autonomous trucks, where a finite-horizon MPC, solved via dynamic programming, uses a pre-trained RL model for terminal cost estimation. We evaluate the framework in a simulation environment with reactive surrounding traffic and compare it against pure MPC with zero terminal cost, rollout with terminal cost estimation using a base policy, and pure RL. Results show that the hybrid approach achieves zero collisions with the lowest cost of any configuration.

AI.tldr: 提出MPC与强化学习混合的自动驾驶重型卡车高速公路控制框架：用预训练RL模型估计终端代价函数，配合动态规划求解的有限时域MPC，在反应式周边交通仿真中实现零碰撞且总代价最低。
AI.motivation: 重型卡车质量大、尺寸大、动力学复杂，关键机动高度依赖周边交通配合，需在安全约束与长时域高效决策间取得平衡。纯MPC受终端代价设计制约，短计算可负担时域下效果受限；纯RL无约束保证，且在稀疏碰撞惩罚下易收敛到过度保守策略。
AI.method: 混合MPC-RL框架：有限时域MPC通过动态规划求解，其终端代价由预训练RL模型估计，从而在保持严格约束满足的同时引入长时域行为先验。在含反应式周边交通的仿真环境中，与零终端代价的纯MPC、使用基础策略估计终端代价的rollout方法、以及纯RL进行对比。
AI.result: 混合方法在所有配置中实现零碰撞，且总代价最低。
AI.conclusion: 将RL的长期价值估计作为MPC终端代价，可弥补有限时域MPC的短视问题并保留约束满足特性，是卡车高速自动驾驶中兼顾安全性与效率的有效方案；但验证限于仿真，缺少实车或高保真场景的泛化证据。

title: Gaussian Distillation of Flow Policies
summary: Flow policies are among the strongest robot controllers and are well suited to modelling multimodal action distributions. Our analysis shows that the continuous-action distributions of the studied flow policies are well approximated by Gaussians. We propose the Gaussian Action Readout (GAR), which replaces a flow policy's final layer with a Gaussian readout trained on just 0.02% of eligible states, while keeping the rest of the network frozen. It samples with one action-network pass, gives closed-form likelihoods, and achieves near-teacher task success at up to twice the inference speed.

AI.tldr: 提出Gaussian Action Readout (GAR)：用冻结的flow策略+仅需0.02%状态训练的高斯读出头替代末端层，实现单次前向采样、闭式似然与最高2倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: Flow策略虽强、能建模多模态动作分布，但推理需多步ODE积分、速度慢且缺乏闭式似然。作者观察到所研究的flow策略的连续动作分布在末端可被高斯良好近似，故试图大幅简化采样过程。
AI.method: 冻结原flow网络，仅将最后一层替换为在少量（0.02%）可选状态上训练的高斯读出层；利用动作分布近似高斯的经验发现，直接输出高斯参数，支持单次动作网络前向采样与闭式对数似然计算。
AI.result: 相比原flow教师策略，任务成功率接近，推理速度最高提升约2倍，并可计算精确似然。
AI.conclusion: 轻量读出层即可保留flow策略的多模态建模能力的主要性能，为VLA/机器人策略提供高效低成本替代方案；但实验规模与实机验证信息在摘要中未充分体现。

title: TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
summary: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: TaskFrame 提出分层 planner-controller 框架：VLM 任务规划器将高层目标分解为原子指令序列，用特殊目标 token 的隐藏状态作为可缓存复用的连续目标嵌入，因果 Transformer 控制器据其与近期观测预测键鼠离散动作与相机连续运动，三阶段训练（规划器监督+依赖感知GRPO、控制器预训练、联合对齐）。
AI.motivation: 通用游戏智能体同时需要高层任务推理与快速视觉环境下的低延迟动作控制，二者计算特性差异大，难以在单一模型中兼得。
AI.method: 分层规划-控制架构。规划端：VLM 将目标分解为有序原子指令，采用监督学习与依赖感知 GRPO 优化；用终止每条指令的特殊 goal token 隐藏状态生成连续目标嵌入并跨控制步缓存复用。控制端：因果 Transformer 结合当前目标嵌入与近期观测，逐步输出离散键盘/鼠标按键动作与连续相机运动。训练分三阶段：规划器训练、控制器预训练、联合对齐。
AI.result: Minecraft 实验中，指令分解质量与通用 VLM 相当；闭环评估下战斗成功率高于所比较基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离规划与控制并由连续目标嵌入衔接，可在实时视觉环境中兼顾高层推理与低延迟动作，为通用游戏/智能体系统提供可行范式。

title: LoRe-MIM: Lost-or-Replaced Masked Image Modeling for Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Whole-Body PET/CT
summary: Deep learning models for whole-body positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) hold significant clinical potential for disease detection, treatment planning, and response assessment. However, the time and cost associated with expert annotations remain major bottlenecks in developing robust and generalizable models. Although self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising approach to mitigating annotation scarcity, its application to whole-body PET/CT remains relatively underexplored due to the limited availability of large-scale datasets and the challenges associated with learning complementary cross-modal representations. To address these limitations, we curate a heterogeneous, multi-tracer, multi-institutional cohort comprising 6,531 whole-body PET/CT scans and propose LoRe-MIM (Lost-Or-Replaced Masked Image Modelling), a novel self-supervised framework designed to learn multimodal representations through masked image reconstruction. Specifically, LoRe-MIM introduces a masking strategy in which image regions are either replaced with zeros (Lost) or substituted with corresponding complementary imaging modality (Replaced), encouraging the model to capture both modality-specific characteristics and cross-modal relationships. We evaluate the learned representations across multiple downstream tasks, including multimodal PET/CT image reconstruction, patch-based classification into cancer vs. non-cancer, whole-body lesion segmentation, label-efficient training, and robustness assessment. Experimental results demonstrate that LoRe-MIM consistently outperforms the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines across these tasks, highlighting its potential as a scalable and generalizable self-supervised learning framework for whole-body PET/CT analysis.

AI.tldr: LoRe-MIM：面向全身PET/CT的多模态自监督掩码图像建模，通过"置零(Lost)/替换为互补模态(Replaced)"的混合掩码策略学习模态特异与跨模态表征。
AI.motivation: 全身PET/CT深度学习有临床价值，但专家标注成本高；SSL虽可缓解标注稀缺，却受限于大规模数据缺乏与跨模态互补表征学习困难，在全身PET/CT上探索不足。
AI.method: 构建6,531例多示踪剂、多中心异构全身PET/CT队列；提出LoRe-MIM自监督框架，掩码区域或被置零（Lost）或被对应互补模态图像替换（Replaced），迫使模型同时建模模态内特征与跨模态关联，并以掩码重建为预训练目标。
AI.result: 在PET/CT图像重建、patch级癌症/非癌症分类、全身病灶分割、标签高效训练与鲁棒性评估等多下游任务上，一致优于对应的SOTA基线。
AI.conclusion: LoRe-MIM可作为可扩展、可泛化的全身PET/CT自监督学习框架；其"模态替换"掩码思想可迁移至其他多模态医学成像。

title: MUSBRIC: LEGO-Compatible Pneumatic Muscle Bricks for Reconfigurable Musculoskeletal Robots
comment: 6 figures. Qiyao Wang and Yinglei Zhu contributed equally to this work
summary: Musculoskeletal robots combine compliant actuators with articulated skeletons, but exploring alternative configurations often requires repeated fabrication. We present MUSBRIC, a modular hardware platform and accompanying MuJoCo-based simulator for reconfigurable musculoskeletal robots. LEGO-compatible endcaps turn fiber-reinforced extensile pneumatic artificial muscles into reusable, plug-and-play muscle bricks that connect directly to standard LEGO components. Experimentally identified actuator behavior supports corresponding musculoskeletal simulations. An elbow-joint prototype validates load-dependent flexion and extension, showing that pulley-guided routing enables reversible motion and a mechanical stop stabilizes the straight posture. A robotic hand demonstrates compliant grasping and multi-joint construction. Matched hardware and simulation sweeps across 15 leg configurations demonstrate systematic exploration of attachment geometry, while a quadruped assembled from four legs demonstrates walking. Together, these demonstrations span mechanism analysis, configuration exploration, and functional robot construction within a single reconfigurable system. The hardware designs and simulation code will be released as open source soon to facilitate reproduction and further development.

AI.tldr: MUSBRIC 提出模块化硬件平台与配套 MuJoCo 仿真器，将纤维增强气动人工肌肉封装为 LEGO 兼容的"肌肉积木"，支持可重构肌骨机器人的快速搭建、实验标定与配置探索。
AI.motivation: 肌骨机器人结合柔性执行器与骨骼结构，但探索不同构型往往需要反复加工制造，迭代成本高、周期长；缺乏可快速重构且硬件-仿真匹配的研究平台。
AI.method: 设计 LEGO 兼容端盖，把纤维增强伸缩型气动人工肌肉（PAM）改造成即插即用的可复用"肌肉积木"；实验辨识执行器特性并据此构建对应 MuJoCo 肌骨仿真模型；以肘关节样机（滑轮导向布线实现可逆屈伸、机械限位稳定伸直姿态）验证载荷相关运动；用手部样机展示柔性抓取与多关节构造；对 15 种腿部构型做硬件-仿真同步扫描，探索连接几何影响；用四条腿组装四足机器人演示行走。
AI.result: 肘关节样机验证了随载荷变化的屈伸与可逆运动；手部实现柔性抓取；15 种腿构型的匹配硬件/仿真扫描显示可系统探索连接几何；四足样机实现行走；硬件与仿真代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: 单一可重构系统即可覆盖机构分析、构型探索与功能机器人构建，为肌骨机器人快速原型与硬件-仿真联合验证提供可复现平台。

title: Self-training for cross-centre coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography using pre-contrast frame subtraction
summary: Deep learning models for coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography often perform poorly on data from centres that were not represented in training. Apart from differences in equipment, the labels of the largest public dataset (ARCADE) are incomplete, as only the segments defined in the SYNTAX score are annotated. In this study, we evaluated whether self-training with pseudo-labels can improve performance on external data without additional manual annotation. Pseudo-labels were generated from two sources, namely the predictions of an nnU-Net model trained on ARCADE and a contrast map obtained by subtracting a pre-contrast frame from the same sequence. The nnU-Net predictions were extended along the contrast map, and pixels detected only in the subtraction image were assigned an ignore label and excluded from the loss. Six models were trained and tested on ARCADE and on two external datasets (XCAD and XACV). All first-round models initialised with the baseline predictions performed better than both the baseline and a control model fine-tuned for the same number of epochs. The model trained on the XCAD pool improved the macro-averaged Dice score by 2.7 points (95% CI 2.3-3.2), while the control decreased it by 0.6 points. A second round of self-training did not lead to further improvement. When an external model trained on 50 fully annotated images was used to generate the initial labels, the XCAD Dice score increased from 0.623 to 0.745 without any XCAD labels, although performance on XACV did not improve because large main vessels were missed. These results suggest that the benefit of self-training depends largely on the sensitivity of the model used to generate the initial pseudo-labels.

AI.tldr: 用自训练伪标签提升冠脉造影分割模型在外部中心数据上的泛化，伪标签由ARCADE训练的nnU-Net预测与减影对比图联合生成。
AI.motivation: 深度学习冠脉血管分割模型在训练未覆盖的中心数据上性能显著下降；最大公开数据集ARCADE标注不完整（仅标注SYNTAX评分定义的节段），希望通过自训练在无额外人工标注的情况下提升跨中心泛化。
AI.method: 伪标签来自两源：ARCADE训练的nnU-Net预测 + 同一序列中预对比帧减影得到的对比度图。nnU-Net预测沿对比度图扩展，仅出现在减影图中的像素赋ignore标签并从损失中排除。共训练6个模型，在ARCADE及XCAD、XACV两个外部数据集上测试；设置相同epoch微调的对照模型，并尝试第二轮自训练；另用50张全标注图像训练的外部模型生成初始标签。
AI.result: 所有以基线预测初始化的首轮模型均优于基线和同epoch微调对照模型。XCAD池训练的模型宏平均Dice提升2.7点（95% CI 2.3–3.2），对照模型下降0.6点；第二轮自训练无进一步提升。用50张标注图像训练的外部模型生成初始标签时，XCAD Dice从0.623升至0.745（未使用任何XCAD标签），但XACV无提升，因大主血管被漏检。
AI.conclusion: 自训练收益很大程度上取决于生成初始伪标签模型的敏感度；标签不完整的数据集可借减影信息与ignore标签机制做半监督扩展，但漏检会限制跨中心迁移效果。

title: Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features provides broad coverage by constraining all directions equally, but lacks semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. To address these issues, we propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings. Specifically, TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from the response directions and magnitudes around semantic anchors, then aggregates them using pre-trained image--anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. Extensive experiments across architectures and tasks demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance. Further analysis shows that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image--text relationships.

AI.tldr: TRAG利用预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部扰动的响应方向与幅度构建锚点级视觉漂移约束，并按图文相关性聚合为图像自适应正则，提升VLM对抗微调的干净与鲁棒性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM对抗微调依赖预训练模型引导以保持图文对齐：匹配视觉特征覆盖广但缺乏语义重点，匹配预测分布有语义聚焦但受候选文本与概率限制，二者均有损零样本性能。
AI.method: 分析视觉表征漂移后提出TRAG：在语义锚点附近用预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部变化的响应构造方向+幅度的锚点级约束，再用预训练图文相关性加权聚合，形成图像自适应正则项嵌入对抗微调。
AI.result: 跨多种架构与任务的实验取得SOTA的干净与鲁棒性能；分析表明TRAG有助于保持预训练图文关系。
AI.conclusion: 用文本编码器响应作为引导信号可更有效抑制语义相关方向的视觉漂移，是VLM鲁棒微调的有效正则化手段，但尚属通用VLM安全/鲁棒性范畴，未涉及具身或机器人任务验证。

title: Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support
summary: Radiological risk stratification and management planning are essential downstream tasks in medical imaging. Automating these tasks is challenging because clinical guideline criteria are distributed across prose, tables, and cross-referenced definitions. We present Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph), a framework that decouples guideline compilation from case evaluation. During compilation, a large language model partitions guidelines into section-based chunks, extracts local decision subgraphs with linked definitions, and aggregates related branches into an executable decision graph. During inference, a fast System One model answers localized clinical questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic, turning opaque single-pass predictions into a traceable decision path without task-specific training. Across 347 cases spanning renal cyst, adnexal mass, and thyroid nodule guidelines, GDGraph improves System One accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8%, outperforming retrieval-augmented GPT-4o (80.1%) and graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought (82.7%) at substantially lower latency and cost. The source code will be available.
