AI.tldr: GDGraph decouples guideline compilation from case evaluation: an LLM compiles radiology guidelines (prose, tables, cross-referenced definitions) into an executable decision graph, and at inference a fast "System One" model answers localized questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic, yielding traceable decision paths without task-specific training.
AI.motivation: Radiological risk stratification and management planning are important downstream tasks, but automating them is hard because clinical guideline criteria are scattered across prose, tables, and cross-referenced definitions.
AI.method: Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph): during compilation an LLM partitions guidelines into section-based chunks, extracts local decision subgraphs with linked definitions, and aggregates branches into an executable decision graph; during inference a fast System One model answers localized clinical questions while deterministic graph traversal resolves Boolean logic, replacing opaque single-pass prediction with a traceable decision path and requiring no task-specific training.
AI.result: On 347 cases spanning renal cyst, adnexal mass, and thyroid nodule guidelines, System One accuracy improves from 57.3% to 90.8%, outperforming retrieval-augmented GPT-4o (80.1%) and graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought (82.7%), at substantially lower latency and cost.
AI.conclusion: Compiling structured clinical guidelines into executable decision graphs and delegating only localized sub-questions to an LLM yields accurate, auditable, low-cost radiology decision support; the source code will be released.

title: RFW-A: Agentic Procedural Generation of 400K Articulated Assets over 500 Categories
comment: 37 pages, 19 figures. Project Page: this https URL
summary: High-quality articulated assets are essential for embodied perception, simulation, and manipulation, yet constructing them at scale remains difficult. Manual annotation and procedural modeling require substantial human effort. Recent agentic systems automate asset construction through program synthesis, but repeat costly reasoning and refinement for every new asset. Our key observation is that assets within a category can share construction logic despite variations in structure and appearance. Agentic synthesis and procedural generation are therefore complementary: agents can construct reusable programs, while procedural execution reuses the resulting logic across many samples. We therefore present RFW-A, which combines the two in a new articulated-asset generation paradigm. Starting from existing articulated programs, RFW-A organizes reusable components and their dependencies into category-level generators. Agents test and refine these generators across sampled configurations and motion states. Once constructed and validated, the generators produce diverse assets through procedural execution with no further model calls or token charges. The estimated API cost of generator authoring averages $10.62, amortizing to $0.05 per asset over 200 assets, versus $1.24 for the sampled per-asset agentic synthesis baseline. Using RFW-A, we built RFW-A-400K, containing over 400K sim-ready articulated assets across more than 500 categories. Experiments show high structural and kinematic validity and stable execution across physics simulators. Beyond asset validity, training with RFW-A-400K improves part-level articulation estimation on seen and unseen categories, while policies trained in simulation with retrieved and program-edited assets transfer zero-shot to real articulated objects.

AI.tldr: RFW-A 提出"智能体编写程序 + 程序化执行复用"的关节物体资产生成范式：先由智能体把已有可动程序整理为类别级生成器并采样测试、迭代精修，随后通过程序化执行批量产出多样资产，无需额外模型调用。作者构建了 400K+、覆盖 500+ 类别的可仿真关节资产数据集 RFW-A-400K。
AI.motivation: 高质量可动关节资产对具身感知、仿真与操作至关重要，但规模化构建困难：人工标注与程序化建模成本高；现有智能体式资产生成对每个新资产重复进行推理与精修，推理开销无法摊销。作者观察到同类别资产虽有结构与外观差异，却共享构建逻辑，因此智能体合成与程序化生成具有互补性。
AI.method: 从现有关节程序出发，将可复用组件及其依赖关系组织为类别级生成器（category-level generator）；智能体在采样得到的配置与运动状态下对生成器进行测试与精修。生成器经验证后，通过程序化执行批量生成资产，无需进一步模型调用或 token 消耗。据此外延构建 RFW-A-400K 数据集，并在物理仿真器中验证执行稳定性，同时用于部件级关节估计训练与策略的零样本真机迁移。
AI.result: 生成器编写 API 成本约 $10.62，在 200 个资产上摊销为 $0.05/资产，对比逐资产智能体合成的 $1.24。RFW-A-400K 含 400K+ 可仿真关节资产、500+ 类别，具备较高结构有效性与运动学有效性，跨物理仿真器执行稳定。用其训练可提升已见与未见类别的部件级关节估计；仿真中基于检索与程序编辑资产训练的策略可零样本迁移到真实关节物体。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体的程序合成能力与程序化生成的样本复用能力结合，是规模化关节资产生成的高效范式：一次性编程成本被大量样本摊销，且生成资产在下游感知训练与 sim-to-real 策略迁移中均有效。

title: Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control
summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured representations. We leverage these representations as intermediate proxies to condition a video generation model, together with an adaptive masking mechanism that improves alignment between the conditioning signals and generated video rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic framework that explicitly maintains and updates game states, allowing players to freely configure their virtual worlds and exercise fine-grained control over character motions while preserving visual quality and gameplay consistency. By combining agentic control with structured proxy-based generation, our framework unlocks new possibilities for player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.

AI.tldr: Wizard：一个"智能体游戏世界模型"，用骨架/几何结构化代理数据条件化视频生成模型，结合自适应掩码与显式游戏状态维护的智能体框架，实现对角色运动的实时精细控制，并零样本泛化到新场景、新角色、新动作。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型/智能体框架仅支持简单游戏设定与预定义运动模式，对未见环境与角色泛化差，实时交互能力有限；需要将游戏逻辑与可控世界表示从视觉生成中解耦，并能由玩家自由配置虚拟世界。
AI.method: 构建覆盖750个场景、178个角色的多样化数据集，包含骨架与几何信息作为结构化代理表示；以该表示作为中间代理条件化视频生成模型，并引入自适应掩码机制提升条件信号与生成视频rollout的对齐；提出智能体框架显式维护与更新游戏状态，实现玩家可配置世界与角色运动细粒度控制。
AI.result: 摘要未给出量化指标；定性上实现了实时、精确的角色运动控制，零样本跨新场景/角色/动作泛化，并在保持视觉质量与游戏一致性的同时支持玩家驱动的内容配置。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体控制与结构化代理生成结合，为玩家驱动的实时、可泛化、机制一致的世界仿真与游戏创作提供了新范式。

title: TouchBridge: Tactile-Conditioned Human-to-Robot Transfer for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations offer an efficient and scalable source of data for dexterous robot manipulation, but differences in sensing and hand morphology complicate the transfer of contact-rich interactions. We present TouchBridge, a hardware--software co-designed framework for human-to-robot data transformation. A wearable human demonstration interface and a corresponding robot interface establish cross-embodiment correspondence in visual and fingertip tactile sensing. We introduce Tac-Retarget, a tactile-conditioned retargeting method that uses measured contact to align fingertip contact patches and preserve their spatial relations within and across hands. Unlike object-aware or simulation-based transfer pipelines, Tac-Retarget requires no object mesh, object-pose estimate, or physics simulation for retargeting, enabling direct and scalable conversion of human demonstrations into robot-domain training data. Combined with visual synthesis and camera-anchored action conversion, TouchBridge produces robot-domain demonstrations for fine-tuning a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model. Across four real-world contact-rich tasks, policies fine-tuned solely on TouchBridge-converted human demonstrations achieve a 72.5% average success rate, compared with 77.5% using an equal number of teleoperated robot demonstrations, while human demonstration collection is 7.0x faster. Under the same policy and training setup, Tac-Retarget outperforms DexPilot and UniDex by 25.0 and 42.5 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: TouchBridge 提出人→机器人软硬件协同的数据转换框架：可穿戴人类示教接口+机器人灵巧手接口建立视觉与指尖触觉的跨本体对应，并提出触觉条件化的 Tac-Retarget 重定向方法，用实测接触对齐指尖接触斑块并保持手内/手间空间关系，无需物体网格、位姿估计或物理仿真即可把人类示教直接转为机器人域训练数据，结合视觉合成与相机锚定的动作转换微调 VLA 模型。
AI.motivation: 人类示教数据高效可扩展，但感知与手部形态差异使富接触交互难以迁移；现有物体感知或仿真驱动的重定向流程依赖物体网格/位姿/物理仿真，成本高、难扩展。
AI.method: 硬件-软件协同：人类示教可穿戴接口与对应机器人接口，在视觉与指尖触觉建立跨本体对应；Tac-Retarget 以实测触觉接触为条件，对齐指尖接触斑块并保持其手内与手间空间关系，实现无物体网格、无物体位姿、无物理仿真的直接重定向；配合视觉合成与相机锚定的动作转换，生成机器人域示教数据用于预训练 VLA 模型微调。
AI.result: 在四项真实世界富接触任务上，仅用 TouchBridge 转换的人类示教微调的策略平均成功率 72.5%，与等量遥操作机器人示教的 77.5% 接近，而人类示教采集速度快 7.0 倍；相同策略与训练设置下，Tac-Retarget 分别比 DexPilot、UniDex 高 25.0 与 42.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 触觉条件化的无物体/无仿真重定向可高效地把人类示教转化用于 VLA 微调的机器人数据，为跨本体富接触操作提供了可扩展的数据获取范式。

title: JEDI: Joint-Embedding Demonstration Compression for In-Context Imitation Learning
summary: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) adapts robot policies through test-time demonstrations, but long multimodal trajectories constrain how many examples fit in context. We ask what a compressed demonstration should preserve. We propose JEDI, which compresses demonstrations into latent slots trained to predict the query episode's next-stage keyframe in a frozen video-JEPA space. Task and process counterfactuals help the slots preserve execution details, while the predictor selects demonstrations from a bank. Post-training with keypoint tokens enables human-hand conditioning on robots. Experiments on LIBERO and real robots show that JEDI supports many-shot context; LIBERO objective controls show improved success and demonstration following over action-only compression. These findings support query-future prediction as a training objective for preserving execution-relevant information in compressed demonstrations.

AI.tldr: JEDI 将演示压缩为潜槽（latent slots），在冻结的视频-JEPA 空间中训练其预测查询回合的下一阶段关键帧；配合任务/过程反事实与关键点 token 后训练，实现多示例上下文与人类手部条件化，提升 LIBERO 与真机上的成功率与演示跟随度。
AI.motivation: 上下文模仿学习（ICIL）依赖测试时演示，但长且多模态的轨迹占用大量上下文，能塞入的示例数受限；核心问题是：压缩后的演示应保留什么信息才足以支撑策略执行。
AI.method: 提出 JEDI：将演示压缩成少量潜槽，以"预测查询回合下一阶段关键帧"为训练目标，监督信号取自冻结视频-JEPA 表示的预测；引入任务级与过程级反事实以迫使潜槽保留执行细节；用预测器从演示库中选择示例；再用关键点 token 做后训练，使策略可在机器人上接受人类手部条件输入。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与真实机器人上，JEDI 支持多示例（many-shot）上下文，成功率与演示跟随度优于纯动作压缩基线；LIBERO 上的目标函数消融实验验证了查询-未来预测目标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: "查询未来预测"可作为压缩演示的有效训练目标，有选择地保留与执行相关的信息；结论基于仿真基准与真机实验，但真机证据规模相对有限。

title: Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures. Code, level space and evaluation suite: this https URL
summary: Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+BiBC. The success-driven terrain curriculum from legged-robot practice is in a top group most often, domain randomisation on uniform levels in none, and PAIRED in none outside Spot, where the fourteen methods lie within 3.8 points on random levels of difficulty 0.25. On three robots the leader on in-distribution random levels is not the leader on held-out terrain. We collect the results into a per-robot guide to choosing a curriculum.

AI.tldr: 提出统一基准：在MuJoCo MJX上对5个3D四足机器人（W01-TEK、Go1、Go2、Barkour vB、Spot）用同一协议评测14种UED/域随机化/机器人课程方法，所有方法以相同环境步数预算驱动同一PPO学生。
AI.motivation: 现有UED方法主要在2D迷宫、网格世界和BipedalWalker上比较，而足式机器人地形课程多为手工设计且只对少数基线评估，缺乏跨机器人与跨地形分布的统一可比基准。
AI.method: 层级表示为8个可解释地形参数的向量；14种课程方法在每台机器人上独立比较；评测包括随机与留出结构化地形成功率、分层bootstrap区间的四分位均值、能力包络（capability envelope）以及逐层级支配比较，并按层级集合给出“未显著低于最优”的top group。
AI.result: 没有任何方法在所有机器人和层级集合上进入top group。含简单/低难度训练层级的方法在Go1、Barkour及除PAIRED+BiBC外的W01-TEK分布内随机层级上占据top group；实践中的成功率驱动地形课程最常入榜，均匀层级上的域随机化从未入榜，PAIRED仅在Spot入榜（此时14种方法在难度0.25随机层级上差距不超过3.8个百分点）；3台机器人上分布内随机层级的领先者并非留出地形上的领先者。
AI.conclusion: UED/课程方法的排序随机器人、层级分布与分布内外设定而变化，不存在普适最优；结论汇总为按机器人选择课程的实用指南，并提示应以留出地形泛化而非仅分布内成功率作为评估核心。

title: The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents for personal health read wearable data and recommend, but do not learn about the individual in a way that can be audited or falsified. We present EpiCoach, an agentic system that treats one athlete, a cross-country mountain biker, as the subject of accountable N-of-1 science. Claims about the athlete live in an evidence-gated hypothesis registry: each must issue a probabilistic prediction about a future session before it occurs, and its belief moves only through computed evidence from a logged statistical fit. Predictions come from a mechanistic digital twin inferred from heart rate, GPS and barometric altitude: a lagged heart-rate response model, a fitness-fatigue model with learned time constants, and a latent technical-descending skill state, measured on discovered trail segments. The agent prescribes the next training week as a constrained experiment maximizing information gain subject to load and safety constraints, around two instrument rides. We evaluate the system two ways over eighteen months of data. A rolling-origin replay benchmark shows the twin beats standard forecasters on heart rate but not segment time, and the agentic loop matches a static model. A live prospective phase runs the weekly cycle: in its first three weeks the ledger sealed 20 predictions, scored 14, the descent forecast calibrated after one correction, the climb forecast pessimistic as the athlete improved, and the safety officer vetoed the agent twice. Every correction is preserved in the registry, a template for auditable, falsifiable personalization in digital health. We release the registry, benchmark and protocol.

AI.tldr: EpiCoach：将单个运动员作为 N-of-1 可问责科学对象的智能体系统，通过证据门控假设注册表、心率/GPS/气压数字孪生与信息增益驱动的训练处方实验，实现可审计、可证伪的个人化健康推荐。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 个人健康智能体只读可穿戴数据并给出建议，却不以可审计或可证伪的方式"学习"个体；缺乏对个体化声明的检验机制与纠错留痕。
AI.method: 构建含数字孪生（滞后心率响应模型、带可学习时间常数的 fitness-fatigue 模型、赛道分段上的隐技能下降状态）与假设注册表（每条声明须在下次训练前给出概率预测，信念仅经记录在案的统计拟合证据更新）；智能体在负荷与安全约束下最大化信息增益，生成下一周"受约束实验"处方；双重评估：滚动起点回放基准 + 18 个月实时前瞻阶段。
AI.result: 回放基准中数字孪生在心率预测上优于标准预测器，但分段用时不如；智能体闭环与静态模型持平。前瞻阶段前三周注册表封存 20 条预测、评分 14 条：下坡预测经一次修正后校准，爬坡预测因运动员进步而偏悲观，安全官两次否决智能体建议；所有修正均保留在注册表中。
AI.conclusion: 提出可审计、可证伪的数字健康个体化模板，并开源注册表、基准与协议；但算法增益有限（孪生仅部分占优、智能体闭环未超静态基线），单受试者规模小，属于方法论贡献而非实证突破。

title: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出HiFOR分层前瞻框架：用分层依赖掩码(HDM)联合预测短期状态演化、语义里程碑和最终目标；将未来潜表示按时间/视角/空间组织成结构化世界模型；再用动作引导的分解式世界检索在去噪过程中按动作表征自适应检索相关未来信息指导动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA中未来预测方法将短期动力学与长期任务目标分开建模，且把预测未来直接注入动作策略，未充分衡量未来信息与当前动作需求的关联性。
AI.method: Hierarchical Foresight Prediction（HDM跨时间尺度依赖联合预测短时状态、语义里程碑、目标状态）+ Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling（沿horizon/view/spatial维度组织未来潜表示）+ Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval（去噪中按动作表征自适应检索相关未来因子作引导）。
AI.result: 在两个仿真基准和六个真实机器人操作任务上验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 分层前瞻+结构化世界模型+动作引导检索可更精准地把未来预测转化为对动作生成的定向指导，提升VLA操作性能。

title: Securing the Robotics Supply Chain
summary: This paper sets out what a sustained federal research and investment agenda would need to include to close that gap--not within a single budget cycle, but over the decade such an undertaking will realistically require. It identifies where the gap is most pronounced today: in the methods needed to verify and certify components of uncertain origin, in the foundational hardware research that has long been underfunded relative to software, in the physical infrastructure researchers need to test systems at scale, and in the workforce required to build and sustain all of it. Robotics should not be treated merely as a downstream beneficiary of a broader artificial intelligence investment strategy. It constitutes its own supply chain, with its own points of failure, and merits its own sustained federal commitment.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一份为期十年的持续性联邦研究与投资议程，旨在弥补美国机器人领域的能力缺口，指出四大薄弱环节：来源不明部件的验证与认证方法、长期被轻视的基础硬件研究、规模化测试所需物理基础设施、以及支撑上述各项的人才队伍；主张机器人应作为独立供应链获得专项联邦投入，而非仅视为AI投资的下游受益者。
AI.motivation: 当前AI投资策略将机器人视为下游应用，忽视其作为独立供应链的独特失效点；硬件、验证认证方法、规模测试基础设施与人才等基础环节长期投入不足，短期预算周期无法解决。
AI.method: 政策与议程分析型论文，基于缺口识别（gap analysis）梳理四大薄弱领域，并提出十年期的持续投资框架与优先级建议；未涉及具体技术方法或实验。
AI.result: 给出缺口分布的结构化判断与投资优先序建议，但无实验验证、量化数据或可复现方法。
AI.conclusion: 机器人需要独立的、持续的联邦研究投资承诺，重点在验证认证、硬件基础研究、规模化测试基础设施与人才培养四个方面。

title: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
summary: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.

AI.tldr: CoAWM 提出跨本体、跨控制频率的连续动作世界模型：先以函数预训练把异构轨迹对齐到共享隐函数空间，再将其接到世界模型骨干上，由观测、语言指令与当前状态条件化预测隐动作函数，单解码器可在任意查询时刻输出末端执行器动作。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人策略/世界模型通常绑定单一本体与固定控制频率，难以复用异构数据；希望学到一个共享的、可跨本体与跨频率采样的时空动力学先验。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 函数预训练——用动作重构与跨时间采样视图的一致性，把不同本体与采样频率的轨迹映射到公共表示；(2) 将预训练函数空间与世界模型骨干连接，以观测/语言/机器人状态为条件预测隐动作函数，由单一解码器对任意查询时刻返回末端执行器动作；将共享动力学先验与任务条件动作选择、时间采样解耦。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；声称两阶段设计扩大了可用预训练数据源、便于扩展到更大更多样数据集，并为跨本体、跨控制频率的经验迁移提供统一基础。
AI.conclusion: 以连续时间函数表征动作为核心的跨本体世界模型为异构机器人数据复用提供了统一范式，但摘要中缺乏真实机器人实验与量化证据。

title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
summary: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. However, most state-of-the-art deep learning approaches require a full scan of the surface, which hinders the development of high-throughput inspection systems. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis (UFLD), a novel algorithm that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive measurement acquisition and provides a prediction uncertainty level after each step, stopping the process once sufficient information is obtained. Unlike existing methods that rely on ensemble models or auxiliary confidence estimation deep learning models, UFLD utilizes a more parameter-efficient conformal prediction framework to determine the optimal stopping time. The proposed UFLD reduces acquisition time by about $40\%$ and achieves $98.4\%$ inspection accuracy, without requiring an additional learned confidence-estimation network. We validated our approach on the MixedWM38 dataset, demonstrating its advantages over existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard convolutional neural networks.

AI.tldr: 提出不确定性感知反馈回路诊断(UFLD)，用强化学习进行自适应测量采集，并用conformal prediction框架确定最优停止时机，在晶圆图缺陷检测中减少约40%采集时间且达到98.4%准确率。
AI.motivation: 半导体晶圆检测要求高精度与低运营成本，但现有深度学习SOTA方法多需全表面扫描，阻碍高通量检测系统的发展；因此需要自适应的按需测量策略，在获得足够信息后尽早停止。
AI.method: UFLD：强化学习驱动的自适应测量采集策略，每步输出预测不确定性水平；不同于依赖集成模型或额外置信度估计网络的做法，采用更参数高效的conformal prediction框架判定最优停止时间。在MixedWM38数据集上验证。
AI.result: 采集时间减少约40%，检测准确率98.4%，优于现有自适应采集流程与标准CNN；无需额外学习置信度估计网络。
AI.conclusion: 将强化学习与conformal prediction结合可构建参数高效的自适应检测框架，在保持高准确率的同时显著提升吞吐量，为高通量晶圆检测提供可行方案。

title: socx: GPU-Accelerated Chance-Constrained Stochastic Optimal Control using JAX
summary: In this article, we present socx, a GPU-accelerated solver for lifted convex reformulations of linear stochastic optimal control under chance constraints, implemented in JAX. We demonstrate that by exploiting the sparse and independent structure of the problem, distributed optimization can reduce it to simpler problems: independent linear-quadratic tracking (LQT) problems and Euclidean projections onto sets. These simpler problems can be solved in parallel and then coupled using the constraints. To validate our solver, we run it on a hover-linearized 3D quadrotor and show a speed-up of up to $98\times$ over MOSEK and up to $2224\times$ over SCS. socx also solves horizons up to $N=1120$, whereas MOSEK runs out of memory at $N=320$. We present ablations to isolate the key components that enable the speed-up.

AI.tldr: socx：基于JAX的GPU加速求解器，用于求解带机会约束的线性随机最优控制的提升凸重构问题；利用问题的稀疏与可分离结构，通过分布式优化将其分解为可并行的独立LQT子问题与欧氏投影，再用约束耦合求解。
AI.motivation: 带机会约束的随机最优控制在提升凸重构后规模庞大，通用商用或开源凸优化求解器（MOSEK、SCS）在长时域下速度慢甚至内存溢出，难以满足在线/长时域控制需求。
AI.method: 在JAX中实现GPU加速求解器；利用问题稀疏性与模块独立性，采用分布式/对偶分解，将整体问题化为多组相互独立的线性二次跟踪（LQT）子问题与集合上的欧氏投影，两者可并行求解，再通过约束进行耦合与一致性协调；附带消融实验定位加速来源。
AI.result: 在悬停线性化3D四旋翼上验证：相比MOSEK最高加速98×，相比SCS最高加速2224×；可求解时域至N=1120，而MOSEK在N=320即内存溢出。
AI.conclusion: 结构化分解+GPU并行可显著突破通用凸求解器在随机最优控制上的规模与速度瓶颈，为长时域机会约束控制提供可行工具。

title: Optimal Path Planning with Localization constraints
summary: This paper studies UAV path planning in areas where GPS signals are not present. Because these drones can easily get lost when they don't have GPS, they must rely on dead reckoning and occasionally pass near cellular towers, which act as landmarks to reset and fix their position. The goal is to find the shortest path from a start to a goal location while keeping the estimation uncertainty within a given bound. To solve this problem, we propose a localization-constrained A* planner that treats uncertainty as a hard constraint during search. The robot state and covariance are propagated using an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF), and only paths that satisfy the covariance limit are considered. We also show that the proposed method does not affect heuristic used in A* and remains admissible and consistent, ensuring optimality among all feasible paths. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations and PyBullet quadrotor test show that the proposed method finds shorter and more reliable paths compared to RRT* and PRM, while always satisfying the uncertainty constraint.

AI.tldr: 提出定位约束A*（localization-constrained A*）规划器，在GPS拒止环境下以EKF协方差上界为硬约束求最短可行路径，并用蒙特卡洛与PyBullet四旋翼实验验证。
AI.motivation: 无GPS的无人机仅靠航位推算会迅速累积位置漂移，必须借道蜂窝基站作为地标重置定位；因此需要在路径规划阶段显式考虑定位不确定性约束，而非事后检验。
AI.method: 在A*搜索中把不确定度作为硬约束：用EKF传播机器人状态与协方差，只保留满足协方差上限的路径；并证明该约束不破坏启发函数性质，启发式仍可采纳且一致，从而保证在所有可行路径中的最优性。
AI.result: 大量蒙特卡洛仿真与PyBullet四旋翼测试显示，相比RRT*与PRM，本方法得到更短、更可靠的路径，且始终满足不确定性约束。
AI.conclusion: 将定位不确定性纳入图搜索约束可在保证最优性的同时提升GPS拒止环境下无人机路径的可行性与可靠性，属于约束规划与状态估计紧耦合的轻量方案。

title: Improving Fine-Grained Manipulation through Demonstration Expansion and Execution Design
summary: Fine-grained manipulation requires a robot policy to follow instructions, remain robust to visual variations, and translate predicted actions into precise robot control. We present Demonstration Expansion and Execution Design (DEED), a framework for adapting a pretrained vision-language-action policy to the five MetaFine tasks through structured demonstration expansion and execution design. DEED generates demonstrations for different instructions from the same initial scene and renders each physical trajectory under different camera positions and lighting conditions while preserving its original states and action targets. A hierarchical sampling strategy balances instructions, trajectories, and visual conditions during supervised adaptation. At deployment, DEED converts predicted action chunks into robot commands using inverse kinematics, gripper mappings selected for each task, and closed-loop replanning. DEED achieves an official Overall score of 85.55%. Fixed-policy evaluations show that performance varies with execution horizon, denoising budget, and gripper mapping.

AI.tldr: DEED框架通过结构化示教扩展与执行设计，将预训练VLA策略适配到MetaFine五项精细操作任务，官方总体得分85.55%。
AI.motivation: 精细操作要求策略同时具备指令跟随、对视觉扰动鲁棒、以及精确的机器人控制转换能力；现有预训练VLA策略在少样本竞赛型任务上需同时解决数据覆盖与执行落地两端问题。
AI.method: (1) 示教扩展：对同一初始场景生成面向不同指令的示教，并将每条物理轨迹在不同相机位姿与光照条件下重渲染，同时保持原始状态与动作目标不变；(2) 分层采样策略在监督微调中平衡指令、轨迹与视觉条件的分布；(3) 执行设计：部署时用逆运动学将预测动作块转为机器人命令，按任务选择夹爪映射，并采用闭环重规划。
AI.result: MetaFine官方Overall得分85.55%；固定策略消融显示性能随执行时域长度、去噪步数预算与夹爪映射方式显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 数据侧的轨迹/视角/光照重渲染扩展与执行侧的IK+夹爪映射+闭环重规划共同构成有效适配方案，执行超参是精细操作性能的关键敏感因素。

title: Adaptive search with path-constrained mobile sensors using multi-arm bandits
summary: We study a constrained sequential decision problem for detecting regions of interest from noisy online measurements collected by a team of energy-constrained mobile sensors. The sensor motion is restricted to a precomputed set of feasible paths that satisfy mobility constraints, limited available energy by requiring return to charging stations, and avoidance of known obstacles. We cast the resulting active path selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and propose an iterative search algorithm that adaptively assigns paths using confidence bounds computed from the collected data. We also propose a graph-based method to construct low-cardinality path covers under the team's constraints. We establish finite-time and anytime probabilistic correctness guarantees for the proposed algorithm, derive non-asymptotic upper bounds on the times required to detect all regions of interest and to label all nodes, and show that these bounds match algorithm-independent lower bounds up to constant factors for a broad class of problem instances. Using numerical simulations, we illustrate the behavior of the proposed approach and the effect of path redundancy and team size on search performance.

AI.tldr: 将能量受限移动传感器团队的主动路径选择建模为多臂老虎机问题，结合图论方法构造低基数路径覆盖，并给出有限时间/任意时刻的概率正确性保证与匹配下界的时长上界。
AI.motivation: 在移动传感器存在能量约束、必须返回充电站、需避障且运动受限于预计算可行路径的条件下，仍需从噪声在线测量中高效检测所有感兴趣区域并标定节点，需要在约束可行集上做自适应的主动路径分配。
AI.method: 1) 将带约束的顺序决策/主动路径选择建模为多臂老虎机（MAB）问题，臂为可行路径；2) 提出迭代搜索算法，基于已收集数据计算的置信界（confidence bounds）自适应指派路径；3) 提出基于图的方法，在团队约束下构造低基数（low-cardinality）路径覆盖；4) 建立有限时间与anytime概率正确性保证，推导检测全部感兴趣区域与标注全部节点所需时间的非渐近上界，并证明在广泛问题类别上与算法无关下界仅差常数因子；5) 数值仿真验证方法行为及路径冗余度、团队规模对搜索性能的影响。
AI.result: 获得有限时间与anytime概率正确性保证；导出的时间上界在广泛问题实例类上与信息论/算法无关下界相差常数因子，即在该意义下渐近最优；仿真显示路径冗余与团队规模对搜索性能有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 能量与运动学约束下的主动感知搜索可归约为 MAB 与图覆盖的组合问题，所提算法兼具可证明的正确性与阶最优的时间复杂度，适用于多移动传感器团队的区域检测任务。

title: Soil Moisture Estimation in Precision Agriculture: A Knowledge Distillation Approach
summary: Accurate soil moisture estimation is critical for precision agriculture, influencing irrigation, fertilization, and harvesting strategies. Traditional methods primarily rely on meteorological and soil property data, while recent approaches incorporate visual modalities such as aerial and geospatial imagery. However, these high-resolution images are expensive and computationally demanding to analyze. In this work, we propose Soil Moisture Distillation (SMD), a Knowledge Distillation (KD)-based multimodal learning framework that leverages unimodal teachers to enhance multimodal soil moisture estimation. SMD surpasses not only traditional multimodal fusion techniques, including MIS-ME, but also outperforms unimodal models, demonstrating the benefits of guided unimodal knowledge transfer. Additionally, we conduct a comparative analysis of soil patches and crop images, showing that crop images provide superior visual cues, leading to improved prediction accuracy. SMD achieves a 2% improvement in MAPE for soil patches and 1.2% for crops over state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging both meteorological and visual data through knowledge distillation for enhanced soil moisture forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出 Soil Moisture Distillation (SMD)，一种基于知识蒸馏的多模态学习框架，用单模态教师模型引导多模态土壤湿度估计，并比较土壤与作物图像的视觉线索差异。
AI.motivation: 精准农业中土壤湿度估计至关重要，但传统方法依赖气象与土壤属性数据，缺乏视觉信息；而航空/地理影像虽含视觉线索却成本高、计算开销大，因此需要一种能低成本引入视觉收益的多模态方案。
AI.method: 采用知识蒸馏（KD）框架：先训练单模态教师（气象数据、视觉图像等），再以教师指导多模态学生模型进行融合学习；同时对比土壤斑块图像与作物图像的视觉表征效果。基线与 MIS-ME 等融合方法对比。
AI.result: SMD 优于传统多模态融合（如 MIS-ME）及单模态模型；MAPE 在土壤斑块上提升约 2%，在作物图像上提升约 1.2%；作物图像相比土壤图像提供更强的视觉线索，预测精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏可有效迁移单模态知识，结合气象与廉价视觉数据显著提升土壤湿度预测；作物图像是更具信息量的视觉模态，为低成本精准农业感知提供可行路径。

title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
comment: 51 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: this https URL
summary: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes. Existing methods often rely on masked inputs, generation-based pairs, or training pairs with limited viewpoint variation, leaving pose and illumination adaptation and bidirectional object-scene interactions insufficiently constrained. We construct the Insert World dataset with strictly aligned Blender-rendered counterfactual pairs and object references across viewpoints and lighting conditions. Building on these data, Geometry-Guided Adaptation couples a VGGT geometry stream with image and text streams under target-scene feature supervision to guide spatially consistent insertion. Complementary 2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision jointly supervises object occupancy and environmental changes while grounding spatial instructions in object regions through image-text attention. We introduce PhysInsert-Bench with dedicated cross-environment and cross-view cases requiring illumination and pose adaptation beyond appearance copying. Experiments on PhysInsert-Bench and DreamBooth demonstrate improved image fidelity; a user study further shows more accurate placement and improved lighting integration, perspective, and pose plausibility.

AI.tldr: PhysInsert：基于VGGT几何流与2D物体-场景空间监督的参考图物体插入框架，联合适配物体位姿/光照与场景变化，并构建Insert World数据集与PhysInsert-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有参考图物体插入方法依赖掩码输入、生成式配对或视角变化有限的数据，导致位姿与光照适配、物体-场景双向交互约束不足。
AI.method: 构建Blender渲染的严格对齐反事实配对数据集Insert World（跨视角、跨光照）与物体参考图；Geometry-Guided Adaptation将VGGT几何流与图像、文本流耦合，在目标场景特征监督下引导空间一致插入；2D物体-场景空间监督通过图文注意力将空间指令定位到物体区域，联合监督物体占据与环境变化。
AI.result: 在PhysInsert-Bench（含跨环境与跨视角光照/位姿适配用例）和DreamBooth上图像保真度提升；用户研究显示放置准确性、光照融合、透视与位姿合理性更好。
AI.conclusion: 引入显式几何先验与双向物体-场景监督，可显著改善参考图插入的空间一致性；但缺乏真实机器人/物理仿真验证，属生成式场景编辑范畴。

title: A Unified Benchmark for Aerial-Enhanced Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Aerial Dataset
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary: Aerial imagery provides complementary spatial context for autonomous driving by exposing road structure beyond the immediate perception range of onboard sensors. Yet map construction from aerial imagery, aerial-assisted online HD mapping, and cross-view localization are typically studied on separate data and benchmarks. We introduce KITScenes Aerial, an extension of the KITScenes Multimodal dataset that augments synchronized onboard sensor data, vehicle poses, and rich Lanelet2 map annotations with spatially associated aerial imagery and higher-resolution neural representations, providing a common basis for a variety of research tasks. Our mapping evaluation focuses on all 53 KITScenes map classes across different model designs, spatial ranges, and aerial resolutions, while retaining compatibility with the widely used three-class setting. Representative baselines show that aerial context is particularly beneficial for fine-grained and extended-range mapping, more than doubling 53-class mAP at the larger mapping extent. Higher-resolution aerial imagery yields a further 4.3 mAP (+24 %) improvement, with gains extending to challenging map elements such as traffic lights. We additionally evaluate cross-view localization under geographically disjoint conditions, where an adapted fine-grained feature-matching baseline achieves a mean translation error of 5.13 m. KITScenes Aerial thus enables unified study of aerial and ground-level information across complementary mapping and localization tasks. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: KITScenes Aerial 将同步车载传感器数据、车辆位姿、Lanelet2 地图标注与空间关联的航空影像及更高分辨率神经表示整合为一个统一数据集，支撑航空影像建图、空地协同在线 HD 建图和跨视角定位的联合研究。
AI.motivation: 航空影像能提供超出车载传感器感知范围的道路结构先验，但现有「航空建图」「航空辅助在线 HD 建图」「跨视角定位」三类任务各自使用独立数据与基准，缺乏统一评测基础。
AI.method: 构建 KITScenes Multimodal 数据集扩展版：同步多模态车载数据 + 车辆位姿 + 丰富 Lanelet2 标注 + 空间对齐航空影像 + 高分辨率神经表示；在 53 类地图要素上，跨不同模型设计、空间范围和航空分辨率进行建图评测（保留三分类兼容设置）；并在地理上不相交条件下评测跨视角定位，采用适配的细粒度特征匹配基线。
AI.result: 航空上下文对细粒度与远距离建图尤其有效，在更大建图范围上 53 类 mAP 提升超过一倍；更高分辨率航空影像再带来 4.3 mAP（+24%）提升，增益延伸至红绿灯等困难要素；跨视角定位平均平移误差 5.13 m。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为航空与地面信息的统一研究提供了公共基础，可支撑互补的建图与定位任务；但论文属于数据集与基准型工作，方法贡献有限。

title: InfantNet: A Large Scale Dataset for Infant Body Pose and Shape Estimation
summary: Infant pose and shape estimation is essential for applications in childcare, developmental monitoring, and medical diagnosis. However, existing methods and datasets are largely designed for adults, and direct transfer to infants fails due to substantial differences in body proportions, articulation limits, and frequent self-occlusion. To address this gap, we introduce InfantNet, the largest real-image infant dataset to date, comprising 108,902 RGB images of infants aged 6-18 months. Each image is annotated with 2D keypoints, and a curated subset of 11,642 images additionally includes 3D pose and shape annotations with full SMIL parameters, verified through multi-view rendering and reprojection-error filtering. We use an iterative annotation pipeline to ensure high fidelity across both 2D and 3D labels. InfantNet establishes a large-scale, comprehensive benchmark for infant 2D keypoint detection and 3D pose-and-shape recovery. Baseline experiments demonstrate that state-of-the-art adult pose estimators do not generalize well to infants, whereas fine-tuning on InfantNet yields a consistent improvement. The gains are even more pronounced for 3D pose and shape estimation, where SMIL-based estimation demonstrates robust performance with accuracy comparable to results reported for SMPL-based models. By releasing the InfantNet dataset and benchmark, we provide a vital resource for advancing infant pose analysis and related healthcare applications.

AI.tldr: InfantNet：迄今最大真实图像婴儿数据集，108,902张6-18月龄婴儿RGB图像（2D关键点全标注，11,642张含SMIL全参数3D姿态与体型标注），建立婴儿2D关键点检测与3D姿态体型恢复基准。
AI.motivation: 现有姿态/体型估计方法与数据集主要面向成人，因婴儿身体比例、关节活动范围差异大且自遮挡频繁，直接迁移效果差，缺少大规模高质量婴儿标注数据。
AI.method: 构建108,902张真实婴儿图像数据集，采用迭代式标注流程；全部图像标注2D关键点，精选子集11,642张给出完整SMIL参数3D标注，并通过多视角渲染与重投影误差过滤校验标签质量；以成人SOTA模型零样本与微调作基线评估。
AI.result: 成人SOTA姿态估计器对婴儿泛化显著不足；在InfantNet上微调后2D与3D指标一致提升，3D姿态体型估计增益更明显，基于SMIL的估计精度与SMPL类模型报告结果相当。
AI.conclusion: InfantNet为婴儿姿态分析及儿童健康相关应用提供大规模基准资源，表明领域内数据与参数化模型适配对婴儿场景至关重要。

title: Fundamental Limits of Sampling-Based Reachability: Geometry and Flow Distortion
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Extended version of the CoRL 2026 paper; submitted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control. Code: this https URL
summary: Sampling-based reachability estimates reachable sets from finitely many simulated trajectory endpoints. Existing guarantees often control missed probability mass or approximation error relative to the convex hull of the reachable set, leaving the geometric error relative to the reachable set incompletely characterized. We study this error as a problem of support estimation under flow distortion. Our assumptions combine a uniform lower bound on the local volume density of the initial set, a lower bound on the sampling density, and a one-sided Lipschitz constant $\mu$ for the vector field. These conditions admit initial sets with corners and dynamics that may expand or contract. In the fine-accuracy regime, $\tilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(2^ne^{n\mu T}(R/r)^n/(\rho\kappa)\bigr)$ independent endpoint samples suffice for Hausdorff accuracy $r$ using the endpoint cloud. Here, $n$ is the state dimension, $T$ is the horizon, $R$ is the volume-equivalent radius, and $\rho$ and $\kappa$ quantify sampling density and local volume density. For $n\ge2$ and sufficiently small $\kappa$, a minimax lower bound over all estimators based only on independent endpoints matches these dependencies up to a dimension-dependent factor $2\cdot4^n$ and logarithmic factors, within the stated parameter range and when the state domain accommodates the construction. The exponential burden in dimension, and in the horizon for expanding systems, is therefore intrinsic to this observation model. Planar experiments illustrate the predicted effects of corners and contraction; robot-arm experiments show how empirical accuracy deteriorates with dimension.

AI.tldr: 该文将采样型可达集估计的几何误差（Hausdorff误差）建模为"流形变下的支撑估计"问题，给出端点样本数的上界与极小极大下界。
AI.motivation: 现有采样可达性保证多只控制遗漏概率质量或相对凸包的近似误差，对"相对真实可达集"的几何误差刻画不完整，因此需要建立 Hausdorff 意义下的样本复杂度理论。
AI.method: 假设初始集局部体积密度一致下界、采样密度下界、向量场单边 Lipschitz 常数 μ（允许扩张或收缩、允许初始集带角点）；用端点点云作支撑估计，推导高精度区间内达到 Hausdorff 精度 r 所需的独立端点样本量及极小极大下界。
AI.result: 样本复杂度为 Õ(2^n e^{nμT}(R/r)^n/(ρκ))；对 n≥2 且 κ 充分小时，任意仅基于独立端点的估计器的下界在差一个 2·4^n 维度因子与对数因子的意义下匹配，说明维度指数负担与扩张系统的时域指数负担本质内在于观测模型。平面实验展示角点与收缩效应，机械臂实验显示精度随维度恶化。
AI.conclusion: 采样型可达集估计存在固有的维度灾难与扩张-时域灾难；该结论刻画了此类观测模型的根本限制，为评估/设计可达性算法提供了理论上界基准。

title: Accurate MRI-free PET Quantification and Reliability Assessment via CT-to-MRI Synthesis and Conformal Prediction
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, including supplementary material. Submitted to Medical Image Analysis
summary: Standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) quantification of amyloid PET commonly relies on a subject-specific T1-weighted MRI, yet a usable MRI is not always available. We therefore combined CT-to-MRI synthesis with conformal prediction for MRI-free PET quantification with reliability assessment. A slice-consistent Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model was strengthened with multi-dataset training and data-source conditioning to enrich the anatomical prior learned from MRI, and with expanded multi-slice CT context to exploit the through-plane continuity of subject-specific anatomy in CT. Synthetic MRI was used for FreeSurfer-based anatomical parcellation and PET quantification, while deep-ensemble uncertainty was calibrated with conformal prediction to estimate a plausible range for the corresponding real MRI-based SUVR. On $^{11}$C-PiB PET from OASIS-3, the proposed method achieved the highest synthesis and parcellation fidelity among the compared methods. Mean cortical SUVR from the proposed synthetic MRI agreed closely with the real MRI-based reference (MAE $0.016 \pm 0.015$, Pearson $r = 0.9987$) and yielded the same amyloid-positivity classification as the real MRI in all 87 test subjects at the prespecified cut-off. Conformal prediction achieved empirical coverage close to the prespecified levels, and at 90% target coverage, 85 of 87 subjects had prediction intervals that supported an unambiguous amyloid-positivity decision. Zero-shot evaluation on an independent external cohort showed that the proposed CT-to-MRI model could support PET quantification without retraining, although conformal calibration required target-cohort recalibration to recover the intended coverage. These findings support CT-to-MRI-based MRI-free PET quantification as a promising approach for providing accurate SUVR measurements and an explicit assessment of their reliability.

AI.tldr: 结合切片一致的 Brownian Bridge 扩散模型（多数据集训练+数据源条件+多层 CT 上下文）实现 CT→MRI 合成，并用深度集成不确定性+conformal prediction 校准，实现无 MRI 的淀粉样蛋白 PET SUVR 定量及其可靠性区间评估。
AI.motivation: 淀粉样蛋白 PET 的 SUVR 定量通常依赖受试者个体的 T1 加权 MRI 做解剖分割，但可用 MRI 并不总有；同时现有合成方法缺乏对定量结果可靠性的显式评估。
AI.method: 切片一致的 Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model 做 CT→MRI 合成，通过多数据集训练与数据源条件增强解剖先验，利用扩展的多层 CT 上下文建模层面连续解剖结构；合成 MRI 输入 FreeSurfer 完成分割与 PET 定量；再用深度集成不确定性配合 conformal prediction 给出对应真实 MRI-SUVR 的预测区间。
AI.result: 在 OASIS-3 的 11C-PiB PET 上合成与分割保真度最优；平均皮层 SUVR 与真实 MRI 参考高度一致（MAE 0.016±0.015，r=0.9987），87 名测试受试者在预设阈值下分类完全一致；conformal 覆盖率接近目标，90% 覆盖下 85/87 受试者区间可支持明确的阳性判定；外部队列零样本可用，但需目标队列重校准恢复覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: CT→MRI 合成的无 MRI PET 定量可提供准确 SUVR 并附带显式可靠性评估，具备临床转化潜力；跨中心泛化仍需 conformal 重校准。

title: AVPS-360: A Spatial Audio-Visual Benchmark for Instance Segmentation and Tracking of Sound-Producing Persons
summary: Audio-visual instance segmentation (AVIS) segments and tracks individual sound-producing objects in videos. Existing benchmarks predominantly use monaural audio, which lacks inter-channel cues for spatially distinguishing concurrent sound sources. We introduce AVPS-360 (Audio-Visual Person Segmentation 360), a spatial audio-visual benchmark bridging AVIS and sound event localisation and detection (SELD). Built upon STARSS23, it pairs first-order Ambisonics audio with synchronised 360° video across 230 recordings totalling 10.5 hours. Recordings average 164.0 seconds. The dataset captures intermittent sound production in real-world interactions dominated by speech, alongside laughter, clapping, and footsteps. It provides 31,678 manually reviewed instance masks linked to source identities and sound-event labels. We also present a baseline that integrates spatial audio with visual features for frame-level segmentation and identity association across frames. Experiments on AVPS-360 show that existing AVIS methods struggle with detection and identity association in long recordings with intermittent sound production, while our baseline substantially improves performance in both aspects.

AI.tldr: AVPS-360：基于STARSS23的空间音频+360°视频视听实例分割（人物）基准，10.5小时/230段录音、31,678个实例掩码，并给出融合空间音频的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视听实例分割（AVIS）基准多用单声道音频，缺乏声道间线索，难以在空间上区分同时发声的多源；本文希望把AVIS与声事件定位检测（SELD）桥接，引入空间音频以支撑并发声源的实例级分割与身份关联。
AI.method: 在STARSS23基础上构建AVPS-360：一阶Ambisonics音频与同步360°视频配对，230段录音共10.5小时（平均164秒），覆盖语音为主的间歇性发声及笑声、拍手、脚步声；人工审核31,678个实例掩码，与声源身份及声事件标签关联。另提出基线：融合空间音频特征与视觉特征进行逐帧分割，并跨帧进行身份关联。
AI.result: 实验表明现有AVIS方法在长时、间歇发声场景下检测与身份关联表现较差；所提基线在检测和跨帧身份关联两方面均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 空间音频是解决并发/间歇声源视听实例分割的关键线索，AVPS-360提供了该类任务的可评测平台；但作为基准/数据集工作，方法贡献有限，属相关背景型资源。

title: MetaRefine: Score Refinement with Multi-Level Features for Image Assessment
summary: An image's original dimensions, aspect ratio, and composition provide important cues that can affect its technical and aesthetic quality. Image assessment methods use resizing, cropping, padding, or patch sampling to accommodate different input sizes. However, these operations can alter or obscure original geometric and compositional cues. Existing assessment models also encode rich multi-level visual evidence that can be further extracted and exploited to improve existing models. This motivates us to combine visual evidence with original-image geometry for score refinement without changing the original scoring pipelines. In this paper, we introduce MetaRefine, a metadata-aware score refinement architecture whose lightweight residual heads predict score corrections from geometry, multi-level visual features, and the frozen model's original score. Across 100 configurations on 21 datasets, MetaRefine improves PLCC in 88 configurations and SRCC in 85, with average relative gains of 7.55% and 7.10%, respectively. It reduces MAE in 90 configurations and RMSE in 89, with average relative reductions of 23.27% and 21.93%, respectively. The median parameter overhead is only 1.11%. MetaRefine can further improve state-of-the-art (SOTA) assessment models on multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MetaRefine：在不改动原有评分流水线的前提下，用元数据（原图尺寸/长宽比/构图）+ 冻结模型多层视觉特征 + 原分数，通过轻量残差头预测分数修正，实现图像质量/美学评估分数精修。
AI.motivation: 现有图像评估方法通过缩放、裁剪、padding、patch采样适配输入尺寸，会破坏原图几何与构图线索；同时现有模型编码的多层级视觉证据未被充分挖掘。作者希望不改变原评分流水线的条件下提升评分精度。
AI.method: MetaRefine：元数据感知的分数精修架构。输入包括原图几何元数据（尺寸、长宽比、构图）、冻结评估模型的multi-level视觉特征以及其原始分数；由轻量残差头（residual heads）回归分数修正量，对原分数做残差式精修。参数开销中位数仅1.11%。
AI.result: 在21个数据集、100种配置上：PLCC在88种配置提升、SRCC在85种提升，平均相对增益7.55%/7.10%；MAE在90种配置降低、RMSE在89种降低，平均相对降幅23.27%/21.93%；并可在多个基准上进一步提升SOTA评估模型。
AI.conclusion: 原图几何元数据+冻结模型多层视觉证据可作为低成本、即插即用的分数精修信号，显著改进现有IQA/美学评估模型而无需重训原流水线。

title: LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation
summary: We present LucidLyra, a framework that makes generatively reconstructed 3D scenes directly queryable for semantics and instances in a feed-forward manner from video latents. While generative 3D reconstruction can synthesize virtual environments from a single image, downstream applications in robotics and physical AI require not only visual realism but also access to scene semantics and object identities. Existing 3D understanding approaches, however, require captured multi-view scenes, have limited generalization capabilities, or rely on expensive per-scene processing and optimization. To bridge this gap, our method distills complementary knowledge from a camera-controlled video diffusion model and frozen 2D vision foundation models into a unified model to jointly infer 3D Gaussians encoding geometry, appearance, open-vocabulary semantics, and class-agnostic instance cues. The resulting scenes support novel-view rendering, open-vocabulary segmentation, and object grouping without per-scene optimization, while training requires neither manual 3D annotations nor captured multi-view data. Our method outperforms baselines combining state-of-the-art 3DGS segmentation approaches with generative 3D scene reconstruction on curated synthetic and real-image-conditioned benchmarks, while preserving reconstruction quality. Furthermore, our latent formulation naturally extends to monocular video, reconstructing structured dynamic 3D scenes across time. By turning renderable but unstructured outputs into queryable 3D worlds, LucidLyra enables downstream applications including 3D scene editing, 3D asset mining, and robotic simulation.

AI.tldr: LucidLyra 从视频潜变量出发，前馈式重建可直接查询语义与实例的三维高斯场景，免逐场景优化、免三维标注。
AI.motivation: 生成式三维重建虽能从单图合成虚拟环境，但机器人/物理AI下游需要场景语义与物体身份；现有三维理解方法依赖多视角采集、泛化差，或需昂贵的逐场景优化。
AI.method: 将相机可控视频扩散模型与冻结的二维视觉基础模型知识蒸馏进统一模型，联合推理编码几何、外观、开放词汇语义与类别无关实例线索的三维高斯；训练无需人工三维标注与多视角数据，可直接处理单目视频。
AI.result: 在合成与真实图像条件基准上，优于"SOTA 3DGS 分割 + 生成式三维重建"的组合基线，并保持重建质量；潜变量公式化自然扩展至单目视频，重建跨时间的结构化动态场景。
AI.conclusion: 把可渲染但无结构的三维输出转为可查询的三维世界，支持新视角渲染、开放词汇分割与物体分组，无需逐场景优化，服务三维编辑、资产挖掘与机器人仿真。

title: A Two-Wheeled Quadrotor with All-Clockwise Tilted Rotors for Level-Attitude Surface Locomotnion
summary: Conventional wheel-equipped quadrotor UAVs must tilt their bodies to generate lateral forces, limiting their ability to maintain a desired attitude during lateral motion. This paper proposes a wheeled quadrotor with all-clockwise tilted rotors that uses surface contact as a constraint to generate propulsion along the contact surface without tilting the vehicle. We analyze feasible forces and system controllability under surface contact and optimize the vehicle design considering different rotor-spin configurations. The optimization results show that a configuration in which all four rotors spin clockwise can generate a larger tangential force than the conventional alternating-spin configuration. This approach enables both aerial and contact-based locomotion without additional rotor-tilting actuators or mechanisms. Simulation results demonstrate both hovering in free space and horizontal locomotion on a floor while maintaining a level attitude.

AI.tldr: 提出全顺时针倾斜旋翼的轮式四旋翼，利用地面接触约束在不倾斜机身的条件下产生切向推力，通过接触受力与可控性分析优化旋翼转向配置，实现自由悬停与保持水平姿态的地面横向移动。
AI.motivation: 传统轮式四旋翼需倾斜机身产生侧向力，无法在横向运动时保持期望姿态；作者希望在无需额外旋翼倾转机构的前提下兼顾空中与接触式运动。
AI.method: 建模地面接触约束下的可行力集合与系统可控性，针对不同旋翼旋转配置进行设计优化；结论为四旋翼全部顺时针旋转时切向推力优于传统交替旋转配置。用仿真验证悬停与地面水平运动。
AI.result: 优化显示全顺时针配置可产生更大切向力；仿真中实现了自由空间悬停与在地面上保持水平姿态的横向移动。
AI.conclusion: 通过在接触状态下利用旋翼反扭矩/推力不对称产生的合力，可在不增加倾转执行器的情况下实现空中—地面双模态运动，但验证仅限仿真，缺乏实机实验。

title: CrossWeave: Cross-Modal Scene and Instance Retrieval from Sparse 2D-3D Alignment
summary: Cross-modal scene and instance retrieval aims to retrieve a corresponding 3D environment or object given query 2D images, serving as a foundational mechanism for spatial reasoning in robotics and AR/VR. Existing methods achieve this by learning alignment only at the level of whole scenes or objects, which provides no supervision for the fine-grained local structure within them. In this work, we show that supervision on a set of sparse 2D-3D correspondences, without scene- or instance-level contrastive objectives, is sufficient to train a single model for both scene- and instance-level retrieval. Specifically, we propose $\textbf{CrossWeave}$, a novel framework for cross-modal retrieval that learns sparse patch-point alignment, which alone outperforms existing methods. An optimal transport-based aggregator over the aligned features gives further gains by clustering structurally redundant regions, freeing descriptor capacity for semantically distinct local features. CrossWeave achieves state-of-the-art performance on both scene- and instance-level retrieval on ScanNet and 3RScan with a $\textit{single model}$, whereas existing methods require separate models for each task. Our results suggest that whole-scene encoding is unnecessary for cross-modal retrieval and that sparse local correspondence supervision is a more effective and flexible alternative.

AI.tldr: CrossWeave 仅在稀疏 2D-3D patch-点对应上做监督，即可训练单一模型同时完成跨模态场景级与实例级检索；配合基于最优传输的特征聚合器达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态检索方法只在整场景或整物体层面学习对齐，缺乏对内部细粒度局部结构的监督，且场景级与实例级需分别训练模型；作者希望验证是否可用稀疏局部对应替代整体的对比学习目标。
AI.method: 提出 CrossWeave 框架：以一组稀疏的 2D-3D 对应作为监督信号，学习 patch 与 3D 点之间的细粒度对齐；再在对齐特征上引入基于最优传输（OT）的聚合器，对结构冗余区域进行聚类，把描述子容量释放给语义上有区分度的局部特征；单一模型统一处理场景级与实例级检索。
AI.result: 在 ScanNet 与 3RScan 上，仅用稀疏 patch-点对齐即超过现有方法；加入 OT 聚合后进一步提升，单一模型在场景级与实例级检索上均取得 SOTA，而对比方法需为两类任务分别训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态检索不必然需要全场景编码，稀疏局部对应监督是一种更高效灵活的对齐范式，可作为机器人及 AR/VR 空间推理的基础模块；但验证仅限室内数据集，是否泛化到真实机器人闭环仍需考察。

title: PhysCount: Do MLLMs Count Visual Appearances or Physical Entities?
summary: Images reveal appearances, but counting often asks about physical objects. A single entity may be visible directly, in several reflections, or through glass, so detecting every visible occurrence does not determine how many entities are present. Existing visual counting benchmarks rarely separate these two operations. We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish what appears in an image from what physically exists in the scene. PhysCount contains 546 real-world images and 4,595 human-written questions organized into 651 target-specific groups. For each group, annotators locate the relevant appearances, label how each is observed, and identify appearances of the same entity. Four complementary question families test the enumeration of appearances, the enumeration of physical entities, image-formation-specific counting, and appearance--entity correspondence. We measure both accuracy on each family and the proportion of groups answered entirely correctly. Across 40 MLLMs, counting visible appearances is substantially easier than recovering the identities that connect them. Even the strongest model answers every question correctly in only 13.36\% of groups. Performance declines when one entity produces many appearances or when its appearances cross observation modes. Higher image resolution improves access to visual evidence but brings limited gains in complete-group accuracy, whereas answering related questions jointly produces a marked improvement. These results expose a gap between recognizing what is visible and correctly recovering the physical entities behind those observations.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhysCount 基准，区分"图像中可见的表象"与"物理上存在的实体"，用546张真实图像、4595个问题、651个目标组，从四种问题族评测40个MLLM的表象计数与实体复原能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉计数任务中，同一实体可能以直接可见、多重反射、隔玻璃等多种形式出现，因此"检测所有可见出现"并不等于"确定实体数目"。现有视觉计数基准几乎不区分这两种操作，也缺乏对观测模式（反射/玻璃/遮挡）如何影响实体同一性判断的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 PhysCount：546张真实图像、4595条人工标注问题、651个目标特定组。每组标注者定位相关表象、标注其观测方式、并识别哪些表象属于同一实体。设四类互补问题族：表象枚举、物理实体枚举、成像方式专属计数、表象—实体对应关系。评测指标为各族准确率及"整组全对"比例，覆盖40个MLLM，并分析实体表象数量、观测模式交叉、图像分辨率、联合作答等影响因素。
AI.result: 表象计数显著易于实体同一性复原；最强模型整组全对率仅13.36%。单一实体产生多个表象或表象跨越不同观测模式时性能下降；提高图像分辨率改善视觉证据获取但对整组全对率提升有限；对相关问题联合作答带来明显提升。
AI.conclusion: "看见什么"与"场景中存在什么"之间存在实质鸿沟，当前MLLM缺乏跨观测模式的实体同一性推理能力；该基准为物理世界理解中的计数与实体归纳提供了诊断工具。

title: BURGER: Benchmarking and Understanding Robotic Generalization via Embodied Drawing
summary: How effectively can vision-language-action (VLA) models learn diverse language-conditioned behaviors as training data scales? Investigating this question requires large and varied robot datasets, whose collection on physical robots remains costly. We introduce BURGER, a language-conditioned robotic drawing benchmark with a scalable, prompt-driven pipeline for generating continuous drawing trajectories, both in simulation and the real world. In BURGER, an agent starts from the same blank canvas and controls a robot arm to draw the object or spatial composition specified by language, while each instruction allows an open-ended variety of valid drawings and stroke orders. Using 28,200 simulated demonstrations spanning 282 drawing tasks, we evaluate five representative VLA models across data scales, language grounding, and multimodal behavior. BURGER supports fine-grained analysis of language grounding, spatial composition, and action generation, revealing distinct failure patterns across VLA models. Our experiments suggest that some VLA models can benefit from greater task diversity and demonstration scale, capture multimodal drawing behaviors, and generalize to unseen compositions of familiar objects. Finally, we deploy a trained policy on a Franka Panda arm, demonstrating the ability to draw reactively under human intervention. Project homepage and code can be found at this https URL .

AI.tldr: BURGER: 语言条件机器人绘画基准，用提示驱动流水线生成连续绘画轨迹（仿真+真机），28,200条演示/282任务，评测五个代表性VLA模型的数据规模、语言接地与多模态行为，并在Franka Panda上部署验证人机交互下的反应式绘画。
AI.motivation: VLA模型能否随数据规模学习多样化语言条件行为，需要大规模、多样化的机器人数据，而真机采集成本高；绘画任务天然具备开放式多解（多样有效轨迹与笔画顺序），适合检验语言接地与多模态行为。
AI.method: 构建可扩展的prompt驱动绘画轨迹生成流水线（仿真与真机一致），让智能体从同一空白画布出发按语言指令绘制物体或空间构图；在28,200条仿真演示、282个绘画任务上，跨数据规模、语言接地和多模态行为三个维度系统评测五种VLA模型，并做语言接地、空间构图、动作生成的细粒度分析；最后将训练策略部署于Franka Panda机械臂。
AI.result: 揭示不同VLA模型各具特征的失败模式；部分模型能从更高任务多样性与演示规模中获益，能捕捉多模态绘画行为，并可泛化到熟悉物体的未见组合；真机策略可在人类介入下反应式调整绘制。
AI.conclusion: BURGER提供了可扩展、低成本且具开放式多解的语言条件机器人基准，可作为VLA数据规模化与语言接地研究的诊断工具。

title: DAWN: Diffusion-based Alignment and unfastening Workflow Network
summary: We present DAWN (Diffusion-based Alignment and unfastening Workflow Network), a hierarchical robotic framework designed to perform real-world, unfastening tasks through multi-modal sensory integration. Autonomous robotic unfastening is crucial for improving recycling processes, enhancing safety, and reducing operational costs; yet, it remains predominantly manual due to inherent challenges in precise screwdriver engagement with fasteners, detailed force execution, and robustness to environmental variability. To address the complexity of learning long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation tasks, we subdivide the unfastening task procedure into two sequential stages: (1) alignment & insertion, and (2) unfastening. DAWN consists of three key components: AlignNet, a diffusion-based policy ensuring precise screwdriver tip engagement; LatchNet, a multi-modal classifier reliably detecting successful stage transitions; and UnfastNet, which achieves stable, force-controlled screw removal. Experimental validation on a Franka Emika robot demonstrates that DAWN achieves alignment & insertion success rates comparable to trained human operators, robustly transitions between stages, and attains an impressive success rate in unfastening across various unseen scenarios. Ablation studies further elucidate critical input modalities and effective training strategies, highlighting DAWN's scalability, robustness, and data efficiency.

AI.tldr: DAWN: 分层扩散策略框架（AlignNet 对齐插入 + LatchNet 多模态阶段切换分类 + UnfastNet 力控旋拧），实现真实机器人长时序接触丰富拆解任务。
AI.motivation: 拆解（unfastening）在回收、安全与成本场景中仍以人工为主，难点在于螺丝刀精确啮合、精细力控制以及对环境变化的鲁棒性；长时序接触丰富任务端到端学习困难。
AI.method: 将任务分解为“对齐&插入”与“旋拧”两阶段；AlignNet 用扩散策略实现刀尖精确啮合；LatchNet 为多模态分类器检测阶段切换成功；UnfastNet 做力控螺丝旋出。Franka Emika 实机验证，并做输入模态与训练策略消融。
AI.result: 对齐插入成功率与受训人类操作员相当；阶段切换鲁棒；在多种未见场景下旋拧成功率高；消融显示关键模态与训练策略的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 任务分层+扩散策略+多模态阶段判定是解决长时序接触丰富操作的有效范式，具备可扩展性、鲁棒性与数据效率。

title: PhysVLMM: Interaction-Conditioned Physical Belief Maps for Articulated Objects in Robot Scene Maps
summary: Mobile robots must open doors and drawers, yet their scene maps record what each object is and whether it has moved, not how it will respond to a pull. This paper proposes PhysVLMM, a method that maintains a physical belief for every articulated part of a Vision-Language-Motion Map and answers a planner's queries about it, with two algorithms: a map update and a query. Watching a part move provably cannot identify its dynamics, and a measured pull identifies only the pulled part, up to one direction. PhysVLMM therefore (i) keeps that direction as a posterior instead of a point estimate, (ii) passes the evidence of each pull in closed form to the untouched look-alike parts of the map, and (iii) answers whether an action will succeed at a stated risk, or abstains. On real doors and drawers in 18 homes, it identifies the joint type in 86% of held-out pulls (48% for a learned single-view method) and predicts the response to a pull with 41% lower error than differentiable simulation (CRPS 0.323 vs. 0.544), four orders of magnitude faster (13 ms vs. 230 s per case). The posterior lowers the final-position error from 0.460 to 0.270, sharing lowers the force error of untouched parts from 56% to 42%, and at every stated risk from 0.02 to 0.30 the false-safe answers stay within it. Pooling all measured parts of a home does as well as the look-alike groups, and simpler variants predict where a pulled part stops at least as well.

AI.tldr: PhysVLMM为视觉-语言-运动地图（VLMotion Map）中的每个铰接部件维护物理后验信念（而非点估计），提出地图更新与查询两个算法：闭式地把每次拉拽证据传播给未被触碰的相似部件，并以给定风险水平回答动作是否成功或弃答。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人场景地图只记录物体是什么、是否移动，不记录它对"拉拽"将如何响应；而单目观察运动在理论上无法辨识动力学，实测拉拽也只能辨识被拉部件的至多一个方向。
AI.method: (i) 将关节方向保留为后验分布而非点估计；(ii) 以闭式方式把每次拉拽证据传播到地图中未被操作的相似外观部件；(iii) 支持带风险阈值的成功性查询与弃答；结合关节类型分类与响应预测（对比可微仿真）。
AI.result: 18个真实家庭的真实门窗抽屉上，关节类型识别在留出拉拽中达86%（单视图学习方法48%）；响应预测CRPS 0.323，比可微仿真低41%误差且快约4个数量级（13 ms vs 230 s）；后验使末端位置误差0.460→0.270，证据共享使未触部件力误差56%→42%；风险0.02–0.30区间内误判安全率均低于阈值。
AI.conclusion: 通过概率化物理信念与跨物体证据共享，移动操作机器人无需逐一试错即可获得可校准的铰接物体交互预测，且能给出风险约束下的可靠弃答。

title: A Tutorial on Shape Servoing of Deformable Objects-Part I: Fundamentals
comment: Part I of a two-part tutorial. 9 pages, 5 figures. Code: this https URL . Interactive demos: this https URL
summary: In robotics, shape control (or shape servoing) refers to the automatic manipulation of a deformable object to achieve a desired shape. It involves a feedback loop that exploits the relation between robot motion and changes in the measured shape. This relation, known as the interaction Jacobian or, in this context, the deformation Jacobian, depends on the object's mechanical properties, geometry, and boundary conditions (e.g., where the object is grasped). Because these factors are often difficult to model accurately, the deformation Jacobian can be estimated locally from observed shape changes produced by commanded robot motions, without requiring a fine-tuned mechanical model. This article is the first of a two-part tutorial on data-driven Jacobian-based shape control of deformable objects. It introduces the central elements of the approach: the formulation of the shape-control problem, shape representation, estimation and online update of the deformation Jacobian, and a standard control law from the literature. It then assembles these elements into a complete shape-servoing loop, derives a local stability condition for this loop, and illustrates why some target shapes cannot be reached. Part II covers more advanced topics. Throughout both parts, a simulated planar example in which two robot arms manipulate an elastic rod observed by a camera illustrates the concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文是数据驱动变形雅可比形状伺服（shape servoing）两篇教程的第一部分，系统梳理形状控制问题建模、形状表示、变形雅可比估计与在线更新、标准控制律、完整闭环及局部稳定性条件，并说明部分目标形状不可达的原因。
AI.motivation: 变形物体的形状控制依赖形变雅可比，而该雅可比由物体力学属性、几何形状与边界条件（如抓取位置）共同决定，精确建模困难。因此需要一套无需精细力学模型、可从实测形状变化中在线估计雅可比的数据驱动框架。
AI.method: 教程形式：将形状控制问题形式化，定义形状表示；基于指令机器人运动与观测到的形状变化，对形变雅可比进行局部估计与在线更新；结合文献中的标准控制律组装完整形状伺服闭环；推导该闭环的局部稳定性条件，并分析目标形状不可达的机理。全程以双臂机器人操作弹性杆并由相机观测的仿真平面算例贯穿说明。
AI.result: 给出完整的、可复现的形状伺服框架要素与稳定性分析结论，并显式刻画了雅可比估计误差与不可达目标形状对系统行为的限制。文中未报告实机实验或定量性能数据，仅以仿真算例验证概念。
AI.conclusion: 该文构建了数据驱动雅可比形状控制的基础教学与理论框架，为后续进阶主题（第二部分）奠定基础；其价值在于方法论梳理与稳定性分析，而非新的实验验证。

title: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
summary: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena. The core bottleneck is that creating better simulations requires significant expert effort and therefore does not scale. To address this, we introduce Gym-Anything for Robotics, a framework in which coding agents create realistic robotics simulations. Our core insight is that simulation creation is a coding agent task, so improvements in coding agents translate directly into richer and more faithful simulations. We select simulations based on U.S. GDP data to cover economically valuable physical work, define what makes a good simulation and a good task, and develop an adversarial creation-audit loop that checks each simulation and task against these definitions. Using this pipeline, we build RoboWorld, a set of 25 simulations with 25 test and 175 training RL environments of varying difficulty. Even the best frontier models fail on every RoboWorld test task, achieving an average reward of only 0.06. Building on RoboWorld, we introduce several new ways for frontier models to improve, including in-context learning across repeated attempts, a privileged teacher that reads the simulator state and teaches a student in context, self-assisted learning from the model's own privileged experience, and code policies that generate demonstrations across varied scenes to train vision-language-action models (VLAs) such as $\pi_{0.5}$. Each of these substantially improves performance. We release our pipeline, RL environments, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Code and data are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 Gym-Anything for Robotics 框架，用编码智能体自动构建机器人仿真，并基于美国GDP数据选取任务，构建 25 个仿真、25 个测试与 175 个训练 RL 环境（RoboWorld）；前沿模型在测试任务上平均奖励仅 0.06，并给出多种提升路径（上下文学习、特权教师蒸馏、自辅助学习、代码策略生成示范训练 VLA）。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人仿真仅覆盖有限的任务与物理现象，扩展仿真覆盖范围依赖大量专家人工投入，无法规模化，成为 embodied AI 大规模训练与 sim-to-real 迁移的瓶颈。
AI.method: 以"仿真创建即编码智能体任务"为核心洞察，构建 agent 自动生成仿真的 pipeline；依据 U.S. GDP 数据选择覆盖经济价值物理劳动的任务；明确定义"好仿真/好任务"标准，并设计对抗式 creation-audit 循环逐一校验；在此基础上产出 RoboWorld（25 个仿真、25 个测试环境、175 个训练 RL 环境，难度分层），并探索 in-context 重试学习、读取仿真器状态的特权教师蒸馏、模型自身特权经验自辅助学习、以及代码策略跨场景生成示范以训练 π0.5 等 VLA。
AI.result: 最强前沿模型在所有 RoboWorld 测试任务上均失败，平均奖励仅 0.06；所提出的四类改进手段（重复尝试的上下文学习、特权教师上下文教学、自辅助学习、代码策略示范增强 VLA）均带来显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将仿真构建形式化为编码智能体任务可使仿真覆盖随编码能力提升而自然扩展，RoboWorld 提供了高难度基准；但主要贡献在数据/基准与训练范式层面，物理保真度与 sim-to-real 迁移尚未以真机证据验证。

title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
summary: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.

AI.tldr: VeriCUA: 提出平台无关的智能体验证框架，将任务完成验证视为"动态证据收集+评估"过程，先据上下文构建任务rubric，再对未满足需求选择GUI或代码检查，并按显式证据规则合成结论，统一支持在线/离线、跨平台与多模态观测。
AI.motivation: 构建与扩展桌面/移动/Web的计算机使用智能体（CUA）需要可靠的任务完成验证，用于数据筛选、评测与强化学习。现有做法（VLM直接判轨迹、生成程序检查应用状态）都只依赖局部视图：VLM受限于给定观测，生成程序受限于可访问状态，可能缺失决定性证据；且为不同平台/权限组合分别定制验证器会带来额外工程成本。
AI.method: 将验证重构为共享流程内的动态证据采集与判定：1）先检视已有上下文，构建任务rubric（分解需求项）；2）对未解决的需求项自适应选择GUI级检查或代码级检查；3）依据显式证据规则融合多来源证据并给出完成判定；同一流程同时覆盖在线与离线场景、不同平台与观测模态，实现平台无关。
AI.result: 在多种设置下与参考标签的一致性优于对比基线；离线设置在困难样本上提升最大，在线设置对虚假完成声明的拒绝能力更强；分析表明收益来源于GUI与代码证据的互补性以及测试时探索。
AI.conclusion: 验证应被视为主动的证据获取过程而非单次视图判断；rubric驱动+双模态（GUI/代码）证据+显式证据规则可在统一框架下提升跨平台CUA验证的准确性与鲁棒性。

title: RADIOlogy: A Single-Pass Approach to Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Code available at this https URL
summary: Current zero-shot anomaly detection methods often rely on complex prompt-learning techniques or computationally expensive sliding-window strategies to achieve fine-grained visual alignment to detect small-scale anomalies. This reliance stems from the fundamental limitation of standard CLIP architectures, where [CLS] token attention and spatial patch pooling struggle to capture subtle, localized anomaly features. While prompt-learning approaches aim to bridge this gap, they typically require a large number of ground-truth segmentation masks from auxiliary datasets, which are often unavailable in specialized domains. In this work, we show an emerging property of multi-head attention pooling in vision-language models: remarkable zero-shot anomaly localization and detection right out of the box. We translate this property into a single-pass anomaly detection technique, RADIOlogy, that does not require dense, windowed execution and significantly outperforms other training-free baselines. Instead, the method relies on a simple contrastive scoring approach that compares the average similarity between vision features and a suite of normal and abnormal prompts. Furthermore, we leverage the agglomerative features of RADIO models to enhance pixel-level anomaly segmentation using a dense anomaly refinement pipeline. Finally, we show how the vision-language family of training-free zero-shot anomaly detection techniques can be applied successfully to the medical domain with minimal modifications. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 利用多模态模型中多头注意力池化自带的零样本异常定位能力，提出单次前向的免训练异常检测方法RADIOlogy，通过正常/异常提示的平均相似度对比评分，并用RADIO的聚合特征做稠密异常细化，无需滑窗密集执行即可显著超越其他免训练基线。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本异常检测方法依赖复杂提示学习或计算昂贵的滑窗策略来捕捉小尺度异常，根源在于标准CLIP的[CLS]注意力与空间patch池化难以捕获细粒度局部异常；而提示学习方法又需要大量辅助数据集的真实分割掩码，在专业领域（如医学）通常不可得。
AI.method: 发现多模态视觉语言模型中的多头注意力池化本身具备开箱即用的零样本异常定位与检测能力；据此设计单次前向（single-pass）检测流程：将视觉特征与一组正常/异常提示的平均相似度做对比打分；再利用RADIO模型的聚合特征，通过稠密异常细化管线提升像素级异常分割；整套免训练范式以极少改动迁移到医学领域。
AI.result: 在免训练设定下显著优于其他training-free基线，不需要密集滑窗执行即可实现细粒度异常检测与定位，并验证了该视觉语言免训练零样本异常检测族在医学域的可迁移性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多头注意力池化提供了一种简洁高效的免训练零样本异常检测/分割途径，提示对比打分+稠密细化的组合可替代提示学习与滑窗策略；但工作聚焦医学异常检测，缺少在机器人操作、具身感知等核心场景中的验证。

title: Beyond Ground Truth: A Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance Engine for Diagnosing Calibrational Blindness in Dental Segmentation
comment: Accepted at 11th IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Computer Science and Data Engineering (IEEE CSDE 2026), Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh. Copyright 2026 IEEE. 5 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: In real-world clinical settings, dental X-ray segmentation using deep learning methods suffers from reliability issues. Even when the segmentation quality is bad, deep learning models show high confidence in their predictions (calibrational blindness). Moreover, in real use, doctors do not have ground-truth masks to check their accuracy. To address this problem, we introduce a simple quality-checking engine called HUS-QA with three stages. We train it on the PRAD (Periapical Dental X-ray) dataset to build our SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 U-Net model, which generates the segmentation mask and then evaluates its quality. Our HUS-QA checks the segmentation mask quality without a ground-truth mask. Prediction confidence, edge sharpness, shape connectivity, and area-size penalty are the simple indicators considered in this research. Results show that standard confidence methods fail (r = -0.1394, p = 1.7864e-3, ROC AUC = 0.4275). By contrast, our HUS-QA shows a positive correlation with actual Dice scores (r = 0.4647, p = 3.7510e-28) and achieves a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405. Therefore, HUS-QA serves as a practical tool for clinical quality control.

AI.tldr: 提出 HUS-QA 三阶段质量检查引擎，在无 GT 掩码条件下利用预测置信度、边缘锐度、形状连通性与面积惩罚等简单指标评估牙科 X 光分割质量。
AI.motivation: 真实临床中分割模型存在"校准盲区"：分割质量差时仍给出高置信度，且医生无 GT 掩码可核对，导致可靠性不足。
AI.method: PRAD 数据集上训练 SimCLR 自监督 ResNet-18 U-Net 生成掩码；HUS-QA 以四个手工指标（置信度、边缘锐度、形状连通性、面积大小惩罚）做无参考质量评估。
AI.result: 标准置信度方法失效（r=-0.1394, ROC AUC=0.4275）；HUS-QA 与真实 Dice 正相关（r=0.4647, p=3.75e-28），ROC-AUC 达 0.8405。
AI.conclusion: HUS-QA 可作为实用临床质量控制工具，但指标为手工设计、面向特定医学影像任务，尚未验证跨任务/跨模态泛化。

title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
summary: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. Observing that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, we propose HairDeck, which generates it as one: each card is a single token, and a set diffusion transformer denoises all cards together. From a single image, HairDeck generates the cards and the spring-bone chains that drive them, yielding an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats. On CHARM's own test set, it lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster, and from single images it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand-based methods. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: HairDeck 将风格化发卡发型（hair cards）视为无序基元集合，用 set diffusion transformer 以单卡单 token 的方式并行去噪生成，并由单图同时输出驱动用的 spring-bone 链，得到可动画资产。
AI.motivation: 游戏/虚拟形象的发型由艺术家布置的发卡缎带构成，用 spring bones 驱动动画。现有图像方法产出写实头发或单一融合网格；唯一生成风格化发卡的 CHARM 将发型自回归解码为长控制点序列，序列长、推理慢且未显式建模发卡的无序集合特性。
AI.method: 把发型表示成无序集：每张发卡编码为一个 token，采用 set diffusion transformer 对所有发卡联合去噪。从单张图像条件生成发卡几何，同时回归 spring-bone 链以支持动画，并导出到下游可用格式。
AI.result: 在 CHARM 自建测试集上，Chamfer 距离降低 44%，发卡朝向误差降低一半以上，推理速度提升 33 倍；单图输入下优于 CHARM、image-to-3D 管线与基于发丝（strand-based）的方法。
AI.conclusion: 以集合扩散替代自回归序列解码是风格化发卡生成的有效范式，兼具精度与效率，并直接产出可动画、可导出的资产；主要证据限于合成/风格化发型基准，缺少真实资产制作流程的系统性评估。

title: A Conveyor Belt Mechanism for Repositionable Magnetic Coupling Between Continuum Robots
summary: This work proposes a novel conveyor belt mechanism enabling continuous, active repositioning of functional elements along the body of a tendon-driven continuum robot. Up to three conveyor belt mechanisms are integrated within a 9 mm diameter continuum robot. We demonstrate equivalent or reduced conveyor belt actuation forces compared to robot tendon actuation forces. As a case study, we mount permanent magnets along two conveyor belts, and demonstrate actively reconfigurable inter-robot coupling. Coupling point location and quantity can be adjusted during robot operation to actively tune the effective stiffness of the coupled multi-robot system. We show that effective stiffness follows a predictable inverse-cubic relationship with coupling location, and increases with the number of coupling points. These findings demonstrate that the conveyor belt mechanism enables active functional element repositioning for changing tasks requirements, with magnetic inter-robot coupling as one proof-of-concept.

AI.tldr: 提出可集成于9mm腱驱动连续体机器人内的传送带机构，实现功能元件沿机器人本体的连续主动重定位，并以磁体沿带布置演示可重构的机器人间耦合与刚度调节
AI.motivation: 连续体机器人功能元件（如磁性耦合点、传感器）通常固定于本体特定位置，无法在任务进行中调整，限制了面向变化任务需求的适应性
AI.method: 在9 mm直径连续体机器人中集成最多3条传送带机构，由腱驱动；对比传送带驱动力与腱驱动力；案例研究：沿两条传送带布置永磁体，运行中调整耦合点位置与数量，测量耦合多机器人系统的有效刚度
AI.result: 传送带驱动所需力不高于（部分情况下低于）机器人腱驱动力的等效水平；有效刚度与耦合位置呈可预测的三次反比关系，并随耦合点数量增加而提高，未披露绝对误差或定量标定细节
AI.conclusion: 传送带机构可作为功能元件主动重定位的通用载体，磁耦合仅是概念验证之一，为按需变刚度、可重构多机器人系统提供硬件途径

title: Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies
summary: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules. We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), which separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering. An executable engine maintains state and resolves interactions. A deterministic compiler encodes these outcomes and attempted actions in a spatially and temporally aligned interaction proxy. The proxy aligns action and skill windows, brief hit reactions, and persistent health by fighter identity and timing. These cues can be controlled separately to render interactions under modified rules. Identity-bound references preserve character appearance across side switches. We train FWM on FightWorld Corpus, spanning 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond the native game. It also allows character and arena customization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FWM, which outperforms existing game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, health-state consistency, and character appearance preservation. Our project is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: FWM 将格斗游戏的规则执行（可执行引擎）与视频渲染解耦，用确定性编译器把状态结果编码成时空对齐的交互代理，渲染器无需重训即可支持伤害缩放、限伤免疫、吸血、多段技能等规则修改，并保持角色外观一致。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型能生成看似合理的战斗画面，但受击反应与血量更新难以与游戏规则保持一致，缺乏可玩、可编程所需的状态持久性与可执行规则约束。
AI.method: 提出 Fight World Model（FWM）：1) 可执行引擎维护状态并判定交互；2) 确定性编译器将判定结果与意图动作编码为空间-时间对齐的交互代理（interaction proxy），按战斗者身份与时序对齐动作/技能窗口、短促受击反应与持续血量；3) 这些线索可单独调控以在修改规则下渲染；4) 身份绑定参考保持换边后的角色外观；5) 在 FightWorld Corpus（52 种技能特效、187 种角色外观变体、15 个竞技场）上训练。
AI.result: 在无需重训渲染器的情况下支持伤害缩放、限次命中免疫、吸血与超出原游戏的多段技能机制，并支持角色与竞技场定制；在动作保真度、受击反应、血量状态一致性、角色外观保持方面优于现有游戏世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 将规则执行与渲染分离的交互代理范式可提升游戏世界模型的可控性与状态一致性，为可编程、可玩的世界模型提供可行路径。

title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
summary: Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introduce a Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) that combines the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction with a compact, rapidly renderable scene representation. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World, in which a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer (DiT) alternate autoregressively to generate spatially consistent worlds. The memory updater spawns Gaussians in newly observed regions and refines existing ones, so that the memory grows with scene extent rather than stream length. Each Gaussian further stores a VAE latent feature, allowing the memory to be rendered directly into the DiT's latent space without VAE re-encoding. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to $38.6\times$ fewer 3D primitives, $3.2\times$ faster memory updates, and $359\times$ faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G)与L3G-World框架，用隐空间3D高斯记忆配合视频DiT自回归交替生成，实现实时、长时程空间一致的交互式世界模型。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需在长时程探索中保持空间一致性并实时生成。现有方法要么依赖时序上下文，要么依赖显式3D记忆，前者内存随流长度线性增长，后者通过重编码RGB渲染结果来条件化隐空间视频生成器，无法实时运行。
AI.method: 构造紧凑的Latent 3D Gaussian Memory：每个高斯存储VAE隐特征，可直接渲染到DiT的隐空间而无需VAE重编码；记忆更新器（在新观测区域生成高斯、精修已有高斯）与视频DiT自回归交替，使记忆随场景范围而非流长度增长。
AI.result: 取得SOTA生成质量与长时程空间一致性；相比最高效的先验3D记忆基线，3D基元最多少38.6×、记忆更新快3.2×、记忆渲染快359×，实现9 FPS实时世界生成。
AI.conclusion: 以隐空间可渲染高斯记忆替代随流长度膨胀的上下文/显式3D记忆，是兼顾实时性、长时程一致性与紧凑性的有效世界模型方案，为具身仿真与交互式生成提供可落地的记忆接口。
